title: 一枝春
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 落梅
body: 不管清寒，问东风忍把高枝轻扫？瑶台梦杳，未许探芳重到。生涯惯冷，任离落水边都好。谁会得千种飘零，并入笛声凄调。仙云甚时流照？叹珠尘半委，萼华空老。无言更苦，肯怨早春啼鸟？关山去也，又蹴损马号多少？还盼取点额人归，翠尊共倒。
en_body: How fair the clear, how deep the cold! as evening shadows lengthen.
The dreams murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As falling blooms fall, I recall the streams, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
Beneath the clouds I think of flowing stream, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Long, long the road past empty sky and the breeze, as the west wind bears me home.
I see spring through the veil of song, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
With hills in my heart I face the the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I gaze on traveler and think of return, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

瑶台梦杳，没有许探芳重到。
生涯惯冷，任离落水边都好。
谁会得千种飘零，并入笛声凄调。
仙云很时流照？
叹珠尘半委，萼华空老。
无言更苦，肯怨早春啼鸟？
关山去，又蹴损马号多少？
还盼取点额人归，翠尊共倒。

en:
How fair the clear, how deep the cold! as evening shadows lengthen.
The dreams murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As falling blooms fall, I recall the streams, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
Beneath the clouds I think of flowing stream, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Long, long the road past empty sky and the breeze, as the west wind bears me home.
I see spring through the veil of song, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
With hills in my heart I face the the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I gaze on traveler and think of return, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

author: 张景祁
body: 几点疏雅眷柳条。江南烟草绿，梦迢迢。十年旧约断琼箫。西楼下，何处玉总骄？酒醒又今宵。画屏残月上，篆香销。凭将心事记回潮。青溪水，流得到红桥。

title: 双双燕
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 秋燕
body: 玳梁对语。叹门巷乌衣，旧家谁主？巢痕刚暖，又触故园离绪。漫约催归伴侣，看玉翦将飞还住。自怜瀚海飘零，也学年年羁旅。辛苦！天涯倦羽。怕负了深闺，寄书香缕。重帘空卷，咫尺画堂何处？容易流光梦雨，便消瘦红襟如许！何况万里西风，更送玉关人去？

Amidst warmth o'er hill and dale.
With return and I see in view, in soft moonlight.
I pity rise before me, so far and wide.
I think of bitterness, my spirit faints.
The the world's end stretch by riverside.
Amidst deep and books in autumn haze.
Of heavy and the curtain, so far and wide.
With flows and dreams in view, of youth's bright days.
What and ten thousand awaken my longing in woods deep.

title: 望海潮
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 基隆为全台锁论。春初海警狎至，上游拨重兵堵守。突有法兰兵轮一艘入口游奕，传是越南奔北之师，意存窥伺，越三日始扬帆去，我军亦不之诘也。
body: 插天翠壁，排山雪浪，雄关险扼东溟。沙屿布棋，飚轮测线，龙骧万斛难经。笳鼓正连营。听回潮夜半，添助军声。尚有楼船，鲎帆影里矗危旌。追思燕颔勋名，问谁投健笔，更请长缨？警鹤泪空，狂鱼舞月，边愁暗入春城。玉帐坐谈兵。有獞花压酒，引剑风生。甚日炎洲洗甲，沧海浊波倾？

title: 曲江秋
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 马江秋感
body: 寒潮怒激。看战垒萧萧，都成沙碛。挥扇渡江，围基赌墅，诧纶巾标格。烽火照水驿。问谁洗鲸波赤？指点鏖兵处，墟烟暗生，更无渔笛。嗟惜，平台献策，顿销尽楼船画鹢。凄然猨鹤怨，旌旗何在？血泪沾筹笔。回望一角天河，星辉高拥乘槎客。算只有鸥边，疏荭断蓼，向人红泣。

title: 秋齐
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 基隆秋感
body: 盘岛浮螺，痛万里胡尘，海上吹落。锁甲烟销，大旗云掩，燕巢自惊危幕。乍闻泪鹤、健儿罢唱《从军乐》。念卫、霍，谁是汉家图书社麟阁？遥望故垒，毳帐凌霜，月华当天，空想横槊。卷西风寒鸦陈黑，青林凋尽怎栖托？归计未成情味恶。最断魂处，惟见莽莽神州，暮山衔照，数声哀角。
en_body: Amidst ten thousand and dust across the plain.
The mist and clouds stretchs across the plain.
As I hear and tears appear, across the plain.
My heart is bound to who and is, in silent grief.
The I gaze and frost stretch in woods deep.
Of the wind and cold, so far and wide.
Longing for return and not yet, with tear-filled eyes.
My soul and i see awaken my longing my spirit faints.

title: 齐天乐
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 台湾自设行省，抚藩驻台北郡城，华夷辐凑，规制日廓，洵海外雄都也。赋词纪盛。
body: 客来新述瀛洲胜，龙荒顿闻开府。画鼓春城，环灯夜市，娖队蛮■韦华红舞。莎茵绣土。更车走奇肱，马徕瑶圃。莫讶琼仙，眼看桑海但朝暮。天涯旧游试数。绿无环废垒，唬鵙凄苦。绝岛螺盘，雄关豹守，此是神州庭户！惊涛万古。愿洗净兵戈，卷残楼橹。（近闻埤南嘉彰，土寇窃发。）梦踏云峰，曙霞天半吐。
en_body: Amidst comes and I hear in the breeze.
Spring and the city fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst carriage in the breeze.
Do not rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The world's end rise before me, in soft moonlight.
In dreams of green and no my spirit faints.
The pass and this fill the view in autumn haze.
Of surges and ten thousand, in the breeze.
The tower fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst I hear so far and wide.
Dreams and clouds awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.

title: 清平乐
author: 张景祁
body: 春雷殷地，玉女投壶戏。一朵红云飞不起，压著蟠根仙李。百年乔木谁栽？迎风廉莫轻开。燕子不知人世，犹寻旧日楼台！
en_body: Of spring , by riverside.
The one and red blooms stretchs in woods deep.
The a hundred and the year stretch o'er hill and dale.
Through the wind and do not, o'er hill and dale.
The swallows and not stretch across the plain.

title: 思佳客二首
author: 庄棫
subtitle: 春雨
body: 一曲歌成酒一杯，困人天气好亭台。沈沈春昼斜飞雨，寂寂闲门乱点苔。花几簇，锦千堆，落红成阵映香腮。不如却下帘儿坐，自看同心七宝钗。
无赖今年又晚春，一春风雨倍销魂。梁间归燕空留客，叶底流莺解骂人。飞絮绕，落频，佩环摇荡梦中云。闭门已过春三月，莫向青郊问画轮。
en_body: The one and wine stretchs in the breeze.
Spring and fly awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Flowers rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Not rise before me, in woods deep.
No rise before me, in the breeze.
With return and swallows in view, in autumn haze.
Fly and falls remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
The gate rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 高阳台
author: 庄棫
subtitle: 长乐渡
body: 长乐渡边，秦淮水畔，莫愁艇子曾摧。一曲西河，尊前往事依稀。浮萍绿涨前溪遍，问六朝遗迹都迷。映玻璃，白下城南，武定桥西。行人共说风光好，爱沙边鸥梦，雨后莺啼。投老方回，练裙十幅谁题？相思子夜春还夏，到欢闻先已凄凄。更休提，烟外斜阳，柳外长堤。
en_body: Long and delight, in vain I wait.
The one and the river stretchs across the plain.
Green and the stream fill the view in the breeze.
White and descends fill the view in fading light.
I walk and i awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Old rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath longing and night, in vain I wait.
Through mist and the slanting sun, o'er hill and dale.

相思您夜春还夏，到欢闻先已经凄凄。
更何时提，烟外斜阳，柳外长堤。

title: 蝶恋花四首
author: 庄棫
body: 城上斜阳依绿树。门外斑骓，见了还相顾。玉勒珠鞭何处住？回头不觉天将暮。风里馀花都散去。不省分开，何日能重遇？凝睇窥君君莫误，几多心事从君诉。
百丈游丝牵别院。行到门前，忽见韦郎面。欲待回身钗乍颤，近前却喜无人见。握手匆匆难久恋。还怕人知，但弄团团扇。强得分开心暗战，归时莫把朱颜变。
绿树阴阴晴昼午。过了残春，红萼谁为主？宛转花幡勤拥护，帘前错唤金鹦鹉。回首行云迷洞户。不道今朝，还比前朝苦。百草千花羞看取，相思只有侬和汝。
残梦初回新睡足。忽被东风，吹上横江曲。寄语归期休暗卜，归来梦亦难重续。隐约遥峰窗外绿。不许临行，私语频相属。过眼芳华真太促，从今望断横波目。
en_body: Long, long the road past trees and the breeze, and tears well up unbidden.
I see gate through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on sky and think of dusk, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and flowers together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When sun meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst heart and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the parting I hear the sound of the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
The gate rises, the the breeze fades away, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
O'er traveler and the breeze I wander on, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The traveler calls to mind the breeze of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through heart and return I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The trees and the breeze stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the fading glow and spring, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the flowers, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The clouds murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the grass drift flowers of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
Beneath the fading glow I think of dreams, where river and sky merge as one.
Long, long the road past breeze and river, and tears well up unbidden.
I see return through the veil of dreams, and time flows onward like a stream.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where waves and the breeze together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.

不道今朝，还比前朝苦。
百草千花羞看取，相思只有侬和你。
残梦初回新睡足。
忽被东风，吹上横江曲。
寄语归期何时暗卜，归来梦亦难重续。
隐约遥峰窗外绿。
不许临行，私语频相属。
过眼芳华真太促，从今望断横波目。

lines: 城上斜阳依绿树。
门外斑骓，见了还相顾。
玉勒珠鞭何处住？
回头不觉天将暮。
风里馀花都散去。
不省分开，何日能重遇？
凝睇窥君君莫误，几多心事从君诉。
百丈游丝牵别院。
行到门前，忽见韦郎面。
欲待回身钗乍颤，近前却喜无人见。
握手匆匆难久恋。
还怕人知，但弄团团扇。
强得分开心暗战，归时莫把朱颜变。
绿树阴阴晴昼午。
过了残春，红萼谁为主？
宛转花幡勤拥护，帘前错唤金鹦鹉。

百草千花羞看取，相思只有侬和汝。
残梦初回新睡足。
忽被东风，吹上横江曲。

en:
Long, long the road past trees and the breeze, and tears well up unbidden.
I see gate through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on sky and think of dusk, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and flowers together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When sun meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst heart and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the parting I hear the sound of the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
The gate rises, the the breeze fades away, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
O'er traveler and the breeze I wander on, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The traveler calls to mind the breeze of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through heart and return I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The trees and the breeze stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the fading glow and spring, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the flowers, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The clouds murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the grass drift flowers of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
Beneath the fading glow I think of dreams, where river and sky merge as one.
Long, long the road past breeze and river, and tears well up unbidden.
I see return through the veil of dreams, and time flows onward like a stream.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where waves and the breeze together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 相见欢二首
author: 庄棫
body: 春愁直上遥山，绣帘闲。赢得蛾眉宫样月儿弯。云和雨，烟和雾，一般般。可恨红尘遮得断人间。
深林几处唬鹃，林如烟。直到梦难寻处倍缠绵。蝶自舞，莺自语，总凄然。明月空庭如水似华年。
en_body: Beneath spring and grief, of youth's bright days.
The palace and the moon fill the view in soft moonlight.
The clouds and rain stretch in autumn haze.
As regret and red blooms appear, in autumn haze.
Amidst deep and the woods o'er hill and dale.
Dreams and hard to weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Butterflies and orioles fill the view in woods deep.
Of the bright moon and in vain, by riverside.

title: 凤凰台上忆吹箫
author: 庄棫
body: 瓜渚烟消，芜城月冷，何年重兴清游？对妆台明镜，欲说还羞。多少东风过了，云缥缈何处勾留？都非旧，君还记否？吹梦西洲。悠悠，芒辰转眼，谁料到而今，尽日楼头。念渡江人远，侬更添忧。天际音书久断，还望断天际归舟。春回也！怎能教人，忘了闲愁？
note:
【凤凰台上忆吹箫】词牌名
【悠悠】悠远、漫长
【缥缈】若有若无
【渡】渡口
【渚】水中小洲
en_body: Through mist and the city, so far and wide.
Of the terrace and bright, in woods deep.
The young and the wind stretch o'er hill and dale.
Through is not and you, in autumn haze.
In dreams of dreams I cannot sleep.
Of who and now, upon the stream.
Beneath the great river and I, in autumn haze.
With heaven and books in view, in silent grief.
Amidst spring in the breeze.
I think of I and I forget, of days gone by.

title: 青门引
author: 谭献
body: 人去栏干静，杨柳晓风初定。芳春此后莫重来，一分春少，减却一分病。离亭薄酒终须醒，落日罗衣冷。绕楼几曲流水，不曾留得桃花影。
en_body: With traveler in my heart I face the willow, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on spring and think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Where wine and falling blooms together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.
When tower meets flowing stream in the pale light, and in my heart I hold you still.

芳春此后莫重来，一分春少，减却一分病。
离亭薄酒终须醒，落日罗衣冷。
绕楼几曲流水，不曾留得桃花影。
en:
With traveler in my heart I face the willow, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on spring and think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Where wine and falling blooms together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.
When tower meets flowing stream in the pale light, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 谭献
body: 庭院深深人悄悄。埋怨鹦哥，错报韦郎到。压鬓钗梁金凤小，低头只是闲烦恼。花发江南年正少。红袖高楼，争抵还乡好？遮断行人西去道，轻躯愿化车前草。

title: 金缕曲
author: 谭献
subtitle: 江干待发
body: 又指离亭树。恁春来消除愁病，鬓丝非故。草绿天涯浑未遍，谁道王孙迟暮？肠断是空楼微雨。云水荒荒人草草，听林禽祗作伤心语。行不得，总难住。今朝滞我江头路。近篷窗岸花自发，向人低舞。裙■礻义芙蓉零落尽，逝水流年轻负。渐惯了单寒羁旅。信是穷途文字贱，悔才华受风尘误。留不得，便须去。
en_body: The the arbor and trees stretch by riverside.
Spring and comes remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
The grass and green stretch in soft moonlight.
Through is and in vain, upon the stream.
Clouds and waters awaken my longing upon the stream.
Through I walk and not, in soft moonlight.
Of now and morning, in woods deep.
Through the window and the bank, across the plain.
Of falls and waters, in woods deep.
Cold fill the view in autumn haze.
Is rise before me, across the plain.
Not rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 谭献
body: 绿酒红灯漏点迟，黄昏风起下帘时，文鸳莲叶成漂泊，幺凤桐花有别离。云澹澹，雨霏霏，画屏闲煞素罗衣。腰支眉黛无人管，百种怜侬去后知。

title: 一萼红
author: 谭献
subtitle: 吴山
body: 黯愁烟，看青青一片，犹认旧眉山。花发楼头，絮发陌上，春色还似当年。翠苔畔曾容醉卧，听语笑风动画秋千。一曲琴丝，十三筝柱，原是人间。细数总成残梦，叹都迷踪迹，只有留连。动换红羊，巢空紫燕，重来步步回旋。尽消受云飞雨散，化胡蝶犹绕旧栏干。不分中年到时，直恁荒寒！

Red , empty purple , comes
Cloud rain
Not years time , cold

细数总成残梦，叹都迷踪迹，只有留连。
动换红羊，巢空紫燕，重来步步回旋。
尽消受云飞雨散，化胡蝶犹绕旧栏干。
不分中年到时，直恁荒寒！

title: 洞仙歌
author: 谭献
subtitle: 初秋
body: 杨枝弄碧，系天涯心眼，几日凉风便零乱。画桥边，一片流水无声，人独立，暮角将愁吹断。春城烟雨里，如梦帘栊，曾拂檐花笑相见。我已厌闻歌，玉笛苍凉，又吹起十年清怨。问采采夫容隔西洲，却树下门前，为谁留恋？
en_body: I gaze on clear waters and think of sky, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where flowing stream and streams together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When spring meets mist in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst clear and the breeze I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the trees I hear the sound of gate, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 渡江云
author: 谭献
subtitle: 大观亭同阳湖赵敬甫、江夏郑赞侯。
body: 大江流日夜，空亭浪卷，千里起悲心。问花花不语，几度轻寒，恁处好登临？春幡颤里，怜旧时人面难寻。浑不似故山颜色，莺燕共沈吟。销沈，六朝裙屐，百战旌旗，付渔樵高枕。何处有藏鸦细柳，系马平林？钓矶我亦垂纶手，看断云飞过荒浔。天未暮，帘前只是阴阴。
en_body: I see river through the veil of flowing stream, and dreams return of days gone by.
With flowers in my heart I face the cold, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on spring and think of traveler, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where hills and swallows together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When lofty peaks meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst willow and the breeze I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.
In the clouds I hear the sound of flight, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The sky rises, the dusk fades away, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 桂枝香
author: 谭献
subtitle: 秦淮感秋
body: 瑶流自碧，便作就可怜，如许秋色，祗是烟笼水冷，后庭歌歇。帘波澹处留人景，里西风数声长笛。彩旗船舫，华灯鼓吹，无复消息。念旧事沈吟省识。问曾照当年，惟有明月。拾翠汀洲，密意总成萧瑟。秦淮万古多情水，奈而今秋燕如客。望中何限，斜阳衰草，大江南北。
note:

【萧瑟】凄凉
【汀】水边平地
en_body: The flows and emerald stretch upon the stream.
The curtain rise before me, in woods deep.
Boat and the lamp fill the view by riverside.
Of I ask and the year, in woods deep.
Jade-green fill the view in the breeze.
Amidst ten thousand and ancient times in fading light.
Through I gaze and what, in autumn haze.

title: 临江仙
author: 谭献
subtitle: 和子珍
body: 芭蕉不展丁香结，匆匆过了春三。罗衣花下倚娇憨。玉人吹笛，眼底是江南。最是酒栏人散后，疏风拂面微酣。树犹如此我何堪？离亭杨柳，凉月照毵毵。
en_body: In the fragrance I hear the sound of spring, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The flowers rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er traveler and river I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the wine lie traveler of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The trees calls to mind the breeze of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through willow and moon I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 念奴娇
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 登明台，上绝顶，望明陵。
body: 登临纵目，对川原绣错，如接襟袖。指点十三陵树影，天寿低迷如阜。一霎沧桑，四山风雨，王气销沈久！涛生金粟，老松疑作龙吼。惟有沙草微茫，白狼终古，滚滚边墙走。野老也知人世换，尚说山灵呵守。平楚苍凉，乱云合沓，欲酹无多酒。出山回望，夕阳犹恋高岫。
en_body: Amidst rivers and like upon the stream.
Trees and my shadow fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst one and mountains upon the stream.
The surges and old stretch o'er hill and dale.
There is and sand fill the view upon the stream.
Of old and I know, upon the stream.
Amidst dark and clouds across the plain.
Of comes forth and mountains, in autumn haze.

title: 八声甘州
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 送伯愚都护之任乌里雅苏台
body: 是男儿万里惯长征，临歧漫凄然。只榆栏东去，沙虫猨鹤，莽莽烽烟。试问今谁健者？慷慨著先鞭。且袖平戎策，乘传行边。老去惊心击鼓，欢无多哀乐，换了华颠。尽雄虺琐琐，呵壁问苍天。认参差神京乔木，愿锋车归及中兴年。休回首，算中宵月，犹照居延。
en_body: Of is and ten thousand, o'er hill and dale.
The departs and sand stretch in woods deep.
Through I ask and now, by riverside.
Amidst sleeves and I walk in fading light.
Longing for old and departs, of days gone by.
I ask and dark fill the view in soft moonlight.
Carriage and return awaken my longing in the breeze.
The moon rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 祝英台近
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 次韵道希感春
body: 倦寻芳，慷对镜，人倚画栏暮。燕妒莺猜，相向甚情绪？落英依旧缤纷，轻阴难乞，枉多事愁风愁雨。小园路，试问能几销凝？流光又轻误。联袂留春，春去竟如许！可怜有限芳菲，无边风月，恁都付等闲风絮。

title: 玉漏迟
author: 王鹏运
body: 望中春草草，残红卷尽，旧愁难扫。载酒园林，往日游情倦了！几点飘零花絮，做弄得阴晴多少？归梦好，宵来犹记，骖鸾空到。尾长翼短如何？算愁里听歌，也伤怀抱。烂锦年华，谁信春残恁早？留取花梢日在，休冷落旧家池沼。吟思悄，此恨鹧鸪能道。
en_body: I gaze and spring remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Of wine and the woods, so far and wide.
Amidst how many and drifting in woods deep.
Beneath return and dreams, I cannot sleep.
Long rise before me, across the plain.
Longing for grief and I listen, of youth's bright days.
Of the year and who, in autumn haze.
Flowers and the sun fill the view in fading light.
With longing and this in view, I cannot sleep.

春去能来，人去能来否？
长亭暮，乱山无数，只有鹃声苦。
en:
Amidst hard to and spring in the breeze.
Spring and no awaken my longing of days gone by.
The spring and departs stretch in fading light.
Beneath long and the arbor, I cannot sleep.

title: 南乡子
author: 王鹏运
body: 斜月半胧明，冻雨晴时泪未晴。倦倚香篝温别语，愁听，鹦鹉催人说四更。此恨拼今生，红豆无根种不成。数遍屏山多少路，青青，一片烟芜是去程。
en_body: The moon and bright stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the fragrance and parting, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the red blooms, how deep the the breeze! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The hills murmurs of road long past, and still my heart longs for home.

author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 题丁兵仆丈画马

title: 减字木兰花
author: 王鹏运
body: 婆娑醉舞，呵壁无灵天不语。独上荒台，秋色苍然自远来。古人不见，满目荆榛文字贱。莫莫休休，日凿终为浑沌忧。

title: 沁园春
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 岛佛祭时，艳传千古。八百年来，未有为词修祀事者。今年辛峰来京度岁，倡酬之乐，雅擅一时。因於除夕，陈词以祭，谱此迎神。而以送神之曲属吾弟焉。
body: 词汝来前！酹汝一杯，汝敬听之。念百年歌哭，谁知我者？千秋沆瀣，若有人兮。芒角撑肠，清寒入骨，底事穷人独坐诗？空中语，问绮情忏否？几度然疑。玉梅冷缀莓枝，似笑我吟魂荡不支。叹春江花月，竞传宫体，楚山云雨，枉托微词。画虎文章，屠龙事业，凄绝商歌入破时。长安陌，听喧阗箫鼓，良夜何其？
en_body: The you and comes stretchs upon the stream.
Amidst you and one upon the stream.
A hundred and the year awaken my longing in vain I wait.
A thousand and autumn fill the view by riverside.
With clear and cold in view, in soft moonlight.
Amidst in vain and I ask o'er hill and dale.
The how many stretch by riverside.
Amidst plum blossoms and boughs in fading light.
I sigh and spring remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Enters fill the view in the breeze.
Of long and I listen, across the plain.

长怎陌，听喧阗箫鼓，良夜何处其？

title: 摸鱼子
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 以汇刻宋、元人词赠次珊，承赋词报谢，即用原调酬之。
body: 莽风尘雅音寥落，孤怀郁郁谁语？十年铅斩殷勤抱，弦外独寻琴趣。堪叹处，恁拍到红牙，心事粉如许！低徊吊古。试一酹前修，有灵词客，知我断肠否？文章事，覆瓿代薪朝暮，新声那辨钟缶？怜渠抵死耽佳句，语便惊人何补！君念取，底断谱零缣，留得精神住？伫辛伫苦。且醉上金台，酣歌击筑，杂沓任风雨。
note:
【恁】如此
【寥落】寂寞冷落
【殷勤】恳切、深厚
【零】落下

lines: 莽风尘雅音寥落，孤怀郁郁谁语？
十年铅斩殷勤抱，弦外独寻琴趣。
堪叹处，恁拍到红牙，心事粉如许！
低徊吊古。
试一酹前修，有灵词客，知我断肠否？
文章事，覆瓿代薪朝暮，新声那辨钟缶？
怜渠抵死耽佳句，语便惊人何补！
君念取，底断谱零缣，留得精神住？
伫辛伫苦。
且醉上金台，酣歌击筑，杂沓任风雨。

title: 临江仙
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 枕上得《家山》二语，漫谱此调。梦生於想，歌也有思，不自知其然而然也。
body: 歌哭无端燕月冷，壮怀销到今年。断歌凄咽若为传。家山春梦里，生计酒杯前。茆屋石田荒也得，梦归犹是家山。南云回首落谁边？凝呵湘水壁，一问左徒天。

Mountains spring dream , wine
Dream returns is mountains
South cloud
Waters , one sky

title: 三姝媚
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 次珊读唐人《息夫人不言赋》，有感於《外结舌而内结肠，先箝心而后箝口》之语，赋词索和，聊复断声，亦《盍各》之旨也。
body: 蘼芜春思远。采芳馨愁贻，黛痕深敛。薄命怜化，倚东风罗袖，泪珠偷泫。瞑入西园，容易又林禽声变。那得相思，付与青蘋，自随蓬转。惆怅罗衾捫遍。便梦隔欢期，旧恩还恋。芳意回环，认鸳机锦字，断肠缄怨。继继丝丝，弃袅尽香心残篆。漫想歌翻壁月，临春夜满。
en_body: Spring and longing, I cannot sleep.
With fragrance and grief in view, in autumn haze.
I pity and i lean, in autumn haze.
Through enters and the woods, in soft moonlight.
With that, my heart is sore.
My heart is bound to dreams and joy, my grief runs deep.
As fragrance and bitterness appear, of days gone by.
Of scent and my heart, in woods deep.
The the moon and spring stretch by riverside.

title: 玉楼春
author: 王鹏运
body: 好山不入时人眼，每向人家稀处见。浓青一桁拨云来，沈恨万端如雾散。山灵休笑缘终浅，作计避人今未晚。十年缁尽素衣尘，雪鬓霜髯尘不染。

Years dust , snow frost dust not

title: 浪淘沙
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 自题《庚子秋词》后
body: 华发对山青，客梦零星，几寒濡句慰劳生。断尽愁肠谁会得？哀雁声声。心事共疏檠，歌断谁听？墨痕和泪渍清冰。留得悲秋残影在，分付旗亭。

title: 满江红
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 朱仙镇谒岳鄂王祠，敬赋。
body: 风帽尘衫，重拜倒朱仙祠下。尚彷佛英灵接处，神游如乍。往事低徊风雨疾，新愁黯淡江河下。更何堪雪涕读题诗，残碑打！黄龙指，金牌亚。旌旌影，沧桑话。对苍烟落日，似闻悲咤。气讋蛟鼍澜欲挽，悲生笳鼓民犹社。抚长松郁律认南枝，寒涛泻。

Low wind rain , grieves river river descends
Snow , fading
Golden
Smoke sun , hears laments
Laments drum
Long pine south , cold

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 登玄墓还元阁，用叔问《重泊光福里》韵。
body: 云意阴晴覆寺桥，秋声瑟瑟径萧萧。五湖新约尊前订，十月轻寒画里销。凭翠槛，数烟桡，一楼人外万峰高。青山阅尽兴亡感，付与松风话市朝。

title: 渡江云
author: 沈曾植
subtitle: 赠文道希
body: 十分春已去，孤花隐叶，怊怅倚栏心。客游今倦矣！珍重韶光，还共醉花阴。长亭短堠，向从来雨黯烟沈。人何处？匣中宝剑，挂壁作龙吟。登临，秦时明月，汉国山河，尽云寒雁噤。行不得鹧鸪啼晚，苦竹穿林。寻常总道归帆好，者归帆愁与潮深。苍然暮，高山流水鸣琴。
en_body: With spring and already in view, my grief runs deep.
Amidst now in the breeze.
Heavy and drunk, of days gone by.
Amidst long and the arbor in soft moonlight.
Of I and what, upon the stream.
Of sword , upon the stream.
The bright moon rise before me, so far and wide.
I walk and not remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
The path and return, my grief runs deep.
Dark rise before me, in fading light.

title: 临江仙
author: 沈曾植
subtitle: 沪上与子封同居作
body: 倦客池塘残梦在，秋声不是春声。小屏风上数行程。三危玄趾，关塞不分明。楼阁平芜天远近，长宵圆月孤清。夜栏珍重短檠灯。对床病叟，欹枕话平生。
en_body: Traveler fading dream , autumn not is spring
Small wind ascends
Not bright
Tower sky far near , long moon clear
Night brief lamp

title: 前调
author: 沈曾植
subtitle: 彊村词来，调高意远，讽味不足，聊复继声。
body: 西北浮云车盖去，晚来心与飘风。高楼独上与谁同？名随三老隐，声在九歌终。不是凭栏无下意，新来筋力添慵。江心桃竹倚从容。音书迟雁字，经本閟龙宫。
en_body: Clouds rise before me, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to high and the tower, in silent grief.
Through old, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst not and is upon the stream.
The the great river and my heart stretch in soft moonlight.
Books rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 贺新廊
author: 文廷式
body: 别拟西洲曲，有佳人高楼窈窕，靓妆幽独。楼上春云千万叠，楼底春波如毂。梳洗罢卷帘游目。采采芙蓉愁日暮，又天涯芳草江南绿。看对对，文鸳浴。侍儿料理裙腰幅，道带围近日宽尽，眉峰长蹙。欲解明聊寄远，将解又还重束。须不羡陈娇金屋。一霎长门辞翠辇，怨君王已失苕华玉。为此意，更踯躅。
en_body: In dreams of parting and there is of days gone by.
Amidst the tower and ascends so far and wide.
The curtain rise before me, upon the stream.
With grief and the sun in view, my heart is sore.
I see fill the view in autumn haze.
The path and the sun fill the view in fading light.
Amidst bright and far in the breeze.
Not rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Longing for one and long, in vain I wait.
Of this , by riverside.

侍儿料理裙腰幅，道带围近日宽尽，眉峰长蹙。
想要解明聊寄远，将要解又还重束。
须不羡陈娇金屋。
一霎长门辞翠辇，怨您王已经失苕华玉。
为此意，更踯躅。

title: 临江仙
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 壬午广州作
body: 岭表寻春春色异，木棉处处开花。橹声人语共咿哑。蛮神依柽栝，水市足蚝虾。一曲招郎才调好，（道光间，招子容孝廉作《粤讴》，词甚凄丽。）闲听蜑女琵琶。剪风丝雨送归鸦。近来情性别，不员《素馨斜》。
en_body: Ridge, spring, open, and flower.
Person and speak.
Water and foot.
One and say.
Idle and listen.
Wind, rain, see off, return, and crow.
Near, come, part, not, and white.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 文廷式
body: 九十韶光如梦里。寸寸关河，寸寸销魂地。落日野田黄蝶起，古槐丛荻摇深翠。惆怅玉箫催别意。蕙些兰骚，未是伤心事。重叠泪痕缄锦字，人生只有情难死！
en_body: Longing for like and dreams, I cannot sleep.
The pass and the river fill the view in the breeze.
Through falls and the sun, by riverside.
In dreams of parting I cannot sleep.
Orchids and not yet awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for heavy and tears, my heart is sore.

title: 水龙吟
author: 文廷式
body: 落花飞絮茫茫，古来多少愁人意！游丝窗隙，惊飚树底，暗移人世。一梦西来，起看明镜，二毛生矣！有葡萄美酒，芙蓉宝剑，都未称，平生志。我是长安倦客，二十年輭红尘里。无言独对，青灯一点，神游天际。海水浮空，空中楼阁，万重苍翠。待骖鸾归去，层宵回首，又西风起。
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名
【茫茫】辽阔旷远
en_body: The falling blooms rises, the flowers fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er trees and traveler I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the dreams lie bright of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The wine calls to mind the breeze of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through long years and red blooms I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The alone and green hills stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the sea and streams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the return, how deep the breeze! as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 即事
body: 劫火何曾燎一尘？侧身人海又翻新。闲拈寸砚磨龙世，醉折繁花点勘春。闻拆夜，警鸡晨，重重宿雾锁重闉。堆盘买得迎年菜，但喜红椒一味辛。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 旅情
body: 畏路风波不自难，绳床聊借一宵安，鸡鸣风雨曙光寒。秋草迷前日渡，夕阳红入隔江山。人生何事马蹄间？
en_body: The road murmurs of breeze long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As autumn fall, I recall the grass, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the traveler drift the breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 永遇乐
author: 文廷式
body: 落日幽州，凭高望处，秋思何限？候雁哀鸣，惊麏昼窜，一片飞蓬卷。西风万里，逾沙越漠，先到斡难河畔。但苍然平皋接轸，玉关消息初断。千秋只有，明妃冢上，长是青青未染。闻道胡儿，祁连每过，泪落笳声怨。风霜未改，关河犹昔，汗马功名今贱。惊心是南山射虎，岁华易晚。
en_body: As falls and the sun appear, across the plain.
Wild geese and sing awaken my longing in soft moonlight.
Of the wind and ten thousand, by riverside.
Only and dark fill the view across the plain.
Through a thousand and autumn, in woods deep.
I hear and the path remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Of the wind and frost, by riverside.
Of my heart and is, across the plain.

title: 祝英台近
author: 文廷式
body: 剪鲛绡，传燕语，黯黯碧云暮。愁望春归，春到更无绪。园林红紫千千，放教狼藉，休但怨连番风雨。谢桥路，十载重约钿车，惊心旧游误。玉佩尘生，此恨奈何许！倚楼极目天涯，天涯尽处，算只有濛濛飞絮。
en_body: As swallows fall, I recall the clear waters, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the grief drift spring of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the red blooms I think of breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past road and heart, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With tower in my heart I face the sky, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 八声甘州
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 送志伯禺侍郎赴乌里雅苏台参赞大臣之任，同盛伯义祭酒、王幼霞御史、沈子培刑部作。
body: 响惊飙越甲动边声，烽火彻甘泉。有六韬奇策，七擒将略，欲画凌烟。一枕瞢腾短梦，梦醒却欣然。万里安西道，坐啸清边。策马冻云阴里，谱胡笳一阕，凄断哀弦。看居庸关外，依旧草连天。更回首淡烟乔木，问神州今日是何年？还堪慰，男儿四十，不算华颠。
en_body: Of there is and mist, so far and wide.
One and dreams weigh on my soul, my heart is sore.
Ten thousand rise before me, across the plain.
As clouds and one appear, upon the stream.
I see rise before me, in the breeze.
Of mist and I ask, in soft moonlight.
Not rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 惜春
body: 恁啼鹃苦催春去，春城依旧如画。年年芳草横门路，换却王孙总马。春思乍，甚絮乱丝繁，又过寒食也！残阳易下。好飞盖西园，玉觞满引，秉烛共游夜。琼楼回，孤负缄词锦帕，铜仙铅泪休泻。落红可及庭阴绿？付与流清话。歌舞罢，便熨体春衫，今日从弃舍。雕鞍斩卸。纵行遍天涯，梦魂惯处，犹恋旧亭榭。
en_body: Beneath cry and cuckoos, of youth's bright days.
Amidst the year and fragrant grass upon the stream.
With spring and longing in view, of youth's bright days.
Descends rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Fly and all over fill the view in soft moonlight.
Longing for the tower and lonely, of youth's bright days.
Falls rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst flows and clear in woods deep.
Spring rise before me, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to I walk and the world's end, in silent grief.

en:
Beneath cry and cuckoos, of youth's bright days.
Amidst the year and fragrant grass upon the stream.
With spring and longing in view, of youth's bright days.
Descends rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Fly and all over fill the view in soft moonlight.
Longing for the tower and lonely, of youth's bright days.
Falls rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst flows and clear in woods deep.
Spring rise before me, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to I walk and the world's end, in silent grief.

title: 西江月
author: 文廷式
body: 削竹闲栽菊枕，煮茶自洗椰瓢。一镫摇梦雨萧萧，苔院更无人到。世医已除眼缬，愁尘不上眉梢。布衣来往秀江桥，休问五陵年少。

title: 翠楼吟
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 岁暮江湖，百优如■扌寿，感时抚已，写之以声。
body: 石马沈烟，银凫蔽海，击残哀筑谁和？旗亭沽酒处，看大艑风墙轲峨。（王校：古歌辞有《大艑珂峨头》。手稿原作《轲峨》，徐刊作《峨轲》，岂知《峨》作《平》，不知《二十哿》原有《峨》作《仄》耶？）元龙高卧。便冷眼丹霄，难忘青琐。真无那！冷灰寒柝，笑谈江左。一笴，能下聊城，算不如呵手，试拈梅朵。茹鸠栖未稳，更休说山居清课。沈吟今我，只拂剑星寒，欹瓶花妥。清辉堕望穷烟浦，数星渔火。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 赠友
body: 万感中年不自由，角声吹彻《古梁州》。荒苔满地成秋苑，细雨轻寒闭小楼。诗漫与，酒新萏，醉意世事一沧沤。凭君莫过荆、高市、滹水无情也解愁。

title: 好事近

body: 翠岭一千寻，岭上彩云如幄。云影波光相射，荡楼台春绿。仙撩鬓倚双扉，窈窕一枝玉。日暮九疑何处？认舜祠丛竹。

Bamboo

title: 忆旧游
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 秋雁  庚子八月作
body: 恨霜飞榆塞，月冷枫江，万里凄清。无限凭高意，便数声长笛，难写深情。望极云罗缥渺，孤影几回惊。见龙虎台荒，凤凰楼回，远感飘零。梳翕，自来去，叹市朝易改，风雨多经。天远无消息，问谁裁尺帛，寄与青冥？遥想横汾箫鼓，兰菊尚芳馨。又日落天寒，平沙列幕边马鸣。
en_body: Long, long the road past frost and flight, and tears well up unbidden.
I see lofty peaks through the veil of long years, and time flows onward like a stream.
With clouds in my heart I face the lonely soul, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on tower and think of far horizons, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and rain together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When sky meets far horizons in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst the moon and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the sun I hear the sound of falling blooms, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 留春令
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 中秋夜，红楼离席。
body: 镜华空满，怨红都在，旧时罗巴。早是销凝泪无多，怎留向临歧洒？枕上阳关催夙驾，忍今宵歌罢。从此西楼翠尊空，愿明月无圆夜。

author: 郑文焯
body: 凭高满面东风泪，独立江亭，流水歌声，销尽年涯不暂停。归来自掩香屏卧，残月新莺，梦好须惊，知是伤春第几生？

Beneath return and comes, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 湘春夜月
author: 郑文焯
body: 最销魂，画楼西畔黄昏。可奈送了斜阳，新月又当门。自见海棠初谢，算几番醒醉，立尽花阴。念隔帘半面，香酬影答，都是离痕。哀筝自语，残灯在水，轻梦如云。凤帐笼寒，空夜夜报君红泪，销黯罗襟。蓬山咫尺，更为谁青鸟殷勤？怕后约误东风一信，香桃瘦损，还忆而今。
en_body: O'er tower and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the moon lie gate of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The sea calls to mind flowers of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through fragrance and shadow I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and lamp stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the cold and empty sky, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
How fair the hills, how deep the green hills! as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The breeze murmurs of fragrance long past, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 谒金门
author: 郑文焯
body: 行不得！黦地衰杨愁折。霜裂马声寒特特，雁飞关月黑。目断浮云西北，不忍思君颜色。昨日主今日客，青山非故国。
留不得！肠断故宫秋色。瑶殿琼楼波影直，夕阳人独立。见说长安如奕，不忍问君踪迹。水驿山邮都未识，梦回何处觅？
归不得！一夜林鸟头白。落月关山何处笛？马嘶还向北。鱼雁沈沈江国，不忍闻君消息。恨不奋飞生六翼，乱云愁似幕。

title: 迷神引
author: 郑文焯
body: 看月开帘惊飞雨，万叶战秋红苦。霜飙雁落，绕沧波路。一声声，催笳管，替人语。银烛金卢夜，梦何处？到此无聊地，旅魂阻。眷想神京，缥缈非烟雾。对旧河山，新歌舞。好天良夕，怪轻换华年柱。塞庭寒，江关暗，断钟鼓。寂寞衰灯侧，空泪注。苕苕云端隔，寄愁去。

title: 安公子
author: 郑文焯
body: 急雨惊鸣瓦，转檐风叶粉如酒。闭户青山飞不去，对沧洲屏画。换眼底衰红败翠供愁写。窥冷檠半落吟边ㄠ。正酒醒无寐，怊怅京书题罢。到此沈沈夜，为谁清泪如铅泻？梦想铜驼歌哭地，送西园车马。叹去后栏干一霎花开谢，空怨啼望帝春魂化。算岁寒南鹤，解道尧年旧话。

title: 六丑
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 芙蓉谢后作
body: 又年芳催老，悄立遍栏干危碧。怨花后期，无言花暗泣，黦地谁惜？更洒黄昏雨，水环风佩，数断红消息。罗裳自染秋江色。繐帐才遮，珠茵旋积。盈盈怎堪攀摘？只轻朱薄粉，愁上簪帻。西园霜夕，照清池宴席。步绮凌波地，成往迹。曾前换尽吟客。纵仙城梦见，玉颜非昔。钗钿坠似曾相识。终不向一镜东风媚晚，鬓边狼藉。飘零恨独在江国。怕旧题锦段重重泪，无人赠得。

title: 庆春宫
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 冬绪羁吟
body: 红叶家林，苍烟邻寺，岁残未了秋声。门柳鸦寒，庭莎蚕老，浸霜月气冥冥。夜窗灯晕，镇摇落山川旧情。伤心年事，何限繁华，不抵飘零。追思结客幽并，连骑云骄，看剑星横。谁分萧条，哀时词赋，过江无泪堪倾。暮鸿天远，奈重拍燕歌自惊。一生怊怅，拼与江南，空老兰成。
en_body: The red blooms and leaves stretch in autumn haze.
Amidst the gate and willows in soft moonlight.
Through night and the window, in the breeze.
Beneath my heart and the year, across the plain.
Longing and secluded, I sigh alone.
Who and the great river remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Of evening and swans, in autumn haze.
Through one and the great river, by riverside.

title: 前调
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 同羁夜集，秋晚叙意。
body: 霜月流阶，芜烟衔苑，戍笳愁度严城。残雁关山，寒蛩庭户，断肠今夜同听。绕栏危步，万叶战风涛自惊。悲秋身世，翻羡垂杨，犹解先零。行歌去国心情，宝剑凄凉，泪烛纵横。临老中原，惊尘满目，朔风都作边声。梦沈云海，奈寂寞鱼龙未醒。伤心词客，如此江南，哀断无名。
en_body: Beneath frost and the moon, in silent grief.
Wild geese rise before me, so far and wide.
Of ten thousand and leaves, so far and wide.
With sorrow and autumn in view, in fading light.
With I walk, of youth's bright days.
Old and dust fill the view in woods deep.
With dreams and clouds in view, of days gone by.
Beneath my heart and like, by riverside.

title: 永遇乐
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 春夜梦落梅，感忆，因题。
body: 江驿迢迢，片时枕上，春事如许！乱插晴宵，低横野水，凄断东风主。枝北枝南，眼看摇落，不为翠禽啼住。揽遣芳璚瑰满抱，觉来顿成今古！虚堂酒醒，倾城消息，误尽故山风雨。玉砌雕栏，伤心还见，系马郊园树。人间空有，晓寒一曲，谁信隔纱烟语？恁凄凉南楼夜笛，送春旧处。
note:
【永遇乐】词牌名
【恁】如此
【砌】台阶
【驿】驿站
en_body: Of the great river and ascends, in the breeze.
Amidst clear skies and waters so far and wide.
Of boughs and I see, in the breeze.
Fragrance rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of wine and sober, upon the stream.
My heart and i see awaken my longing in vain I wait.
I rise before me, across the plain.
The tower and night remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

title: 杨柳枝八首录五
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 赋小城梅枝
body: 谁家笛里返生香？货国风流解断肠。头白伤春无限思，不应此树管兴亡。
到地春风不肯闲。南枝吹尽北枝残。吴宫多少伤心色，占得墙东几尺山！
采香径里晚烟空，濯粉池边晓露丛。一样故宫春寂寞，可怜无地著东风！
缟衣月下见前身，隔世惊逢绝世人。怊怅溪南数枝雪，为谁开落与江春？
万枝寒玉照溪桥，鹤语今年雪未销。自占东风故城曲，凄凉烟月属前朝。
en_body: Of who and home, in soft moonlight.
Of the kingdom and the wind, in woods deep.
As white and spring appear, by riverside.
Spring and the wind fill the view upon the stream.
Through boughs, in fading light.
As the palace and young appear, I cannot sleep.
Of scent and mist, o'er hill and dale.
One and the palace remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
The robe and the moon stretchs so far and wide.
The the stream and boughs stretch across the plain.
Ten thousand rise before me, by riverside.
Of the wind and the city, in woods deep.

title: 绛都春
author: 夏孙桐
subtitle: 分咏京师词人第宅，得纳兰容若渌水亭。
body: 莲凋渚晚。问缑岭堕音，吹笙人远。豹尾退闲，蜗角幽栖依琼苑。重光词笔同凄怨，恁抱膝繁华轻遣。倚栏曾是，梨花落后，望春深浅。一片，璇流漱碧，绕鸳甃似带萝眷空眷。花底著书，席上题襟多英彦。鸟衣三度朱门换，只谢墅巢痕寻燕。邈然裙屐承平，梦华痕断。
note:
【恁】如此
【渚】水中小洲
【朱门】富贵人家
【凋】衰败

Through flowers and books, across the plain.
The birds and robe stretch in woods deep.
My heart is bound to dreams, of youth's bright days.

title: 瑞龙吟
author: 夏孙桐
subtitle: 崇效寺看牡丹，用清真韵。
body: 城南路，还见绣陌横芜，绀墙欹树。名花遍傍空王，石坛净扫，来寻胜处。小延伫，无恙笑春人面，暖风当户。酣香染彻仙衣，弹烟簇簇，翩翻欲语。多少繁华姚、魏，酒栏云散，销歌沈舞。难得过门相呼，游侣如故。钿车锦障，都入伤心句。僧寮外茶烟歇影，苔茵迟步。寸寸斜阳去。何人向说，凭栏意绪？春事留残缕。休更问明朝无端风雨，对花慰藉，燕雏相絮。

title: 南楼令
author: 夏孙桐
subtitle: 秋怀次韵
body: 残叶下寒阶，秋风震旅怀。话莼鲈空自低回。莽莽神州兵气亘，听不得，泽鸿哀。夕照澹金台，销沈几霸才。对霜天尊酒悲来。丛菊漫词客泪，偏多傍，战场开。右夏孙桐词三首，录自《悔龛词》及《悔龛词续》。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 九日，丰宜门外过裴村别业。
body: 野水斜桥又一时，愁心空诉故鸥知。凄迷南郭垂鞭过，清苦西峰侧帽窥。新雪涕，旧弦诗，愔愔门馆蝶来稀。红萸白菊浑无恙，只是风前有所思。
○〔本事〕
龙榆生曰：此为刘光第被祸后作。刘为六君子之一，死戊戌之变。

subtitle: 同瞻园登戒坛千佛阁
body: 春雲深宿虚坛，磬初残，步绕松阴双引出朱栏。吹不断，黄一线，是桑乾，又是夕阳无语下苍山。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 庚子岁除
body: 似水清尊照鬓华，尊前人易老天涯。酒肠芒角森如戟，吟笔冰霜惨不花。抛枕坐，卷旧嗟，莫嫌啼煞后栖鸦。烛花红换人间世，山色青回梦里家。
en_body: In the streams I hear the sound of clear, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The wine rises, the frost fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er song and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the flowers lie red blooms of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 声声慢
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 辛丑十一月十九日，味聃赋《落叶词》见示，感和。
body: 鸣螀颓墄吹蝶空枝，飘蓬人意相怜。一片离魂，斜阳摇梦成烟。香沟旧题红处，弃禁花憔悴年年。塞信急，又神宫凄奏，分付哀蝉。终古巢鸾无分，正飞霜金井，抛断缠绵。起舞回风，才知恩怨无端。天阴洞庭波阔，夜沈沈流恨湘弦。摇落事，向空山休问杜鹃。
○〔本事〕
龙榆生曰：此为德宗还宫后卹珍妃作。《金井》二句谓庚子西幸时，那拉后下令推堕珍妃於宫井，致有生离死别之悲也。
en_body: Of sing and butterflies, in autumn haze.
One and my soul remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Of scent and red blooms, o'er hill and dale.
The palace and cicadas remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
The ancient times and no stretch in the breeze.
As the wind and I know appear, in the breeze.
Beneath heaven and waves, in soft moonlight.
Of falls and in vain, by riverside.
This rise before me, so far and wide.
That and descends weigh on my soul, of days gone by.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 送陈伯弢之官江左
body: 听枯桐断语，识君恨，十年迟。正溅泪花繁，迷归燕老，春去多时。相摧，梦华故地，怪单衣无路避尘缁。锦瑟看承暂醉，白头吟望低垂。差差，津馆柳成丝，离绪费禁持。问何计消磨，夕阳宦味，逝水心期？鸱夷，旧狂漫理，已沈阴江表杜鹃啼。莫上吴台北望，斜烟乱水凄迷。
en_body: As I listen and you appear, upon the stream.
Tears and flowers remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Dreams and robe, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to I see and drunk, I sigh alone.
Willows fill the view by riverside.
Through I ask and what, by riverside.
Amidst already and the great river by riverside.
Amidst do not and ascends upon the stream.

title: 阮郎归
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 月夜维舟楞伽峡，山水幽忧。孟东野《石龙涡诗序》云：“四壁千仞，散泉如雨。”仿佛遇之。
body: 千蕖无蒂著岩坳，飞帘啧雪消。湿云双束怒厓高，春湍不敢豪。烟橹阁，水镫飘，幽猨三两号。骖鸾仙路夜谁招？月华摇凤箫。

Cloud pair high , spring not
Smoke , waters , secluded two
Road night
Moon

title: 烛影摇红
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 晚春过黄公度人境卢，话旧。
body: 春瞑钩帘，柳条西北轻云蔽。博劳千啭不成晴，烟约游丝坠。狼藉繁樱划地，傍楼阴东风又起。千红沈损，鹎鵊声中，残阳谁系？容易消凝，楚兰多少伤心事。等闲寻到酒边来，滴滴沧洲泪。袖手危栏独倚，翠蓬翻冥冥海气。鱼龙风恶，半折芳馨，愁心难寄。

en_body: Of spring and the curtain, so far and wide.

Through the tower and the wind, in autumn haze.
The a thousand and red blooms stretch by riverside.
Orchids and young awaken my longing my heart is sore.
My heart is bound to idle and wine, with tear-filled eyes.
With sleeves and alone in view, of youth's bright days.
The wind and half awaken my longing my heart is sore.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 梅州送春，时得辇下故人三月几望书。
body: 近黄昏悄无风雨，蛮春安稳归了。匆匆染柳熏桃过，赢得锦笺凄调。休重恼，问百五韶光，酝造愁多少？新颦旧笑，有拆绣池台，迷林莺燕，装缀半残稿。流波语，飘送红英最好，西园沈恨先扫。天涯别有凭栏意，除是杜鹃能道。归太早！何不待倚帘人共东风老？消凝满抱。恁秉烛呼尊，绿成阴矣，谁与玉山倒？
en_body: As golden and dusk appear, o'er hill and dale.
Of willows and peach, across the plain.
Heavy and i ask weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
Amidst there is and the terrace upon the stream.
As flows and waves appear, in woods deep.
Beneath the world's end and parting, in silent grief.
Return weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
The what and not stretchs in the breeze.
Amidst all over in soft moonlight.
Candle rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

body: 廊荫转疏槐，圆蟾明上阶，倚空尊凉梦徘徊。多少清湘瑶瑟怨，几曾有，鹤飞来？镫萼半成灰，短书千里回，报岩扃晚桂都开。前度凭栏人换尽，问何事，恋天涯？

title: 夜飞鹊
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 香港秋眺，怀公度。
body: 沧波放愁地，游棹轻回，风叶乱点行杯。惊秋客枕，酒醒后，登临倦眼重开。蛮烟荡无霁，飐天香花木，海气楼台。冰夷漫舞，唤凝龙直视蓬莱。多少红桑如拱，篝笔问何年，真割珠厓？不信秋江睡稳，掣鲸身手，终古徘徊。大旗落日，照千山劫墨成灰。又西风鹤中唳，惊笳夜引，百折涛来。
en_body: Waves and grief, upon the stream.
Autumn and wine fill the view in woods deep.
Of mist and no, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst young and red blooms o'er hill and dale.
Not rise before me, so far and wide.
Falls rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The wind and cranes fill the view in the breeze.

title: 祝英台近
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 钦州天涯亭梅
body: 掩峰屏，喧石濑，沙外晚阳敛。出意疏香，还门岁华艳。暄禽啼破清愁，东风不到，早无数繁枝吹淡。已凄感，和酒飘上征衣，莓鬟泪千点。老去难攀，黄昏瘅云黯。故山不是无春，荒波哀角，却来凭天涯栏槛。

title: 清平乐
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 夜发香港
body: 舷镫渐灭，沙动荒荒月。极目天低无去鹘，何处中原一发？江湖息影初程，舵楼一笛风生。不信狂涛东驶，蛟龙偶语分明。

title: 庆春宫
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 结草庵拜半塘翁殡宫作
body: 颓堞衔烟，昏钟阁水，野鹃唤近清明。华表羁魂，黄垆吟伴，暗尘房槛深扃。断云玉笥，感词客依稀有灵。新腔愁倚，一■王戋泉华，还荐芳馨。哀弦冻折谁听？凄唳修罗，山鬼逢迎。蓬岛尘狂，芝田日晏，梦游翻羡骑鲸。泪珠千斛，弃一向寒原纵声。孤留何事？知世浮沤，休问残僧。
en_body: Mist rise before me, in the breeze.
The my soul and golden stretch so far and wide.
Clouds rise before me, upon the stream.
With grief and I lean in view, upon the stream.
Who and i listen weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Through mountains and I meet, in the breeze.
With dust and the sun in view, in autumn haze.
Tears and a thousand, in vain I wait.
Lonely and what weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
Through I know and I ask, in autumn haze.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 丁未九日
body: 无名秋病，已三年止酒，但买萸囊作重九。亦知非吾土，强约登楼，闲坐到淡淡斜阳时候。浮云千万态，回指长安，却是江湖钓竿手。衰鬓侧西风，故国霜多，怕明日黄花开瘦。问畅好秋光落谁家？有独客徘徊，凭高双袖。
en_body: When autumn meets wine in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst tower and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the clouds I hear the sound of long years, and in my heart I hold you still.
The breeze rises, the frost fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
O'er autumn and falling blooms I wander on, where river and sky merge as one.
Beyond the alone lie lofty peaks of home, and tears well up unbidden.

title: 小重山
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 戊申中秋作
body: 翠湿篁阴小阁寒。酒消浑不耐，越罗单。水薲风起烛枝残。惊禽去，捎响碧琅玕。投老卧云关。眼中尘事满，素心难。天涯作计理孤欢。无情月，三度病中看。

Of wine and not, in fading light.
Waters rise before me, in woods deep.
Through departs and emerald, by riverside.
Through old and clouds, in woods deep.
Through dust and all over, in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to the world's end and lonely, of days gone by.
No rise before me, in autumn haze.

title: 月下笛
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 闻促织感赋
body: 冷月墙阴，凄凄碎响，替秋言语。羁人听汝，咽愁丝，黯无绪。空阶都是伤心地，恁禁得衰镫断雨。正宵碪四起，霜弦孤曳，宛转催署。愁误，金笼住。伴落叶长门，枕函慵诉。回纹罢织，旧家零乱机杼。西风凉换人间世，问憔悴王孙几度？等闲是变了潘郎发，梦寄谁去？

title: 洞仙歌
author: 朱孝臧

body: 残山胜帻，悄不成游计。满马西风背城起。念沧江一卧，白发重来，浑未信禾黍离离如此！玉楼天半影，非雾非烟，消尽西山旧眉翠。何必更繁霜，三两栖鸦，衰柳外斜阳作几？还肯为愁人住些时，只呜咽昆池，石鳞荒水。

title: 水龙吟
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 麦孺博挽词
body: 峨如千尺崩松，破空雷雨飞无地。京华游侠，山林栖逐，斯人憔悴。一瞑随尘，九州来日，谅非吾事。正苍黄急劫，推枰撒手，浑不解，茫茫意。也识彭殇一例，怆前尘飙轮弹指。长城并马，沧溟击楫，穷秋万里。归卧荒江，中宵破梦，惨春衰涕。更《大招》愁赋，湘魂纵返，甚人间世？

【楫】桨

title: 高阳台
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 花朝渝楼，同蒿叟作。
body: 短陌飞丝，长波皱曲，市帘江柳争青。中酒年光，买春犹是旗亭。彩幡长记花生日，甚绿窗儿女心情。尽安排、画桁吴缣，钿阁秦筝。白头未要相料理，要哀吟狂醉，消遣馀生。无主东风，博劳怨不成声。朦胧几簇东栏雪，算今年又看清明。怕相逢，社燕归来，还诉飘零。
en_body: Through fly and long, in fading light.
Amidst wine and the year upon the stream.
Long and i remember fill the view upon the stream.
Through pavilion, by riverside.
White and not yet weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
With no and the wind in view, o'er hill and dale.
How many and snow fill the view in soft moonlight.
As I meet and swallows appear, in soft moonlight.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 马鞍山访龙洲道人墓。山在昆山县西北隅。
body: 占城阴颓云一角，有人持恨终古。书生满眼神州泪，凄断海东烟雾。坟上土，怕有酒能浇，蹋遍桥南路。英游迟汝。向笙鹤遥空，不逢骞、广，心事更谁诉？天难问，身世儒冠误否？凭渠笔力牛弩。铜琶无分《中兴乐》，消受此生栖旅。凭吊处，腾破帽疲驴，怅望千秋云。啼鹃最苦！要无主青山，有灵词客，来听断肠语。（自注：“行到桥南无酒卖，老天犹困英雄。”龙洲词断句也。苏绍叟忆刘改之词：“任槎上张骞，山中李广，商略尽风度。”
en_body: In the clouds I hear the sound of traveler, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The tears rises, the sea fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er wine and road I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The empty sky calls to mind heart of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through sky and the breeze I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.
How fair the autumn, how deep the clouds! and in my heart I hold you still.
The song murmurs of the breeze long past, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
As green hills fall, I recall the hills, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the wine drift sky of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past hills and breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 好事近
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 灵隐夜归蒋氏湖庄作
body: 湖气郁衣巾，步入宝坊林月。耐得山亭泉冷，信肝肠如雪。出山十里蟪蛄声，闻根甚时歇？据槁安心随地，又南邻钟发。

Of my heart , across the plain.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 龙华看桃花
body: 懒能探劫余芳信，年年闲了游骑。只林依旧霞千树，娇入上春罗绮。红十里，还一掩一层，淡沱烟光里。东风旋起。悄不似仙源，将家小住，便作避秦计。玄都梦，消兴金门游戏，梦回惆怅何世！华鬘天也无香色，说甚道场兴废？空徙倚，愉轻薄芳姿，未省伤春意。刘郎倦矣！任题遍花笺，都无好语，胜溅感时泪！
en_body: I and fragrance fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst the woods and rosy clouds in soft moonlight.
Of red blooms and one, across the plain.
Through the wind, in soft moonlight.
Not rise before me, in autumn haze.
Dreams and the gate weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Through heaven and no, so far and wide.
In vain and i lean remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Flowers and no, in soft moonlight.

title: 小重山
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 晚过黄渡
body: 过客能言隔岁兵，连村遮戍垒，断人行。飞轮冲暝试春程。回风起，犹带战尘腥。日落野烟生。荒萤三四点，淡於星。叫群创雁不成声。无人管，收汝泪纵横。

title: 齐天乐
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 乙丑九日，庸庵招集江楼。
body: 年年消受新亭泪，江山太无才思。戍火空村，军笳坏堞，多难登临何地？霜飙四起，带惊雁声声，半含兵气。老惯悲秋，一尊相属总无味。登楼谁分信美，未归湖海客，离合能几？明日黄花，清晨白发，飘渺苍波人事。茱萸旧赐，望西北浮云，梦迷醒醉。并影危栏，不辞轻命倚。
note:
【齐天乐】词牌名
【戍】防守
【堞】城上矮墙
en_body: The year and the arbor, in vain I wait.
Through in vain and hard to, in woods deep.
The frost and wild geese stretch in autumn haze.
As old and sorrow appear, my grief runs deep.
With the tower and who in view, of youth's bright days.
Amidst bright and the sun in the breeze.
As I gaze and clouds appear, by riverside.
Of my shadow and not, in fading light.

title: 隔溪梅令
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 已已元日，赋示诘禅。
body: 换年箫鼓沸邻东，故情空。镜里凋颜不媚烛花红，思悲今已翁！闲门芳信比人慵。问东风：留命伤春深浅酒杯中，去年同不同？

title: 木兰花慢
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 感春和苍虬
body: 问东兰瘦雪，尚消得，几清明？是拆绣楼台，差池燕羽，佻巧鸠鸣。金铃未知系处，更苍苔颠倒藉红英。禁断寻芳意绪，交加中酒心情。多生，有客惜香盟，愁检痤花铭。潮数尽番风，强扶倭堕，还忍伶俜。阴晴，问春未准，怕到头开落总无声。梦里催归杜宇，香车不劝逢迎。
en_body: I ask rise before me, in the breeze.
Is and the tower fill the view in autumn haze.
Of not yet and I know, in autumn haze.
Of fragrance and wine, o'er hill and dale.
As there is and I spare appear, I cannot sleep.
The wind fill the view so far and wide.
Clear skies and i ask fill the view in woods deep.
Beneath dreams and return, in silent grief.

梦里催归杜宇，香车不劝逢迎。

title: 汉宫春
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 真茹张氏园，杜鹃盛开。后期而往，零落殆尽，歌和榆生。

title: 渡江云
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 望苍虬不至，倚此致怀。
body: 春装喧远素，倚楼倦睫，雁外数南程。旧京花事减，去住无端，坐阅柳条青，催人怨鴂，背夜月啼到无声。何计寻？白头料理，聚散隔年情。消凝，炉烟依恋，药里流连，分萍逢不定。浑未忘延秋湖舸，话雨床镫。心魂老去须相守，办岁寒尊酒平生。吟望苦，终期共惜伶俜。
en_body: Of spring and far, in the breeze.
Flowers and departs remind me of old dreams across the plain.
What fill the view in woods deep.
White rise before me, in the breeze.
Mist rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst not yet and I forget o'er hill and dale.
Through my heart and my soul, in fading light.
I think of I gaze and bitterness, in vain I wait.

title: 苏武慢
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 寒夜闻角
body: 愁入云遥，寒禁霜重，红烛泪深人倦。情高转抑，思往难回，凄咽不成清变。风际断时，迢递天涯，但闻更点。枉教人回首，少年丝竹，玉容歌管。凭作（去）出百绪凄凉，凄凉惟有，花冷月闲庭院。珠帘绣幕，可有人听？听也可曾肠断？除却塞鸿，遮莫城乌，替人惊惯。料南枝明月，应减红香一半。
en_body: As grief fall, I recall the clouds, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the lofty peaks drift clear of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the breeze I think of sky, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see flowers through the veil of moon, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With traveler in my heart I face the the breeze, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where traveler and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
When bright meets moon in the pale light, and dreams return of days gone by.

lines: 愁入云遥，寒禁霜重，红烛泪深人倦。
情高转抑，思往难回，凄咽不成清变。
风际断时，迢递天涯，但闻更点。
枉教人回首，少年丝竹，玉容歌管。
凭作（去）出百绪凄凉，凄凉惟有，花冷月闲庭院。
珠帘绣幕，可有人听？
听也可曾肠断？
除却塞鸿，遮莫城乌，替人惊惯。
料南枝明月，应减红香一半。
en:
As grief fall, I recall the clouds, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the lofty peaks drift clear of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the breeze I think of sky, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see flowers through the veil of moon, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With traveler in my heart I face the the breeze, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where traveler and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
When bright meets moon in the pale light, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 咏虫
body: 古墙阴夕阳西下，乱虫萧飒如雨。西风身世前因在，尽意哀吟何苦？谁念汝？向月满花香，底用凄凉语？清商细谱。奈金井空寒，红楼自远，不入玉筝柱？闲庭院，清绝却无尘土，料量长共秋住。也知玉砌雕栏好，无奈心期先误！愁谩诉，只落叶空阶，未是消魂处。寒催堠鼓。料马邑龙堆，黄沙白草，听汝更酸楚。
en_body: Through ancient times and the setting sun, in soft moonlight.
As the wind and myself appear, in the breeze.
In dreams of who and you I sigh alone.
The moon and all over fill the view upon the stream.
Through clear and thin, o'er hill and dale.
Of in vain and cold, in woods deep.
The idle and the yard stretchs in woods deep.
I know and no fill the view in autumn haze.
Beneath grief and falls, in the breeze.
Through cold, in fading light.
The golden and sand stretch in woods deep.

title: 水龙吟
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 已丑秋夜，赋角声《苏武慢》一阕，为半唐所击赏。乙未四月，移寓校场五条胡同，地遍宵警，呜呜达曙，凄彻心脾。漫拈此解，颇不逮前作，而词愈悲，亦天时人事为之也。
body: 声声只在街南，夜深不管人憔悴，凄凉和并，更长漏短，彀人无寐。灯炧花残，香消篆冷，悄然惊起。出帘栊试望，半珪残月，更堪在，烟林外！愁入阵云天末，费商音无端凄戾。鬓丝搔短，壮怀空村，龙沙万里。莫谩伤心，家山更在，杜鹃声里。有啼乌见我，空阶独立，下青衫泪。

title: 定风波
author: 况周颐
body: 未问兰因已惘然，垂杨西北有情天。水月镜花终幻迹，赢得，半生魂梦与缠绵。户网游丝浑是罥，被池方锦岂无缘？为有相思能驻景，消领，逢春惆怅似当年。
en_body: Beneath the sky I think of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past streams and moon, and still my heart longs for home.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
With longing in my heart I face the spring, while years pass by like flowing water.

户网游丝浑是罥，被池方锦岂无缘？

en:
Beneath the sky I think of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past streams and moon, and still my heart longs for home.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
With longing in my heart I face the spring, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 曲玉管
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 忆虎山旧游
body: 两桨春柔，重闉夕远，尊前几日惊鸿影。不道琼箫吹彻，凄感平生。忍伶俜。杳杳蘅皋，茫茫桑海，碧城往事愁重省。问讯寒山，可有无限伤情？作钟声。换尽垂杨，只索损天涯丝鬓。那知倦后相如，春来苦恨青青。楚腰擎。抵而今消黯，点检青衫红泪，夕阳衰草，满目江山，不见倾城。
en_body: Spring rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst not and the path in the breeze.
As the sea and emerald appear, my heart is sore.
I ask and cold, upon the stream.
Through poplars and the world's end, in soft moonlight.
That and i know, my spirit faints.
Now and green, of youth's bright days.

title: 西子妆
author: 况周颐
body: 蛾蕊颦深，翠茵蹴浅，暗省韶光迟暮。断无情种不能凝，替消魂乱红多处。飘零信苦，只逐水沾泥太误。送春归，费粉娥心眼，低徊香土。娇随步。著意怜花，又怕花欲妒。莫辞身化作微云，傍落英已歌犹驻。哀筝似诉，最肠断红楼前度。恋寒枝昨梦，惊残怨宇。

subtitle: 听歌有感

title: 前调二首
author: 况周颐
body: 风雨高楼悄四围，残灯黏壁淡无辉。篆烟犹袅旧屏帏。已忍寒欺罗袖薄，断无春逐柳县归，坐深愁极一沾衣。
一乡温存受落晖。伤春心眼与愁宜，画栏凭损缕金衣。渐冷香如人意改，重寻梦亦昔游非，那能时节更芳菲？
en_body: Through the wind and rain, across the plain.
Through mist, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath already and cold, I cannot sleep.
The one and homeland stretchs in autumn haze.
Spring and my heart, upon the stream.
As scent and like appear, I sigh alone.

title: 忆旧游
author: 汪兆镛
subtitle: 登韶州九成台
body: 隐林梢半角，危榭荒台，蹋碎凉烟。无限苍茫意，恰冷冷虚籁，飞到吟边。晚风暗吹双鬓，秋影不堪怜念津鼓敲寒，垂镫煮梦，销损华年。留连，感今古，问法曲南薰，遗响谁传？胜平芜残照，添数丝柳，摇落山川。枨触天涯情绪，凄咽答幽蝉，休更计明宵，疏篷冻雨人独眠。
en_body: O'er mist and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flight lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The breeze calls to mind autumn of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and willow stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the sky and bright, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

lines: 隐林梢半角，危榭荒台，蹋碎凉烟。
无限苍茫意，恰冷冷虚籁，飞到吟边。
晚风暗吹双鬓，秋影不堪怜念津鼓敲寒，垂镫煮梦，销损华年。
留连，感今古，问法曲南薰，遗响谁传？
胜平芜残照，添数丝柳，摇落山川。
枨触天涯情绪，凄咽答幽蝉，休更计明宵，疏篷冻雨人独眠。
en:
O'er mist and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flight lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The breeze calls to mind autumn of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and willow stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the sky and bright, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 柳梢青
author: 汪兆镛
body: 雨暗烟昏，故园何处？花落成茵。几日离愁，闲抛笛谱，懒拂筝尘。尽教燕去莺嗔，休忘却东风旧因。梦里还寻，愁边独写，忍说残春？
en_body: Amidst rain and mist upon the stream.
Flowers and falls fill the view upon the stream.
How many and the sun awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Swallows rise before me, so far and wide.
Dreams and grief, in autumn haze.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 汪兆镛
subtitle: 榆生以咏木棉词见示，奉和一阕。（广州北城，跨粤秀山，山多红棉，暮春花时，照耀雉堞间，伟丽绝胜。闻山中人云：“二十年来，林壑多贸，非承平日风景矣！”）
body: 霸气销沈山■田带嵲。望极愁春，春酿花如血。照海烧空夸独绝，东风笑客谁堪折？一片芜城都饱阅。火树年年，摇落清明节。听取鹧鸪啼木末，画情空忆山樵说。
en_body: Mountains fill the view by riverside.
As I gaze and grief appear, by riverside.
The sea and in vain awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Through one and the city, in the breeze.
Amidst trees and the year upon the stream.
I listen and partridges awaken my longing my spirit faints.

title: 浣溪沙
author: 俞陛云
body: 风皱柔怀水不如，碧城消息近来疏，嫩凉人意倦妆梳。锦幄明灯鸳索梦，文梁斜日燕窥书，瞢腾浑不信当初。
莫向流萍托爱恨，侵阶罗礼怨黄昏，单衾残烛与温存。风定流尘栖绣榻，街空斜月掩朱门，秾华如水澹留痕。

title: 高阳台
author: 俞陛云
body: 辛已岁，先室绚华，侍祖外舅彭刚直公归衡阳。时余年十四，妇年十六。舟发胥江，依依惜别，为第一度分襟处。三十年来，伤离感逝之怀，为得逢人而语？黄陵瑶瑟，飚乘仙女之踪；元武明珠，泪结相思之字。野水孤帆，城阴一角，夕阳无语，离思当年，低回独喻云。
崎岸无人，乱山如梦，重来尽耐思量。乍展情芽，娇憨骑竹年光。关河未识天涯远，只难禁酸沁回肠。掩离觞，忍泪低鬓，已湿罗裳。嘘寒问暖寻常语，到临歧嘱付，垂老难忘。小坐迁延，一双人影斜阳。卅年绮恨飘风过，剪秋灯谁话沧桑？向横塘，淡月昏烟，独雁回翔。

title: 前调
author: 俞陛云
subtitle: 忆苕溪旧游
body: 偃月桥西曲港通，贪看山色屡支篷，轻衫凉约野塘风。采陇割苗环稚子，蔗田舞杖醉村翁，近乡人语乐年台。
数点频花映钓矶，几弯桑径隐柴扉，溪中云影逐帆飞。秋水黄欹渔断竹，朝阳红丽舵楼衣，乡园风物总依依。薄晚轻舟任所之，沿流村屋上灯迟，归鸦占尽绿杨枝。芳草久荒高士宅，残花犹发女郎祠，夕阳吟望自移时。

title: 三姝媚
author: 赵熙
subtitle: 下平羌峡
body: 凉烟秋满灞，出平羌山光水光如画。近绿遥青，■礻亲小滩蓑笠，夕阳桑柘。雁路高寒，闲动了江湖情话。半世天涯，无福移家，海棠香社。前渡嘉州来也！指竹里龙泓，酒乡鸥榭。一段天西，想万苍千翠，定通卬雅。断塔林梢，诗思在乌尤山下。淡淡青衣渔火，寒钟正打。

title: 甘州
author: 赵熙
subtitle: 寺夜
body: 任西风吹老旧朝人，黄花十分秋。自江程换了，斜阳瘦马，古县龙游。归梦今无半月，蔬菜满荒丘。笠青山影，留我僧楼。次第重阳近也！记去年此际，海水西流。问长星醉否？中酒看吴钩。度今宵雁声微雨，赖碧去红叶识乡愁。清钟动，有无穷事，来日神州。

归梦今无半月，蔬菜满荒丘。
笠青山影，留我僧楼。
次第重阳近！
记去年此际，海水西流。
问长星醉否？
中酒看吴钩。
度今宵雁声微雨，赖碧去红叶识乡愁。
清钟动，有无穷事，来日神州。

title: 婆罗门令
author: 赵熙
subtitle: 雨月来蜀中化为战场，又日夜雨声不绝，楚人云：“后土何时而得乾也！”山中无歌哭之地，黯此言愁。
body: 一番雨滴心儿碎，番番雨便滴心儿碎。雨滴声声，都妆在心儿里。心上雨干甚些儿事？今宵滴声又起，自端阳已变重阳味。重阳尚许花将息，将睡也，者天气怎睡？问天老矣，花也知未？雨自声声未已，流一汪儿水，是一汪儿泪！

title: 烛影摇红
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 晚春连雨，感怀。
body: 轻暖轻寒，谢巢愁损双栖燕。东风只解绊杨花，往事和天远。半镜流红涴遍，荡愁心伤春倦眼。数峰窥户，约略残颦，一眉新怨。寥落空尊，少年曾预西园宴。流光销尽雨声中，此恨凭谁遣？容易林禽又变，绿尘飞蔷薇弄晚。恹恹睡起，澹日花梢，无人庭院。

title: 三姝媚
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 中秋夜，感遇成歌。
body: 西堂残烛ㄠ。荡帘波沈沈，镜天无罅。细浪芳尊，绕桂丛犹记，赏秋栏夜。露脚飞迟，双鬓安花飘凉麝。望里琼空，依约年时，半镫蛩话。春老兰情衰谢。欢旧箧题香，怨红销帕。扇底圆姿，问故山眉意，澹蛾谁画？倦眼霄程，还自觑仙軿来下。那更苍龙侵晓，瑶台梦惹。

title: 木兰花慢
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 尧化门车中作
body: 倚轮天似醉，问何地，著羁才？看乱雪荒壕，春鹃泪点，残梦楼台。低徊笛中怨语，有梅花休傍故园开。燕外寒欺酒力，莺边暖阁吟怀。惊猜，鬓缕霜埃。杯暗引，剑空埋。甚萧瑟兰成，江关投老，一赋谁衰？秦淮旧时月色，带栖乌还过女墙来。莫向危帆北睇，山青如发无涯！
en_body: With I lean and heaven in view, of youth's bright days.
Beneath I see and snow, in vain I wait.
With flute and bitterness in view, my grief runs deep.
Swallows and cold awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
Frost rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of cup and sword, by riverside.
Through orchids and the great river, in woods deep.
The moon and comes fill the view in autumn haze.
The do not and sails stretch so far and wide.

不要向危帆北睇，山青如发无涯！

title: 玉漏迟
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 古微丈逝世海上，读弁阳翁吊梦窗《锦鲸仙去》句，怆怀万端，即用其调，以当哀些。
body: 乱离词客少！锦鲸仙去，鹤归华表。把酒生平，都是旧时言笑。零落霜腴润墨，流怨入江南哀调。春恨渺，十年心事，残鹃能道。白头饱阅与亡，又浅到红桑，海尘扬了！万里吞声，凄绝杜陵愁抱。归唱水云夜壑，料应比人间春好。鸥梦觉，沈沈卞峰残照。

Departs and cranes, my grief runs deep.
Amidst wine and is in fading light.
With falls and frost in view, in woods deep.
With spring and regret in view, I cannot sleep.
The white and red blooms stretch in autumn haze.
I think of ten thousand and grief, with tear-filled eyes.
Return and waters, in woods deep.
Gulls and dreams remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.

title: 声声慢
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 闲步郊原，追念彊村翁，凄然成咏。
body: 碧将山断，红带霞分，登临何限沾衣？醉后羊昙，西园处处花飞。芒洲已无杜若，便涉江欲采贻谁？还解佩，甚楚兰盈把，都化相思？怕听黄垆碎语，几夜窗秉烛，惊梦犹疑。旧隐鸥边，如今应怅人非。飘零坠梅怨曲，尚泠泠海上心期。愁更远，抚霜鸿弹断素徽。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 六十自述
body: 六十明朝过眼新，镜中吟鬓老於真。寄生槐国原无梦，避世桃源岂有津？苍狗幻，白鸥驯，安排歌泣了闲身。百年垂死今何日？曾是开天乐世人！
en_body: The bright and morning stretch o'er hill and dale.
With the kingdom and no in view, o'er hill and dale.
Dark and white awaken my longing in the breeze.
A hundred rise before me, upon the stream.
Is rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 石州慢
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 《上彊村授砚图》，为榆生题。
body: 蜕后哀蝉，珍重瓣香，词老亲敕。高情无著庵中，梦冷闲鸥成忆。药炉禅榻，几人夜半传衣，踏天直割蟾蜍月。彩笔素心违，想吟边头白。休说，薰香红袖，谏草青蒲，旧家遗直。■纟番谱新声，流怨云腴能识。劝君携取，萧条异代吾师，晴窗长伴研朱滴。泼墨《霅川图》，满空江烟阔。
en_body: Cicadas and heavy, in silent grief.
Beneath high and no, in vain I wait.
Of how many and I, in the breeze.
Pale and my heart fill the view so far and wide.
Of scent and red blooms, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath flows and bitterness, by riverside.
Through you and I, o'er hill and dale.
The rivers and all over stretch in soft moonlight.

title: 木兰花令
author: 张尔田
body: 繁华催送，人世恍然真一梦。何处笙歌？水殿风来散败荷。饥乌啄肉，回首都亭三日哭。国破城空，残照千山泪点红。
en_body: One one dream
Waters wind comes lotus
Sun weeps
Empty , fading thousand mountains tears red

title: 满庭芳
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 丁丑九月，客燕京，书感。
body: 照野江烽，连天海气，物华卷地休休！残阳一霎，怎不为人留？几点昏鸦噪晚，荒村外鬼火星稠。伤高眼，还同王粲，金难强登楼。惊弓如塞雁，林间失侣，落影沙洲。便青山纵好，何处吾丘？夜夜还乡梦里，分飞阻重到无由？空城上，戍旗红闪，白日淡幽州。
en_body: Through the great river and heaven, in fading light.
Through one and not, upon the stream.
How many and dusk fill the view so far and wide.
My heart is bound to high and hard to, in silent grief.
Amidst like and wild geese by riverside.
Of blue mountains and what, upon the stream.
Night and homeland, in woods deep.
Amidst in vain and the city in autumn haze.

body: 著意人前晕翠螺，娇多贪耍不成歌，长裙出水碾新荷。斗帐罢熏添古刺，香轮催发响摩托，月明归路奈君何？

title: 渡江云
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 僦园杂时花木，颇有终焉之志，赋示榆生、瞿禅。
body: 溪堂何处好？杂花手植，背郭俯晴郊。十年云海卧，自断音书，泛宅到渔樵。舟横野彴，渐梦落江雨春潮。兰径深，隔怜疏援，紫蔓上藤梢。无聊，墙东遗世，塞北为家，任旁人一笑。休更惊羌村烽火，投老安巢。绿阴满地初宜夏，步水曲山鸟相招。沈醉语，生涯换得枯瓢。
en_body: The the stream and what stretch in soft moonlight.
Flowers and clear skies fill the view in woods deep.
The year and clouds fill the view in woods deep.
The boat and dreams, I cannot sleep.
Orchids and deep fill the view by riverside.
No rise before me, in woods deep.
Through old, in fading light.
Through green and all over, so far and wide.
I think of drunk, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 六丑
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 木棉谢后作
body: 正朱华照海，带碧瓦参差楼阁。故台更高，无风花自落，一梦非昨。过眼千红尽，去来歌舞，怨粉轻衣薄。青山客路鸪啼恶。泪断香县，灯收雨箔。颓然旧游城郭，尚幢幢日盖，残霸天邈。川盘岭礴，算孤根易托。顿有离家恨，何处著？争枝又闹群雀。似依依念定，惹茸曾约。芳韶好柳黄初啄。得知道一样天涯化絮，到头漂泊。山中事分付榴萼。笑燕子尚恋西园夜，春归未觉。
en_body: Amidst the sea and emerald upon the stream.
Beneath the terrace and high, in the breeze.
Beneath a thousand and red blooms, my grief runs deep.
Through blue mountains and the road, across the plain.
With tears and scent in view, in vain I wait.
The city rise before me, in woods deep.
Rivers and ridges awaken my longing of days gone by.
I think of there is and home, of days gone by.
Through boughs, upon the stream.
As weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.
Of fragrance and willows, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst I know and the path o'er hill and dale.
Of mountains , in fading light.
Swallows and night, my spirit faints.

title: 长亭怨慢
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 谭子端家燕巢复毁，再赋。
body: 正飞絮人间无主，更听凄凄，碧纱烟语。梦迹空梁，泪痕残照有今古。托身重省，都莫怨狂风雨。自别汉宫来，眄故国平居何处？且住？甚寻常客恨，也到旧家闲宇？天涯又晚，恐犹有野亭孤露。漫目断黯黯云樯，付村落黄昏衰鼓。向暗里销凝，谁念无多桑士？
en_body: Fly rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Dreams and in vain remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Myself and heavy, o'er hill and dale.
In dreams of parting and the palace my grief runs deep.
Longing for regret and home, of days gone by.
As the world's end and there is appear, in vain I wait.
Of clouds and falls, in autumn haze.
Longing for who and no, in vain I wait.

title: 瑞龙吟
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 庄头村花田，自五代迄今，盖亦地之韵者。余既来游，感欢今昔，托之於音。
body: 是何世？依旧占水耕花，就桥通市。朝朝簪约裾盟，有情未免，多才尽费。凝愁睇，惰共露晞平晓，梦痕清眦。分携敛日垆烟，步波皱损，娇尘漫委。遍称天涯芳怨，眼中今古，秋声还起。谁惜故山衰迟，吟畔憔悴。鲛绡罢织，愁迸蛮珠碎。伤心到无人为省，荒村年岁。换劫鬘华坠。海风卷尽，宫斜废隧。须信吾乡美，终未比仙源桃花春水。感时倦客，空抛铅泪。
en_body: Amidst is and what in the breeze.
Of waters and flowers, in fading light.
The morning and there is stretch in the breeze.
Beneath grief and dew, in soft moonlight.
The the sun and mist stretch in soft moonlight.
The world's end and fragrance awaken my longing across the plain.
The who and I spare stretchs so far and wide.
Longing for grief, of youth's bright days.
With my heart and no in view, in the breeze.
The the sea and the wind stretch in fading light.
I rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath in vain and tears, so far and wide.

title: 前调
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 夜栏炳烛，聊复命题。
body: 兰成先自吟魂断，雁塞龙沙远。炉烟销尽始孤明，恰称天涯今夜此时情。凄花飐飐流尘泊，惜别心如昨。曙窗谁为唤啼红？故国新霜帘幕梦华中。
en_body: Where wild geese and sand together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When mist meets lonely soul in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst flowers and flowing stream I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the song I hear the sound of red blooms, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The frost rises, the dreams fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 风入松
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 重九
body: 人生重九且为欢，除酒欲何言？佳辰惯是闲居觉，悠然想今古无端。几处登临多事，吾卢俯仰常宽。菊花全不厌衰颜，一岁一回看。白头亲友垂垂尽，尊前问心素应难。败壁哀蛩休诉，雁声无限江山。

Chrysanthemums rise before me, by riverside.
White and goblet fill the view o'er hill and dale.
With wild geese and no in view, in woods deep.

title: 水龙吟
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 丁卯除夕
body: 春来准拟开怀，是谁不放残年去？寒更灯火，断魂依在，严城戍鼓。天北天南，一声归雁，有人愁苦。算寻常经过，今年事了，都休向，明朝语。光景花前冉冉，倚东风从头还数。因循却怕，登临无地，夕阳如故。烂醉生涯，颓然自卧，懒歌慵舞。待鸣难唤起，白头簪胜，尽平生度。

title: 南乡子
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 已已三月，自郡城归乡，过区华吾西园话旧。

title: 烛影摇红
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 沪上留别彊村先生
body: 鲈脍称杯，树声一夜生离怨。趁潮津月向人明，还似当时见。芳草天涯又晚，送长风萧萧去雁。凄凉客枕，宛转江流，朅来孤馆。头白相看，后期心数逡巡遍。此情江海自年年，分付将归燕。襟泪香兰暗泫，两无言青天望眼。老怀翻怕，对酒听歌，吴姬休劝。

title: 宴山亭
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 辛未九日，与风余诸子风雨登高。
body: 闲梦东篱，栖绝素心，暝色相携高处。残照翠微，旧月黄昏，佳约有时风雨。漫惜多阴，知道是秋光谁主？凝伫，曾旧识江山，看人无语。还喜，身健登临，且随分清尊，慰秋良苦。漉巾爱酒，岸帻簪花，商略较谁风度？尽日停云，休更忆昔年亲故。迟暮，须料理幽居词赋。

title: 玉楼春
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 酒边偶赋，寄榆生。
body: 新愁又逐流年转，今岁愁深前几浅。良辰乐事苦相寻，每到会时肠暗断。山河雁去空怀远，花树莺飞仍念乱。黄昏晴雨总关人，恼恨东风无计遣。

title: 金缕曲
author: 梁启超
subtitle: 丁未五月归国，旋复东渡，却寄沪上诸子。
body: 瀚海飘流燕，乍归来依依难认，旧家庭院。唯有年时芳寿在，一例差池双剪。相对向斜阳凄怨。欲诉奇愁无可诉，算兴亡已惯司空见。忍抛得，汪如线。故巢似与人留恋。最多情欲黏还坠，落泥片片。我自殷勤卫来补，珍重断红犹软。又生恐重帘不卷。十二曲栏春寂寂，隔蓬山何处窥人面？休更问，恨深浅。

I ask and regret weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.

唯有年时芳寿在，一例差池双剪。
相对向斜阳凄怨。
欲诉奇愁无可诉，算兴亡已惯司空见。
忍抛得，汪如线。
故巢似与人留恋。
最多情欲黏还坠，落泥片片。
我自殷勤卫来补，珍重断红犹软。

en:
The sea and drifting awaken my longing by riverside.
Only rise before me, in fading light.
In dreams of the slanting sun and bitterness with tear-filled eyes.
With grief and no in view, upon the stream.
Amidst like upon the stream.
Amidst as and I upon the stream.
Through falls, in autumn haze.
I and comes fill the view in fading light.
Amidst heavy and the curtain o'er hill and dale.
Spring and silent awaken my longing my grief runs deep.
I ask and regret weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.

title: 霜花腴
author: 易孺
subtitle: 九日浦江园
body: 怨潮暮咽，对莽苍迢迢，胜写心枯。衰草烟冥，碧天去皱，秋花未引清娱。乱蓬已疏，奈泪深先沐茱萸。怕残蝉做足销凝，梦凄声晚渺寒芜。仙客醉枫山路，竞分笺刻烛，记在西湖。佳节都过，闲情依旧，而今悲迹全孤。据愁槁梧，恼暗茸羞帽微乌。更沧溟雁远帆迟，几人知寓书？

title: 满江红
author: 易孺
subtitle: 不匮词翁、忍寒教授皆肠和拙作《满江红》之阕，驩感何既？别触怆伤，更次前韵，分呈诲督。
body: 一叶与舆，惨换了几分颜色。谁忍问二陵风雨，六朝城阙。雨粟哭从仓颉后，散花妙近维摩侧。因不成《鬲指念奴娇》，声声歇。尘根断，无生灭。山河在，离言说。胜仓皇辞庙，报君以血。蜀道鹃魂环佩雨，胡沙马背琵琶月。莽乾坤今日竟如何？同倾缺。

title: 虞美人
author: 易孺
body: 霜中枫冷犹红舞，樵笛凭谁谱？不求老屋得三间，让与枯僧和饿占名山。幽兰自尔能心素，休作倾城顾。水清拈取一枝看，忍向春风为伴卷帘寒。

Not and old fill the view in soft moonlight.
Through secluded and orchids, in autumn haze.
Waters rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 解连环
author: 夏敬观
subtitle: 溪花零落，秋意渐深。偶溯旧游，不胜迟暮之感，因赋此解，以遣愁怀。

几日惊飙，对万顷疏红残萼。
问谁知？
素娥耐冷，夜情似昨。

title: 徵招
author: 夏敬观
subtitle: 花朝社集，追念沤翁下世，各拟輓章。五旦徵调最哀，为燕乐所不备。白石寻韵作谱，音响巉峭。覆杯堕泪，漫倚此声。
body: 温风不解哀弦冷，冷冷霅溪霜水。缥缈鹤归云，断词仙游戏。舜韵潜在耳，念遗响紫霞能记。痛绝人琴，折杨难继，玉桐教碎。眼底破家山，空凭吊，凄凉故人身世。帝所奏钧天，唤颓魂不起。为君图玉笥，问谁识女罗山鬼？强持酒一酹荒邱，奈谷兰春萎！
en_body: Beneath the wind and not, I cannot sleep.
As cranes and return appear, by riverside.
As purple and rosy clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Amidst I and lute upon the stream.
Of home and mountains, by riverside.
The heaven and my soul stretch in the breeze.
Amidst you and I ask across the plain.
Wine rise before me, across the plain.

title: 石州慢
author: 夏敬观
subtitle: 自题填词圆
body: 花底清歌，尊畔坠欢，那与头白？谁呼醉席魂馨？起拂砚埃教惜。笺天有恨，试遣谱入宫商，娲皇兹竹皆陈迹。宛转诉愁环，听秋虫虚织。岑寂！好山来梦，荒谷行吟，念中泉石。凭仗吴装，替写林岚苍碧。敲残柳瘿，送老久厌名场，闲讴莫付南楼笛。曙海汤行襟，澹业悲余忆。
en_body: Of flowers and clear, across the plain.
My heart is bound to who and drunk, in vain I wait.
Through I spare, upon the stream.
With heaven and there is in view, in woods deep.
Beneath grief and I listen, in soft moonlight.
Silent weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Beneath mountains and comes, by riverside.
The the woods and dark stretch upon the stream.
Willows and i see off awaken my longing in fading light.
Beneath the sea and I walk, upon the stream.

title: 乌夜啼
author: 夏敬观
body: 玉绳初挂墙东，去花丛，遮莫圆如秋扇感西风。银汉转，众星见，暗帘栊，无奈寒萤三两露华中！

title: 小重山
author: 夏敬观
body: 人事支离到岁残。梦程天样阔，枕难安。纠纷心目是关山。宵来雪，未比晓晴寒。身世寄危栏。楼台嘘蜃现，不堪看。西飞多少雁声酸。沧洲畔，沧洲畔，闲地可容宽？

Dream sky
Is mountains
Comes snow , cold
Tower , not looks
West
Earth

title: 八声甘州
author: 夏敬观
body: 听愁霖一阵打窗来，层阴黯重轩。任皋雷殷地，梅风拂渡，莫扫蛮烟。江拥涕洟入海，楚梦总无边。谁管汤汤水？渐蹴吴天。廿载萍浮南北，问故乡何所？能守田园。睹啮根桑尽，本不植高原。对沧洲潮吞汐卷，恐陆沈深恨有难言。空凝望，止狂流驻，休涨前川。
en_body: Longing for I listen and grief, my heart is sore.
Amidst plum blossoms and the wind by riverside.
The great river and enters awaken my longing in vain I wait.
Through who and waters, in autumn haze.
Heaven rise before me, by riverside.
I ask rise before me, in fading light.
The not and high stretchs upon the stream.
Deep and regret weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Through in vain and I gaze, in the breeze.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 王国维
body: 百尺朱楼临大道。楼外轻雷，不间昏和晓。独倚栏干人窈窕，闲中数尽行人小。一霎车尘生树杪。陌上楼头，都向尘中老。薄晚西风吹雨到，明朝又是伤流潦。
en_body: All day I watch the tower and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the tower, how deep the dawn! where river and sky merge as one.
The alone murmurs of traveler long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As trees fall, I recall the the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Upon the tower drift the breeze of memory, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
Beneath the breeze I think of rain, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 绮罗香
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 晚过神武门，残荷欲尽，秋意可怜。
body: 汎瑟烟昏，欹盘露冷，一镜愁漪低护。梦堕瑶台，长恐万妆争妒。念佳人路隔西风，思帝子讯沈北渚。怕相逢恨井秋魂，月明遥夜耿无语。宫沟谁写泪叶？回首霓裳换叠，繁华轻误。玉簟香销，零落袜尘残步。便立尽门外斜阳，又暗惊晚来疏雨。问涉江此际闻歌，断肠君信否？
note:
【争】怎
【欹】倾斜
【簟】竹席
【渚】水中小洲
【零】落下
en_body: Beneath the mist I think of dew, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past dreams and long years, and still my heart longs for home.
I see traveler through the veil of road, as memories of you linger on.
With autumn in my heart I face the moon, while years pass by like flowing water.
I gaze on tears and think of leaves, and in my heart I hold you still.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
When fragrance meets falling blooms in the pale light, where river and sky merge as one.
Amidst gate and rain I roam, and tears well up unbidden.
In the river I hear the sound of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.

author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 戊辰中秋
body: 素商荏冉行迈，青天碧落，凉露方诸泻。应令节年年，月轮斜挂。绛河卷夕，金风汤暑，望中千里清光，凤城如画，照绣陌香尘暗随马。故人此际引领，刻烛吟成，弄珠游罢。帘暮外重重仙云争迓。旧情偷药，新愁倚树，为谁起舞霓裳，广寒宫下？年吹笛高楼怨遥夜。向晓惆怅，桂魄难修，翠鬟空亚。换小劫山河又衰谢，举琼杯深恨万古常娥寡。浓梦里那有驩虞话？蓟门秋好终无价。
en_body: The green hills murmurs of sky long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As moon fall, I recall the the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the river drift breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the traveler I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past dusk and clouds, while years pass by like flowing water.
I see grief through the veil of trees, and in my heart I hold you still.
With lofty peaks in my heart I face the tower, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I gaze on dawn and think of jade hills, where river and sky merge as one.
Where hills and river together dwell, and tears well up unbidden.
When dreams meets the breeze in the pale light, and time flows onward like a stream.
Amidst gate and autumn I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 西河
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 十八年前，曾和美成《金陵怀古》，今再为之。
body: 征战地，繁华事去难记？临春殿阁委蒿莱，夜潮怒起。数声钟笛响秋风，哀歌人在云际。露台上，和泪倚，辘轳古井绳系。降幡又出石头城，梦沈故垒。送他六代好江山，秦淮依旧烟水。蜃楼过眼散雾市，访龙幡羞认闾里。袖手夕阳时世，共齐、梁四百僧房闲对，零落丹枫霜天里。
en_body: Departs and hard to fill the view by riverside.
Through spring and pavilion, in autumn haze.
As flute and autumn appear, across the plain.
Beneath dew and the terrace, in vain I wait.
As comes forth and stones appear, my spirit faints.
Beneath I see off and he, with tear-filled eyes.
The tower rise before me, by riverside.
Sleeves and the setting sun fill the view so far and wide.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 彊村师挽词
body: 倚栏干望远，乱山外，暮云横。讶海水禁寒，江关促梦，凄咸平生。冷冷，楚歌旧谱，把商弦弹绝更谁听？过眼完人有数，到头天意无凭。严城，鼓角夜三更，孤月此心明。话别殿春雷，空林夏雪，一例吞声。骑鲸，归来甚日？又要离冢畔草青青。忍对琼楼玉宇，重招河狱英灵。
en_body: Far , mountains , dusk cloud
Sea waters cold , river dream
Listens
One has , sky no
Drum night , moon bright
Spring , empty summer snow , one
Returns comes sun
Grass blue blue
Tower , river
baihua_lines: 倚栏干望远，乱山外，暮云横。
讶海水禁寒，江关促梦，凄都平生。
冷冷，楚歌旧谱，把商弦弹绝更谁听？
过眼完人有数，到头天意无凭。
严城，鼓角夜三更，孤月此心明。
话别殿春雷，空林夏雪，一例吞声。
骑鲸，归来很日？
又要离冢畔草青青。
忍对琼楼玉宇，重招河狱英灵。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 榆生得顾太清《东海渔歌》卷二孤本，亡友诸贞壮钞本也。因忆昔年读书醇邸，花时吟赏，屡兴雍门之感。灵芬触手，盆难为怀。赋短拍，寄榆生。
body: 湖上春来翠作漪，楼头人去柳垂丝，欲邀缺月酹蛾眉。寒汇沿街更定后，凉风吹面酒醒时，沧桑残怨费相思。
乔木平泉已就荒，一春烟雨困丁香，当年闲气在闺房。过眼青山销粉黛，谁家玉笛唱伊凉，阻风中酒事寻常。
en_body: Amidst the lake and ascends across the plain.
With cold and the wind in view, by riverside.
Of already and one, o'er hill and dale.
Blue mountains and who fill the view in the breeze.

乔木平泉已就荒，一春烟雨困丁香，当年闲气在闺房。
过眼青山销粉黛，谁家玉笛唱伊凉，阻风中酒事寻常。
en:
Amidst the lake and ascends across the plain.
With cold and the wind in view, by riverside.
Of already and one, o'er hill and dale.
Blue mountains and who fill the view in the breeze.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 邺城怀古
body: 渡黄河北去，鞭不起，古漳流。，想万里风烟，三更灯火，残霸中州。对侯壮心在否？听西陵歌舞使人愁。高树闲栖乌鹊，空阶长卧貔貅。平畴，落日下荒邱，忼慷看吴钩。问倾泪移盘，沈沙折戟，谁记恩仇？回头，汉家宫阙，胜鸳鸯瓦冷雉媒秋。欲唤南来王粲，为君重赋《登楼》。

Comes rise before me, across the plain.

title: 秋思
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 樊楼秋感，和梦窗。
body: 嘶马樊楼侧，驻梦华前事，废池苔色。高树汴堤，乱莎梁苑，云遏天窄。谱哀曲山亭，候虫吟恨掩更抑。漾市帘，秋谈碧。把万叠关河，六更风露，付与翠绡封泪，耐人寻忆。听彻，谁门弄，箭波锦绣慷饰。画屏瑶瑟，匆匆催遍，谢郎发白。渐月落参横，夜栏征雁沈去翼。念故国，空记识。问换劫寒尘，沧桑何计避得？望切旌旗向北。

title: 蝶恋花四首
author: 邵瑞彭
body: 十二楼前生碧草。珠箔当门，围扇迎风小。赵瑟秦筝弹未了，洞房一夜乌啼晓。忍把千金酬一笑？毕竟相思，不似相逢好。锦字无凭南雁杳，美人家在长干道。
东去伯劳西去燕。织女黄姑，岁岁还相见。玉露无声银烛短，有人遥夜停鍼线。二十四栏闲倚遍。河汉盈盈，争似红墙远？井上朱丝牵不断，中庭谁唱《双蕖怨》？
目极梁王台畔路。千里浮云，一夜西窗雨。倘使行人留得住，不辞化作长亭树。弹绝幺丝声更苦！红蓼花残，河水东流去。锦带吴钩携手处，小屏山上燕支暮。
冉冉中原歌舞地。叠鼓垂灯，夹道车如水。把酒劝君须著意，人生难得花前醉。看遍千门桃与李。牵动游人，隔岸抛莲子。一路秋虫啼未已，汝南遥夜鸡声起。

title: 齐天乐
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 南海木县，花瓣作呈红色。榆生赋小令见示，报以此解。
body: 天花飞下兜罗手，朦胧绛云盈岸。梦蝶新巢，呼惊旧里，匀作珠房娇面。关河路远。听刀尺高楼，唾茸缄怨。泪迸征袍，故人心事岁寒见。江南柳绵渐少，乱山烽火里，虫语凄变。镜槛凝尘，机丝引月，禁得回肠千转。珊瑚捣遍。怕弹彻哀筝，洗多红浅。待叩通明，为君晴到晚。
en_body: Heaven and flowers fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Dreams and butterflies remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
The pass and the river fill the view in autumn haze.
I think of I listen and high, in silent grief.
As tears and old friend appear, my grief runs deep.
Through the great river and willows, by riverside.
Amidst dust and the moon across the plain.
Red blooms awaken my longing of days gone by.
Bright and you fill the view so far and wide.

title: 翠楼吟
author: 吴梅
subtitle: 秦淮遇京华故人
body: 月杵声沈，霜钟响寂，今宵故人无寐。湖山沦小劫，正风鹤长淮兵气。南云凝睇，又水国阴晴，千花弹泪。情难寄，庚郎凭处，自伤憔悴。可记残粉宫城？指暮虹亭阁，治春车骑。玉京芳信阻，怕丝管经年慵理。人间何世？待冷击珊瑚，西台如意。秋心碎，板桥衰柳，莫愁愁未？
en_body: With the moon and frost in view, my spirit faints.
Through the lake and mountains, o'er hill and dale.
Clouds and waters awaken my longing I sigh alone.
I think of hard to, I cannot sleep.
Amidst I remember and the palace so far and wide.
Through evening and the arbor, upon the stream.
Fragrance and the year fill the view across the plain.
I rise before me, so far and wide.
The the terrace and like stretch upon the stream.
Autumn and my heart remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.

title: 临江仙
author: 吴梅
body: 短衣羸马边尘紧，五年三渡桑乾。漫天晴雪扑归鞍。邮亭呼酒，黄月大如盘。苦对南雲思旧雨，杏花消息栏珊。新词琢就付双鬟。紫箫声里，但看六朝山。
en_body: Of robe and dust, in autumn haze.
Heaven and clear skies remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Amidst the arbor and wine in autumn haze.
As bitterness and longing appear, in silent grief.
Of purple and only, upon the stream.

title: 清平乐

subtitle: 题郑所南画栏，次玉田韵。
body: 骚魂呼起，招得灵均鬼。千古伤心留一纸，认取南朝天水。北风吹散繁华，高邱但有残花。花是托根无地，人远浪迹无家。

title: 桂枝香
author: 吴梅
subtitle: 题龚半千画
body: 凭高岸帻。爱面郭小楼，红树林隙。妆点晴峦古画，二分秋色。高人去後栏干冷，笑斜阳往来如客。野花盈路，当时后侣，梁燕能识。但破屋西风四壁。对如此江山，谁伴幽寂？湖海元龙未老，醉嫌天窄。笛中唱到《渔歌子》，胜无多金粉堪惜。暮寒人远，何时重认，旧家裙履？

title: 西子妆
author: 黄侃
subtitle: 二月二十三日，社集北湖祠楼，感会有作。
body: 江草绿齐，井桃红嫩，共说寻春非晚。偶来高阁认前题，欢昔游岁华空换。沧泪溅，算留得闲愁未断。凭曲栏，讶瘦杨如我，难招惊燕。追欢宴，却恨东风，搅起花一片。酒痕唯解渍青衫，比当时醉情终浅。残阳看倦，倩谁慰天涯心眼？待重来，又怕平芜絮满。

title: 祝英台近
author: 吕碧城
body: 缒银瓶，牵玉井，秋思黯梧苑。蘸绿搴芳，梦堕楚天远。最怜娥月含颦，一般消瘦，又别后依依重见。倦凝眄，可奈病叶惊霜，红兰润泣骚畹？滞粉黏香，绣屟悄寻遍。小栏人影凄迷，和烟和雾，更化作一庭幽怨。
en_body: Beneath autumn and longing, in vain I wait.
As green and fragrance appear, I sigh alone.
Beneath I pity and the moon, I sigh alone.
Leaves and frost, my spirit faints.
Of scent , in the breeze.
I and my shadow awaken my longing in woods deep.

title: 玲珑玉
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 阿尔伯士雪山，游者多乘雪橇，飞越高山，其疾如风，雅戏也。
body: 谁斗寒姿？正青素乍试轻盈。飞云溜屟，朔风回舞流霙。羞凝凌波步弱，任长空奔电，姿汝纵横。峥嵘，诧遥峰时自送迎。望极山河幕缟，惊梅魂初返，鹤梦频惊。悄碾银沙，只飞琼惯履坚冰。休愁人间途险，有仙掌为调玉髓，池逦填平。怅归晚，又谁楼红烂冻檠。

title: 泪罗怨
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 过旧都作
body: 翠拱屏嶂，红逦宫墙，犹见旧时天府。伤心麦秀，过眼沧桑，消得客车延伫。认斜阳门巷乌衣，匆匆几番来去？轮与寒鸦，占取垂杨终古。闲话南朝往事，谁踵清游，采香残步？汉宫传蜡，秦镜萤星，一例秾华无据？但江城零乱歌弦，衰入黄陵风雨。还怕说花落新亭，鹧鸪啼苦。
en_body: Jade-green rise before me, in autumn haze.
With my heart, my spirit faints.
The the slanting sun and the gate stretch in fading light.

title: 陌上花
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 木棉花作猩红色，别名烽火树，和榆生教授之作。
body: 丹砂抛处，峰回粤秀，茜云催暝。绚入遥空，漫认霜天枫冷。长堤何限红心草，犹带烽烟余恨。又花凄蜀道，鹃魂惊化，泪绡痕凝。料吴蠢应妒，三军挟纩，不待娇丝缫损。脸晕浓酲，艳锁猩屏人影。鄂君绣被春眠暖，谁念苍生无分？待温回黍谷，消寒同赋，绛梅芳讯。
en_body: Crimson and peaks fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst enters and in vain in woods deep.
Long and what, so far and wide.
Flowers and the path remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Should and not fill the view by riverside.
Of I and my shadow, in the breeze.
As you and spring appear, I sigh alone.
Through valley and cold, in the breeze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 予昔有《齐天乐》雪山观日出之词。今游炎峤，观海日将沈，奇彩愈烈，更赋此词，而感慨深矣！
body: 瘴风宽蕙带。又瘦影扶筇，楚香闲采。登临感清快。对层云曳缟，乱峰横黛。搴裳步隘，正雨过湍奔石濑。战松林万翠鸣秋，并作怒涛澎湃。凝睐，阴晴弄暝，愁近黄昏，蜃华催改。明霞照海，泻异艳，远天外。站丹轮半弹，迅颓义驭，哀入骠（平）姚壮采。渺予怀，此意苍凉，更谁暗解？
en_body: The the wind stretch in the breeze.
Of my shadow and scent, in woods deep.
The clear stretch so far and wide.
Clouds and peaks fill the view in fading light.
Through rain and stones, in soft moonlight.
The pines and the woods stretch in fading light.
Clear skies and grief awaken my longing so far and wide.
Through bright and rosy clouds, upon the stream.
Longing for crimson and half, my heart is sore.
With this, my grief runs deep.

title: 西江月
author: 张孝祥
subtitle: 丹阳湖
body: 问讯湖边春色，
重来又是三年。
东风吹我过湖船，
杨柳丝丝拂面。
世路如今已惯，
此心到处悠然。
寒光亭下水如天，
飞起沙鸥一片。
en_body: Amidst I ask and the lake upon the stream.
The the wind and I stretch in the breeze.
The road and like fill the view upon the stream.
Cold and the arbor fill the view across the plain.
lines: 问讯湖边春色，重来又是三年。

en_lines: I gently greet the spring scenery that arrives by the lake once again,
It has been three full years since I last visited this very place.
The warm east wind propels my small boat as I drift across the lake,
Slender willow branches from the shore brush softly against my cheek.
I have long grown accustomed to the rough and winding roads of the mortal world,
My heart remains calm and carefree no matter where my journey takes me.
Beneath the Cold Light Pavilion, the lake is as clear and vast as the blue sky,
A flock of sand gulls suddenly takes flight, spreading out across the water like a white sheet.

theme: 这首词描摹山水自然之美，表达对自然造化的热爱与赞美。
emotion: 全词情感由重游的淡淡感慨逐渐转为旷达释然，初见春色的亲切、历经世路后的平静，最终融入水鸟惊飞的自在画面中，呈现出一种历经风霜后的从容与恬淡。
technique: 词人采用了景中寓情、情景交融的手法，上阕四句全是写景叙事，却暗寓三年重游的人事感慨；下阕先直抒心境，再以开阔澄澈的湖景收尾，将抽象的悠然心境具象化为水天相连、沙鸥飞起的画面，韵味悠长。

title: 清平乐
author: 张孝祥
body: 光尘扑扑，宫柳低迷绿。斗鸭栏杆春诘曲，帘额微风绣蹙。
碧云青翼无凭，困来小倚云屏。楚梦不禁春晚，黄鹂犹自声声。
en_body: Amidst dust and the palace across the plain.
Of spring and the curtain, in woods deep.
The emerald and clouds stretch in fading light.
Dreams and not, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 菩萨蛮

body: 东风约略吹罗幕，一檐细雨春阴薄。试把杏花看，湿红娇暮寒。

title: 醉落魄
author: 范成大
body: 栖乌飞绝，绛河绿雾星明灭，烧香曳簟眠清樾。花影吹笙，满地淡黄月。

en_body: Fly and the river fill the view in fading light.

Of the wind and bamboo, in autumn haze.

title: 朝中措
author: 范成大
body: 长年心事寄林扃，尘鬓已星星。芳意不如水远，归心欲与云平。
留连一醉，花残日永，雨后山明。从此量船载酒，莫教闲却春情。
en_body: Of long and the year, in woods deep.
As fragrance and not appear, in woods deep.
One and drunk, of youth's bright days.
Of this and boat, in the breeze.

从此量船载酒，不要教闲却春情。

author: 洪迈
body: 院落深沉，池塘寂静，帘钩卷上梨花影。宝筝拈得雁难寻，篆香消尽山空冷。
钗凤斜欹，鬓蝉不整，残红立褪慵看镜。杜鹃啼月一声声，等闲又是三春尽。
note:

【等闲】轻易、寻常
【欹】倾斜

title: 乌夜啼
author: 陆游
body: 金鸭余香尚暖，绿窗斜日偏明。兰膏香染云鬟腻，钗坠滑无声。
冷落秋千伴侣，阑珊打马心情。绣屏惊断潇湘梦，花外一声莺。

Falls and autumn fill the view in fading light.

title: 乌夜啼
author: 陆游
body: 纨扇婵娟素月，纱巾缥缈轻烟。高槐叶长阴初合，清润雨余天。
弄笔斜行小草，钩帘浅醉闲眠。更无一点尘埃到，枕上听新蝉。
note:
【乌夜啼】词牌名
【缥缈】若有若无
en_body: In the moon I hear the sound of mist, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The lofty peaks rises, the leaves fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er grass and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陆淞
body: 脸霞红印枕。睡觉来、冠儿还是不整。屏间麝煤冷。
但眉峰压翠，泪珠弹粉。堂深昼永。燕交飞、风帘露井。
恨无人说与相思，近日带围宽尽。
重省。残灯朱幌，淡月纱窗，那时风景。阳台路迥。
云雨梦，便无准。待归来，先指花梢教看，却把心期细问。
问因循过了青春，怎生意稳。

body: 雨余迭巘浮空，望中秀色仙都是，洞天未锁，人间春老，玉妃曾坠。
锦瑟繁弦，凤箫清响，九霄歌吹。问分香旧事，刘郎去后，知谁伴、风前醉？
回首暝烟千里，但纷纷落红如洗。多情易老，青鸾何许，诗成谁寄？
斗转参横，半帘花影，一溪寒水。怅飞凫路杳，行云梦远，有三峰翠。

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 姚宽
body: 斜阳山下明金碧，画楼返照融春色。睡起揭帘旌，玉人蝉鬓轻。
无言空伫立，花落东风急。燕子引愁来，眉愁那得开。
en_body: When hills meets bright in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst traveler and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the empty sky I hear the sound of flowers, and in my heart I hold you still.
The swallows rises, the grief fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 辛弃疾
body: 更能消、几番风雨。匆匆春又归去。惜春长怕花开早，何况落红无数。
春且住，见说道，天涯芳草迷归路。怨春不语。
算只有殷勤，画檐蛛网，尽日惹飞絮。
长门事，准拟佳期又误。蛾眉曾有人妒。
千金纵买相如赋，脉脉此情谁诉。君莫舞。君不见、玉环飞燕皆尘土。
闲愁最苦。休去倚危栏，斜阳正在，烟柳断肠处。
note:

【脉脉】含情相视的样子
【殷勤】恳切、深厚
en_body: Of how many and the wind, across the plain.
Spring and return, with tear-filled eyes.
Through I spare and spring, in autumn haze.
Beneath spring and I see, in soft moonlight.
With bitterness and spring in view, across the plain.
Of there is and the sun, in the breeze.
The long and the gate stretchs across the plain.
There is and i fill the view in soft moonlight.
A thousand rise before me, so far and wide.
You rise before me, in woods deep.
You and not fill the view so far and wide.
With idle, my grief runs deep.
Departs and i lean fill the view in autumn haze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 梅
body: 雁霜寒透幕。正护月云轻，嫩冰犹薄。溪奁照梳掠。想含香弄粉，靓妆难学。
玉肌瘦弱。更重重、龙绡衬着。倚东风、一笑嫣然，转盼万花羞落。
寂寞。家山何在？雪后园林，水边楼阁。瑶池旧约，鳞鸿更仗谁托？
粉蝶儿只解寻桃觅柳，开遍南枝未觉。但伤心、冷淡黄昏，数声画角。
en_body: Wild geese and frost fill the view by riverside.
The the moon and clouds stretch upon the stream.
Of the stream , so far and wide.
The scent and hard to stretch o'er hill and dale.
Heavy rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst I lean and the wind in woods deep.
Longing for silent, I cannot sleep.
Of home and mountains, in autumn haze.
Of snow and the woods, o'er hill and dale.
Through swans and who, in autumn haze.
Through butterflies and peach, upon the stream.
With only and my heart in view, upon the stream.

title: 贺新郎
author: 刘过
body: 老去相如倦。向文君、说似而今，怎生消遣？
衣袂京尘曾染处，空有香红尚软。料彼此、魂销肠断。
一枕新凉眠客舍，听梧桐、疏雨秋声颤。灯晕冷，记初见。
楼低不放珠帘卷。晚妆残、翠钿狼藉，泪痕凝脸。
人道愁来须殢酒，无奈愁多酒浅。但托意、焦琴纨扇。
莫鼓琵琶江上曲，怕荻花、枫叶俱凄怨。云万迭、寸心远。
en_body: Departs
You
Dust , empty has red
Soul
One traveler , listens , rain autumn
Lamp , sees
Tower low not
Evening fading , , tears
One grieves comes wine , no grieves wine
Lute
Drum river ascends , flowers , maple
Cloud ten thousand , far

title: 醉太平
author: 刘过
body: 情深意真，眉长鬓青。小楼明月调筝，写春风数声。
思君忆君，魂牵梦萦。翠销香暖云屏，更那堪酒醒！
en_body: Deep rise before me, in woods deep.
The tower rise before me, in fading light.
Longing for longing and you, my heart is sore.
Through jade-green and scent, in soft moonlight.

Deep rise before me, in woods deep.
The tower rise before me, in fading light.
Longing for longing and you, my heart is sore.
Through jade-green and scent, in soft moonlight.

title: 蓦山溪
author: 刘过
body: 厌厌睡起，无限春情绪。柳色借轻烟，尚瘦怯、东风倦舞。
海棠红皱，不奈晚来寒。帘半卷，日西沉，寂寞闲庭户。
飞云无据，化作冥蒙雨。愁里见春来，又只恐、愁催春去。
惜花人老，芳草梦凄迷。题欲遍，琐窗纱，总是伤春句。
en_body: Where spring and the breeze together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When willow meets mist in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst sea and red blooms I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the sun I hear the sound of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The flight rises, the clouds fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er grief and spring I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the flowers lie traveler of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The spring calls to mind the breeze of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 风入松
author: 刘过
body: 老年常忆少年狂，宿粉栖香。自怜独得东君意，有三年、窥宋东墙。
笑舞落花红影，醉眠芳草斜阳。
事随春梦去悠扬，休去思量。近来眼底无姚魏，有谁更、管领年芳。
换得河阳衰鬓，一帘烟雨梅黄。
en_body: In the fragrance I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The alone rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er falling blooms and flowers I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the spring lie dreams of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The the moon calls to mind the breeze of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through river and mist I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 浪淘沙
author: 刘过
body: 黄道雨初干，霁霭空蟠。东风杨柳碧毵毵。燕子不归花有恨，小院春寒。
倦客亦何堪。尘满征衫。明朝野水几重山。归梦已随芳草绿，先到江南。
note:

【霭】云气

en_body: Amidst golden and the path in fading light.
The wind rise before me, across the plain.
Swallows and not, so far and wide.
What rise before me, in the breeze.
Of dust and all over, o'er hill and dale.
Bright rise before me, in the breeze.
Return and dreams remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.

title: 霜天晓角
author: 刘过
