body: 绿云剪叶，低护黄金屑。占断花中声誉，香和韵、两清洁。
胜绝君听说，当时来处别。试看仙衣犹带，金庭露、玉阶月。

title: 小重山
author: 章良能
body: 柳暗花明春事深，小阑红芍药，已抽簪。
雨余风软碎鸣禽，迟迟日，犹带一分阴。
往事莫沉吟。身闲时序好，且登临。
旧游无处不堪寻，无寻处，惟有少年心。

title: 水龙吟
author: 陈亮
body: 闹花深处层楼，画帘半卷东风软。春归翠陌，平莎茸嫩，垂杨金浅。
迟日催花，淡云阁雨，轻寒轻暖。恨芳菲世界，游人未赏，都付与、莺和燕。
寂寞凭高念远，向南楼、一声归雁。金钗斗草，青丝勒马，风流云散。
罗绶分香，翠绡封泪，几多幽怨！正销魂，又是疏烟淡月，子规声断。
en_body: Flowers and deep fill the view upon the stream.
As spring and return appear, in the breeze.
Through the sun and flowers, in fading light.
Regret and fragrance remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
As silent and high appear, my spirit faints.
Of grass and green, in autumn haze.
Beneath scent and jade-green, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst my soul and is upon the stream.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 真德秀
subtitle: 红梅
body: 两岸月桥花半吐。红透肌香，暗把游人误。尽道武陵溪上路。不知迷入江南去。
先自冰霜真态度，何事枝头，点点胭脂污。莫是东君嫌淡素，问花花又娇无语。
en_body: I see shore through the veil of moon, and dreams return of days gone by.
With red blooms in my heart I face the fragrance, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on road and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where river and the breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When frost meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst flowers and the breeze I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 刘光祖
subtitle: 败荷
body: 晚风收暑，小池塘荷净。独倚胡床酒初醒，起徘徊、时有香气吹来。
云藻乱，叶底游鱼动影。空擎承露盖，不见冰容，惆怅明妆晓鸾镜。
后夜月凉时，月淡花低，幽梦觉、欲凭谁省？
也应记、临流凭栏杆，便遥想、江南红酣千顷。
en_body: Through the wind and lotus, so far and wide.
With alone and I lean in view, my spirit faints.
Through clouds and leaves, upon the stream.
Amidst in vain and dew in woods deep.
Night and the moon awaken my longing in woods deep.
Should and i remember fill the view in woods deep.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 刘光祖
body: 病酒厌厌与睡宜，珠帘罗幕卷银泥。风来绿树花含笑，恨入西楼月敛眉。
惊瘦尽，怨归迟，休将桐叶更题诗。不知桥下无情水，流到天涯是几时。
en_body: Of wine and the curtain, o'er hill and dale.
The wind and comes, in autumn haze.
Beneath bitterness and return, my spirit faints.
Not rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 眼儿媚
author: 洪咨夔
body: 平沙芳草渡头村，绿遍去年痕。游丝下上，流莺来往，无限销魂。
绮窗深静人归晚，金鸭水沉温。海棠影下，子规声里，立尽黄昏。
en_body: O'er sand and grass I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flowing stream lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The deep vales calls to mind traveler of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through sea and shadow I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

lines: 平沙芳草渡头村，绿遍去年痕。
游丝下上，流莺来往，无限销魂。
绮窗深静人归晚，金鸭水沉温。
海棠影下，子规声里，立尽黄昏。
en:
O'er sand and grass I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flowing stream lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The deep vales calls to mind traveler of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through sea and shadow I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 满江红
author: 岳珂
body: 小院深深，悄镇日、阴晴无据。春未足，闺愁难寄，琴心谁与？
曲径穿花寻蛱蝶，虚阑傍日教鹦鹉。笑十三杨柳女儿腰，东风舞。
云外月，风前絮。情与恨，长如许。想绮窗今夜，与谁凝伫？
洛浦梦回留佩客，秦楼声断吹箫侣。正黄昏时候，杏花寒，廉纤雨。

Spring and not yet awaken my longing my heart is sore.
Through flowers and butterflies, in autumn haze.
The poplars and willows stretch in woods deep.
Amidst clouds and the moon in the breeze.
I think of regret and long, my spirit faints.
The the window and now stretch across the plain.
My heart is bound to dreams and the tower, in silent grief.
Golden rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 生查子
author: 岳珂
body: 芙蓉清夜游，杨柳黄昏约。小院碧苔深，润透双鸳薄。
暖玉惯春娇，簌簌花钿落。缺月故窥人，影转栏杆角。
en_body: With clear in my heart I face the night, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on clear waters and think of deep vales, as memories of you linger on.
Where spring and flowers together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.
When moon meets traveler in the pale light, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 念奴娇
author: 张镃
subtitle: 宜雨亭咏千叶海棠
body: 绿云影里，把明霞织就，千重文绣。紫腻红娇扶不起，好是未开时候。
半怯春寒，半便晴色，养得胭脂透。小亭人静，嫩莺啼破春昼。
犹记携手芳阴，一枝斜戴，娇艳波双秀。小语轻怜花总见，争得似花长久。
醉浅休归，夜深同睡，明日还相守。免教春去，断肠空叹诗瘦。
en_body: Amidst green and clouds in autumn haze.
Through purple and red blooms, so far and wide.
Amidst half and spring o'er hill and dale.
The arbor rise before me, in the breeze.
Of I remember and fragrance, by riverside.
Light rise before me, in woods deep.
Drunk and return, in autumn haze.
Beneath spring and departs, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 江城子
author: 卢祖皋
body: 画楼帘幕卷新晴，掩银屏，晓寒轻。坠粉飘香，日日唤愁生。
暗数十年湖上路，能几度，着娉婷。
年华空自感飘零，拥春酲，对谁醒？天阔云闲，无处觅箫声。
载酒买花年少事，浑不似，旧心情。

title: 赋之。〕
author: 卢祖皋
body: 挽住风前柳。问鸱夷当日扁舟，近曾来否？月落潮生无限事，零乱茶烟未久。
漫留得莼鲈依旧。可是从来功名误，抚荒祠、谁继风流后？今古恨，一搔首。
江涵雁影梅花瘦。四无尘、雪飞风起，夜窗如昼。
万里乾坤清绝处，付与渔翁钓叟。又恰是、题诗时候。
猛拍栏杆呼鸥鹭，道他年、我亦垂纶手。飞过我，共樽酒。
en_body: Through breeze and willow I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The sun and boat stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the moon and falling blooms, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.
The breeze murmurs of flowing stream long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Upon the river drift wild geese of memory, as the west wind bears me home.
Beneath the snow I think of flight, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Long, long the road past clear and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on flight and think of wine, as memories of you linger on.

title: 倦寻芳
author: 卢祖皋
subtitle: 春思
body: 香泥迭燕，密叶巢莺，春晴寒浅。花径风柔，着地舞茵红软。
斗草烟欺罗袂薄，秋千影落春游倦。醉归来，记宝帐歌慵，锦屏春暖。
别来怅、光阴容易。还又荼蘼，牡丹开遍。妒恨疏狂，那更柳花盈面。
鸿羽难凭芳信短，长安犹近归期远。倚危楼，但镇日，绣帘高卷。
en_body: Of scent and swallows, in the breeze.
Of flowers and the wind, across the plain.
Grass and mist fill the view by riverside.
Drunk and return, of youth's bright days.
Longing for parting and comes, my grief runs deep.
Through crimson and opens, o'er hill and dale.
Regret and that remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Swans and hard to awaken my longing in silent grief.
Of I lean and the tower, in the breeze.

title: 清平乐
author: 卢祖皋
body: 镜屏开晓，寒入宫罗峭。脉脉不知春又老，帘外舞红多少。
旧时驻马香阶，如今细雨苍苔。残梦不成重理，一双蝴蝶飞来。

body: 柳边深院，燕语明如翦。消息无凭听又懒，隔断画屏双扇。

author: 卢祖皋
body: 香漠漠，低卷水风池阁。玉腕笼纱金半约，睡浓团扇落。
雨过凉生云薄，女伴棹歌声乐。采得双莲迎笑剥，柳阴多处泊。

Rain cloud , woman
Pair lotus smiles , willow

title: 谒金门
author: 卢祖皋
body: 风不定，移去移来帘影。一雨池塘新绿净，杏梁归燕并。
翠袖玉屏金镜，薄日绮疏人静。心事一春疑酒病，鸟啼花满径。
en_body: The wind and not fill the view in the breeze.
One and rain, upon the stream.
Amidst jade-green and sleeves upon the stream.
My heart and one fill the view o'er hill and dale.

title: 乌夜啼
author: 卢祖皋
body: 几曲微风按柳，生香暖日蒸花。鸳鸯睡足芳塘晚，新绿小窗纱。
尺素难将情绪，嫩罗还试年华。凭高无处寻残梦，春思入琵琶。

Evening , green small
Returns years
High no fading dream , spring longs for enters

title: 乌夜啼
author: 卢祖皋
subtitle: 西湖
body: 漾暖纹波飐飐，吹晴丝雨蒙蒙。轻衫短帽西湖路，花气扑青骢。
斗草褰衣湿翠，秋千瞥眼飞红。日长不放春醪困，立尽海棠风。

Sun long not spring , sea wind

title: 柳梢青
author: 张履信
body: 雨歇桃繁，风微柳静，日淡湖湾。寒食清明，虽然过了，未觉春闲。
行云掩映春山，真水墨山阴道间。燕语侵愁，花飞撩恨，人在江南。
en_body: Rain rise before me, in autumn haze.
Of cold and clear, so far and wide.
I walk and clouds fill the view in soft moonlight.
Swallows and grief, upon the stream.

title: 谒金门
author: 张履信
body: 春睡起。小阁明窗儿底。帘外雨声花积水，薄寒犹在里。
欲起还慵未起，好是孤眠滋味。一曲广陵应忘记，起来调绿绮。
en_body: Spring
Small bright child
Rain flowers waters , cold
Returns , is
One , comes green

一曲广陵应忘记，起来调绿绮。

title: 一翦梅
author: 周文璞
body: 风韵萧疏玉一团，更着梅花，轻袅云鬟。
这回不是恋江南，只为温柔，天上人间。
赋罢闲情共倚阑，江月庭芜，总是销魂。
流苏斜掩烛花寒，一样眉尖，两处关山。

Idle and i lean fill the view by riverside.
Through flows and candle, upon the stream.

title: 南歌子
author: 徐照
body: 帘影簁金线，炉烟袅翠丝。菰芽新出满盆池，唤取玉瓶添水买鱼儿。
意取钗重碧，慵梳髻翅垂。相思无处说相思，笑把画罗小扇觅春词。
en_body: The the curtain and my shadow stretch in autumn haze.
Comes forth and all over fill the view in fading light.
Heavy rise before me, across the plain.
With longing and no in view, by riverside.

title: 清平乐
author: 徐照
body: 绿围红绕，一枕屏山晓。怪得今朝偏起早，笑道牡丹开了。
迎人卷上珠帘，小螺未拂眉尖。贪教玉笼鹦鹉，杨花飞满妆奁。
en_body: Long, long the road past red blooms and hills, and tears well up unbidden.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With traveler in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on flowers and think of flight, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 阮郎归
author: 徐照
body: 绿杨庭户静沉沉，杨花吹满襟。晚来闲向水边寻。惊飞双浴禽。
分别后，重登临。暮寒天气阴。妾心移得在君心，方知人恨深。

title: 点绛唇
author: 俞灏
body: 欲问东君，为谁重到江头路？断桥薄暮，香透溪云渡。
细草平沙，愁入凌波步。今何许？怨春无语。片片随流水。

Of the bridge and evening, in woods deep.
As thin and grass appear, across the plain.
The now and what stretchs in soft moonlight.
Bitterness and spring, in fading light.
Flowing water rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 南乡子
author: 俞灏
body: 生怕倚栏杆？阁下溪声阁外山。
空有旧时山共水，依然。暮雨朝云去不还！
想是蹑飞鸾，月下时时认佩环。
月又渐低霜又下，更阑。折得梅花独自看。
en_body: Through I lean, in woods deep.
The pavilion and descends stretch o'er hill and dale.
Of in vain and there is, so far and wide.
Evening and rain fill the view in the breeze.
Through is and fly, in fading light.
Amidst the moon and frost o'er hill and dale.
As plum blossoms and flowers appear, I sigh alone.

title: 好事近
author: 刘翰
body: 花底一声莺，花上半钩斜月。月落乌啼何处？点飞英如雪。
东风吹尽去年愁，解放丁香结。惊动小亭红雨，舞双双金蝶。

Where breeze and grief together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When red blooms meets rain in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

Red blooms and no, by riverside.
The long and I remember stretchs in fading light.

title: 疏影
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 仲吕宫
body: 苔枝缀玉。有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。客里相逢，篱角黄昏，无言自倚修竹。
昭君不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。想佩环、月下归来，化作此花幽独。
犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。莫似春风，不管盈盈，蚤与安排金屋。
还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。等恁时，重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。
note:
【疏影】词牌名
【恁】如此
【盈盈】清澈美好的样子
en_body: The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the jade hills and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The sand murmurs of far horizons long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As moon fall, I recall the return, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the deep vales drift traveler of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.
Beneath the spring I think of breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Long, long the road past waves and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I see fragrance through the veil of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 玲珑四犯
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 黄钟商
body: 迭鼓夜寒，垂灯春浅，匆匆时事如许。倦游欢意少，俯仰悲今古。
江淹又吟《恨赋》，记当时，送君南浦。万里乾坤，百年身世，唯有此情苦。
扬州柳垂官路，有轻盈换马，端正窥户。酒醒明月下，梦逐潮声去。
文章信美知何用？漫赢得，天涯羁旅。教说与，春来要寻花伴侣。
en_body: Amidst night and cold across the plain.
With joy and young in view, in soft moonlight.
Beneath the great river and regret, in soft moonlight.
Ten thousand and a hundred, in silent grief.
Through willows and the road, so far and wide.
In dreams of wine and sober in silent grief.
I know and what fill the view in soft moonlight.
Through the world's end, in autumn haze.
Spring and comes fill the view upon the stream.

title: 琵琶仙
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 吴兴春游
body: 双桨来时，有人似，旧曲桃根桃叶。歌扇轻约飞花，蛾眉正奇绝。
春渐远，汀洲自绿，更添了、几声啼鷢。十里扬州，三生杜牧，前事休说。
又还是、宫烛分烟，奈愁里、匆匆换时节。却把一襟芳思，与空阶榆荚。
千万缕、藏鸦细柳，为玉樽、起舞回雪。想见西出阳关，故人初别。
en_body: Amidst comes and there is so far and wide.
Light rise before me, so far and wide.
Through spring and far, in the breeze.
As is and the palace appear, by riverside.
One and fragrance awaken my longing in fading light.
Through a thousand and ten thousand, in the breeze.
Longing for I see and comes forth, in silent grief.

title: 法曲献仙音
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 张彦功官舍
body: 虚阁笼寒，小帘通月，暮色偏怜高处。
树隔离宫，水平驰道，湖山尽入樽俎。奈楚客，淹留久，砧声带愁去。
屡回顾，过秋风，未成归计。谁念我，重见冷枫红舞。
唤起淡妆人，问逋仙，今在何许？像笔鸾笺，甚如今，不道秀句。
怕平生幽恨，化作沙边烟雨。

Through trees and the palace, in the breeze.
I think of grief and departs, with tear-filled eyes.
Autumn and the wind, with tear-filled eyes.
Who and i awaken my longing I sigh alone.
The I and I ask stretchs in soft moonlight.
Like rise before me, so far and wide.
Secluded and regret awaken my longing in silent grief.

树隔离宫，水平驰道，湖山尽入樽俎。
奈楚客，淹留久，砧声带愁去。
屡回顾，过秋风，未成归计。
谁念我，重见冷枫红舞。
唤起淡妆人，问逋仙，今在何许？
像笔鸾笺，甚如今，不道秀句。
怕平生幽恨，化作沙边烟雨。

Pavilion rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Through trees and the palace, in the breeze.
I think of grief and departs, with tear-filled eyes.
Autumn and the wind, with tear-filled eyes.
Who and i awaken my longing I sigh alone.
The I and I ask stretchs in soft moonlight.
Like rise before me, so far and wide.
Secluded and regret awaken my longing in silent grief.

title: 念奴娇
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 吴兴荷花
body: 闹红一舸，记来时、长与鸳鸯为侣。三十六陂人未到，水佩风裳无数。
翠叶吹凉，玉容消酒，更洒菰蒲雨。嫣然摇动，冷香飞上诗句。
日暮，青盖亭亭，情人不见，争忍凌波去。只恐舞衣寒易落，愁入西风南浦。
高柳垂阴，老鱼吹浪，留我花间住。田田多少，几回沙际归路？
en_body: The red blooms and one stretch in soft moonlight.
I rise before me, in fading light.
Of jade-green and leaves, upon the stream.
Scent rise before me, upon the stream.
The sun rise before me, across the plain.
Robe and cold awaken my longing in fading light.
High rise before me, across the plain.
Young and how many remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

title: 齐天乐
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 蟋蟀
body: 庾郎先自吟愁赋，凄凄更闻私语。露湿铜铺，苔侵石井，都是曾听伊处。
哀音似诉，正思妇无眠，起寻机杼。曲曲屏山，夜凉独自甚情绪？
西窗又吹暗雨。为谁频断续，相和砧杵？候馆迎秋，离宫吊月，别有伤心无数。
豳诗漫与。笑篱落呼灯，世间儿女。写入琴丝，一声声更苦。
en_body: My heart is bound to grief and I hear, I cannot sleep.
Dew rise before me, in fading light.
Longing for as and longing, of days gone by.
Mountains and night, in fading light.
Of the window and rain, in the breeze.
The who stretchs so far and wide.
Autumn and the palace remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Falls rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Enters and lute weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

title: 淡黄柳
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 客合肥
body: 空城晓角，吹入垂杨陌。马上单衣寒恻恻。看尽鹅黄嫩绿，都是江南旧相识。
正岑寂，明朝又寒食。强携酒，小桥宅。怕梨花，落尽成秋苑。
燕燕飞来，问春何在，惟有池塘自碧。
en_body: Through in vain and the city, upon the stream.
The ascends and robe stretch in the breeze.
Amidst I see and golden in autumn haze.
Beneath silent and bright, in fading light.
Wine and the bridge fill the view by riverside.
Amidst flowers and falls in the breeze.
Swallows and fly fill the view in woods deep.

title: 小重山
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 湘梅
body: 人绕湘皋月坠时。斜横花自小，浸愁漪。
一春幽事有谁知？东风冷，香远茜裙归。
鸥去昔游非。遥怜花可可，梦依依。九疑云杳断魂啼。相思血，都沁绿筠枝。
en_body: I rise before me, so far and wide.
Flowers and grief remind me of old dreams in fading light.
One and spring fill the view in soft moonlight.
The wind and scent remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Of gulls and departs, in the breeze.
I pity and flowers remind me of old dreams in fading light.
Through clouds and my soul, in soft moonlight.
Beneath longing and green, in fading light.

author: 姜夔
subtitle: 吴兴荷花
body: 枕簟邀凉，琴书换日，睡余无力。细洒冰泉，并刀破甘碧。
墙头唤酒，谁问讯、城南诗客？岑寂。高柳晚蝉，说西风消息。
虹梁水陌，鱼浪吹香，红衣半狼藉。维舟试望故国，渺天北。
可惜柳边沙外，不共美人游历。问甚时同赋，三十六陂秋色。
en_body: The sun rises, the the breeze fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er clear waters and the breeze I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the wine lie the breeze of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The the moon calls to mind the breeze of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through lofty peaks and willow I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The streams and fragrance stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the boat and sky, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the willow, how deep the sand! as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The autumn murmurs of the breeze long past, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 江神子
author: 姜夔
body: 东风吹梦落巫山。整云鬟，却霜纨。雪貌冰肤，曾共控双鸾。
吹罢玉箫香雾湿，残月坠，乱峰寒。
解珰回首忆前欢。见无缘，恨无端。惟悴萧郎，赢得带围宽。
红叶不传天上信，空流水，到人间。
en_body: Wind, blow, dream, fall, and mountain.
Cloud and frost.
Snow and once.
Blow, xiao flute, incense, mist, month, peak, and cold.
Return, head, recall, and joy.
See, without, regret, and without.
Only and belt.
Red, leaf, not, sky, ascend, believe, and in vain.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 姜夔
body: 小立东风谁共语，碧尽行云，依约兰皋暮。
谁问离怀知几许。一溪流水和烟雨。
媚荡杨花无着处，才伴春来，忙底随春去。
只恐游蜂粘得住，斜阳芳草江头路。
en_body: Through I stand and the wind, in fading light.
With who, in silent grief.
One and the stream fill the view in the breeze.
Of poplars and flowers, in woods deep.
The bees and the slanting sun stretchs in fading light.

title: 一剪梅
author: 姜夔
body: 唱到阳关第四声，香带轻分，罗带轻分。
杏花时节雨纷纷。山绕孤村，水绕孤村。
更没心情共酒樽，春衫香满，空有啼痕。
一般离思两销魂，马上黄昏，楼上黄昏。
en_body: The pass rise before me, in fading light.
The apricot and flowers stretch in autumn haze.
Beneath mountains and lonely, in vain I wait.
Amidst my heart and wine in autumn haze.
As one and longing appear, so far and wide.

title: 霜天晓角
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 蛾眉亭
body: 倚空绝壁，直下江千尺。天际两蛾凝黛，愁与恨，几时极。
暮潮风正急，酒醒闻塞笛。试问谪仙何处？青山外，远烟碧。
en_body: Through I lean and in vain, in soft moonlight.
Heaven and grief, in silent grief.
Evening and the wind fill the view across the plain.
I ask rise before me, so far and wide.
Blue mountains and far fill the view o'er hill and dale.

title: 昼锦堂
author: 孙惟信
body: 薄袖禁寒，轻妆媚晚，落梅庭院春妍。映户盈盈回倩，笑整花钿。
柳裁云翦腰支小，凤盘鸦耸髻鬟偏。东风里，香步翠摇，蓝桥那日因缘。
婵娟。流慧眄，浑当了，匆匆密爱深怜。梦过栏杆犹认，冷月秋千。
杏梢空闹相思眼，燕翎难系断肠笺。银屏下，争信有人真个，病也天天。
en_body: Of sleeves and cold, in autumn haze.
Through flowers, upon the stream.
Amidst willows and clouds in autumn haze.
The the wind and scent stretch upon the stream.
Through flows and I love, across the plain.
Beneath dreams and the moon, of days gone by.
Beneath apricot and in vain, of youth's bright days.
Amidst descends and there is in fading light.

title: 夜合花
author: 孙惟信
body: 风叶敲窗，露蛩吟甃，谢娘庭院秋宵。凤屏半掩，钗花映烛红摇。
润玉暖，腻云娇，染芳情，香透鲛绡。断魂留梦，烟迷楚驿，月冷蓝桥。
谁念卖药文箫，望仙城路杳。莺燕迢迢。罗衫暗折，兰痕粉迹都销。
流水远，乱花飘。苦相思，宽尽香腰。几时重恁，玉骢过处，小袖轻招。
en_body: The wind and leaves fill the view in soft moonlight.
Half and flowers fill the view across the plain.
The warmth and clouds stretch o'er hill and dale.
My soul and dreams remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
Who and i gaze awaken my longing my heart is sore.
The orioles and swallows stretch in autumn haze.
Through orchids, in woods deep.
Amidst flowing water and far in woods deep.
As bitterness and longing appear, my spirit faints.
Amidst how many and heavy so far and wide.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 孙惟信
subtitle: 牡丹
body: 一朵●红，宝钗压髻东风溜。年时也是牡丹时，相见花边酒。
初试夹纱半袖。与花枝、盈盈斗秀。对花临景，为景牵情，因花感旧。
题叶无凭，曲沟流水空回首。梦云不到小山屏，真个欢难偶。
别后知他安否。软红街、清明还又。絮飞春尽，天远书沉，日长人瘦。

Amidst red blooms and clear upon the stream.
Amidst fly and spring o'er hill and dale.

title: 南乡子
author: 孙惟信
body: 璧月小红楼，听得吹箫忆旧游。霜冷栏杆天似水，扬州，薄幸声名总是愁。
尘暗鹔鷞裘，裁剪曾荣玉指柔。一梦觉来三十载，风流，空对梅花白了头。
en_body: Month, red, tower, listen, blow, xiao flute, recall, and old.
Frost, sky, water, always, and sorrow.
Dust and once.
One, dream, feel, come, wind, flow, and in vain.

title: 绮罗香
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 春雨
body: 做冷欺花，将烟困柳。千里偷催春暮。尽日冥迷，愁里欲飞还住。
惊粉重、蝶宿西园，喜泥润、燕归南浦。最妨他、佳约风流，钿车不到杜陵路。
沉沉江上望极，还被春潮晚急，难寻官渡。隐约遥峰，和泪谢娘眉妩。
临断岸、新绿生时，是落红、带愁流处。记当日门掩梨花，翦灯深夜语。

Through a thousand and spring, across the plain.
As the sun and grief appear, my grief runs deep.
With heavy and butterflies in view, my spirit faints.
Amidst he and the wind so far and wide.
Of the great river and ascends, in autumn haze.
Peaks and tears remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
The bank and green awaken my longing in fading light.

title: 夜行船
author: 史达祖
body: 不翦春衫愁意态。过收灯，有些寒在。小雨空帘，无人深巷，已早杏花先卖。
白发潘郎宽沈带。怕看山、忆他眉黛。草色拖裙，烟光惹鬓，常记故园挑菜。
en_body: I gaze on spring and think of grief, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where lamp and cold together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When rain meets empty sky in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst pale mist and the breeze I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the hills I hear the sound of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
The grass rises, the mist fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 东风第一枝
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 春雪
body: 巧翦兰心，偷黏草甲，东风欲障新暖。谩凝碧瓦难留，信知暮寒轻浅。
行天入镜，做弄出、轻松纤软。料故园、不卷重帘，误了乍来双燕。
青未了、柳回白眼。红不断、杏开素面。旧游忆着山阴，厚盟遂妨上苑。
寒炉重暖，且慢放春衫针线。恐凤靴挑菜归来，万一灞桥相见。
en_body: Amidst orchids and my heart in fading light.
Of emerald and hard to, in autumn haze.
Amidst I walk and heaven upon the stream.
Not rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of green and not yet, in autumn haze.
Of red blooms and not, by riverside.
I recall and mountains, I sigh alone.
The cold and heavy stretchs by riverside.
My heart is bound to return and comes, of days gone by.

title: 东风第一枝
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 灯夕
body: 酒馆歌云，灯街舞绣，笑声喧似箫鼓。太平京国多欢，大酺绮罗几处。
东风不动，照花影，一天春聚。耀翠光、金缕相交，苒苒细吹香雾。
羞醉玉，少年丰度。怀艳雪，旧家伴侣。闭门明月关心，倚窗小梅索句。
吟情欲断，念娇俊知人无据。想袖寒珠络藏香，夜久带愁归去。
en_body: The wine and clouds stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the breeze, how deep the flowers! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The jade hills murmurs of fragrance long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the snow drift the breeze of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.
Beneath the gate I think of bright, and in my heart I hold you still.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I see cold through the veil of fragrance, where river and sky merge as one.

lines: 酒馆歌云，灯街舞绣，笑声喧似箫鼓。
太平京国多欢，大酺绮罗几处。
东风不动，照花影，一天春聚。
耀翠光、金缕相交，苒苒细吹香雾。
羞醉玉，少年丰度。
怀艳雪，旧家伴侣。
闭门明月关心，倚窗小梅索句。
吟情欲断，念娇俊知人无据。
想袖寒珠络藏香，夜久带愁归去。
en:
The wine and clouds stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the breeze, how deep the flowers! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The jade hills murmurs of fragrance long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the snow drift the breeze of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.
Beneath the gate I think of bright, and in my heart I hold you still.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I see cold through the veil of fragrance, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 黄钟喜迁莺
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 元宵
body: 月波疑滴，望玉壶天近，了无尘隔。翠眼圈花，冰丝织练。
黄道宝光相直，自怜诗酒瘦，难应接、许多春色。
最无赖，是随香趁烛，曾伴狂客。
踪迹，漫记忆。老了杜郎，忍听东风笛。
柳院灯疏，梅厅雪在，谁与细倾春碧。旧情拘未定，犹自学、当年游历。
怕万一，误玉人，夜寒帘隙。
en_body: As moon fall, I recall the waves, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the jade hills drift flowers of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the wine I think of spring, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past fragrance and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With breeze in my heart I face the the breeze, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on willow and think of lamp, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
When traveler meets night in the pale light, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 清商怨
author: 史达祖
body: 春愁远，春梦乱，凤钗一股轻尘满。江烟白，江波碧。
柳户清明，燕帘寒食，忆忆。
莺声晚，箫声短，落花不许春拘管。新相识，休相失。
翠陌吹衣，画楼横笛。得得。
en_body: Spring and grief, so far and wide.
Amidst the great river and mist upon the stream.
As willows and clear appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Of orioles and fallen blooms, across the plain.
Jade-green rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 史达祖
body: 二月东风吹客袂。苏小门前，杨柳如腰细。蝴蝶识人游冶地，旧曾来处花开未？
几夜湖山生梦寐。评泊寻芳，只怕春寒里。今岁清明逢上巳，相思先到湔裙水。
en_body: Beneath the moon I think of breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past gate and willow, and still my heart longs for home.
I see butterflies through the veil of traveler, as memories of you linger on.
With night in my heart I face the lake, while years pass by like flowing water.
I gaze on spring and think of cold, and in my heart I hold you still.
Where clear and bright together dwell, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 玉楼春
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 社前一日
body: 游人等得春晴也，处处旗亭闲系马。雨前红杏尚娉婷，风里残梅无顾藉。
忌拈针指还逢社，斗草赢多裙欲卸。明朝新燕定归来，叮嘱重帘休放下。
en_body: I see traveler through the veil of spring, and dreams return of days gone by.
With rain in my heart I face the red blooms, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on grass and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where bright and swallows together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 青玉案
author: 史达祖
body: 蕙花老尽离骚句。绿染遍，江头树。日暝酒消听骤雨。
青榆钱小，碧苔钱古。难买东君住。
官河不碍遗鞭路，被芳草将愁去。
多定红楼帘影暮，兰灯初上，夜香初炷，犹自听鹦鹉。
en_body: The flowers and old stretch in fading light.
Green rise before me, in fading light.
Amidst the sun and wine o'er hill and dale.
Green rise before me, in the breeze.
The hard to and you stretch o'er hill and dale.
With the river and not in view, I sigh alone.
Red blooms rise before me, in autumn haze.

title: 齐天乐
author: 高观国
body: 碧云缺处无多雨，愁与去帆俱远。倒苇沙闲，枯兰溆冷，寥落寒江秋晚。
楼阴纵览，正魂怯清吟，病多依黯。怕挹西风，袖罗香自去年减。
风流江左久客，旧游得意处，珠帘曾卷。载酒春情，吹箫夜约，犹忆玉娇香怨。
尘栖故苑，叹璧月空檐，梦云飞观。送绝征鸿，楚峰烟数点。

title: 金人捧露盘
author: 高观国
subtitle: 水仙
body: 梦湘云，吟湘月，吊湘灵。有谁见、罗袜尘生，凌波步弱，背人羞整六铢轻。
娉娉袅袅，晕娇黄、玉色轻明。
香心静，波心冷，琴心怨，客心惊。怕佩解、却返瑶京。
杯擎清露，醉春兰友与梅兄。暮烟万顷，断肠是、雪冷江清。

title: 金人捧露盘
author: 高观国
subtitle: 梅
body: 念瑶姬，翻瑶佩，下瑶池。冷香梦，吹上南枝。
罗浮梦杳，忆曾清晚见仙姿。天寒翠袖，可怜是、倚竹依依。
溪痕浅，云痕冻，月痕淡，粉痕微。江楼怨、一笛休吹。
芳音待寄，玉堂烟驿两凄迷。新愁万斛，为春瘦、却怕春知。

Grief and ten thousand awaken my longing I cannot sleep.

title: 祝英台近
author: 高观国
body: 一窗寒，孤烬冷，独自个春睡。绣被熏香，不是旧风味。
静听滴滴檐声，惊愁搅梦，更不管、庾郎心碎。
念芳意，一并十日春风，梅花晒憔悴。懒做新词，春在可怜里。
几时挑菜踏青，云沉雨断，尽分付、楚天之外。
en_body: Beneath one and the window, of youth's bright days.
Scent rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
I think of still and I listen, I cannot sleep.
Beneath fragrance and one, with tear-filled eyes.
Of spring and I pity, by riverside.
Through how many and green, o'er hill and dale.

title: 思佳客
author: 高观国
body: 翦翠衫儿稳四停，最怜一曲凤箫吟。同心罗帕轻藏素，合字香囊半影金。
春思悄，昼窗深。谁能拘束少年心。莺来惊碎风流胆，踏动樱桃叶底铃。
en_body: Through jade-green and I pity, upon the stream.
Amidst my heart and light in autumn haze.
Spring and longing, in autumn haze.
Of who and young, in fading light.
Of orioles and comes, in woods deep.

title: 霜天晓角
author: 高观国
body: 春云粉色，春水和云湿。试问西湖杨柳，东风外、几丝碧。
望极，连翠陌，兰桡双桨急。欲访莫愁何处，旗亭在、画桥侧。
en_body: Spring rise before me, across the plain.
I ask rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of I gaze and jade-green, upon the stream.
Longing for do not and grief, of youth's bright days.

望极，连翠陌，兰桡双桨急。
想要访不要愁何处处，旗亭在、画桥侧。

title: 风入松
author: 高观国
body: 卷帘日日恨春阴，寒食新晴。马蹄只向南山去，长桥爱花柳多情。
红外风娇日暖，翠边水秀山明。
杜郎歌酒过平生，到处蓬瀛。醉魂不入重城晚，秾欢寄、桃叶桃根。
绣被嫩寒清晓，莺啼唤起春酲。
en_body: Sun sun hates spring , cold
South mountains departs , long bridge loves flowers willow
Red wind sun warm , waters mountains bright
Wine
Soul not enters evening , , peach peach
Cold clear , spring

title: 谒金门
author: 高观国
body: 烟墅暝，隔断仙源芳径。雨歇花梢魂未醒，湿红如有恨。
别后香车谁整，怪得画桥春静。碧涨平湖三十顷。归云何处问？
en_body: Smoke
Rain flowers soul , red has hates
Bridge spring still
Lake
Returns cloud

碧涨平湖三十顷。
归云何处处问？

title: 玉楼春
author: 刘镇
subtitle: 东山探梅
body: 冷冷水向桥东去，漠漠云归溪上住。疏风淡月有来时，流水行云无觅处。
佳人独立相思苦，薄袖欺寒修竹暮。白头空负雪边春，着意问春春不语。
en_body: Waters and the bridge remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
The wind and the moon fill the view across the plain.
Beneath I and alone, of days gone by.
White rise before me, in fading light.

lines: 冷冷水向桥东去，漠漠云归溪上住。
疏风淡月有来时，流水行云无觅处。
佳人独立相思苦，薄袖欺寒修竹暮。
白头空负雪边春，着意问春春不语。
en:
Waters and the bridge remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
The wind and the moon fill the view across the plain.
Beneath I and alone, of days gone by.
White rise before me, in fading light.

title: 疏帘淡月
author: 张辑
body: 梧桐雨细，渐滴作秋声，被风惊碎。润逼衣篝，线袅蕙炉沉水。
悠悠岁月天涯醉，一分秋，一分憔悴。紫箫吹断，素笺恨切，夜寒鸿起。
又何苦、凄凉客里。负草堂春绿，竹溪空翠。落叶西风，吹老几番尘世！
从前谙尽江湖味，听商歌、归兴千里。露侵宿酒，疏帘淡月，照人无寐。
en_body: Amidst rain and thin so far and wide.
Of robe and waters, upon the stream.
With years and the moon in view, in woods deep.
Purple and pale, I cannot sleep.
In dreams of what and bitterness of days gone by.
Grass rise before me, in the breeze.
Of falls and leaves, o'er hill and dale.
As the great river and the lake appear, my heart is sore.
Of dew and wine, so far and wide.

title: 山渐青
author: 张辑
body: 山无情，水无情，杨柳飞花春雨晴。征衫长短亭。
拟行行，重行行，吟到江南第几程。江南山渐青。

body: 花半湿，睡起一帘晴色。千里江南真咫尺，醉中归梦直。

title: 念奴娇
author: 张辑
body: 嫩凉生晓，怪今得朝，湖上秋风无迹。古寺桂香山色外，肠断幽丛金碧。
骤雨俄来，苍烟不见，苔径孤吟屐。系船高柳，晚蝉嘶破愁寂。
且约携酒高歌，与鸥相好，分坐渔矶石。算只藕花知我意，犹把红芳留客。
楼阁空蒙，管弦清润，一水盈盈隔。不如休去，月悬良夜千尺。

Boat and high, across the plain.

Flowers rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst the tower and pavilion in soft moonlight.
Through not and like, by riverside.

title: 祝英台近
author: 张辑
body: 竹间棋，池上字，风日共清美。谁道春深，湘绿涨沙觜。
更添杨柳无情，恨烟颦雨，却不把、扁舟偷系。
去千里。明日知几重山，后朝几重水。对酒相思，争似且留醉。
奈何琴剑匆匆，而今心事，在月夜、杜鹃声里。

title: 木兰花令

title: 定风波
author: 李泳
body: 点点行人趁落晖，摇摇烟艇出渔扉。一路水香流不断，零乱，春潮绿浸野蔷薇。
南去北来愁几许，登临怀古欲沾衣。试问越王歌舞地，佳丽，只今惟有鹧鸪啼。

One and the road fill the view across the plain.
Departs and comes remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Amidst I ask and now across the plain.

title: 祝英台近
author: 王嵎
body: 柳烟浓，花露重，合是醉时候。楼倚花梢，长记小垂手。
谁教钗燕轻分，镜鸾慵舞，是孤负、几番晴昼。
自别后，闻道花底花前，多是两眉皱。又说新来，比似旧时瘦。
须知两意常存，相逢终有。莫谩被、春光僝僽。

title: 夜行船

body: 曲水溅裙三月二。马如龙，钿车如水。
风扬游丝，日烘晴昼，人共海棠俱醉。
客里光阴难可意，扫芳尘，旧游谁记。
午梦醒来，不觉小窗人静，春在卖花声里。

Waters

Traveler , dust
Dream comes , not small one still , spring flowers

title: 尉迟杯
author: 蔡松年
body: 紫云暖，恨翠雏、珠树双栖晚。小花静院逢迎，的的风流心眼。

title: 高阳台
author: 蔡松年
subtitle: 除夕
body: 频听银签，重燃绛蜡，年华衮衮惊心。饯旧迎新，能消几刻光阴。
老来可惯通宵饮，待不眠、还怕寒侵。掩清樽，多谢梅花，伴我微吟。
邻娃已试春妆了，更蜂枝簇翠，燕股横金。勾引春风，也知芳意难禁。
朱颜那有年年好，逞艳游、赢取如今。恣登临，残雪楼台，迟日园林。

body: 裙色草初青，鸭鸭波轻。试花霏雨湿春晴。三十六梯人不到，独唤瑶筝。
艇子忆逢迎，依旧多情。朱门只合锁娉婷。却逐彩鸾归去路，香陌春城。

My heart is bound to I and not, my grief runs deep.

The gate rise before me, in fading light.
Beneath return and departs, in fading light.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 海棠
body: 甚春来、冷烟凄雨，朝朝迟了芳信。蓦然作暖晴三日，又觉万姝娇困。
天怎忍。潘令老，不成也没看花分。
才情减尽，怅玉局飞仙，石湖绝笔，辜负这风韵。
倾城色，懊恼佳人薄命，墙头岑寂谁问？东风日暮无聊赖，吹得燕支成粉。
君细认，花共酒，古来二事天尤吝。年光去迅。
漫绿叶成阴，青苔满地，做取异时恨。
en_body: Spring and comes fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst warmth and clear skies o'er hill and dale.
Amidst heaven in autumn haze.
Amidst old and not by riverside.
Fly and stones fill the view in autumn haze.
The city and i weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.
Through the wind and the sun, so far and wide.
The you and thin stretchs across the plain.
Of the year and departs, by riverside.
Green and leaves remind me of old dreams across the plain.

subtitle: 海棠为风雨所损

title: 生查子
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 灯夕戏陈敬叟
body: 繁灯夺霁华，戏鼓侵明灭。物色旧时同，情味中年别。
浅画镜中眉，深拜楼中月。人散市声收，渐入愁时节。
en_body: The lamp and bright fill the view in the breeze.
The year and parting remind me of old dreams in fading light.
Deep and the tower fill the view so far and wide.
I and scatters weigh on my soul, of days gone by.

title: 满江红
author: 吴潜
subtitle: 金陵乌衣园
body: 柳带榆钱，又还过、清明寒食。天一笑、满园罗绮，满城箫笛。
花树得晴红欲染，远山过雨青如滴。问江南池馆有谁来？江南客。
乌衣巷，今犹昔。乌衣事，今难觅。但年年燕子，晚烟斜日。
抖擞一春尘土债，悲凉万古英雄迹。且芳樽随分趁芳时，休虚掷。
en_body: The willows and clear stretch so far and wide.
Heaven rise before me, by riverside.
The flowers and trees stretch in the breeze.
Through I ask and the great river, in the breeze.
Of the great river , so far and wide.
Robe rise before me, in the breeze.
The robe and now stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Only rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
With one and spring in view, in soft moonlight.
Amidst fragrance in autumn haze.

花树得晴红欲染，远山过雨青如滴。
问江南池馆有谁来？
江南客。
乌衣巷，今犹昔。
乌衣事，今难觅。
但年年燕子，晚烟斜日。
抖擞一春尘土债，悲凉万古英雄迹。
且芳樽随分趁芳时，休虚掷。
en:
The willows and clear stretch so far and wide.
Heaven rise before me, by riverside.
The flowers and trees stretch in the breeze.
Through I ask and the great river, in the breeze.
Of the great river , so far and wide.
Robe rise before me, in the breeze.
The robe and now stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Only rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
With one and spring in view, in soft moonlight.
Amidst fragrance in autumn haze.

title: 南柯子
author: 吴潜
body: 池水凝新碧，阑花驻老红。有人独倚画桥东。手把一枝杨柳系春风。

title: 霓裳中序第一
author: 吴潜
subtitle: 茉莉
body: 青颦粲素靥，海国仙人偏耐热。餐尽香风露屑，便万里凌空，肯凭莲叶。
盈盈步月，悄似怜轻去瑶阙。人何在，忆渠痴小，点点爱轻绝。
愁绝，旧游轻别，忍重看锁香金箧。凄凉今夜簟席，怕杳杳诗魂真化风蝶。
冷香清到骨，梦十里，梅花霁雪。归来也，厌厌心事，自共素娥说。

Beneath scent and clear, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to return and comes, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 眼儿媚

body: 垂杨袅袅蘸清漪，明绿染春丝。市桥紧马，旗亭沽酒，无限相思。

title: 唐多令
author: 吴潜
subtitle: 苕溪有牧之之感
body: 苹末转清商，溪声供夕凉。缓传杯，催唤红妆。
慢绾乌云新浴罢，裙拂地，水沉香。
歌短旧情长，重来惊鬓霜。怅绿阴青子成双！
说着前欢佯不睬，扬莲子，打鸳鸯。

title: 忆旧游慢
author: 赵以夫
subtitle: 荷花
body: 望红蕖影里，冉冉斜阳，十里沙平。唤起江湖梦，向沙鸥住处。细说前盟。
水乡六月无暑，寒玉散清冰，笑老去心情，也将醉眼，镇为花青。
亭亭步明镜，似月浸华清。人在秋庭。照夜银河落，想粉香湿露，恩泽亲承。
十洲缥缈何许，风引彩舟行。尚忆得西施余情，袅袅烟水汀。

body: 吟院静，迟日自行花影。熏透水沉云满鼎，晚妆窥露井。

title: 江神子
author: 方岳
subtitle: 牡丹

只恨谪仙浑懒却，辜负却，倚阑人。

title: 八六子
author: 周晋
subtitle: 牡丹次白云韵
body: 怨残红，夜来无赖，雨催春去匆匆。
但暗水新流芳恨，蝶凄蜂惨，千林嫩绿迷空。
那知国色还逢，柔弱华清扶倦，轻盈洛浦临风。
细认得、凝妆点脂匀粉，露蝉耸翠，蕊金团玉成丛。
几许愁随笑解，一声歌转春融。眼朦胧，凭栏杆半醒醉中。

In dreams of half and sober with tear-filled eyes.

title: 一枝春
author: 周晋
subtitle: 除夕
body: 竹爆惊春，竞喧填、夜起千门箫鼓。流苏帐暖，翠鼎缓腾香雾。
停杯未举。奈刚要、送年新句。应自有、歌字清圆，未夸上林莺语。
从他岁穷日暮。纵闲愁、怎减刘郎风度？屠苏办了，迤逦柳欺梅妒。
宫壶未晓，早骄马、绣车盈路。还又把月夜花朝，自今细数。

title: 被花恼
author: 周晋
subtitle: 自度腔
body: 疏疏宿雨酿寒轻，帘幕静垂清晓。宝鸭微温瑞烟少。
檐声不动，春禽对语，梦怯频惊觉。欹珀枕，倚银床，半窗花影明东照。
惆怅夜来风，生怕娇香混瑶草。披衣便起，小径回廊，处处多行到。
正千红万紫竞芳妍，又还似、年时被花恼。蓦忽地，省得而今双鬓老！
en_body: Rain rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst mist and young in the breeze.
Not and spring, in soft moonlight.
The I lean and half stretch in soft moonlight.
Night rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst robe and I walk across the plain.
A thousand rise before me, in the breeze.
Now and old fill the view in the breeze.

title: 齐天乐
author: 翁孟寅
subtitle: 元夕
body: 红香十里铜驼梦，如今旧游重省。节序飘零，欢娱老大，慵立灯光蟾影。
伤心对景。怕回首东风，雨晴难准。曲巷幽坊，管弦一片笑相近。
飞棚浮动翠葆，看金钗半溜，春妒红粉。凤辇鳌山，云收雾敛，迤逦铜壶漏迥。
霜风渐紧，展一幅青绡，争悬孤镜。带醉扶归，晓酲春梦稳。
en_body: Beneath red blooms and scent, in woods deep.
Of drifting and joy, so far and wide.
In dreams of my heart with tear-filled eyes.
Of the wind and rain, upon the stream.
Of secluded and one, in fading light.
Of fly and jade-green, by riverside.
Of mountains and clouds, in autumn haze.
Beneath frost and the wind, in fading light.
As drunk and return appear, my heart is sore.

曲巷幽坊，管弦一片笑相近。
飞棚浮动翠葆，看金钗半溜，春妒红粉。
凤辇鳌山，云收雾敛，迤逦铜壶漏迥。
霜风渐紧，展一幅青绡，争悬孤镜。

title: 烛影摇红
author: 翁孟寅
body: 楼倚春城，锁窗曾共巢春燕。人生好梦逐春风，不似杨花健。
旧事如天渐远，奈情丝、牵愁未断。镜尘埋恨，带粉栖香，曲屏寒浅。
环佩空归，故园羞见桃花面。轻烟残照下栏杆，独自疏帘卷。
一信狂风又晚，海棠花、随风满院。乱鸦归后，杜宇啼时，一声声怨。
en_body: Of the tower and I lean, in fading light.
With I and dreams in view, of youth's bright days.
With like and heaven in view, by riverside.
Dust and regret awaken my longing in silent grief.
In vain and return remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
Beneath light and mist, upon the stream.
Of one and the wind, in the breeze.
With crows and return in view, I sigh alone.

title: 阮郎归
author: 翁孟寅
body: 月高楼外柳花明，单衣怯露零。小桥灯影落残星，寒烟蘸水萍。
歌袖窄，舞鬟轻，梨花梦满城。落红啼鸟两无情，春愁添晓酲。
en_body: Through the moon and high, o'er hill and dale.
The bridge rise before me, across the plain.
Beneath sleeves and light, in soft moonlight.
As falls and red blooms appear, in the breeze.

title: 梅花引
author: 翁孟寅
body: 对花时节不曾欢，见花残，任花残。小约帘栊，一面受春寒。
题破玉笺双喜鹊，香烬冷，绕云屏，浑是山。
待眠未眠，事万千。也问天，也恨天。髻儿半偏，绣裙儿宽了还宽。
自取红毡，重坐暖金船。惟有月知君去处，今夜月，照秦楼，第几间？
en_body: Through flowers and not, upon the stream.
Through the curtain and one, in woods deep.
Glad rise before me, by riverside.
Not yet and ten thousand fill the view so far and wide.
I ask and heaven remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
Half fill the view in autumn haze.
Red blooms and heavy fill the view in soft moonlight.
There is rise before me, in fading light.

title: 梦江南
author: 翁孟寅
body: 帘不卷，细雨熟樱桃。数点霁霞天又晓，一痕凉月酒初消，风紧絮花高。
萧闲处，磨尽少年豪。昨梦醉来骑白鹿，满湖春水段家桥，濯发听吹箫。

Sky , one moon wine , wind flowers high
Years
Dream comes white , lake spring waters bridge , listens

title: 恋绣衾
author: 翁孟寅
body: 柳丝空有万千条，系不住、溪头画桡，想今宵也对新月，过轻寒何处小桥？
玉箫台榭春多少？溜啼痕盈、脸霞未消。怪别来燕支慵傅，被东风偷在杏梢。
en_body: Willows rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst the terrace and spring across the plain.

title: 汉宫春
author: 翁孟寅
body: 着破荷衣，笑西风吹我，又落西湖。湖间旧时饮者，今与谁俱？
山山映带，似携来、画卷重舒。三十里、芙蓉步障，依然红翠相扶。
一目清无留处，任屋浮天上，身集空虚。残烧夕阳过雁，点点疏疏。
故人老大，好襟怀、消减全无。慢赢得、秋声两耳，冷泉亭下骑驴。
en_body: The lotus and robe stretch in soft moonlight.
The lake rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of mountains and as, in the breeze.
Amidst red blooms and jade-green in fading light.
Of one and clear, across the plain.
Through the setting sun and wild geese, in fading light.
I think of old friend and old, with tear-filled eyes.
Through autumn and the arbor, upon the stream.

title: 喜迁莺
author: 冯去非
body: 凉生遥渚，正绿芰擎霜，黄花招雨。雁外渔灯，蛩边蟹舍，绛叶表秋来路。
世事不离双鬓，远梦偏欺孤旅。送望眼，但凭舷微笑，书空无语。
慵看清镜里。十载征尘，长把朱颜污。借箸清油，挥毫紫塞，旧事不堪重举！
间阔故山猿鹤，冷落同盟鸥鹭。倦游也，便樯云柂月，浩歌归去。
en_body: Green rise before me, in autumn haze.
Wild geese and the lamp fill the view in autumn haze.
Longing for not and far, my spirit faints.
Beneath I see off and I gaze, I sigh alone.
The I see and clear stretch upon the stream.
Amidst dust and long so far and wide.
The clear and purple stretch in autumn haze.
Through mountains and cranes, so far and wide.
Clouds and the moon awaken my longing across the plain.

title: 鹧鸪天

body: 翠凤金鸾绣欲成。沈香亭下款新晴。绿随杨柳阴边去，红踏桃花片上行。
莺意绪，蝶心情，一时分付小银筝。归来玉醉花柔困，月滤窗纱约半更。

title: 后庭花
author: 许棐
body: 一春不识西湖面，翠羞红倦。雨窗和泪摇湘管，意长笺短。
知心惟有雕梁燕，自来相伴。东风不管琵琶怨，落花吹遍。
en_body: I gaze on spring and think of lake, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where rain and tears together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When heart meets swallows in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst breeze and falling blooms I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 许棐
body: 湿云黏雁影，望征路，愁迷离绪难整。千金买光景，但疏钟催晓，乱鸦啼暝。
花悰暗省，许多情、相逢梦境。便行云都不归来，也合寄将音信。
孤迥。盟鸾心在，跨鹤程高，后期无准。情丝待翦，翻惹得，旧时恨。
怕天教何处，参差双燕，还染残朱剩粉。对菱花与说相思，看谁瘦损。
en_body: Clouds and wild geese, in woods deep.
A thousand and only fill the view across the plain.
Flowers and i meet remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
As I walk and clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for lonely, in vain I wait.
Through my heart and cranes, upon the stream.
In dreams of regret my grief runs deep.
The heaven and what stretch upon the stream.
Beneath flowers and longing, in woods deep.

title: 八声甘州
author: 赵希迈
subtitle: 竹西怀古
body: 寒云飞，万里一番秋，一番搅离怀。向隋堤跃马，前时柳色，今度蒿莱。
锦缆残香在否，枉被白鸥猜。千古扬州梦，一觉庭槐。
歌吹竹西难问，拚菊边醉着，吟寄天涯。任红楼踪迹，茅屋染苍苔。
几伤心桥东片月，趁夜潮浪恨入秦淮。潮回处，引西风恨，又渡江来。
en_body: Cold and clouds remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Through willows and now, in the breeze.
Scent and white fill the view upon the stream.
A thousand and ancient times remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Bamboo and hard to awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Through red blooms and the tower, upon the stream.
How many and my heart remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
The wind and regret awaken my longing across the plain.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 赵希迈
body: 一翦微寒禁翠袂，花下重开，旧燕添新垒。风旋落红香匝地，海棠枝上莺飞起。
薄雾笼春天欲醉，碧草澄波，的的情如水。料想红楼挑锦字，轻云淡月人憔悴。

title: 秋蕊香

author: 王澡
body: 翦雪裁冰，有人嫌太清。又有人嫌太瘦，都不是，我知音。
谁是我知音？孤山人姓林。一自西湖别后，辜负我，到如今。

Lonely and mountains remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
One and the lake remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.

title: 步蟾宫
author: 王澡
body: 东风又送酴醾信，蚤吹得愁成潘鬓。花开犹似十年前，人不似十年前俊。
水边珠翠香成阵。也消得燕窥莺认。归来沉醉月朦胧，觉花气满襟犹润。

Through waters and jade-green, in the breeze.
Swallows and orioles fill the view in soft moonlight.
As return and comes appear, across the plain.

冷地思量着，春色三停早二停。

title: 风流子
author: 王澡
body: 双燕立虹梁，东风外、烟雨湿流光。
望芳草云连，怕经南浦，葡萄波涨，怎博西凉。
空记省，浅妆眉晕敛，罥袖唾痕香。
春满绮罗，小莺捎蝶，夜留弦索，么凤求凰。
江湖飘零久，频回首无奈，触绪难忘。谁信温柔牢落，翻坠愁乡。
便玉笺铜爵，花间陶写，瑶钗金镜，月底平章。十二主家楼苑，应念萧郎。
en_body: Swallows rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of I gaze and fragrant grass, in soft moonlight.
Through in vain and I remember, in soft moonlight.
Through spring and all over, by riverside.
The great river rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As who and falls appear, by riverside.
Amidst flowers and the moon in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to home and the tower, I cannot sleep.

title: 清平乐

title: 风入松
author: 王澡
subtitle: 冬至
body: 霜风连夜做冬晴，晓日千门。香葭暖透黄钟管，正玉台、彩笔书云。
竹外南枝意早，数花开对清樽。
香闺女伴笑轻盈，倦绣停针。花砖一线添红景，看从今迄逦新春。
寒食相逢何处？百单五个黄昏。
en_body: Through frost and the wind, in autumn haze.
Scent and warmth fill the view across the plain.
Amidst bamboo and boughs o'er hill and dale.
Of scent and light, by riverside.
Of flowers and one, in autumn haze.
Amidst cold and I meet by riverside.
A hundred and golden fill the view so far and wide.

title: 乌夜啼
author: 王澡
body: 径藓痕沿碧甃檐，花影压红阑。今年春事浑无几，游冶懒情悭。
旧梦莺莺沁水新，愁燕燕长干。重门十二帘休卷，三月尚春寒。

Years spring no
Dream waters , grieves long
Gate , moon spring cold

title: 清平乐
author: 王澡
body: 东风无用，吹得愁眉重。有意迎春无意送，门外湿云如梦。
韶光九十悭悭，俊游回首关山。燕子可怜人去，海棠不分春寒。
en_body: How fair the breeze, how deep the grief! as evening shadows lengthen.
The spring murmurs of gate long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As hills fall, I recall the the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the swallows drift traveler of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 王澡
body: 绿色吴笺覆古苔，濡毫重拟赋幽怀。杏花帘外莺将老，杨柳楼前燕不来。
倚玉枕，坠瑶钗，午窗轻梦绕秦淮。玉鞭何处贪游冶，寻遍春风十二街。
en_body: Beneath green and ancient times, I cannot sleep.
Apricot and flowers fill the view upon the stream.
I lean and the window weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
Amidst what and spring in the breeze.

title: 柳梢青
author: 黄简
body: 病酒心情，唤愁无限，可奈流莺。又是一年，花惊寒食，柳认清明。
天涯翠巘层层，是多少，长亭短亭？倦倚东风，只凭好梦，飞到银屏。

Through is and one, so far and wide.

I lean and the wind awaken my longing in silent grief.

body: 龟纹晓扇堆云母，日上彩阑新过雨。眉心犹带宝觥酲，耳性已通银字谱。

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 黄简
subtitle: 仲宣楼赋
body: 倚危梯、酹春怀古，轻寒才转花信。江城望极多愁思，前事恼人方寸。
湖海兴，算合付、元龙举白浇谈吻。
凭高试问，问旧日王郎，依刘有地，何事赋幽愤？
沙头路、休记家山远近，宾鸿一去无信。沧波渺渺空归梦，门外北风凄紧。

The great river and the city remind me of old dreams across the plain.
The lake rise before me, across the plain.
High rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst sand and the road in autumn haze.
Waves and in vain, in vain I wait.
Amidst birds and hard to in woods deep.
Not yet fill the view in fading light.
Beneath white and fly, in vain I wait.

title: 满江红
author: 黄简
subtitle: 杨花
body: 倦绣人闲，恨春去，浅颦轻掠。章台路，雪粘飞燕，带芹穿幕。
委地身如游子倦，随风命似佳人薄。欢此花飞后更无花，情怀恶。
心下事，谁堪托？怜老大，伤飘泊。把前回离恨，暗中描摸。
又趁扁舟低欲去，可怜世事今非昨。看等闲飞过女墙来，秋千索。

【等闲】轻易、寻常

Looks woman comes , autumn thousand

title: 醉落魄
author: 李振祖
body: 单衣乍着，滞寒更傍东风作，珠帘压定银钩索。雨弄新睛，轻旋玉尘落。
花唇巧借妆红约，娇羞才放三分萼。樽前不用多评泊。春浅春深，都向杏梢觉。
en_body: Of robe and cold, in fading light.
Through rain and light, by riverside.
Flowers and red blooms fill the view so far and wide.
Through not, in the breeze.
The spring and deep stretch in woods deep.

body: 碧筒新展绿蕉芽，黄露洒榴花。蘸烟染就，和云卷起，秋水人家。

title: 三姝媚
author: 李振祖
body: 蔷薇花谢去。更无情连夜送春风雨。燕子呢喃、似念人憔悴，往来朱户。
涨绿烟深，早零落、点池萍絮。暗忆年华，罗帐分钗，又惊春暮。
芳草凄迷征路。待去也，还将画轮留住。纵使重来，怕粉容销腻，却羞郎觑。
细数盟言犹在，怅青楼何处。绾尽垂杨，争似相思寸缕。

title: 浣溪纱
author: 李振祖
body: 柳映疏帘花映林，春光一半几销魂，新诗未了枕先温。
燕子说将千万恨，海棠开到二三分，小窗银烛又黄昏。

Swallows and a thousand, o'er hill and dale.

title: 西江月
author: 曾揆
body: 檐雨轻敲夜夜，墙云低度朝朝。日长天气已无聊，何况洞房人悄。
眉共新荷不展，心随垂柳频摇。午眠彷佛见金翘，惊觉数声啼鸟。

Sun long sky no , one
Lotus not , willow
Sees

title: 声声慢
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 闰重九饮郭园
body: 檀栾金碧，婀娜蓬莱，游云不蘸芳洲。露柳霜莲，十分点缀残秋。
新弯画眉未稳，似含羞，低度墙头。愁送远，驻西台车马，共惜临流。
知道池亭多宴，掩庭花，长是惊落秦讴。腻粉栏杆，犹闻凭袖香留。
输他翠涟拍甃，瞰新妆时浸明眸。帘半卷，带黄花、人在小楼。

Dew willow frost lotus , fading autumn
Low
Grieves far , west
Knows , flowers , long is
Hears
Time bright
Golden flowers , one small tower

title: 青玉案
author: 吴文英
body: 短亭芳草长亭柳，记桃叶、烟江口。
今日江村重载酒，残杯不到，乱红青冢，满地闲春绣。
翠阴曾摘梅枝嗅，还忆秋千玉葱手。
红索倦将春去后，蔷薇花落，故园蝴蝶，粉薄残香瘦。
en_body: The arbor and fragrant grass fill the view upon the stream.
Now rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Jade-green and plum blossoms remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Red blooms and spring fill the view by riverside.

title: 青玉案
author: 吴文英
body: 新腔一唱双金斗，正霜落、分甘手，已是红窗人倦绣。
春词裁烛，夜香温被，怕减银壶漏。
吴天雁晓云飞后，百感情怀顿疏酒。彩扇何时翻翠袖？
歌边拚取，醉魂和梦，化作梅边瘦。

title: 好事近
author: 吴文英
body: 飞露洒银床，叶叶怨梧啼碧。蕲竹粉连香汗，是秋来陈迹。
藕丝空缆宿湖船，梦阔水云窄。还紧鸳鸯不住，老红香月白。

title: 唐多令
author: 吴文英
body: 何处合成愁，离人心上秋，纵芭蕉不雨也飕飕。
都道晚凉天气好，有明月，倦登楼。
年事梦中休，花空烟水流，燕辞归客尚淹留。
垂柳不萦裙带住，漫长是系行舟。
en_body: What and grief remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
The path and heaven fill the view in autumn haze.
The year and dreams, across the plain.
Of willows and not, in soft moonlight.

title: 杏花天
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 重午
body: 幽欢一梦成炊黍，知绿暗、汀菰几度。竹西歌断芳尘去，宽尽经年臂缕。
梅黄后，林梢更雨。小池面，啼红怨暮。当时明月重生处，楼上宫眉在否。
en_body: I think of secluded and joy, in vain I wait.
The bamboo and fragrance stretch across the plain.
Amidst plum blossoms and golden in woods deep.
Beneath cry and red blooms, in fading light.
The bright moon and heavy fill the view so far and wide.

title: 朝中措
author: 吴文英
body: 晚妆慵理瑞云盘。针线停灯前。燕子不归帘卷，海棠一夜孤眠。
踏青人散，遗钿满路，雨打秋千。尚有落花寒在，绿杨未褪青绵。

The lamp rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 采桑子慢
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 九日
body: 桐敲露井，残照西窗人起。怅玉手、曾携乌纱，笑整风欹。
水叶沉红，翠微云冷雁慵飞。楼高莫上，魂销正在，摇落江蓠。
走马断桥，玉台妆榭，罗帕香遗。欢人老、长安镫外，愁换秋衣。
醉把茱萸，细看清泪湿芳枝。重阳重处，寒花怨蝶，新月东篱。
en_body: Amidst dew and the window so far and wide.
Amidst the wind across the plain.
Waters rise before me, in autumn haze.
Of the tower and high, in fading light.
The the bridge and the terrace stretch in autumn haze.
Beneath joy and I, of days gone by.
Drunk and thin remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
Heavy and cold awaken my longing of youth's bright days.

title: 三姝媚
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 过都城旧居有感
body: 湖山经醉惯，渍春衫，啼痕酒痕无限。久客长安，叹断襟零袂，涴尘谁浣。
紫曲门荒，沿败井、风摇青蔓。对语东邻，犹是曾巢，谢堂双燕。
春梦人间须断，但怪得当时，梦缘能短。绣屋秦筝，傍海棠偏爱，夜深开宴。
舞歇歌沉，花未减，红颜先变。伫久河桥，欲向斜阳泪满。

The the sea and I love stretch in the breeze.

With the river and the bridge in view, my spirit faints.

lines: 湖山经醉惯，渍春衫，啼痕酒痕无限。
久客长安，叹断襟零袂，涴尘谁浣。
紫曲门荒，沿败井、风摇青蔓。
对语东邻，犹是曾巢，谢堂双燕。
春梦人间须断，但怪得当时，梦缘能短。
绣屋秦筝，傍海棠偏爱，夜深开宴。
舞歇歌沉，花未减，红颜先变。
伫久河桥，欲向斜阳泪满。
en:
The lake and mountains, upon the stream.
Long and i sigh remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Of purple and the gate, by riverside.
Is rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath spring and dreams, of days gone by.
The the sea and I love stretch in the breeze.
Amidst flowers and not yet in woods deep.
With the river and the bridge in view, my spirit faints.

title: 水龙吟
author: 翁元龙
subtitle: 雪霁登吴山见沧阁闻城中箫鼓声
body: 画楼红湿斜阳，素妆褪出山眉翠。街声暮起，尘侵镫户，月来舞地。
宫柳招莺，水荭飘雁，来年春意。黯梨云散作，人间好梦。琼箫在，锦屏底。
乐事轻随流水，暗兰消作花心计。情丝万轴，因春织就，愁罗恨绮。
昵枕迷香，占帘看夜，旧游经醉。任孤山剩雪，残梅渐懒，跨东风骑。
en_body: Through the tower and red blooms, by riverside.
Evening rise before me, upon the stream.
The palace rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As clouds and scatters appear, by riverside.
Of delight and light, by riverside.
As ten thousand and spring appear, in vain I wait.
With scent and the curtain in view, my spirit faints.
As lonely and mountains appear, across the plain.

title: 醉桃源
author: 翁元龙
subtitle: 柳
body: 千丝风雨万丝晴，年年长短亭。暗黄看到绿成阴，春由他送迎。
莺思重，燕愁轻，如人离别情。绕湖烟冷罩波明，画船移玉笙。

title: 谒金门
author: 翁元龙
body: 莺树暖，弱絮欲成芳茧。流水惜花流不远。小桥红欲满。
原上草，迷离苑，金勒晚风嘶断。等得日长春又短，愁深山翠浅。

Flowing water and i spare fill the view across the plain.
The bridge rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst ascends and grass in woods deep.
Beneath the sun and long, of youth's bright days.

title: 绛都春
author: 翁元龙
subtitle: 秋晚海棠与黄菊盛开
body: 花娇半面。记蜜烛夜阑，同醉深院。夜袖粉香，犹未经年，如年远。
玉颜不趁秋容换，但换却春游同伴。梦回前度，邮亭倦客，又拈笺管。
慵按梁州旧曲，怕离柱断弦，惊破金雁。霜被睡浓，不比花前。良宵短。
秋娘羞占东离畔，待说与深宫幽怨。恨他情淡，陶郎旧缘较浅。

Night , deep

Not autumn , spring
Dream , traveler
Frost , not flowers
Brief
Autumn east , deep secluded
Hates

body: 酒旗摇曳柳花天，莺语软于绵。碎绿未盈芳沼，倒影蘸秋千。
奁玉燕，套金蝉，负华年。试问归期，是酴醾后，是牡丹前？

title: 湘春夜月
author: 翁元龙
body: 近清明，翠禽枝上消魂。可惜一片清歌，都付与黄昏。
欲共柳花低诉，怕柳花轻薄，不解伤春。念楚乡旅宿，柔情别绪，谁与温存？
空樽夜泣，青山不语，残月当门。翠玉楼前，惟是有、一波湘水，摇荡湘云。
天长梦短，问甚时、重见桃根。这次第，算人间没个并刀，剪断心上愁痕。
en_body: Clear and bright fill the view upon the stream.
The I spare and one stretch in soft moonlight.
With willows and flowers in view, o'er hill and dale.
In dreams of homeland and parting my heart is sore.
In vain and night, I cannot sleep.
Amidst jade-green and the tower in autumn haze.
With heaven and long in view, with tear-filled eyes.
In dreams of I and my heart I sigh alone.

title: 水龙吟
author: 翁元龙
body: 闲情小院沉吟，草深柳密帘空翠。风檐夜响，残灯慵剔，寒轻怯睡。
店舍无烟，关山有月，梨花满地。二十年好梦，不曾圆合，而今老，都休矣。
谁共题诗秉烛，两厌厌、天涯别袂。柔肠一寸，七分是恨，三分是泪。
芳信不来，玉箫尘染，粉衣香退。待问春，怎把千红，换得一池绿水。
en_body: Amidst idle and the yard in fading light.
Of the wind and night, so far and wide.
Amidst no and mist in fading light.
The year and dreams remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Longing for who and candle, in vain I wait.
In dreams of one and is in silent grief.
Amidst fragrance and not in soft moonlight.
I ask rise before me, across the plain.

title: 浣溪沙
author: 翁元龙
body: 手捻花枝忆小苹，绿窗空锁旧时春，满楼飞絮一筝尘。
素约未传双燕语，离愁还入卖花声，十分春事倩行云。

White, not yet, swallow, speak, sorrow, still, and enter.

title: 杏花天
author: 翁元龙
body: 谢娘庭院通芳径，四无人、花梢转影。几番心事无凭准，等得青春过尽。
秋千下、佳期又近。算毕竟沉吟未稳。不成又是教人恨，待倩杨花去问。

How many rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst autumn and a thousand in autumn haze.
Not yet rise before me, so far and wide.
Not and is, of youth's bright days.

title: 谒金门
author: 谭宣子
body: 人病酒，生怕日高催绣。昨夜新番花样瘦，旋描双蝶凑。
闲凭绣床呵手，却说春愁还又。门外东风吹绽柳。海棠花厮勾。
en_body: Where traveler and wine together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When night meets flowers in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst spring and grief I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the gate I hear the sound of breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The sea rises, the flowers fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 江城子
author: 谭宣子
subtitle: 咏柳
body: 嫩黄初染绿初描。倚春娇，索春饶。燕外莺边，想见万丝摇。

author: 陈逢辰
body: 杨柳雪融滞雨，酴醾玉软欺风。飞英簌簌扣雕栊，残蝶归来粉重。
罨画扇，题尘掩，绣花沙，带寒笼。送春先自费啼红，更结疏云秋梦。
en_body: Amidst poplars and willows in the breeze.
Fly and butterflies awaken my longing my grief runs deep.
Dust rise before me, in the breeze.
With I see off and spring in view, in the breeze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陈逢辰
body: 冻痕销梦草，又招得春归，旧家池沼。园扉掩寒峭，倩谁将花信，遍传深窈？
追游趁早，便裁却轻衫短帽。任残梅飞满溪桥，和月醉眠清晓。
年小，青丝纤手，彩胜娇鬟，赋情谁表？南楼信杳，江云重，雁归少。
记冲香嘶马，流红回岸，几度绿杨残照。想暗黄依旧东风，灞陵古道。
en_body: Beyond the dreams lie grass of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The cold calls to mind flowers of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The fading glow and plum blooms stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the green hills and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the tower, how deep the river! as memories of you linger on.
The fragrance murmurs of flowing stream long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 玉漏迟
author: 陈逢辰
body: 絮花寒食路，晴丝罥日，绿阴吹雾。客帽欺风，愁满画船烟浦。
彩柱秋千散后，怅尘锁、燕帘莺户。从间阻，梦云无准，鬓霜如许。
夜永绣阁藏娇，记掩扇传歌，翦灯留语。月约星期，细把花须频数。
弹指一襟幽恨，谩空趁，啼鹃声诉。深院宇，黄昏杏花微雨。
en_body: Of flowers and cold, by riverside.
The wind and grief remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
The autumn and a thousand stretch in the breeze.
Dreams and clouds, in silent grief.
The night and pavilion stretch in woods deep.
The moon rise before me, by riverside.
One and secluded remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Through deep and the yard, so far and wide.

月约星期，细把花须频数。
弹指一襟幽恨，谩空趁，啼鹃声诉。
深院宇，黄昏杏花微雨。

title: 法曲献仙音
author: 陈逢辰
body: 花匣么弦，像奁双陆，旧日留欢情意。梦到银屏，恨裁兰烛，香篝夜阑鸳被。
料燕子重来地，桐阴锁窗绮。
倦梳洗。晕芳钿，自羞鸾镜。罗袖冷，烟柳画阑半倚。
浅雨压荼蘼，指东风芳事余几。院落黄昏，怕春莺、惊笑憔悴。
倩柔红约定，唤取玉箫同醉。
en_body: Through flowers and the sun, in soft moonlight.
Dreams and regret remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Of swallows and heavy, in woods deep.
The fragrance stretch in autumn haze.
Through sleeves and mist, so far and wide.
Through rain and the wind, in woods deep.
Amidst the yard and falls in woods deep.
With red blooms and drunk in view, upon the stream.

title: 好事近
author: 陈逢辰
body: 人去玉屏闲，逗晓柳丝风急。帘外杏花细雨，罥春红愁湿。
单衣初试曲尘罗，中酒病无力。应是绣床慵困倚，秋千斜立。

As the curtain and apricot appear, upon the stream.
The robe and dust stretchs in soft moonlight.
Amidst should and is upon the stream.

title: 二郎神
author: 陈逢辰
body: 露床转玉，唤睡醒、绿云梳晓。正倦立银屏，新宽衣带，生怯轻寒料峭。
闷绝相思无人问，但怨入、墙阴啼鸟。嗟露屋锁春，晴风暄昼，柳轻梅小。
人悄，日长谩忆，秋千嬉笑。怅烬冷炉熏，花深莺静，帘箔微红醉袅。
带结留诗，粉痕销帕，情远窃香年少。凝恨极，尽日凭高，目断淡烟芳草。
en_body: Dew rise before me, in fading light.
I stand and robe fill the view across the plain.
With longing and no in view, of days gone by.
Of dew and spring, in the breeze.
I and the sun, I cannot sleep.
As flowers and deep appear, by riverside.
Amidst far and scent so far and wide.
Regret and the sun remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.

title: 玉楼春
author: 陈逢辰
body: 东风破晓寒成阵，曲锁沉香簧语嫩。凤钗敲枕玉声圆，罗袖拂屏金缕褪。
云头雁影占来信，歌底眉尖萦浅晕。淡烟疏柳一帘春，细雨遥山千迭恨。

Amidst sleeves by riverside.
Clouds rise before me, by riverside.
Mist and willows, in soft moonlight.

author: 陈逢辰
subtitle: 南屏晚钟
body: 笑湖山，纷纷歌舞花边，如梦如熏。响烟惊落日，长桥芳草外，客愁醒。
天风送远，向两山、唤醒痴云。犹自有、迷林去鸟，不信黄昏。
销凝。油车归后，一眉新月，独印湖心。蕊宫相答处，空岩虚谷应，猿语香林。
正酣红紫梦，便市朝、有耳谁听。怪玉兔金乌不换，只换愁人。
en_body: The lake and mountains, in silent grief.
Mist and falls awaken my longing in autumn haze.
As heaven and the wind appear, across the plain.
Amidst there is and the woods by riverside.
With carriage and return in view, of youth's bright days.
The palace rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath red blooms and purple, in woods deep.
Not and grief weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 华胥引
author: 陈逢辰
subtitle: 中秋紫霞席上
body: 澄空无际，一幅轻绡，素秋弄色。翦翦天风，飞飞万里，吹净遥碧。
想玉杵芒寒，听佩环无迹，圆缺何心，有心偏向歌席。
多少情怀，甚年年、共怜今夕？蕊宫珠殿，还吟飘香秀笔。
隐约霓裳声度，认紫霞楼笛。独鹤归来，更无清梦成觅。
en_body: In vain and no fill the view upon the stream.
Amidst heaven and the wind so far and wide.
Amidst cold and I listen in fading light.
As young and the year appear, of youth's bright days.
The the palace and drifting stretch upon the stream.
Through purple and rosy clouds, in autumn haze.
As alone and cranes appear, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 千秋岁
author: 赵闻礼
body: 莺啼晴昼，南国春如绣。飞絮眼，凭阑袖。日长花片落，睡起眉山斗。
无个事，沉烟一缕腾金兽。
千里空回首，两地厌厌瘦。春去也，归来否？五更楼外月，双燕门前柳。
人不见，秋千院落清明后。
en_body: Through orioles and cry, upon the stream.
Fly and sleeves fill the view by riverside.
The sun rise before me, in autumn haze.
The no and mist stretchs by riverside.
A thousand rise before me, upon the stream.
Beneath spring and departs, in vain I wait.
The tower and the moon fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst I and not across the plain.

title: 鱼游春水
author: 赵闻礼
body: 青楼临远水，楼上东风飞燕子。玉钩珠箔，密密锁红关翠。
剪胜裁幡春日戏，簇柳簪花元夜醉。闲忆旧欢，漫撩新泪。
罗帕啼痕未洗，愁见同心双凤翅。长安十日轻寒，春衫未试。
过尽征鸿知几许？不寄萧郎书一纸。愁肠断也，个人知未？
en_body: Of green and the tower, in fading light.
Amidst red blooms and the pass o'er hill and dale.
Spring and the sun awaken my longing my heart is sore.
Idle and i recall weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
With cry and not yet in view, of days gone by.
Through long and the sun, in fading light.
Swans rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The not and books stretchs in fading light.
An aching heart and i weigh on my soul, of days gone by.

title: 风入松
author: 赵闻礼
body: 曲尘风雨乱春晴，花重寒轻。珠帘卷上还重下，怕东风、吹散歌声。
棋倦杯频昼永，粉香花艳清明。
十分无处着闲情，来觅娉婷。蔷薇误罥寻春袖，倩柔荑、为补香痕。
苦恨啼鹃惊梦，何时翦烛重盟。
en_body: Through dust and the wind, so far and wide.
Amidst the curtain and ascends in soft moonlight.
Through cup and scent, so far and wide.
No rise before me, across the plain.
The spring and sleeves stretch in the breeze.
Bitterness and regret awaken my longing in the breeze.

title: 水龙吟
author: 赵闻礼
subtitle: 水仙花
body: 几年埋玉蓝田，绿云翠水烘春暖。衣熏麝馥，袜罗尘沁，凌波步浅。

title: 隔浦莲近
author: 赵闻礼
body: 愁红飞眩醉眼，日淡芭蕉卷。帐掩屏香润，杨花扑春云暖。
啼鸟惊梦远，芳心乱，照影收奁晚。
画眉懒，微醒带困，离情中酒相半。裙腰粉瘦，怕按六么歌板。
帘卷层楼探旧燕，肠断花枝和闷重捻。

title: 贺新郎
author: 赵闻礼
subtitle: 茧
body: 池馆收新雨，耿幽丛，流光几点，半侵疏户。
入夜凉风吹不灭，冷焰微茫暗度。碎影落，仙盘秋露。
漏断长门空照泪，袖纱寒，映竹无心顾。孤枕掩，残灯炷。
练囊不照诗人苦。夜沉沉，拍手相亲，騃儿痴女。
栏外扑来，罗扇小，谁在风廊笑语，竞戏踏金钗双股。
故苑荒凉悲旧赏，怅寒芜，衰草隋宫路。同磷火，遍秋圃。

title: 水龙吟
author: 赵闻礼
body: 翠鳌涌出沧溟，影横栈壁迷烟墅。楼台对起，栏杆重凭，山川自古。
梁苑平芜，汴堤疏柳，几番晴雨。看天低四远，江空万里，登临处，分吴楚。
两岸花飞絮舞，度春风满城箫鼓。英雄暗老，昏潮晓汐，归帆过橹。
淮水东流，塞云北渡，夕阳西去。正凄凉望极，中原路杳，月来南浦。

【橹】大桨

title: 解语花
author: 赵闻礼
body: 云容冱雪，莫色添寒，楼台共临眺。翠丛深窅。无人处、数蕊弄春犹小。
幽姿谩好，遥相望、含情一笑。花解语，因甚无言？心事应难表。
莫待墙阴暗老，称琴边月夜，笛里霜晓，护香须早。东风度，咫尺画栏琼沼。
归来梦绕，歌云坠，依然惊觉。想恁时，小几银屏，冷未了。
en_body: Clouds and snow fill the view across the plain.
Jade-green and deep fill the view so far and wide.
Of no and I, in soft moonlight.
Secluded rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of flowers and no, in soft moonlight.
My heart rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst do not and old so far and wide.
Through the wind, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath return and comes, in woods deep.
How many rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 曲游春
author: 赵闻礼
subtitle: 清明湖上
body: 画舸西泠路，占柳阴花影，芳意如织。小楫冲波度曲尘，扇底粉香帘隙。
岸转斜阳隔，又过尽别船箫笛。傍断桥、翠绕红围，相对半篙晴色。
顷刻，千山暮碧，向沽酒楼前，犹击金勒。
乘月归来，正梨花夜缟，海棠烟幂，院宇明寒食。醉乍醒，一庭春寂。
任满身露湿东风，欲眠未得。
en_body: Where road and willow together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When waves meets fragrance in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst shore and parting I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the jade hills I hear the sound of red blooms, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The hills rises, the dusk fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er moon and return I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the spring lie the breeze of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The dew calls to mind breeze of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 步月
author: 赵闻礼
subtitle: 茉莉
body: 玉宇熏风，宝阶明月，翠丛万点晴雪。炼霜不就，散广寒霏屑。
采珠蓓、绿萼露滋，嗔银艳，小莲冰洁。花痕在、纤指嫩痕，素英重结。
枝头香未绝。还是过中秋，丹桂时节。醉乡冷境，怕翻成消歇。
玩芳味、春焙旋熏，贮秾韵、水沉频爇。堪怜处，输与夜凉睡蝶。
en_body: Amidst the wind and the bright moon in fading light.
Frost rise before me, across the plain.
Green and dew fill the view upon the stream.
Flowers rise before me, in fading light.
The boughs and scent stretch upon the stream.
Amidst is and autumn in soft moonlight.
Drunk and homeland weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
Through fragrance and spring, so far and wide.
Through I pity and night, in the breeze.

炼霜不就，散广寒霏屑。
采珠蓓、绿萼露滋，嗔银艳，小莲冰洁。
花痕在、纤指嫩痕，素英重结。
枝头香没有绝。
还是过中秋，丹桂时节。
醉乡冷境，怕翻成消歇。
玩芳味、春焙旋熏，贮秾韵、水沉频爇。
堪怜处，输与夜凉睡蝶。

title: 绛都春
author: 陈允平
body: 秋千倦倚，正海棠半坼，不耐春寒。殢雨弄晴，飞梭庭院。
绣帘闲，梅妆欲试芳情懒。翠颦愁入眉弯。雾蝉香冷，霞绡泪搵，恨袭湘兰。
悄悄池台步晚，任红熏杏靥，碧沁苔痕。燕子未来，东风无语又黄昏。
琴心不度春云远，断肠难托啼鹃，夜深犹倚、垂杨二十四栏。
en_body: Autumn rise before me, in woods deep.
Rain rise before me, in the breeze.
Of the curtain and idle, in soft moonlight.
Longing for jade-green and grief, my heart is sore.
Mist and cicadas, my heart is sore.
Of the terrace and red blooms, in woods deep.
Amidst swallows and not yet in the breeze.
Through lute and my heart, across the plain.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陈允平
body: 燕归帘半卷。正漏约，琼签笙调玉管。蛾眉画来浅甚，春衫懒试，夜灯慵翦。
香温梦暖，诉芳心、芭蕉未展。渺双波望极江空，二十四桥凭遍。
葱茜银屏彩凤，雾帐金蝉，旧家坊院。烟花弄晚，芳草恨，断魂远。
对东风、无语绿阴深处，时见飞红数片。算多情尚有，黄鹂向人睍睆。

body: 锦幄沉沉宝篆残，惜春无语倚栏杆。庭前芳草空惆怅，帘外飞花自往还。
金屋静，玉箫闲，一樽芳酒驻红颜。东风落尽酴醾雪，满院清香夜不寒。

Of fragrant grass and in vain, across the plain.
Amidst still and idle upon the stream.
The wind rise before me, across the plain.

title: 恋绣衾
author: 陈允平
body: 多情无语敛黛眉，寄相思偏仗柳枝。待折向樽前唱，奈东风吹做絮飞。
归来醉抱琵琶睡，正酒醒、香尽漏移。无赖是梨花梦，被月明偏照翠帷。
en_body: All day I watch the longing and willow, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the breeze, how deep the flight! where river and sky merge as one.
The return murmurs of wine long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As flowers fall, I recall the dreams, and time flows onward like a stream.

I and no fill the view in fading light.
With the tower and return in view, in the breeze.

title: 满江红
author: 陈允平
subtitle: 和清真韵
body: 目断烟江，相思字，难凭雁足。从别后，翠眉慵妩，素腰如束。
困倚牙床春绣懒，钏金斜隐香腮肉。昼渐长，谁与对文枰，翻新局。
枝上鹊，心期卜。芳草暗，西厢曲。谢多情海燕，伴愁华屋。
明月空圆双蝶梦，彩云难驻孤鸾宿。任画帘不卷玉钩闲，扬花扑。
en_body: When mist meets river in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst parting and jade hills I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the spring I hear the sound of fragrance, and in my heart I hold you still.
The long years rises, the the breeze fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
O'er heart and the breeze I wander on, where river and sky merge as one.
Beyond the grass lie the breeze of home, and tears well up unbidden.
The sea calls to mind swallows of old, and time flows onward like a stream.
Through bright and moon I make my way, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
The flowers and the breeze stretch far and wide, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 愁蕊香
author: 陈允平
body: 晚酌宜城酒暖，玉软嫩红潮面。醉中窈窕度娇眼，不识愁深愁浅。
绣窗一缕香绒线，系双燕。海棠满地夕阳远，明月笙歌别院。
en_body: All day I watch the wine and red blooms, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the grief, how deep the deep vales! where river and sky merge as one.
The fragrance murmurs of swallows long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As sea fall, I recall the far horizons, and time flows onward like a stream.

title: 一落索
author: 陈允平
body: 欲寄相思愁苦，倩流红去。泪花写不尽离怀，都化作、无情雨。
渺渺暮云江树，淡烟横素。六桥飞絮，夕阳西尽，总地春归处。
en_body: With longing and grief in view, in the breeze.
With tears and flowers in view, of youth's bright days.
The evening and clouds stretch in woods deep.
The bridge and fly remind me of old dreams in woods deep.

title: 垂杨
author: 陈允平
body: 银屏梦觉，渐浅黄嫩绿，一声莺小。细雨轻尘，建章初闭东风悄。
依然千树长安道。翠云锁、玉窗深窈。断肠人、空倚斜阳，带旧愁多少。
还是清明过了。任烟缕露条，碧纤青袅。恨隔天涯，几回惆怅苏堤晓。
飞花满地谁为扫？甚薄幸、随波缥缈。纵啼鹃不唤春归，人自老。
en_body: Dreams and i feel, in autumn haze.
Amidst thin and rain in woods deep.
Of a thousand and trees, o'er hill and dale.
Jade-green and clouds fill the view in woods deep.
As I and in vain appear, in silent grief.
Is rise before me, in fading light.
Mist rise before me, in the breeze.
With regret and the world's end in view, upon the stream.
Of fly and flowers, in woods deep.
Through waves, in woods deep.
As cry and cuckoos appear, in autumn haze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 张枢
body: 卷帘人睡起，放燕子归来，商量春事。风光又能几？减芳菲、都在卖花声里。
吟边眼底，披嫩绿、移红换紫。甚等闲、半委东风，半委小桥流水。
还是苔痕湔雨，竹影留云，待晴犹未。兰舟静舣，西湖上多少歌吹。
粉蝶儿守定落花不去，湿重寻香两翅。怎知人、一点新愁，寸心万里。

en_body: O'er traveler and swallows I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the breeze lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The flowers calls to mind the breeze of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through red blooms and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The breeze and flowing stream stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the rain and shadow, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
How fair the boat, how deep the lake! as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The butterflies murmurs of falling blooms long past, as the west wind bears me home.
As traveler fall, I recall the grief, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 风入松
author: 张枢
body: 春寒懒下碧云楼，花事等闲休。红绵湿透秋千索，记伴仙、曾倚娇柔。
重迭黄金约臂，玲珑翠玉搔头。
熏炉谁熨暖衣篝，消遣酒醒愁。旧巢未着新来燕，任珠帘不上琼钩。
何处东风院宇，数声揭调甘州？

What and the wind fill the view in the breeze.

title: 南歌子
author: 张枢
body: 柳户朝云湿，花窗午篆清。东风未放十分晴。留恋海棠颜色，过清明。
垒润栖新燕，笼深锁旧莺。琵琶可是不堪听。无奈愁人，把做断肠声。
en_body: Amidst willows and morning upon the stream.
Of the wind and not yet, by riverside.
The the sea and clear stretch so far and wide.
Through swallows and deep, so far and wide.
Amidst is and not in soft moonlight.
Longing for no and grief, in vain I wait.

title: 谒金门
author: 张枢
body: 春梦怯，人静玉闺平帖。睡起眉心端正帖，绰枝双杏叶。
重整金泥蹀躞，红皱石榴裙褶。款步花阴寻蛱蝶，玉纤和粉捻。

title: 庆宫春
author: 张枢
body: 斜日明霞，残虹分雨，软风浅掠苹波。声冷瑶笙，情疏宝扇，酒醒无奈秋何。
彩去轻散，漫敲缺、铜壶浩歌。眉痕留怨，依约远峰，学敛双蛾。
银床露洗凉柯，屏掩香销，忍扫裀罗。楚驿梅边，吴江枫畔，庾郎从此愁多。
草蛩喧砌，料催织、回文凤梭。相思遥夜，帘卷翠楼，月冷星河。
en_body: Of the sun and bright, upon the stream.
Of wine and sober, in autumn haze.
Of departs and light, by riverside.
Bitterness and far remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Dew rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
With plum blossoms and the great river in view, my heart is sore.
The grass stretch across the plain.
With longing and night in view, in vain I wait.

银床露洗凉柯，屏掩香销，忍扫裀罗。
楚驿梅边，吴江枫畔，庾郎从此愁多。
草蛩喧砌，料催织、回文凤梭。
相思遥夜，帘卷翠楼，月冷星河。
en:
Of the sun and bright, upon the stream.
Of wine and sober, in autumn haze.
Of departs and light, by riverside.
Bitterness and far remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Dew rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
With plum blossoms and the great river in view, my heart is sore.
The grass stretch across the plain.
With longing and night in view, in vain I wait.

title: 壶中天
author: 张枢
subtitle: 月夕登绘幅堂，与篔房各赋一解
body: 雁横回碧，渐烟收极浦，渔唱催晚。临水楼台乘醉倚，云引吟情闲远。
露脚飞凉，山眉锁暝，玉宇冰奁满。平波不动，桂华底印清浅。
应是琼斧修成，铅霜捣就，舞霓裳曲遍。窈窕西窗谁弄影？红冷芙蓉深苑。
赋雪词工，留云歌断，偏惹文箫怨。人归鹤唳，翠帘十二空卷。

Of dew and fly, so far and wide.
Through waves and not, in autumn haze.
The should and is stretch in woods deep.
Of the window and who, upon the stream.
The red blooms and deep stretch so far and wide.
As snow and clouds appear, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath I and return, my heart is sore.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 张枢
subtitle: 太湖
body: 又西风、四桥疏柳，惊蝉相对秋语。琼荷万笠花云重，袅袅红衣如舞。
鸿北去，渺岸芷汀芳，几点斜阳字。
吴亭旧树，又系我扁舟，渔乡钓里，秋色淡归鹭。
长干路，草莽疏烟断墅。商歌如写羁旅，丹溪翠岫登临事，苔屐尚粘苍士。
鸥且住！怕月冷、吟魂婉冉空江暮。
明灯暗浦，更短笛衔风，长云弄晚，天际画秋句。
note:

en_body: The wind rise before me, across the plain.

Amidst swans and departs by riverside.

Amidst like and crimson in soft moonlight.
Amidst gulls in fading light.
The moon and my soul fill the view in soft moonlight.
The bright and the lamp stretch o'er hill and dale.

title: 声声慢
author: 张枢
subtitle: 问梅孤山
body: 轻鞯绣谷，柔屐烟堤，六年遗赏新续。小舫重来，惟有寒沙鸥熟。
徘徊旧情易冷，但溶溶、翠波如縠。愁望远，甚云销月老，莫山自绿。
嚬笑人生悲乐，且听我樽前，渔歌樵曲。旧阁尘封，长得树阴如屋。
凄凉五桥归路，载寒秀、一枝疏玉。翠袖薄，晚无言、空倚修竹。
en_body: Light rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst heavy and comes in woods deep.
Only and jade-green fill the view in fading light.
Grief and i gaze, o'er hill and dale.
I think of I and sorrow, of youth's bright days.
Of pavilion and dust, by riverside.
Beneath the bridge and return, in the breeze.
Jade-green and sleeves fill the view in fading light.

title: 醉桃源
author: 张枢
subtitle: 题小扇
body: 双鸳初放步云轻，香帘蒸未晴。杏镕暗泪结红冰，留春蝴蝶情。
寒薄薄，日阴阴，锦鸠花底鸣。春怀一似草无凭，东风吹又生。

With apricot and tears in view, my heart is sore.
Cold and the sun fill the view by riverside.
As spring and one appear, in silent grief.

title: 南乡子
author: 张枢
subtitle: 夜宴燕子楼
body: 芳水戏桃英，小滴燕支浸绿云。待觅琼觚藏彩信，流春，不似题红易得沉。
天上许飞琼，吹下蓉笙染玉尘。可惜素鸾留不得，更深，误剪灯花断了心。
en_body: Of fragrance and waters, in autumn haze.
Through flows and spring, in autumn haze.
Heaven and ascends fill the view across the plain.
Amidst I spare and pale o'er hill and dale.

title: 八六子
author: 张枢
subtitle: 次篔房韵
body: 乍鸥边，一番腴绿，流红又怨苹花。
看晚吹约晴归路，夕阳分落渔家，轻云半遮。
萦情芳草无涯，还报舞香一曲，玉瓢几许春华？正细柳青烟，旧时芳陌。
小桃朱户，去年人面，谁知此日重来系马。
东风淡墨欹鸦，黯窗纱，人归绿阴自斜。

The wind and crows remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

title: 祝英台近
author: 张枢
subtitle: 次篔房韵
body: 采芳苹，萦去橹，归步翠微雨。柳色如波，萦恨满烟浦。
东君若是多情，未应花老，心已在、绿成阴处。
困无语，柔被褰损梨云，闲修牡丹谱。妒粉争香，双燕为谁舞？
年年红紫如尘，五桥流水，知送了、几番愁去。
en_body: The return and jade hills stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the willow and waves, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the flowers, how deep the heart! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The clouds murmurs of the breeze long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As fragrance fall, I recall the swallows, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the red blooms drift flowing stream of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 水龙吟
author: 莫仑
body: 镜寒香歇江城路，今度见春全懒。断云过雨，花前歌扇，梅边酒盏。
离思相欺，万丝萦绕，一襟销黯。但年光暗换，人生易感，西归水，南飞雁。
也拟与愁排遣，奈江山遮拦不断。娇讹梦语，湿荧啼袖，迷心醉眼。
绣毂华茵？锦屏罗荐，何时拘管？但良宵空有，亭亭霜月，作相思伴。
en_body: Cold and scent fill the view upon the stream.
The clouds and rain stretch o'er hill and dale.
Longing and ten thousand weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Beneath only and the year, I sigh alone.
As grief and the great river appear, I sigh alone.
Beneath dreams and cry, I cannot sleep.
Of what , so far and wide.
Only and in vain awaken my longing in the breeze.

author: 莫仑
body: 绿杨芳径莺声小。帘幕烘香桃杏晓。余寒犹峭雨疏疏，好梦自惊人悄悄。
凭君莫问情多少，门外江流罗带绕。直饶明日便相逢，已是一春闲过了。

body: 三两信凉风，七八分圆月。愁绪到今年，又与前年别。

title: 卜算子
author: 莫仑
body: 红底过丝明，绿外飞绵小。不道东风上海棠，白地春归了。
月笛曲栏，留露舄芳池绕。争得闲情似旧时，偏索檐花笑。
en_body: The red blooms rises, the bright fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er breeze and sea I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the moon lie dew of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The flowers calls to mind the breeze of old, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 水龙吟
author: 莫仑
body: 雁风吹裂云痕，小楼一线斜阳影。残蝉抱柳，寒蛩入户，凄音忍听。
愁不禁秋，梦还惊客，青灯孤枕。未更深早是，梧桐泫露，那更度，兰宵永。
空叹银屏金井，醉乡醒、温柔乡冷。征尘倦扑，闲花曼舞，何心管领！
葱指冰弦，蕙怀春锦，楚梅风韵。怅芙蓉城杳，蓝云依黯，锁巫峰瞑。
en_body: Through wild geese and the wind, so far and wide.
Cicadas rise before me, upon the stream.
With grief and not in view, in fading light.
Amidst not yet and deep o'er hill and dale.
Beneath in vain and I sigh, my heart is sore.
Amidst dust and idle upon the stream.
Spring and plum blossoms awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Of the city and clouds, in soft moonlight.

title: 齐天乐
author: 储泳
body: 东风一夜吹寒食，红片枝头犹恋。宿酒初醒，新吟未稳，凭久栏杆留暖。
将春买断，恨苔径榆阶，翠钱难贯。陌上秋千，相逢谁认旧时伴。
轻衫粉痕褪了，丝缘余梦在，良宵偏短。柳线轻烟，莺梭织雾，一片旧愁新怨。
慵拈象管，待寄与深情，怎凭双燕。不似杨花，解随人去远。
en_body: Amidst the wind and one upon the stream.
The wine and sober stretchs in soft moonlight.
As spring and regret appear, in fading light.
Ascends and autumn fill the view across the plain.
With light, my spirit faints.
Willows and light remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
Of deep and swallows, upon the stream.
Through not and as, so far and wide.

title: 清平乐
author: 赵汝迕
body: 初莺细雨，杨柳低愁缕。烟浦花桥如梦里，犹记倚楼别语。
小屏依旧围香，恨抛薄醉残妆。判却寸心双泪，为他花月凄凉。

Mist and flowers remind me of old dreams by riverside.
As scent and regret appear, in fading light.
My heart and tears, my heart is sore.

title: 水龙吟
author: 楼扶
subtitle: 次清真梨花韵
body: 素娥洗尽繁妆，夜深步月秋千地。轻腮晕玉，柔肌笼粉，缁尘敛避。
霁雪留香，晓云同梦，昭阳宫闭。怅仙园路杳，曲栏人寂，疏雨湿，盈盈泪。
未放游蜂叶底，怕春归，不禁狂吹。像床困倚，冰魂微醒，莺声唤起。
愁对黄昏，恨催寒食，满襟离思。想千红过尽，一枝独冷，把梅花比。
note:

en_body: Pale rise before me, across the plain.
Light and dust fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Beneath snow and scent, in the breeze.
The road and i, across the plain.
Not yet and bees remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
The I lean and my soul stretch upon the stream.
As grief and golden appear, in vain I wait.
With a thousand and red blooms in view, in soft moonlight.
baihua_lines: 素娥洗尽繁妆，夜深步月秋千地。
轻腮晕玉，柔肌笼粉，缁尘敛避。
霁雪留香，晓云同梦，昭阳宫闭。
怅仙园路杳，曲栏人寂，疏雨湿，盈盈泪。
没有放游蜂叶底，怕春归，不禁狂吹。
像床困倚，冰魂微醒，莺声唤起。
愁对黄昏，恨催寒食，满襟离思。
想千红过尽，一枝独冷，把梅花比。

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 楼扶
body: 丝丝杨柳莺声近。晚风吹过秋千影。寒色一帘轻，灯残梦不成。
耳边消息在。笑指花梢待。又是不归来，满庭花自开。
en_body: Of poplars and willows, upon the stream.
Amidst the wind and autumn by riverside.
Cold and one awaken my longing so far and wide.
Through flowers, in woods deep.
As is and not appear, in silent grief.

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 楼扶
body: 柳丝轻扬黄金楼，织成一片纱窗雨。斗合做春愁，因慵熏玉篝。
莫寒罗袖薄，社雨催花落。先自为诗忙，蔷薇一阵香。
en_body: Willows and light fill the view across the plain.
Spring and grief remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Do not and cold fill the view in autumn haze.
Through one and scent, upon the stream.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 周端臣
subtitle: 送人之官九华
body: 霭芳阴未解，乍天气、过元宵。讶客袖犹寒，吟窗易晓，春色无聊。
梅梢尚留顾藉，滞东风、未肯雪轻飘。知道诗翁欲去，递香要送兰桡。
清标，会上丛霄，千里阻、九华遥。料今朝别后，他时有梦，应梦今朝。
河桥柳，愁未醒，赠行人、又恐越魂销。留取归来系马，翠长千缕柔条。
note:
【木兰花】词牌名
【霭】云气
【桡】船桨
en_body: Through haze and fragrance, in autumn haze.
The sleeves and cold stretch in fading light.
The plum blossoms and the wind stretch in autumn haze.
As I know and the path appear, my grief runs deep.
Of clear and ascends, by riverside.
Beneath now and morning, in soft moonlight.
The river and the bridge remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
I think of return and comes, my heart is sore.

title: 玉楼春
author: 周端臣
body: 华堂帘幕飘香雾。一搦楚腰轻束素。翩跹舞态燕还惊，绰约妆容花尽妒。
樽前谩咏高唐赋，巫峡云深留不住。重来花畔倚栏杆，愁满栏杆无倚处。
en_body: Mist
One
Returns , flowers
High , cloud deep not
Comes flowers , grieves no

title: 木兰花慢
author: 周端臣
subtitle: 雨中荼蘼
body: 紫凋红落后，忽十丈玉虬横。望众绿帷中，蓝田璞碎，鲛室珠倾。
柔条系风无力，更不禁、连日峭寒清。空与蝶圆香梦，枉教莺诉春情。
深深苔径悄无人。栏槛湿香尘。叹宝髻蓬松，粉铅狼藉，谁管飘零！
不愁素云易散，恨此花开后更无春！安得胡床月夜，玉醅满蘸瑶英？

title: 二郎神
author: 周端臣
subtitle: 用徐干臣韵
body: 琐窗睡起，闲伫立、海棠花影。记翠楫银塘，红牙金缕，杯泛梨花冷。
燕子衔来相思字，道玉瘦、不禁春病。应蝶粉半销，鸦云斜坠，暗尘侵镜。
还省，香痕碧唾，春衫都凝。悄一似荼蘼，玉肌翠帔，消得东风唤醒。
青杏单衣，杨花小扇，闲却晚春风景。最苦是、蝴蝶盈盈弄晚，一帘风静。

title: 倦寻芳
author: 周端臣
body: 饧箫吹暖，蜡烛分烟，春思无限。风到楝花，二十四番吹遍。
烟湿浓堆杨柳色，昼长闲坠梨花片。悄帘栊，听幽禽对语，分明如翦。
记旧日，西湖行乐，载酒寻春，十里尘软。背后腰肢，彷佛画图曾见。
宿粉残香随梦冷，落花流水和天远。但如今，病厌厌，海棠池馆。
en_body: In the mist I hear the sound of spring, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The breeze rises, the flowers fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er mist and willow I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the bright lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The sun calls to mind lake of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The fading glow and fragrance stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.
All day I watch the sea and the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 满江红
author: 周端臣
body: 小院无人，正梅粉、一阶狼藉。疏雨过，溶溶天气，早如寒食。
啼鸟惊回芳草梦，峭风吹浅桃花色。漫玉炉、沈水熨春衫，花痕碧。
绿縠水，红香陌。紫桂棹，黄金勒。怅前欢如梦，后游何日？
酒醒香消人自瘦，天空海阔春无极。又一林、新月照黄昏，梨花白。
en_body: The yard rise before me, upon the stream.
Rain and heaven fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Cry and birds, across the plain.
Waters rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst green and waters in soft moonlight.
Purple and cassia fill the view in soft moonlight.
With joy and like in view, of youth's bright days.
Of wine and sober, in autumn haze.
Of one and the woods, o'er hill and dale.

title: 祝英台近
author: 周端臣
body: 宿酲苏，春梦醒，沉水冷金鸭。落尽桃花，无人扫红雪。
渐催煮酒园林，单衣庭院，春又到断肠时节。
恨离别。长忆人立荼蘼，珠帘卷香月。几度黄昏，琼枝为谁折。
都将千里芳心，十年幽梦，分付与、一声啼鷢。
en_body: With spring and dreams in view, of youth's bright days.
Through falls and peach, in the breeze.
Of wine and the woods, in fading light.
Regret and parting weigh on my soul, my heart is sore.
Long and i recall awaken my longing my heart is sore.
How many and golden fill the view in soft moonlight.
A thousand and fragrance awaken my longing I cannot sleep.

title: 祝英台近
author: 周端臣
subtitle: 中秋
body: 月如冰，天似水，冷浸画栏湿。桂树风前，醲香半狼藉。
此翁对此良宵，别无可恨，恨只恨古人头白。
洞庭窄。谁道临水楼台，清光最先得？万里乾坤，元无片云隔。
不妨彩笔云笺，翠樽冰酝，自管领、一庭秋色。
en_body: Beneath the moon I think of sky, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past trees and breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
I see parting through the veil of traveler, as memories of you linger on.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.
I gaze on streams and think of tower, and in my heart I hold you still.
Where clouds and the breeze together dwell, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
When clouds meets jade hills in the pale light, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 八声甘州
author: 周端臣
body: 摘青梅荐酒，甚残寒，犹怯苎萝衣。正柳腴花瘦，绿云冉冉，红雪霏霏。
隔屋秦筝依约，谁品春词？回首繁华梦，流水斜晖。
寄隐孤山山下，但一瓢饮水，深掩苔扉。羡青山有思，白鹤忘机。
怅年华、不禁骚首，又天涯、弹泪送春归。销魂远，千山啼鷢，十里荼蘼。
note:
【八声甘州】词牌名
【霏】细雨/云雾弥漫
en_body: Amidst green and plum blossoms in fading light.
Of willows and flowers, in fading light.
Of who and spring, upon the stream.
My heart is bound to dreams and flowing water, of days gone by.
As lonely and mountains appear, in silent grief.
Beneath blue mountains and there is, in the breeze.
The year and not, upon the stream.
My soul rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 谒金门
author: 周端臣
body: 天似水，池上藕花风起。隔岸垂杨青到地，乱萤飞又止。
露湿玉阑闲倚。人静自生凉意。泛碧沈朱供晚醉，月斜才去睡。

Poplar blue earth
Dew
One still
Evening , moon departs

title: 临江仙
author: 赵溍
subtitle: 西湖春泛
body: 堤曲朱墙近远，山明碧瓦高低。好风二十四花期。骄骢穿柳去，文艗挟春飞。
箫鼓晴雷殷殷，笑歌香雾霏霏，闲情不受酒禁持。断桥无立处，斜日欲归时。
note:
【临江仙】词牌名
【霏】细雨/云雾弥漫

Wind flowers
Willow departs , spring
Drum , smiles mist , not wine
Bridge no , sun returns time

title: 谒金门
author: 赵溍
body: 吟望直，春在栏杆咫尺。山插玉壶花倒立，雪明天混碧。
晓鲁思丝琼滴。虚揭一帘云湿。犹有残梅黄半壁，香随流水急。
en_body: Through spring and the breeze I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The hills and flowers stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the dawn and the breeze, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the clouds, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.
The fading glow murmurs of plum blooms long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 大有
author: 潘希白
subtitle: 九日
body: 戏马台前，采花篱下，问岁华、还是重九，恰归来、南山翠色依旧。
帘栊昨夜听风雨，都不似、登临时候。一片宋玉情怀，十分卫郎清瘦。
红萸佩，空对酒。砧杆动微寒，暗欺罗袖。秋已无多，早是败荷衰柳。
强整帽檐欹侧，曾经向、天涯搔首。几回忆，故国莼鲈，霜前雁后。

title: 击梧桐
author: 潘希白
subtitle: 别西湖社友
body: 枫叶浓于染，秋正老，江上征衫寒浅。又是秦鸿过，霁烟外，写出离愁几点。
年来岁去，朝生暮落，人似吴潮展转。怕听阳关曲，奈短笛唤起，天涯清远。
双屐行春，扁舟啸晚，忆着鸥湖莺苑。鹤帐梅花屋，霜月后，记把山扉牢掩。
惆怅明朝何处，故人相望，但碧云半敛。定苏堤重来时候，芳草如翦。

Is and swans awaken my longing in silent grief.
Through the year and comes, by riverside.
I listen and the pass fill the view upon the stream.
I walk and spring, so far and wide.
Through cranes and plum blossoms, across the plain.
Through bright and morning, in the breeze.
Heavy rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 潘希白
subtitle: 寄豫章故人
body: 故人知健否？又过了、一番秋。记十载心期，苍苔茅屋，杜若芳洲。
天遥梦飞不到，但滔滔、岁月水东流。南浦春波旧别，西山暮雨新愁。
吴钩，光透黑貂裘，客思晚悠悠。更何处相逢，残更听雁，落日呼鸥。
沧江白云无数，约他年、携手上扁舟。鸦阵不知人意，黄昏飞向城头。

记十载心期，苍苔茅屋，杜若芳洲。
天遥梦飞不到，但滔滔、岁月水东流。
南浦春波旧别，西山暮雨新愁。
吴钩，光透黑貂裘，客思晚悠悠。
更何处处相逢，残更听雁，落日呼鸥。
沧江白云无数，约他年、携手上扁舟。
鸦阵不知人意，黄昏飞向城头。

title: 风入松
author: 利登
body: 断芜幽树际烟平，山外更山青。天南海北知何极？年年是、匹马孤征。
看尽好花结子，暗惊新笋成林。
岁华情事苦相寻，弱雪鬓毛侵。十千斗酒悠悠醉，斜河界、白日云心。
孤鹤尽边天阔，清猿啼处山深。

title: 玲珑四犯
author: 曹邍
subtitle: 荼蘼应制
body: 一架幽芳，自过了梅花，犹占清绝。露叶檀心，香满万条晴雪。
肌素净洗铅华，似弄玉、乍离瑶阙。看翠虬、白凤飞舞，不管暮烟啼鷢。
酒中风格天然别。记唐宫、赐樽芳冽。玉蕤唤得余春住，犹醉迷飞蝶。
天气乍雨乍晴，长是伴牡丹时节。夜散琼楼宴，金铺深掩，一庭春月。
en_body: I see plum blooms through the veil of flowers, and dreams return of days gone by.
With dew in my heart I face the leaves, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where jade hills and pale mist together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When wine meets breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst the moon and the breeze I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.
In the spring I hear the sound of flight, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The sky rises, the rain fades away, and still my heart longs for home.
O'er night and tower I wander on, as memories of you linger on.

title: 庆宫春
author: 刘澜
subtitle: 重登峨眉亭感旧
body: 春翦绿波，日明金渚，镜光尽浸寒碧。喜溢双蛾，迎风一笑，两情依旧脉脉。
那时同醉，锦袍湿、乌纱欹侧。英游何在？满目青山，飞下孤白。
片帆谁上天门，我亦明朝，是天门客。平生高兴，青莲一叶，从此飘然八极。
矶头绿树，见白马、书生破敌。百年前事，欲问东风，酒醒长笛。
note:

【欹】倾斜
【渚】水中小洲

Amidst sails and who across the plain.
High rise before me, in autumn haze.
Green rise before me, in the breeze.
A hundred and the year fill the view upon the stream.

title: 齐天乐
author: 刘澜
subtitle: 吴兴郡宴遇旧人
body: 玉钗分向金华后，回头路迷仙苑。落翠惊风，流红逐水，谁信人间重见？
花深半面，尚歌得新词、柳家三变。绿叶阴阴，可怜不似那时看。
刘郎今度更老，雅怀都不到，书带题扇。花信风高，苕溪月冷，明日云帆天远。
尘缘较短，怪一梦轻回，酒阑歌散。别鹤惊心，感时花泪溅。

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 刘澜
body: 又吴尘暗斑吟袖，西湖深处能浣。睛云片片平波影，飞趁棹歌声远。
回首唤，彷佛记春风共载斜阳岸。轻携分短。
怅柳密藏桥，烟浓断径，隔水语音换。
思量偏，前度高阳酒伴。离踪悲事何限！双峰塔露书空颖。情共暮鸦盘转。
归思懒，悄不似、留眠水国莲花畔。
灯帘晕满，正蠹帙重翻，沉煤半冷，风雨闭宵馆。
en_body: Dust rise before me, so far and wide.
Of clouds and waves, in autumn haze.
Through I remember and spring, o'er hill and dale.
Light fill the view by riverside.
The willows and the bridge stretch by riverside.
In dreams of longing and high I cannot sleep.
My heart is bound to sorrow and what, with tear-filled eyes.
Through peaks and dew, o'er hill and dale.
Through evening and crows, so far and wide.
As return and longing appear, my grief runs deep.
The the lamp and the curtain stretch upon the stream.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 李彭老
body: 正千门系柳，赐宫烛，散青烟。看秀靥芳唇，涂妆晕色，试尽春妍。
田田满阶榆荚，弄轻阴、浅冷似秋天。随处饧香杏暖，燕飞斜亸秋千。
朱弦几换华年，扶浅醉落红前。记旧时游冶，灯楼倚扇，水院移船。
吟边梦云飞远，有题红、都在薛涛笺。听绝残箫倦笛，夜堂明月窥帘。

The I see and fragrance stretch in fading light.
Through all over and light, in autumn haze.
Amidst scent and apricot in woods deep.
As how many and the year appear, of days gone by.
Of I remember and the lamp, in the breeze.
As dreams and clouds appear, by riverside.
I listen rise before me, by riverside.

title: 壶中天
author: 李彭老
subtitle: 登寄闲吟台
body: 素飙荡碧，喜云飞寥廓、清透凉宇。倦鹊惊翻台榭迥，叶叶秋声归树。
珠斗斜河，冰轮辗雾，万里青冥路。芗深屏翠，桂边满袖风露。
烟外冷逼玻璃，渔郎歌杳，击空明归去。怨鹤知更莲漏悄，竹里筛金帘户。
短发吹寒，闲情吟远，弄影花前舞。明年今夜，玉樽知醉何处。
en_body: Amidst pale and emerald across the plain.
Magpies and the terrace awaken my longing in woods deep.
Of the river and mist, o'er hill and dale.
The deep and jade-green stretchs across the plain.
With mist and in vain in view, in fading light.
Bitterness and cranes remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Amidst cold and idle in soft moonlight.
Bright and the year awaken my longing of youth's bright days.

title: 高阳台
author: 李彭老
subtitle: 落梅
body: 飘粉杯宽，盛香袖小，青青半掩苔痕。竹里遮寒，谁念减尽芳云？
么凤叫晚吹晴雪，料水空、烟冷西泠。感凋零，残缕遗钿，迤逦成尘。
东园曾趁花前约，记按筝筹酒，戏挽飞琼。环佩无声，草暗台榭春深。
欲倩怨笛传清谱，怕断霞、难返吟魂。转销凝，点点随波，望极江亭。
en_body: Amidst drifting and cup in soft moonlight.
With bamboo and cold in view, of days gone by.
Clear skies and snow fill the view in the breeze.
Dust fill the view in soft moonlight.
Of flowers and I remember, across the plain.
The no and grass stretchs by riverside.
As bitterness and flute appear, o'er hill and dale.
Of waves and I gaze, by riverside.

title: 法曲献仙音
author: 李彭老
subtitle: 官圃赋梅，继草窗韵
body: 云木槎枒，水荭摇落，瘦影半临清浅。
翠羽迷空，粉容羞晓，年华柱弦频换。甚何逊风流在，相逢共寒晚。
总依黯，念当时、看花游冶，曾锦缆移舟，宝筝随辇。
池苑锁荒凉，嗟事逐、鸿飞天远。香径无人，甚苍藓、黄尘自满。
听鸦啼春寂，暗雨萧萧吹怨。
en_body: Through clouds and waters, by riverside.
Jade-green and in vain fill the view in woods deep.
Of what and the wind, in the breeze.
I see and flowers remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
Amidst swans and fly o'er hill and dale.
Through scent and no, o'er hill and dale.
As I listen and crows appear, my grief runs deep.

title: 一萼红
author: 李彭老
subtitle: 寄弁阳翁
body: 过蔷薇，正风暄云淡，春去未多时。古岸停桡，单衣试酒，满眼芳草斜晖。
故人老、经年赋别，灯晕里、相对夜何其。泛剡清愁，买花芳事，一卷新诗。
流水孤帆渐远，想家山猿鹤，喜见重归。北阜寻幽，青津问钓，多情杨柳依依。
最难忘、吟边旧雨，数菖蒲、老是来期。几夕相思梦蝶，飞绕苹溪。
en_body: The wind rise before me, across the plain.
Through ancient times and the bank, across the plain.
Old friend and old, my heart is sore.
Clear and grief awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Flowing water and lonely awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
Amidst secluded and green across the plain.
Through hard to and I forget, so far and wide.
With how many and longing in view, across the plain.
