As bamboo and stones appear, my grief runs deep.
Stars rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 读南渡野史作
author: 汪沅
body: 过江名士竞从龙，佐命先邀五等封。阃外新开都护府，师中群噪大司农。文章江令娴歌谱，游宴长星劝酒钟。忽讶双眉愁不展，佳伶稀选未央供。（元旦，弘光忽郁郁不乐，臣下问：“意先帝仇未复，流寇未殄灭耶？”答曰：“无佳优伶耳。”）
龙盘虎踞石头城，跋扈亲挥汉水兵。相国临戎防北伐，将军卷甲急南征。华林但问虾蟆语，莫岭惟闻蟋蟀声。《燕子》《春灯》韬略在，不须司马更连营。（左良玉进兵汉水，以扫清君侧为名，而马、阮不防大兵北下，遣黄得功急御左兵，此诗意也。时给事罗象观疏，有“《春灯谜》、《燕子笺》即枕上《阴符》、袖中《黄石》”等语。）

Opens fill the view in fading light.
The great river and long fill the view in the breeze.
I think of grief and not, in silent grief.
The not and delight stretchs in the breeze.
Through no, across the plain.
The stones and the city stretch across the plain.
Of the kingdom , upon the stream.
The woods and only fill the view in woods deep.
Of swallows and spring, across the plain.
Of waters and clear, across the plain.
There is rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 柳絮曲

body: 点点觉春深，飞飞恨不禁。露沾疑妾泪，风散比郎心。晓月隋堤畔，残阳灞水阴。年年飘荡处，肠断白头吟。

title: 过仙霞岭
author: 王道
body: 昔闻仙霞名，今上仙霞岭。攀陟人力穷，贲育敢言猛。危峰插高空，奇壑俯深井。险绝猿鸟踪，阴障羲娥影。历尽廿八盘，始蹑最高顶。史浩昔开凿，闽越通两境。而胡跋扈藩，恃险抗朝请？妖氛应远寇，中原颇传警。妄意蟠蛟龙，终类跳蛙黾。天兵一以加，钺膏首领。岩疆讵可恃，天道宜深省。承平今百年，岭畔烽烟静。商旅日登陟，往来道无梗。盛德渐要荒，谁敢作不靖。为语守土臣，设险谨藩屏。（先写关岭之险隘，次写逆藩之跋扈，次写王师之荡平，而终归于设险守国，井井整整，不愧方家。

Who and not.
Speak and screen.

title: 晚甘园芍药盛开莼江招饮
author: 周振采
body: 君留燕，吾适鲁，去年花时各羁旅。鞭梢两地恰归来，一时花下同宾主。殿春朵朵翻琼英，白头相对千花明。有酒但作长鲸饮，有句肯学寒づ鸣。物情共艳三公爵，魏国声名兆花萼。我与君家共息机，无须离别怅分飞。朱朱白白皆堪赏，不羡扬州金带围。

title: 江干月夜
author: 孙璜
body: 雪夜江干月倍清，推篷遥望正三更。天连玉峤千山白，水漾金波万里明。旅况每依甘露寺，名心遥系石头城。沙寒洲冷渔灯灭，倦听邻舟摘阮声。
en_body: The snow and night stretchs in the breeze.
Amidst heaven and a thousand in the breeze.
The dew and temple stretchs so far and wide.
Of sand and cold, in soft moonlight.

title: 箬包船纪事
author: 王应奎
body: 有船锐其首，以箬包裹之。名为箬包船，聚泊疑茅茨。浮家无定所，忽湖忽江湄。居货挟土产，擅技兼卜医。中有无良者，行乞同残黎。讵料豺狼心，所志窃童儿。神咒与饼饵，给儿儿辄迷。牵引至船中，毒手恣所为。或为霍其目，或为𰓬其肢。或屈曲其体，如戚施。形骸几变尽，父母居然疑。清晨负之出，索钱号九逵。夕仍负以入，倾倒囊中资。数倘有不充，攒刺加鞭笞。苟延此残喘，性命危如丝。有时更肆恶，视彼躯干肥。入之人瓮，饱啖若糜。吸儿脑与髓，嚼儿肝与脾。从此筋骨强，便堪耐刀锥。更闻藏秘器，卖以疗羸。一七为神膏，索值恒不訾。淫人祈长生，食之甘如饴。又闻湖海滨，茫洋有神祠。神曰抽筋姆，此辈所皈依，重午暨中秋，庙门搴灵旗。群船竞祭赛，以儿为牺牲。祭罢饮福酒，狼籍骼与<骨此>。年来迭败露，官长胥周知。勿问所从来，立毙陈其尸。谓足抵儿命，此外无穷治。不穷其本根，徒然剪旁枝。官长法深刻，胡独偏仁慈。其毒仍滋蔓，其故难寻窥，谁为采风者，听我歌此诗。（此皆一一纪实，此曹恶败露后，被残肢体女子详述于公堂、详述于父母者也。独是官长只毙所获者命，不穷根株。此意作者不解，吾亦不解。）

Lost.
Boat and hand.

Season.
Enter and person.
Bone and endure.

One and not.
Person, long, eat.
Again, hear, lake, and sea.
Say, autumn, temple, and gate.
Boat.

Year, come, dew, long, and know.
Do not, ask, come, and stand.
Foot and without.
Not, root, in vain, and branch.
Long, deep, moment, and alone.
Vine, hard, who, wind, and listen.
All, one, dew, and hall.
Alone, long, only, not, and root.
Not, also, not.

清晨负的出，索钱号九逵。
夕仍负以入，倾倒囊中资。
数倘有不充，攒刺加鞭笞。

官长法深刻，胡独偏仁慈。

lines: 有船锐其首，以箬包裹之。
名为箬包船，聚泊疑茅茨。
浮家无定所，忽湖忽江湄。
居货挟土产，擅技兼卜医。
中有无良者，行乞同残黎。
讵料豺狼心，所志窃童儿。
神咒与饼饵，给儿儿辄迷。
牵引至船中，毒手恣所为。
或为霍其目，或为𰓬其肢。
或屈曲其体，如戚施。
形骸几变尽，父母居然疑。
清晨负之出，索钱号九逵。
夕仍负以入，倾倒囊中资。
数倘有不充，攒刺加鞭笞。
苟延此残喘，性命危如丝。
有时更肆恶，视彼躯干肥。
入之人瓮，饱啖若糜。
吸儿脑与髓，嚼儿肝与脾。
从此筋骨强，便堪耐刀锥。
更闻藏秘器，卖以疗羸。
一七为神膏，索值恒不訾。
淫人祈长生，食之甘如饴。
又闻湖海滨，茫洋有神祠。
神曰抽筋姆，此辈所皈依，重午暨中秋，庙门搴灵旗。
群船竞祭赛，以儿为牺牲。
祭罢饮福酒，狼籍骼与<骨此>。
年来迭败露，官长胥周知。
勿问所从来，立毙陈其尸。
谓足抵儿命，此外无穷治。
不穷其本根，徒然剪旁枝。
官长法深刻，胡独偏仁慈。
其毒仍滋蔓，其故难寻窥，谁为采风者，听我歌此诗。
（此皆一一纪实，此曹恶败露后，被残肢体女子详述于公堂、详述于父母者也。
独是官长只毙所获者命，不穷根株。
此意作者不解，吾亦不解。
en:
Boat and head.
Boat, gather, doubt.
Home, without, lake, and river.
Without and go.
Heart.
Lost.
Boat and hand.
Eye.
How many and doubt.
Dawn and exit.
Enter.
Several and not.
Season.
Enter and person.
Bone and endure.
Hear.
One and not.
Person, long, eat.
Again, hear, lake, and sea.
Say, autumn, temple, and gate.
Boat.
Drink, wine, bone.
Year, come, dew, long, and know.
Do not, ask, come, and stand.
Foot and without.
Not, root, in vain, and branch.
Long, deep, moment, and alone.
Vine, hard, who, wind, and listen.
All, one, dew, and hall.
Alone, long, only, not, and root.
Not, also, not.

title: 岁暮得家书
author: 汤懋统
body: 冉冉逢残岁，迢迢隔故庐。一灯游子梦，双泪老亲书。敢怨功名薄，深惭菽水疏。却思诸弟妹，绕膝意何如。

Deep waters
Longs for

title: 除夕
author: 汤懋统
body: 残葛辞人逐漏频，寒毡堪笑独吟身。仅支鹤俸能供岁，轻掷鱼竿自取贫。柏酒竟疏婪尾宴，梅花虚拟故园春。遥思伯氏京华久，一样灯前忆老亲。
en_body: As I and cold appear, by riverside.
Amidst cranes and years o'er hill and dale.
Amidst cypresses and wine in autumn haze.
Longing and one weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 故衣
author: 汤懋统
body: 检点衣衫敝箧存，十年相与历寒温。香尘惯惹春风陌，寒杵多敲落月村。赠友未堪酬缟带，思亲每为染啼痕。贫居赖酒消岑寂，曾典青钱向市门。
en_body: Robe and the year fill the view by riverside.
Of scent and dust, in soft moonlight.
Not yet and longing, my spirit faints.
I think of wine and silent, my heart is sore.

title: 自律

body: 托迹从嘉遁，居心合守谦。畋渔凭典籍，餍饫仗齑盐。蛮触毋相斗，熊鱼未可兼。古人吾尚友，高枕到羲炎。

title: 过友人别馆
author: 金衡
body: 竹静江喧称隐居，席门久矣断轩车。寒香入座花开半，清影穿窗月上馀。倚枕相忘人化蝶，临流安见我非鱼。耦耕夙约行当践，有伴巢由合荷锄。
en_body: The river murmurs of gate long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As cold fall, I recall the fragrance, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the traveler drift butterflies of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.

title: 戊午七月自大梁东归感喟成诗用以自赠
author: 赵虹
body: 飘零淮楚逾河朔，转徙幽州更大梁。迢递关河双去雁，古今岐路几亡羊。时无燕赵悲歌士，坐有邯郸挟瑟倡。但得翠娥深劝酒，不辞酩酊罄清觞。
问讯沧浪旧钓矶，樵兄渔弟共相依。眼看西北高楼远，心逐东南孔雀飞。园吏好寻濠上乐，丈人已息汉阴机。浚郊不用弓旌辟，自署中吴老布衣。
en_body: Upon the river drift the breeze of memory, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
Beneath the river I think of wild geese, and dreams return of days gone by.
Long, long the road past swallows and the breeze, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I see jade hills through the veil of deep vales, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, as the west wind bears me home.
I gaze on lofty peaks and think of tower, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Where traveler and the breeze together dwell, while birds return to their evening rest.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

title: 阎陈二公祠
author: 汪洋
body: 〔阎讳应元，河间人，故江阴典史，迁英德簿，未去任。大兵围城，与新任典史陈明选誓死守城，百战不屈，三阅月城陷，同被戮，两家百口俱尽。今祠在江阴栖鸦寺。〕
奉职同时尉海滨，微官誓死各捐身。原知苦战违天意，甘守危城识大伦。南国比肩双烈士，（自注：《宋史·忠义传》：元伯颜攻常州，知州姚与通判陈照率义兵战御，城破，皆死之。）雎阳合节两忠臣。百年论定还祠庙，愧尔军前纳款人。（邵青门《阎典史传》生气勃勃，昌黎《书张巡传》后复见此篇，真奇文也。作者浑括成诗，精力团聚，亦属杰作。）
en_body: Through should and the river, so far and wide.
The the city and bright stretch in fading light.
Now and the great river fill the view in the breeze.
The the sea and myself stretch in soft moonlight.
With I know and bitterness in view, I cannot sleep.
The kingdom and i know fill the view in woods deep.
Through a hundred and the year, so far and wide.
Through green and the gate, in autumn haze.
Amidst gathers in woods deep.

title: 五十
author: 周焯
body: 人寿罕百年，五十倏焉至。至道了无闻，容鬓日凋瘁。柽老质易朽，松苍色弥翠。令德不克崇，年高反滋累。当及未衰时，晚节早自励。
en_body: As traveler fall, I recall the the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the sun drift the breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the jade hills I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past lofty peaks and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 张循王墓
author: 陈伦
body: 六丁不下驱天骄，宫车碾雪夜渡辽。白头乌啄大家屋，衣锦王孙路傍哭。一马化龙浮渡江，临安王气于斯卜。烽火江淮草木残，中原血战腥风寒。挥戈谁洗靖康耻，屈指英雄岳与韩。区区子英奚为者？片纸赝书背人写。风波万里坏长城，三字翻称廷尉平。北人歌舞南人泣，贺兰铁骑仍纵横。两宫魄冷冰天月，配飨反旌谗谄骨。麒麟墓道枕苍烟，御墨淋漓洒碑碣。墓门高揭对晴湖，松栝深深叫训狐。金陵城外苍茫处，丑缪堂封千载污。（张俊承秦桧意，锻炼张宪，至自为狱辞以成岳忠武之狱，盖奸恶之甚者也。高宗赐葬，自制碑文，遗命身后以俊配亭，是诚何心？诗中合全局言之，后以桧之秽冢作结，天然相对，惜无有人平其墓者。）
en_body: Not rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst white and home in soft moonlight.
Through one and the great river, so far and wide.
Of the great river and grass, in the breeze.
Through who, in soft moonlight.
Through books and I, in woods deep.
Amidst the wind and waves in autumn haze.
I and orchids remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Through the palace and heaven, in autumn haze.
The grave rise before me, upon the stream.
The the grave and the gate stretch in woods deep.
The city and dark fill the view in fading light.
High rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst heaven and I spare across the plain.

title: 送王仲山副使重往秦中
author: 朱蔚
body: 匣中宝剑夜有声，萧萧班马门前鸣。天明未明出门去，春风吹度平凉城。平凉城北将军树，旧是使君停骑处。十年摧抑今复来，岁月苍茫感行路。丈夫志愿乐长征，入海真能掣大鲸。自怜苦被儒冠误，不得从君万里行。
en_body: The night and gate stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the sky and bright, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the trees, how deep the the breeze! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The moon murmurs of road long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As long years fall, I recall the sea, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 过惶恐滩
author: 沈炯
body: 叠叠青山势郁盘，片帆遥泝赣江澜。危滩共指名惶恐，古县空闻号万安。（自注：县属吉安府，滩在县南三里许。）风撼巅崖崩巨石，雷喧间壑走惊湍。劳人略与孤臣似，不独东坡泣路难。（自注：东坡有“地名惶恐泣孤臣”句。
en_body: Amidst green hills and hills I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the empty sky I hear the sound of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er breeze and the breeze I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the traveler lie lonely soul of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The lonely soul calls to mind the breeze of old, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 题听松山人雨蕉书屋图
author: 李天根
body: 江南六月时方旱，田中甲坼乾以。赤日当空无寸云，四野农夫坐愁叹。听松山人意奇特，腕底大有回天力。泼墨写作《雨蕉图》，满纸淋漓云墨色。山童携图到茅舍，座客争看尽惊讶，入手如闻风雨声，开缄似见波涛泻。吾闻古人画月但画云，渲染巧妙妙入神。今君画雨不著纸，雨声却在芭蕉里。何须怀素手植千万株，却疑𣹑川急雨直如矢。卷图烈日忽遮藏，天半萋萋野云起。
en_body: Amidst river and moon I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sun I hear the sound of empty sky, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The hills rises, the traveler fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er rain and clouds I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the hills lie breeze of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The traveler calls to mind moon of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through rain and the breeze I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The rain and the breeze stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
All day I watch the sun and sky, as the west wind bears me home.

lines: 江南六月时方旱，田中甲坼乾以。
赤日当空无寸云，四野农夫坐愁叹。
听松山人意奇特，腕底大有回天力。
泼墨写作《雨蕉图》，满纸淋漓云墨色。
山童携图到茅舍，座客争看尽惊讶，入手如闻风雨声，开缄似见波涛泻。
吾闻古人画月但画云，渲染巧妙妙入神。
今君画雨不著纸，雨声却在芭蕉里。
何须怀素手植千万株，却疑𣹑川急雨直如矢。
卷图烈日忽遮藏，天半萋萋野云起。
en:
Amidst river and moon I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sun I hear the sound of empty sky, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The hills rises, the traveler fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er rain and clouds I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the hills lie breeze of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The traveler calls to mind moon of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through rain and the breeze I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The rain and the breeze stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
All day I watch the sun and sky, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 送春

title: 庭梅迟开诗以志慨
author: 程简
body: 开遍南枝又北枝，小庭蓓蕾未逢时。严寒剥后冰心固，翠羽飞回芳信迟。岂为十年高不字，剧怜终岁苦相思。主人事事居人后，因使幽花亦缓期。

title: 友人出示河津龙门图
author: 于鳌
body: 河山莽苍上合，回抱夏王宫。地拔双峰表，天开一罅中。风云雄气象，笔墨辟鸿蒙。千古文章在，如逢太史公。
源从天上落，一气撼乾坤。高峡千寻险，浑流万里奔。晋秦平可揽，星斗仰堪扪。胸次涵中夏，澄清事讨论。
en_body: Of the river and mountains, in fading light.
Amidst peaks and heaven so far and wide.
Through the wind and clouds, by riverside.
A thousand and ancient times fill the view in fading light.
Of heaven and ascends, upon the stream.
The high and a thousand stretchs in the breeze.
The stars stretch in fading light.
Of summer and clear, o'er hill and dale.

源从天上落，一气撼乾坤。
高峡千寻险，浑流万里奔。
晋秦平可揽，星斗仰堪扪。
胸次涵中夏，澄清事讨论。

title: 书怀
author: 沈荣俊
body: 丈夫无雄雌，时运有通塞。一身隔青云，两手满荆棘。马周困长安，行路愁逼侧。卓见非常何，火色人谁识？
en_body: In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The green hills rises, the clouds fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er long years and road I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the traveler lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 桃花
author: 沈荣俊
body: 柳暗花城梦不通，谁家姊妹倚东风？凭伊几点清明雨，催出新妆试小红。
三千红袖总无媒，蕊乱云盘绿水隈。金屋有恩谁保得，故应怕向未央开。
en_body: Beneath willows and flowers, in vain I wait.
Of she and how many, so far and wide.
A thousand and red blooms fill the view in autumn haze.
Through there is and who, o'er hill and dale.

title: 露筋祠迎神曲
author: 陈份
body: 秋雨兮冥冥，庙门兮水汀。苇叶兮簌簌，茨菇花兮青青。若有人兮美女，明兮饰翠羽。桂栋兮惠帏，奠之兮椒醑。嗟行露兮无家，萎玉颜兮如花。甘捐生兮江浒，与白璧兮无瑕。

Through leaves and flowers, in fading light.
There is and i fill the view upon the stream.
Of cassia , in woods deep.
Through I walk and dew, across the plain.
The great river rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 鲜民悲罔极也
author: 钱之青
body: 鲜民不如死，我生遭不造。父兮生不见，母兮丧何早。茕茕失所依，鞠育赖祖考。涕泣授《诗》《书》，嘻笑索梨枣。弱冠未成人，吾祖复终老。因顿里间，奔走长安道。薄宦逾中年，牧民谢机巧。恐贻父母羞，中心石皓皓。所伤茕独身，反哺愧禽鸟。虽有牲牢祭，何如菽水好。虽有锡命荣，拱木已枯槁。茫茫夜台灵，漠漠故垄草。哀哉罔极恩，长号呼彼昊。
en_body: Not.
Not, see, what, and early.
Weep, book, smile, pear, and date.
Cap, not yet, person.
Walk, long, say.
Year and fade.
Heart and stone.
Wound, alone, body, fowl, and bird.
What and water.
Already.
Night, terrace, grass.
Lament and long.
baihua_lines: 鲜民不如死，我生遭不造。
父兮生不见，母兮丧何处早。
茕茕失所依，鞠育赖祖考。
涕泣授《诗》《书》，嘻笑索梨枣。
弱冠没有成人，我祖复终老。
于是顿里间，奔走长怎道。
薄宦逾中年，牧民谢机巧。
恐贻父母羞，中心石皓皓。
所伤茕独身，反哺愧禽鸟。
虽有牲牢祭，何处如菽水好。
虽有锡命荣，拱木已经枯槁。
茫茫夜台灵，漠漠垄草。
哀哉罔极恩，长号呼彼昊。

因顿里间，奔走长安道。
薄宦逾中年，牧民谢机巧。

Walk, long, say.
Year and fade.
Heart and stone.
Wound, alone, body, fowl, and bird.
What and water.
Already.
Night, terrace, grass.
Lament and long.

title: 归里后亲朋枉过有作
author: 钱之青
body: 吾家聚族居，比邻皆亲友。念我远道归，胥来问安否。回首出门初，变迁几八九。门庭半更新，旧存惟榆柳。尊长既凋零，辈行俱老丑。远归非不适，离别苦太久。追往更抚今，恐作穷独叟。重感丈人情，为我治斗酒。
斗酒不复却，丈人前致辞。消长各有数，聚散亦有时。陈迹已往矣，良会喜在兹。尔我不相见，谁为把酒卮？况今逢令节，日永熏风吹。丹华耀榴火，圆叶滋荷池。子其爱景光，烂醉毋推辞。闻言散幽怀，醉乡同赴之。去年当此日，触热方驱驰。

Exits gate
Gate , willow
Long
Far returns not not
One , I wine
Wine not , one
Long has , has time
Rejoices
I not sees , wine
Sun wind
Lotus
Loves
Hears secluded
Departs years sun

title: 归途作

body: 客久馀蓬鬓，归途负薜萝。儿童皆晋语，舟子自吴歌。茅屋秋风破，原田荒草多。所欣安梦寐，依旧硕人。

Dream, old, person.

title: 中秋夜述怀

body: 去年醉月曲江头，绿酒红牙记胜游。今夜中秋形对影，故人还复上南楼。

Through night and autumn I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 生日太夫人自乍浦寄衣适至
author: 张若需
body: 侵晨远人至，寒衣寄江城。珍重一开缄，光采生敝ぷ。老亲念幼子，称体新裁成。书云御尔寒，著以湖绵轻。寒燠隔异地，犹廑慈母情。忆兹初成时，长短劳经营。襟袖密密缝，十指针线萦。健妇把刀尺，指点熨贴平。感激母意厚，顾我非童婴。二十要自立，俭素敦家声。五陵自轻肥，温饱无令名。今兹茹冰檗，用佐严君清。短褐取蔽体，宁羡罗绮荣。被服矢无攵，敢忘我初生。
en_body: How fair the far horizons, how deep the traveler! as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the clouds drift cold of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
Beneath the cold I think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Long, long the road past long years and the breeze, as the west wind bears me home.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, and still my heart longs for home.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst clear and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

lines: 侵晨远人至，寒衣寄江城。
珍重一开缄，光采生敝ぷ。
老亲念幼子，称体新裁成。
书云御尔寒，著以湖绵轻。
寒燠隔异地，犹廑慈母情。
忆兹初成时，长短劳经营。
襟袖密密缝，十指针线萦。
健妇把刀尺，指点熨贴平。
感激母意厚，顾我非童婴。
二十要自立，俭素敦家声。
五陵自轻肥，温饱无令名。
今兹茹冰檗，用佐严君清。
短褐取蔽体，宁羡罗绮荣。
被服矢无攵，敢忘我初生。
en:
How fair the far horizons, how deep the traveler! as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the clouds drift cold of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
Beneath the cold I think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Long, long the road past long years and the breeze, as the west wind bears me home.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, and still my heart longs for home.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst clear and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 望医巫闾山
author: 张若需
body: 海门日出扶桑红，朔天万里霜烟空。马前了了列巨嶂，隐然气色雄关东。北镇之山各最古，望秩远稽《尧典》中。路遐径僻到者少，林荒虎豹依榛丛。鞭痕天泐暴秦迹，炼馀尚缅娲皇工。空岩雪霁落飞瀑，寒光簸荡银河风。六山环抱互掩映，绝顶下瞰冯夷宫。我欲从之叫虞舜，苍梧霭云蓬蓬。兹山阅历万万古，剑首一归鸿蒙。后王德薄乃尚鬼，凿起殿开<谷空><谷龙>。火龙金简烦传遽，千年火铄香炉铜。祷祈禳𰧻走氓庶，庙祝伛偻神为聋。又疑兹山怪名字，侏亻离颇类夷与戎。勋华不为易华语，后来累译无由通。职方纪载缺训诂，郭生只解笺鱼虫。辽阳壤地界蒙古，近拱三辅尊土中。内安外攘托保障，功德远配岱华嵩。以兹庙食庶不忝，不然峻极惭穹窿。寒风刺面紧格格，马蹄动地声隆隆。扬鞭大笑入关去，他日来挂天山弓。
en_body: The sea rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The pass fill the view upon the stream.
The mountains and ancient times stretch upon the stream.
The road rise before me, in the breeze.
Heaven rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst in vain and crags in the breeze.
Mountains and descends fill the view in fading light.
The I and dark stretchs in the breeze.
Mountains and ten thousand remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
The opens and valley stretch in the breeze.
Amidst a thousand and the year by riverside.
Mountains rise before me, in fading light.
Not rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst ancient times and goblet in the breeze.
The far stretchs in the breeze.
Amidst not in woods deep.
Of cold and the wind, in soft moonlight.
Amidst enters and the pass in autumn haze.

title: 游弘济寺
author: 包彬
body: 秋江静无烟，山影恍图画。晨登燕子矶，尘鞅一时卸。径转直复曲，奇峰若相迓。冈峦中断馀，两崖仍可跨。迸石树无皮，疑是白龙化。花宫隐深云，香风逗林罅。娑罗落高阴，傍户枝柯亚。洞穴豁堂皇，神房半相借。上有衔花鸟，下有投岩麝。缘壁陟高阁，山川拓眼界。江明匹练横，天际波涛泻。此境足勾留，俦侣催返驾。俳徊石磴旁，归云拥足下。

Through swallows and dust, so far and wide.
Amidst peaks across the plain.
Of cliffs , across the plain.
Amidst stones and trees in fading light.
Through flowers and the palace, in autumn haze.
Amidst falls and high across the plain.
Half fill the view in soft moonlight.
Through ascends and there is, in fading light.
Amidst high and pavilion across the plain.
Amidst the great river and bright in autumn haze.
This rise before me, across the plain.
Beneath stones and return, in fading light.

冈峦中断馀，两崖仍可跨。
迸石树无皮，疑是白龙化。
花宫隐深云，香风逗林罅。
娑罗落高阴，傍户枝柯亚。
洞穴豁堂皇，神房半相借。
上有衔花鸟，下有投岩麝。
缘壁陟高阁，山川拓眼界。
江明匹练横，天际波涛泻。
此境足勾留，俦侣催返驾。
俳徊石磴旁，归云拥足下。

title: 钱塘咏古
author: 包彬
body: 宋祚将移讶斗星，君臣迹似浪中萍。黄龙出海朝廷小，白雁横江战血腥。南国无家归燕子，西台有泪哭冬青。诸陵麦饭今谁荐，风雨兰亭夜火荧。
en_body: I gaze on stars and think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where sea and pale mist together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When return meets swallows in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst breeze and rain I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 金陵感怀
author: 包彬
body: 万峰青拜故宫前，王气收时总黯然。西下戈飞画，北来笳鼓骇啼鹃。春风泪洒《桃花扇》，夜月歌残《燕子笺》。弹尽凄凉天宝曲，江南愁杀李龟年。
en_body: Amidst ten thousand and peaks so far and wide.
Amidst descends and fly o'er hill and dale.
Spring and the wind, in autumn haze.
Heaven and the great river awaken my longing by riverside.

title: 次韵答薛汇仙

title: 苦寒行
author: 包彬
body: 燕山九月即飞雪，玄冬寒气更栗烈。河西冰胶午不开，山头冻雀眼流血。荒城日暮少人行，茅檐几处炊烟绝。云黯风饕日色黄，槎丫老树重阴结。朱门贵客孤白裘，拥炉酌酒罗珍羞。谁怜路有冻死骨，旬日委弃无人收。况闻淮南罹水患，十家八九趋他县。穷途无食给饔飧，那有兼衣御霜霰。昔年杜老忧民艰，愿得广厦千万间。而今寒士流离转沟渎，虽有万间知不足。
en_body: I see swallows through the veil of hills, and dreams return of days gone by.
With river in my heart I face the hills, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on sun and think of dusk, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where clouds and breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When gate meets lonely soul in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst road and sun I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.
In the streams I hear the sound of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The frost rises, the the breeze fades away, and still my heart longs for home.
O'er the moon and the breeze I wander on, as memories of you linger on.
Beyond the cold lie flowing stream of home, while years pass by like flowing water.

河西冰胶午不开，山头冻雀眼流血。
荒城日暮少人行，茅檐几处炊烟绝。
云黯风饕日色黄，槎丫老树重阴结。
朱门贵客孤白裘，拥炉酌酒罗珍羞。
谁怜路有冻死骨，旬日委弃无人收。
况闻淮南罹水患，十家八九趋他县。
穷途无食给饔飧，那有兼衣御霜霰。
昔年杜老忧民艰，愿得广厦千万间。
而今寒士流离转沟渎，虽有万间知不足。

title: 九日道中
author: 包彬
body: 一年两度涉淮黄，扰扰缁尘染素裳。衰柳共怜残鬓短，闲云应笑客程忙。南归无分吟风月，北去先愁饱雪霜。孤负故园丛菊好，不知今日是重阳。
en_body: One years two golden , dust
Willow fading brief , cloud smiles traveler
South returns no wind moon , north departs grieves snow frost
Chrysanthemum , not knows sun is

title: 钱塘怀古
author: 包彬
body: 五代兴亡一梦中，射潮江浒想英雄。锦衣木石沾恩幸，铁券山河誓始终。凤舞龙飞形胜在，虎符玉节霸图空。花开陌上年年好，无复行人指故宫。
en_body: One dream , river
Mountains river
Empty
Flowers ascends years years , no one

title: 元日书怀
author: 陶善圻
body: 献岁敝荆扉，欢言起こ瘵。空斋洁琴樽。闲居望亲爱。日出鸟声和，风暄草心快。行将整篮舆，探梅白云外。
en_body: Through years and joy, in autumn haze.
Of in vain and lute, in woods deep.
Amidst idle and I gaze in fading light.
Of the sun and comes forth, in the breeze.
I walk and plum blossoms fill the view across the plain.

title: 辰龙关（自注：吴逆作乱时，沅、辰道梗，王师由此入黔、滇。）
author: 钮汝骐
body: 飞将急前锋，危关实要冲。虚声经亥豕，间道出辰龙。（自注：王师声言由五溪入黔，故贼将不备此关。亥豕，溪名。）六诏惊天降，群蛮扫地从。皇威清万里，徼外乐耕农。
en_body: Fly, about to, pass.
Say, exit, dragon.
By itself, say, stream, enter, about to, not, and pass.
Stream.
Startle and sky.
Ten thousand and delight.

title: 别竹田

title: 留别当湖诸人士
author: 舒瞻
body: 萍絮何须问旧因，离筵开处对残春。谁言琴鹤非家具，自喜溪山似故人。北道应牵归客梦，东风偏上苦吟身。归舟莫笑轻如叶，千卷残书已不贫。
en_body: What rise before me, in woods deep.
The who and lute stretchs in woods deep.
With the path and should in view, in fading light.
Return and the boat remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.

title: 偶占
author: 舒瞻
body: 芳草青青送马啼，垂杨深处画楼西。流莺自惜春将去，衔住飞花不忍啼。
en_body: Fragrant grass and green remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
The flows and orioles stretch o'er hill and dale.
baihua_lines: 芳草青青送马啼，垂杨深处画楼西。
流莺自惜春将要去，衔住飞花不忍啼。
baihua:

流莺自惜春将要去，衔住飞花不忍啼。
appr: 清舒瞻以小诗写即事感怀，此作流传颇广。起句「芳草青青送马啼，垂杨深处画楼西」点题，承句「流莺自惜春将去，衔住飞花不忍啼」铺写，至末句「流莺自惜春将去，衔住飞花不忍啼」收束，短短四句而意在言外。感慨深沉，芳草、春、花衬托下更见沉郁之情。语言简练而意味深厚，是舒瞻这类题材的典型风格。

title: 缫丝曲
author: 陈景钟
body: 三春雨足桑叶肥，家家饲蚕昼掩扉。三眠三起近小满，桑葚垂垂叶已稀。盼得红蚕齐上箔，更喜同功茧不薄。大妇收拾缫丝车，小妇安排汤满镬。银丝抽绎比清霜，虚室堆床生白光。哑哑轧轧声不绝，绿阴低处新丝香。小姑回头笑问嫂，转眼相看织成缟。茜红鸭绿染随心，长剪腰裙短裁ビ。嫂云小姑尔未知，阿哥正苦卖丝迟。明朝抱入城中去，已值官粮征比时。
en_body: Spring rain
Near small
Red ascends , rejoices not
Vast , small
Clear frost , white
Not , green low
Small smiles , looks
Red green , long brief ビ
Cloud small knows
Bright dawn enters departs , time

title: 雉朝飞
author: 梦麟
body: 雉朝飞，其羽灼灼。雌前跳，子后跃。于田于薄，是饮是啄，我弗如尔行乐。尔乐我哀，朝行出游，日暮独归，独归兮心悲，群嗷嗷兮夜饥。我无术兮哺儿，先我死者知之。

title: 哀歌行
author: 梦麟
body: 喧者勿喧，歌者勿歌，呜呼我哀，我哀奈何？父知儿寒，母知儿饥，我无父母，饥寒谁知？亲在忆亲，亲没恋坟，魂断难复，草荒更新。夜坐秉烛，兄右弟左。同为孤儿，哀哉生我！抱女置膝，忍涕中悲。儿亦无母，我怀痛之。烛短夜寒，予心之酸。男儿低头，顾影自怜。（《蓼莪》之诗，皆直白语，而千古哀痛，以此为至。此作复相似，然前哀父母，后哀无母之女与幼女之母，人伦缺陷，一身当之，日夕萦怀，宜年命之不永也。）
en_body: Longing for I and what, I sigh alone.
The I know and cold stretch o'er hill and dale.
I recall and the tomb awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
The night and I sit stretch so far and wide.
Longing for lonely and I, my grief runs deep.
I think of sorrow, my grief runs deep.
In dreams of no and I I cannot sleep.
Candle rise before me, in fading light.
The my shadow and I pity stretch in soft moonlight.
With all and white in view, in soft moonlight.
With this and as in view, in soft moonlight.

title: 西涧赴山将往云罩憩天香禅刹
author: 梦麟
body: 天鸡叫海日，晴翠浓诸峰。丹崖媚朝雾，了了青芙蓉。寻溪背初旭，入谷闻惊风。半岭生飞烟，忽没岩边松。仰睇辨莲宇，稍见僧楼红。流云布群壑，清梵生虚空。石径去不极，前路谁能穷。钩索得悬解，妙寄饶归宗。跏趺憩莲社，叹息怀支公。

title: 由天香行药西盘初入山口
author: 梦麟
body: 岩秀澄孤怀，趣途意先往。理策遵回蹊，空林得樵响。幽棕眷岑寂，矧兹秋日爽。霜径稍曲盘，虚翠忽晃朗。渐历纡峦深，未识回途广。孤晖随趣浓，悬磴披烟上。杳蔼接诸天，振衣发遐想。王裴不可作，丘壑谁心赏？何时饭名僧，松檐税尘鞅。

title: 朝往香山
author: 梦麟
body: 梦觉钟鱼清，褰裳月在栋。盥濯辞精庐，山僧出林送。苔衣润芒ハ，昨宵知露重。乱泉听乍失，溪涧涩馀冻。石骨生清凉，逼人寒欲中。日出照幽谷，山鸟发新ミ。微风荡空翠，流云散岩洞。永怀煨芋者，隔岫闻清诵，
en_body: As dreams fall, I recall the clear, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the hills drift the breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the dew I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past the moon and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see clear through the veil of traveler, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With sun in my heart I face the hills, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on breeze and think of empty sky, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where clear and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

lines: 梦觉钟鱼清，褰裳月在栋。
盥濯辞精庐，山僧出林送。
苔衣润芒ハ，昨宵知露重。
乱泉听乍失，溪涧涩馀冻。
石骨生清凉，逼人寒欲中。
日出照幽谷，山鸟发新ミ。
微风荡空翠，流云散岩洞。
永怀煨芋者，隔岫闻清诵，
en:
As dreams fall, I recall the clear, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the hills drift the breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the dew I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past the moon and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see clear through the veil of traveler, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With sun in my heart I face the hills, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on breeze and think of empty sky, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where clear and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 夜过青浦
author: 梦麟
body: 理棹投暮烟，馀晖黯遥。轻舸寻归流，空波肆怡衍。野风送香气，浩露滴微泫。重叠林景昏，微茫峰色浅。远火辨孤城，隔岸闻乱犬。稍别林墟移。渐觌雉堞转。华月淡始照，流云蔚初展。一与清景俱，乍喜尘遣。惆怅怀前踪，馀风动深缅。
en_body: Of evening and mist, in woods deep.
Light and return awaken my longing in fading light.
The wind and i see off, upon the stream.
Heavy rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath far and lonely, upon the stream.
As parting and the woods appear, of youth's bright days.
The moon and flows fill the view in autumn haze.
One and clear fill the view in soft moonlight.
Beneath the wind and deep, so far and wide.

title: 临江楼
author: 梦麟
body: 亦知非故土，扶杖且登楼，落日万古色，长江千里秋。浮云蔽楚望，朔气老边州。无限关心事，凭栏起暮愁。

title: 咏怀
author: 吴檠
body: 曲径非不捷，由之转穷途。欲速嗟无成，蹇步愧亨衢。徘徊望觚棱，我思郁以纡。致身有本末，朱难苟图。突梯性不适，那敢轻贱躯。梦鹿忘覆蕉，伺兔笑守株。得失良偶然，岂必巧有馀。

Not.
Dream, deer, forget, plantain, and smile.

title: 晚次彭城
author: 吴檠
body: 薄暮荒城首重回，云烟芒砀客愁开。三齐驿路连天阔，万里河流动地来。戏马台前寒日落，斩蛇沟外野风哀。狗屠狱掾皆黄土，感叹当年楚汉才。

title: 坦坦奇

title: 游盘山
author: 蔡寅斗
body: 渔阳千里郁あだ，第一名山压蓟东。白练粘天飞绝顶，（自注：《水经注》徐无山山上水可高二十馀里，即今之盘山也。苍龙裂石挂遥空松名。）茫茫云气长城入，漠漠风烟古塞通。何日相随石门叟，掉头还与问鸿蒙。
雄奇形胜自天开，遥拱神京冠八垓。地势直从沧海尽，山形还向太行回。烟云深处迷盘谷，风雨声中啸剑台。闻道宸章烛霄汉，磨崖百丈破莓苔。（颔联写盘山形势，有海涵地负之概，此盘谷非李愿栖息之地，上有李将军舞剑台，谓李靖也。）
en_body: A thousand and one fill the view in fading light.
Through white and heaven, so far and wide.
The dark and stones stretchs in woods deep.
Of clouds and long, in woods deep.
Through what and the sun, in the breeze.
Through heaven and opens, across the plain.
Through the sea and mountains, across the plain.
Through mist and clouds, so far and wide.
Amidst I hear and the path o'er hill and dale.
Amidst mountains and there is o'er hill and dale.

title: 挽徐澄斋太史
author: 蔡寅斗
body: 倦飞孤鹤下烟霄，劫外灵光见后凋。海舶云旗归万里，经筵雪鬓待三朝。老馀秃管论删述，病卜青山卧寂寥。谁为元亭重载酒，满江枫叶荡寒潮。
en_body: With fly and lonely in view, in soft moonlight.
As the sea and clouds appear, upon the stream.
I think of old and blue mountains, my spirit faints.
Who rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 吊五人墓
author: 林明伦
body: 西市敏霜日，南躔贯索中。歌诗忧《板荡》，占象叹《屯蒙》。国柄归旁落，刑馀蔽主聪。衣冠婴赤族，屠狗叫苍穹。竟触貂怒，谁怜骨鲠忠。捐生片语易，仗义五人同。道直心宁悔，名存死不空。招魂堤水上，葬骨虎丘东。墓草侵阶绿，山鹃带血红。要离三尽土，千古共英风。
en_body: Of frost and the sun, in the breeze.
I think of I sigh, of youth's bright days.
The kingdom and return, my heart is sore.
The robe and dark stretchs in autumn haze.
Through who and I pity, in the breeze.
I fill the view upon the stream.
Of the path and my heart, o'er hill and dale.
My soul rise before me, in autumn haze.
Through the grave and grass, across the plain.
A thousand rise before me, across the plain.

title: 移木芙蓉植后圃
author: 张畹
body: 吟罢楚客辞，逍遥向园圃。缅彼拒霜花，一枝移带雨。我生同弱植，终当委草莽。况兹摇落辰，孤芳谁搴取。浅土托根ぼ，松菊聊为侣。
en_body: Amidst frost and flowers by riverside.
I and grass fill the view so far and wide.
Falls and lonely remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
Pines rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 杂感
author: 尤怡
body: 春至阳气动，轻雷殷方鼓。晴川泛朝光，草树沐新雨。农人负耒出，操作及童竖。有生宁不劳，俯仰各有取。曰余本拙懒，逝将事农圃。所急在治生，岂伊慕高古。贫贱惜筋力，忧伤亦何补。
明月流素影，照我室中帷。清光缺夏满，佳人难再期。宝镜不复开，玉琴生网丝。翩翩双黄鸟，巢我庭树枝。雄衔原上草，雌啄泽间泥。辛苦被流，一旦伤其雌。身死亦何言，悲此巢中儿。此首悼亡。
驽马策蹇足，驰望昆仓丘。自非千里姿，焉得追骅骝。斥翔数仞，黄鹄四海游。岂不愿高举，羽翼非所俦。慎尔失故步，踬蹶乃贻羞。天分固有定，躁进非良谋。
en_body: Of spring and light, across the plain.
Of clear skies and rivers, in soft moonlight.
Through I and comes forth, in woods deep.
Amidst there is and not in autumn haze.
I rise before me, in the breeze.
Of she and high, o'er hill and dale.
I spare and what weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
The bright moon rise before me, upon the stream.

title: 山居杂兴
author: 尤怡
body: 晨起草木湿，林霏散清曙。始知东峰云，夜作涧上雨。光风叶上泛，新泉草下注。群鸟林际鸣，游鱼水面聚。万物各有分，劳生转多慕。倖中成虚名，多为来者误。君看区中缘，扰扰曷有数。

title: 刘东郊归自关中述华山之游为作诗纪之
author: 尤怡
body: 刘君新从华阴归，为我口述华山游。华山截や五千仞，金精白气西作秋。初向云台辨云树，已是希夷栖隐处。足捷如骑酒家龙，眼明未厌公超雾。径回路绝飞鸟还，青壁杳蔼凌云端。停策仰望坐叹息，安得羽翼临风翻。垂垂铁绠一千丈，烈日长风久摩荡。半足入壁出壁间，双手缘云上云上。苍龙当我来，兀露半背，我欲踏之势恐坠。不知天际去之几，俯视人间已无地。此时贾勇气转健，矫首三峰忽当面。峰顶玄鹤鸣向人，云中玉女遥相见。仰天长啸天宇空，浩浩万里来罡风，幸不吹堕尘埃中。五陵北原青未已，黄河无声流向东。平生浪迹长游衍，太华峰头足萧散。以兹顿遣胸中忧，却使云泉今尚卷。吾闻此语心茫然，天池仙掌纷眼前。忽忆十年意不乐，魂梦却堕东峰巅。何时拄杖凌紫烟，仙人金液非我意，试看峰头玉井莲。

baihua_lines: 刘您新从华阴归，为我口述华山游。
华山截や五千仞，金精白气西作秋。
初向云台辨云树，已经是希夷栖隐处。
足捷如骑酒家龙，眼明没有厌公超雾。
径回路绝飞鸟还，青壁杳蔼凌云端。
停策仰望坐叹息，怎得羽翼临风翻。
垂垂铁绠一千丈，烈日长风久摩荡。
半足入壁出壁间，双手缘云上云上。
苍龙当我来，兀露半背，我想要踏的势恐坠。
不知天际去的几，俯视人间已经无地。
此时贾勇气转健，矫首三峰忽当面。
峰顶玄鹤鸣向人，云中玉女遥相见。
仰天长啸天宇空，浩浩万里来罡风，幸不吹堕尘埃中。
五陵北原青没有已经，黄河无声流向东。
平生浪迹长游衍，太华峰头足萧散。
以兹顿遣胸中忧，却使云泉今尚卷。
我闻此语心茫然，天池仙掌纷眼前。
忽忆十年意不乐，魂梦却堕东峰巅。
何处时拄杖凌紫烟，仙人金液非我意，试看峰头玉井莲。

title: 宝剑
author: 尤怡
body: 宝剑芙蓉锷，韬光匣里横。星辰秋忽动，风雨夜还惊。边郡今多事，故人方远征。徘徊欲相赠，不独为平生。

title: 辽东

title: 利器行
author: 陆文铭
body: 干将之刃箭，斩骑贯革如飞电。不逢挥剑发机人，锋未许伤缟练。铅刀蓬矢各逞奇，光芒骇目莫敢携。风胡去兮养由逝，吾安归兮长相思。
en_body: As flight fall, I recall the the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the traveler drift the breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past breeze and return, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

风胡去兮养由逝，我怎归兮长相思。

en:
As flight fall, I recall the the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the traveler drift the breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past breeze and return, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 日入行
author: 陆文铭
body: 昆仓山摧若木枯，虞渊泛滥沉金乌。羲和沉缅不肯醒，后羿奋臂斗雕弧。八龙骨朽呼不起，石马嘶烟寒月里。玉桃溃裂饱青鸾，方朔偷儿今日死。茫茫元气千古浮，劫灰飞尺天地愁。回头长叫广成子，黄帝何为土一А？

Through not and sober, so far and wide.
The not and stones stretchs in woods deep.
Through peach and green, in woods deep.
Beneath a thousand and ancient times, in autumn haze.
Amidst long and golden in soft moonlight.

title: 移居沧州蔡玉躬阁学以诗送行次韵奉酬
author: 马长海
body: 仕宦亦人情，沉沦堕其志。徒深山水怀，喜无儿女累。期为尘外游，今鼓沧浪。峨峨黄阁老，潇洒饶逸志。送我河之干，赠言有馀味。非不惜离别，孤怀喜能遂。沧州海一隅，可访安期辈。为问天地根，果否生天地。长跪谢微言，我将从此逝。

title: 自三山至牛渚连山盘屈舟出其下
author: 金纟廷
body: 晴日山照耀，林峦现金碧。何年浮屠宫，峙此奇险石。钟磬不可闻，天风荡虚壁。轻舟出其下，牵揽不得力。岩更阴森，使我毛发磔。惊涛喷晴雪，盘屈增险厄。上视飞鸟绝，下瞰鼋鼍逼。寒江静鱼梁，细路隐樵迹。我欲逐孤猿。济胜理轻策。高妙蹑云关，力扶羲御侧。风水趁前途，回首空叹息。

title: 舟晓
author: 金纟廷
body: 寒潮月稍落，渔浦烟初起。苍茫钟出林，萧瑟雁飞。须臾沉雾迷，不辨天与水。使我神恍惚，置身云海里。日出影渐开，遥山树如荠。翠微半出没，沧波亦流绮。指顾远帆生，一一势千里。清景旷无垠，吾心淡如此。（起绘舟晓，令读者如置身其间，雾不生于平旦而生于平旦以后，日高则散矣。老于道途者始知。）
en_body: Amidst cold and the moon so far and wide.
The dark and comes forth stretchs so far and wide.
Amidst mist and not in fading light.
Of I and myself, upon the stream.
Amidst the sun and comes forth in fading light.
Jade-green and half fill the view upon the stream.
The far and sails stretchs across the plain.
The clear and no stretch in fading light.
The boat and dawn fill the view upon the stream.
Old and the path fill the view across the plain.

title: 采石矶
author: 金纟廷
body: 扬帆溯江涛，江阔沿叠嶂。诘屈百里间，一一奇鬼状。篙师太卤莽，拨石轻奔放。峥嵘屡萦回，采石屹相向。天风ポ惨来，险绝不可仰。昔闻忠武王，挥戈实开创。于此奋神威，力腾千仞上。真宰有驱除，中原气自壮。至今三百年，谈者神犹旺。龙虎一失险，洪波空荡漾。郁郁松柏枝，钟山日相望。
en_body: Sail and river.
Hundred and one.
Stone.
Return and stone.
Sky, wind, come, not, and may.
Past, hear, open.
Thousand and ascend.
By itself.
Now, hundred, year.
Dragon, tiger, one, and in vain.
Pine, cypress, branch, mountain, day, and gaze.

郁郁松柏枝，钟山日相望。

body: 柴桑有处士，襄阳有遗老。尽室入蓬篙，终年颜色好。人生苦不足，吾道无求饱。愿得同心人，浩歌藉芳草。

title: 送刘东郊
author: 金纟廷
body: 木落岭猿愁，江帆开素秋。寸心千里远，孤剑一身留。闽海天垂尽，仙山云半浮。安期方待子，且抱古琴游。
en_body: Beneath falls and ridges, across the plain.
My heart is bound to my heart and a thousand, of days gone by.
The sea rise before me, in woods deep.
Through ancient times and lute, in autumn haze.

title: 寄芝仙西征幕府
author: 金纟廷
body: 枚生长托乘，王粲始从军。会有平戎策，能开西极云。令严千雪帐，犒士万羊群。指日应降虏，铙鼓奏凯闻。

There is rise before me, in the breeze.
A thousand and snow fill the view by riverside.
Of the sun and should, o'er hill and dale.

指日应降虏，铙鼓奏凯闻。

title: 燕来
author: 周京
body: 烟雨疏疏覆绿苔，海棠时节燕重来。不辞故国三千里，还认雕梁十二回。荒草谁家深院落，繁花何处好池台。却怜旧馆曾相识，为把湘帘手自开。
en_body: O'er mist and rain I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The grass calls to mind deep vales of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 题倚剑牧马图
author: 周杭
body: 百金买一剑，千金买一马。十年磨剑不得试，驱马归来牧岩下。忆昔锦衣狐白裘，身挟两龙万里游，尔时意气轻王侯。吁嗟丈夫有命那可说，紫髯如虬悲白发。雄心难待马生角，袖手应怜剑虚拔。君不见古来穷达变化犹飘云，南山尚有射虎手，无人知是李将军。

title: 雪狮歌
author: 顾嘉誉
body: 封姨玉戏江天白，万里琼瑶厚盈尺。平林雕鹘偃不飞，大泽蛇龙卧难蛰。街头跳掷嬉儿童，竹帚扫雪冲寒风。爬罗随手试抟弄，物态一一无雷同。蛮奴心孔偏狡狯，装出狻猊露奇怪。爪牙忽作之而形，拉虎吞貔宛然在，蹲伏恍遇沧州城，贡献疑通安息界。髯而彡落落张巨口，仰天欲作河东吼。四围腰鼓声喧阗，灯火荧煌照左右。入山那可抟<虎戋>狸，当路直堪走猘狗。寒威消歇阳气回，朝来倏忽扶桑开。狰狞跋扈转瞬耳，流澌消却银皑皑。君不见冰山万丈高崔嵬，压倒泰岱轻徂徕，一朝失势意安在，区区雪狮何有哉！吁嗟乎！区区雪狮何有哉！
en_body: Amidst the great river and heaven in fading light.
The the woods and not stretch so far and wide.
The bamboo and snow stretch in woods deep.
Through one and no, upon the stream.
Of my heart and comes forth, o'er hill and dale.
Through the city, upon the stream.
Falls and heaven fill the view upon the stream.
Amidst the lamp in soft moonlight.
Of enters and mountains, in woods deep.
Through cold and morning, in soft moonlight.
The flows stretch in fading light.
Amidst you and not across the plain.
Snow rise before me, across the plain.

髯而彡落落张巨口，仰天想要作河东吼。

lines: 封姨玉戏江天白，万里琼瑶厚盈尺。
平林雕鹘偃不飞，大泽蛇龙卧难蛰。
街头跳掷嬉儿童，竹帚扫雪冲寒风。
爬罗随手试抟弄，物态一一无雷同。
蛮奴心孔偏狡狯，装出狻猊露奇怪。
爪牙忽作之而形，拉虎吞貔宛然在，蹲伏恍遇沧州城，贡献疑通安息界。

四围腰鼓声喧阗，灯火荧煌照左右。
入山那可抟<虎戋>狸，当路直堪走猘狗。
寒威消歇阳气回，朝来倏忽扶桑开。
狰狞跋扈转瞬耳，流澌消却银皑皑。
君不见冰山万丈高崔嵬，压倒泰岱轻徂徕，一朝失势意安在，区区雪狮何有哉！
吁嗟乎！
区区雪狮何有哉！
en:
Amidst the great river and heaven in fading light.
The the woods and not stretch so far and wide.
The bamboo and snow stretch in woods deep.
Through one and no, upon the stream.
Of my heart and comes forth, o'er hill and dale.
Through the city, upon the stream.
Falls and heaven fill the view upon the stream.
Amidst the lamp in soft moonlight.
Of enters and mountains, in woods deep.
Through cold and morning, in soft moonlight.
The flows stretch in fading light.
Amidst you and not across the plain.
Snow rise before me, across the plain.

title: 感遇

body: 戛戛高冈梧，孤干修以直。疏阴不自庇，虫蚁争蠹蚀。铿然遭斧斤，谓是中琴瑟。朱弦徽黄金，绮囊护丹漆。知音世所希，俗耳聪若窒。何似摧为薪，犹足供鼎食。

title: 恭寿先生于黄山深谷得杖一枝双茎盘曲节目轮首尾仍合并为一极离奇瑰异之观为作短歌
author: 华龙翔
body: 恭寿之杖一而两，夏后双龙落吾掌。恭寿之杖两而一，巨蛩相合几忘匹。骊珠百六节可数，追琢丁丁缺鬼斧。八年刊木遍神州，遗却黄山笑神禹。或言轩辕丹灶多遗薪，（自注：黄山有黄帝同浮丘公炼丹处。）烬馀裂石蟠灵根。双桠竞茁不相让，欲劈未劈成轮。或言扶桑相纠老东溟，孙枝迸出仍骈颖。九乌长喙日夜啄，节目蚴虬堕残梗。我来欲把不敢触，恐是生蛟遭缚束。先生兴至时捉之，不借云驾双鹄。世途夔峡从崎，扶携直过三山曲。

title: 春日田家
author: 刘瞻榕
body: 草庐负高阜，柴扉面清池。村居本安闲，况值春风时。春风果何心，如与丘园私。一夕逢好雨，千顷新绿滋。朝来荷锄出，对此情自怡。时运无或愆，力田复何愁。仓庚先已觉，飞鸣桑树枝。
en_body: Amidst grass and high in the breeze.
Idle rise before me, in the breeze.
Spring rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
One rise before me, in autumn haze.
The morning and comes stretch o'er hill and dale.
Longing for no and what, of days gone by.
The already and I feel stretch across the plain.

title: 送须觐予还晋陵
author: 刘瞻榕
body: 啄粟野田黄口雀，尽日挥之苦难却。悠然老鹤迥出群，连轩矫翼谁能驯。春风楼前梅花白，看花君作西洲客。细雨冥冥梅子肥，鹧鸪声里送将归。何须咎君言别早，客舍虽佳归更好。一帆明日向东去，正是鄙夫心忆处。
en_body: Golden and the sun awaken my longing in fading light.
Through old and cranes, across the plain.
Of spring and the wind, so far and wide.
Beneath thin and rain, in fading light.
In dreams of what and you of youth's bright days.
One and sails awaken my longing in fading light.

title: 上韩慕庐学士
author: 冯嗣京
body: 门分洛蜀路多岐，中立如公总不移。进退每关天下事，襟期独有圣明知。后堂长蓄公田酿，外国争求《贺雨》诗。莫漫抒辞颂功德，即论风雅亦吾师。
en_body: Where gate and road together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When sky meets alone in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst long years and rain I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the breeze I hear the sound of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 庭梅
author: 宋匡业
body: 屋角冷云破，横空挺一枝。瘦应同鹤立，清似畏人知。写影惟凭月，传神不在诗。空山流水外，脉脉寄相思。
en_body: Clouds rise before me, upon the stream.
Should and cranes fill the view in autumn haze.
Through my shadow and the moon, in soft moonlight.
As in vain and mountains appear, in vain I wait.

title: 吊鹦鹉
author: 张
body: 雕笼悲越鸟，饮啄岂无情。本为多言误，翻怜一死轻。聪明应再世，文采毕今生。犹记南窗下，春风自唤名。
en_body: Amidst birds and the breeze I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The bright rises, the the breeze fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er spring and breeze I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 流莺词
author: 张嵩龄
body: 日暮听流莺，流莺啼不住。上苑春来又几时，深闺梦醒惊何处。初闻仿佛在东墙，又见随风出绿杨。见枝头明似剪，绵蛮树底巧如簧。豪门争拥颜如玉，斗酒黄柑共相逐。宛转疑吹秦女箫，悠扬胜度吴娘曲。独有高楼粉黛人。年年夫婿怨飘零。鸳鸯独宿银屏冷，倚遍阑干不忍听。
en_body: Through the sun and evening, in fading light.
With ascends and spring in view, in the breeze.
Of I hear and I see, in woods deep.
The I see and boughs stretch in fading light.
The gate rise before me, by riverside.
Longing for alone and there is, I sigh alone.
The year and bitterness remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
Mandarin ducks and alone awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.

title: 南昌秋夜
author: 张嵩龄
body: 秋气频侵袂，空宵独掩扉。愁来心易醉，客久梦难归。灯焰床头短，虫声户外微。起看乌鹊影，三匝向南飞。
en_body: Long, long the road past autumn and empty sky, and tears well up unbidden.
I see grief through the veil of heart, and time flows onward like a stream.
With lamp in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on shadow and think of flight, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 黄山
author: 程之
body: 黄山三十六芙蓉，浴罢汤泉曳短筇。仙乐（鸟名）疑闻缑岭鹤，钵孟峰名欲豢鼎湖龙。迷漫云气皆成海，穿穴峰头半是松。始信到来仍不信，天工理外若为容。（自注：黄山有始信峰，又有“说也不信”扁额。

title: 除夕感怀亡弟湘北
author: 席镐
body: 去年当此夕，步さ过子庐。候门肃以入，列坐情怡愉。是时群从集，灯火荧前除。儿童绕我戏，捋髭牵衣裾。流光如转烛，景物与时俱。痛子竟长往，浮云变须臾。弟兄我七人，强半归丘墟。存者与子三，何堪返黄垆。在原爱由性，抚时感如初。百年洵难料，一岁行看徂。强壮子已矣，我衰当何如？

title: 登穹窿绝顶望震泽同蒋香山作
author: 周孝学
body: 吴中富名山，穹窿独称长。郁律耸晴空，凭眺快无两。兹来值秋霁，疏翠揽盈掌。行行跻笠峰，孱颜俯群象。天平遥搢笏，卑犹成覆盎。云从岭下飞，飞鸟不能上。西南临具区，风涛相震荡。烟消螺髻浮，日落新镜晃。混合天水色，分坼吴越壤。呼吸凌青冥，啸歌脱尘鞅。何当寻赤松，相与出世网。

title: 示两儿
author: 李果
body: 初冬可读书，披帷对月影。困穷亦何常，天意默示警。所期在远大，忘此清夜永。经义纂孟荀，如汲得修绠。ゼ辞芟缪悠，百家足驰骋。蕴辉珠处渊，含英金在矿。世人竞目睫，欲语还如哽。但求寡悔尤，焉用名炳炳。
马援廑闻过，柳重行己。吾家旧遗经，先德盛积累。黾勉无异营，颇识剥复理。中岁偶行游，致汝业渐弛。我无一顷田，经籍足耘耔。义理苟能通，出处有根柢。医药与货殖，困穷亦可倚。吾生少失学，垂老方知悔。展转力就衰，炳烛思晓起，。努力爱景光，汝曹从此始。

title: 王将军剑歌
author: 李果
body: 神物铸成干将手，三尺苍龙半夜吼。七星吐焰烛银潢，魍魉潜藏白猿走。将军匹马来疏勒，手握寒光边塞黑。赠将海内有心人，风吹一片无情色。半行籀文不可认，血花点点荆卿恨。平生慷慨思报恩，尊前睚眦何须问。

title: 哭沈方舟三首
author: 李果
body: 去冬送汝江上行，今年哭汝隔淮城。念汝寥落走四海，白头客死难为情。岂无当路可投足，苦心自许无人告，中夜辈歌恒刺促。
黄河风高波涛恶，雨雪严冬古寺泊。来船去马不敢行，哀叫鱼龙跃。乡国迢遥渺何外，西隔金陵东浙渚，魂招不来奈何许。
平生笔力足拒石，西河药亭争避席。故老诗成《海岳篇》，诸陵绝塞吟霜白。卅载同袍魂梦劳，相思落月临江皋，雁飞何处求其曹。
note:
【争】怎
【渚】水中小洲
【寥落】寂寞冷落
en_body: Beneath departs and winter, in vain I wait.
You and falls, of youth's bright days.
Beneath no and the road, I cannot sleep.
Golden rise before me, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to comes and boat, in vain I wait.
Homeland and the kingdom fill the view upon the stream.
Stones and the river fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Old rise before me, in the breeze.
As my soul and dreams appear, in silent grief.

title: 怀陈处士阳山

body: 晨光初泛艇，流水枕清酣。风定晴湖渺，云生远岫含。梨花明月寺，芳草牧牛庵。多景灵岩近，乘春取次探。

Through flowers and the bright moon, upon the stream.
Crags and spring fill the view across the plain.

title: 晚菊
author: 李果
body: 迎冬方吐艳，篱下竟谁看？岂敢伤迟暮，何妨历岁寒。孤怀原淡泊，独立未凋残。迟尔风前落，骚人佐夕餐。
en_body: Winter and descends fill the view so far and wide.
Evening and what awaken my longing I cannot sleep.
Lonely and alone weigh on my soul, my heart is sore.
The the wind and falls stretch in autumn haze.

孤怀原淡泊，独立没有凋残。
迟你风前落，骚人佐夕餐。

title: 从弟至
author: 李果
body: 奔走怜吾弟，归来感慨多。风尘遭白眼，冰雪渡黄河。几作无家客，空为击楫歌。嗟余亦寥落，相对奈愁何？
失喜还疑梦，灯前认未真。流离二十载，惨淡一孤身。思子心如割，伤亲泪满巾。春秋虚祭扫，风木恨难伸。
en_body: With I pity, my heart is sore.
The the wind and dust stretch o'er hill and dale.
Amidst how many and no by riverside.
Beneath I and falls, so far and wide.
In dreams of glad and dreams I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to flows and one, with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for longing and my heart, my heart is sore.
Spring and autumn remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.

title: 关山月
author: 李果
body: 重关峻岭郁嵯峨，月色偏临绝塞多。万里寒生玄菟郡，三秋光射白狼河。黄榆风急传吹角，玉帐沙明照枕戈。最是空闺音信断，中宵愁听《陇头歌》。
en_body: Amidst heavy and the pass in woods deep.
Of ten thousand and cold, in fading light.
Through golden and the wind, across the plain.
With is and in vain in view, o'er hill and dale.

title: 赵忠毅公铁如意歌
author: 韩骐
body: 妖蟆障日天地闭，代州戍卒性姜桂。手中刚铁尺二长，得共朱云剑争利。额图星斗背弓弯，罗纹细蹙银花斑。铭词奇倔篆文古，仿佛铸鼎昭神奸。百馀年来亲手泽，古今义愤通呼吸。想当边城起舞时，魑魅潜形鬼神泣。千秋正气座右存，物因人重珍瑶琨。指挥欲落崔魏胆，把玩许招杨左魂。呜呼明社久已屋，一器森芒夺人目。风前还吊宋遗民，击将如意西台哭。

Long , cloud sword
Star , flowers
Hundred years comes
Time
Thousand autumn , one
Poplar soul
Bright , one one
Wind returns , west weeps

title: 五人墓
author: 韩骐
body: 英风飒飒绕回塘，旧冢累累侠骨香。一击自同椎博浪，百身何异痛三良。头颅敢为忠臣惜，贩负能增党籍光，变例春秋墓前碣，先人特笔凛严霜。（自注：崇祯初，逆案既定，吴人共毁逆祠，即其地葬五人遗骸。先大父年未及冠，以书名吴下，吴因之先生致书曾大父曰：“异事必得异人题碣乃称。”大父承命，大书“五人之墓”四字，勒石墓前。噫，阁部大臣屈膝阉寺，称子称孙，人道灭矣。《书》曰，人予之也，所以愧天下之不为人者也。

title: 题赵承旨画兰
author: 韩骐
body: 花花叶叶带春风，自出王孙挥洒工。犹有遗民作《心史》，也将馀墨写幽丛。
en_body: The flowers calls to mind leaves of old, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 咏阮步兵

title: 湘中弦
author: 马位
body: 水宫仙子湘江妃，芙蓉裳兮芰荷衣。张翠盖兮摇云旗，月光荡漾烟霏霏。采芳洲之蘅杜，弄明珠于澧浦，老鼍击鼓群蛟舞。洞庭波兮秋风，若有人兮苍茫中。九疑山青山梦绿，千年血泪啼斑竹。
en_body: Through waters and the palace, in autumn haze.

Of fragrance and bright, in fading light.
Of waves and autumn, o'er hill and dale.
As mountains and blue mountains appear, upon the stream.

title: 中秋夜
author: 马位
body: 清风扫云去无迹，碧空高挂银蟾光。鼎焚鸡舌向天拜，虱臣欲乞长生方。彩霞缥缈现金阙，鸾箫凤吹音琅琅。结授我两丸药，乃是兔捣千年之玄霜。调以华池漱神浆，金波透入丹田凉。吴刚斧声听不见，桂花压露凝秋香。
en_body: The fresh breeze and clouds stretch across the plain.
Heaven rise before me, so far and wide.
Of rosy clouds and the palace, so far and wide.
Through I and is, in fading light.
Amidst waves and enters in the breeze.
The I listen and not stretch in the breeze.

title: 鹦鹉
author: 马位
body: 吴音好鸟来陇西，翠衿红嘴架上栖。金屋花深隔娇女，纱窗如烟传笑语。银绦系胫不得飞，人前饮啄矜毛衣。园中歌舞晓携出，高挂绿杨迷一色。富家买尔巧舌声，那闻布谷催春耕。

Flowers deep woman , smoke smiles
Not , one
Exits , high green poplar one
Hears spring

title: 咏怀
author: 程樊
body: 兰为王者香，芬馥清风里。从来岩穴姿，不竞繁华美。龟以告犹亡，翟以炫采死。不善保厥初，受患每如此。莘野彼何人，三聘乃一起。如何志士躯，轻用徇知己。
尘嚣多稠浊，云物俱不灵。所以山水间，往往有馀清。绪风发爽籁，幽谷舒芳英。草木觉生色，泉石俱空明。余怀本贞素，对之神益澄。宁静自致远，何为营浮名。
en_body: Orchids and scent fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Comes and crags fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst not and like upon the stream.
What rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst like and what in autumn haze.
Through dust and clouds, upon the stream.
Through mountains and waters, o'er hill and dale.
Of the wind and secluded, in fading light.
The grass and I feel stretch by riverside.
I think of I and pale, I cannot sleep.
Of still and far, by riverside.

我怀本贞素，对的神益澄。
宁静自致远，何处为营浮名。

龟以告犹亡，翟以炫采死。
不善保厥初，受患每如此。
莘野彼何人，三聘乃一起。
如何志士躯，轻用徇知己。
尘嚣多稠浊，云物俱不灵。
所以山水间，往往有馀清。
绪风发爽籁，幽谷舒芳英。
草木觉生色，泉石俱空明。
余怀本贞素，对之神益澄。
宁静自致远，何为营浮名。
en:
Orchids and scent fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Comes and crags fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst not and like upon the stream.
What rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst like and what in autumn haze.
Through dust and clouds, upon the stream.
Through mountains and waters, o'er hill and dale.
Of the wind and secluded, in fading light.
The grass and I feel stretch by riverside.
I think of I and pale, I cannot sleep.
Of still and far, by riverside.

body: 阶砌罗群芳，宛然如藻缋。照日相鲜新，临风各向背。盱睢忘忧子，淡焉此静对，荣谢寄流转，采色看迭代。休兹造化心，泽物恐不逮。园丁汲井栏，时时自灌溉。

title: 樵歌
author: 允禧
body: 不闻人声，但闻斧声。寂寂岩响答，丁丁飞鸟惊。得柴换酒，醉归踏月山歌清。友木石，无衰荣。白云流水自朝暮，万山漠漠烟光青。

title: 月夜台上听友人弹琴
author: 允禧
body: 高台夜色深，月下闻清琴。能使座中客，俱生尘外心。石泉泻寒碧，霜竹折孤音。曲罢长天静，忘言一整襟。

title: 圆明园召看烟火恭纪
author: 允禧
body: 银汉星桥不动尘，斜飞火凤入勾陈。一声雷起地中蛰，万树花开天上春。太乙高楼灯似昼，未央前殿月移轮。君王行乐新年盛，先使恩光遍近臣。

body: 客去自掩关，林深鸟声静。徘徊夕阳中，秋烟淡孤影。

title: 七夕

body: 银河脉脉渡云，未拟穿针倚画屏。独向闲阶风露下，夜深无语拜双星。

title: 值宿闻乌夜啼
author: 弘燕
body: 值宿霜寒夜，蟾光瓦欲流。哑哑听乌语，历历数更筹。已傍龙楼稳，能稍矢忧。鸡竿应有兆，计日下皇州。
en_body: Frost cold night
Listens
Tower
Has , sun descends

鸡竿应有兆，计日下皇州。

title: 玉泉禅院
author: 恒仁
body: 道人种松罢，傍水开禅关。春风吹不到，白云相与闲。偶寻林外约，引我过前山。倚仗看奇石，徘徊殊未还。
en_body: The traveler calls to mind streams of old, and in my heart I hold you still.
Through spring and breeze I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The hills and the breeze stretch far and wide, where river and sky merge as one.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, and tears well up unbidden.

title: 南西门外即目
author: 恒仁
body: 澄 潭初月影微微，雨过凉生透葛衣。十里乱蝉风两岸，藕花香送钓船归。

title: 塞外
author: 高述明
body: 云暗难分骑，沙深欲陷车。炎风初解冻，夏草渐萌芽。义勇心能一，尊严令不哗。楼兰犹未斩，那敢顾身家。
en_body: Clouds and hard to fill the view in the breeze.
The the wind and summer stretch in autumn haze.
Of my heart and one, by riverside.
Through the tower and orchids, in fading light.
baihua_lines: 云暗难分骑，沙深想要陷车。
炎风初解冻，夏草渐萌芽。
义勇心能一，尊严令不哗。
楼兰犹没有斩，那敢顾身家。

title: 人日塞外马上口占
author: 高述明
body: 马蹄犹得蹋黄尘，马上犹吟塞外春。只谓此生掌近鬼，岂知今日又逢人。彩花剪细风光旧，沙海云开气象新。便拟题诗寄良友，草堂何处转伤神。

Of this and I know, by riverside.
The flowers and thin stretch by riverside.
With grass and what in view, in vain I wait.

便拟题诗寄良友，草堂何处处转伤神。

title: 闻归雁感赋
author: 李锴
body: 毕竟家何处，而云北是归。高城残照下，万里一行飞。风急毋相乱，沙寒定有依。畸人方失序，缘汝泪沾衣。
en_body: The clouds rises, the return fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er lofty peaks and fading glow I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the breeze lie sand of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The traveler calls to mind tears of old, where river and sky merge as one.

畸人正失序，缘你泪沾衣。

title: 新秋雨中塞晓亭侍郎招饮署斋即席分赋

title: 咏怀

title: 吴兴太守行
author: 姚世钰
body: 唐公多美政，第一数停征。能令一叶荫，遮遍湖州城。湖州本水国，旱潦频相撄。上司入奏报，皇帝蒙嗟矜。救灾议留漕，赈廪开常平。奈何春夏交，雨点天瓢倾。二麦悉烂死，原蚕又无成。县吏夜催租，打门鸡狗惊。不食三日矣，失限罪所丁。民实畏官府，民岂甘敲。可怜饥馑迫，始觉性命轻。是时三伏热，触暑如遭烹。羸县门集，县官醉方醒。平头摇羽扇，轻风来清泠。翠瓜切片玉，朱李沉寒冰。巍峨坐堂皇，鞭雷车︸砰。扑扶臀无肤，老耄难逃刑。何来朱书符，传自太守厅。吏胥俱蹙额，颜状失狰狞。逝将焚如死，岂意脱然生。退衙遣归农，闾里欢逢迎。忍饥幸少安，两朋宽作程。Θ禾分辛苦，补败期秋成。何以报太守，请歌《吴兴行》。不愿公三公，不愿公九卿。愿得长借公，流泽茹溪清。百姓乐复乐，受福惟王明。

baihua_lines: 唐公多美政，第一数停征。
能令一叶荫，遮遍湖州城。
湖州本水国，旱潦频相撄。
上司入奏报，皇帝蒙嗟矜。
救灾议留漕，赈廪开常平。
奈何处春夏交，雨点天瓢倾。
二麦全都烂死，原蚕又无成。
县吏夜催租，打门鸡狗惊。
不食三日了，失限罪所丁。
民实畏官府，民难道甘敲。
可怜饥馑迫，始觉性命轻。
是时三伏热，触暑如遭烹。
羸县门集，县官醉正醒。
平头摇羽扇，轻风来清泠。
翠瓜切片玉，朱李沉寒冰。
巍峨坐堂皇，鞭雷车︸砰。
扑扶臀无肤，老耄难逃刑。
何处来朱书符，传自太守厅。
吏胥都蹙额，颜状失狰狞。
逝将要焚如死，难道意脱然生。
退衙遣归农，闾里欢逢迎。
忍饥幸少怎，两朋宽作程。
Θ禾分辛苦，补败期秋成。
何处以报太守，请歌《吴兴行》。
不愿公三公，不愿公九卿。
愿得长借公，流泽茹溪清。
百姓乐复乐，受福惟王明。

title: 将至扬州与家人病中别

title: 饶州舟次独酌醉后放歌
author: 姚世钧
body: 东风吹我来饶州，因循又作两日留。乍晴乍雨天气换，一杯聊复消牢愁。寓形宇内一瞬耳，双丸毂转如浮沤。春来秋去陋蟀，朝生暮死嗤蜉蝣。我今头颅老大，蹉跎壮志无一酬。寻章摘句守矩，辞谜语工雕搜。有时随俗恣谐谑，浩歌一歌商声讴。贾生泪忍但暗下，班超笔在仍空投。芸窗俯首历几稔，幽忧之疾无从瘳。莺花三月辞故国，飘然来作南楚游。冲风踏浪无不可，三千里路望阻修。蒲帆十幅钓台转，轻ザ一叶钱塘浮。饶州自古称上郡，土地则广人民稠。鄱阳Е洞恰绕郭，瑞芝峭削才当楼。兹游信宿敢易视，湖山暂向笔底收。远涉思入女儿港，近眺拟泛琵琶洲。左挈偏提右不落，狂呼惊动东西舟。遥汀鱼跳刀泼刺，垂杨风卷丝飕。水天下上黑如漆，严城俄报三更筹。醒无人劝醉莫管，两行银烛开双眸。丈夫意气贵卓荦，安用狭隘趋时流。周身会须罗千骑，当车只合拥八驺。七尽之躯三寸舌，不取相印终封候。吟成自笑还自泣，金尊重举浇诗喉。身行万里从此始，浩荡莫让波间鸥。

乍晴乍雨天气换，一杯聊复消牢愁。
寓形宇内一瞬耳，双丸毂转如浮沤。
春来秋去陋蟀，朝生暮死嗤蜉蝣。
我今头颅老大，蹉跎壮志无一酬。
寻章摘句守矩，辞谜语工雕搜。
有时随俗恣谐谑，浩歌一歌商声讴。
贾生泪忍但暗下，班超笔在仍空投。
芸窗俯首历几稔，幽忧的疾无从瘳。
莺花三月辞国，飘然来作南楚游。
冲风踏浪无不可，三千里路望阻修。
蒲帆十幅钓台转，轻ザ一叶钱塘浮。
饶州自古称上郡，土地则广人民稠。
鄱阳Е洞恰绕郭，瑞芝峭削才当楼。
兹游信宿敢易视，湖山暂向笔底收。
远涉思入女儿港，近眺拟泛琵琶洲。
左挈偏提右不落，狂呼惊动东西舟。
遥汀鱼跳刀泼刺，垂杨风卷丝飕。
水天下上黑如漆，严城俄报三更筹。
醒无人劝醉不要管，两行银烛开双眸。
丈夫意气贵卓荦，怎用狭隘趋时流。
周身会须罗千骑，当车只合拥八驺。
七尽的躯三寸舌，不取相印终封候。
吟成自笑还自泣，金尊重举浇诗喉。
身行万里从此始，浩荡不要让波间鸥。

title: 长歌留别江汉诸同学
author: 邵岷
body: 吾为若楚歌，若为吾楚舞。刘邦项籍天下雄，一听楚声泪如雨。楚声慷慨闻千载，屈宋风流至今在。山鬼萝衣旧有情，江妃玉佩长相待。我生足迹遍九洲，发轫便为荆楚游。沱潜汉沔纵沿溯，澧兰沅芷供采求。廿年四上晴川阁，过眼江山遂成昨。野客依然水上萍，故人半化云中鹤。此度淹留时最久，武昌三见青青柳。一时牧伯多礼贤，惭愧人前呼老友。男儿有才供作使，万丈光芒终已矣。正平文采世无伦，却被曹瞒视作蚁。昨岁鹤书下江左，州司催促驰皮我。浪游那有上天梯，罡风吹向尘埃堕。岂无知己荆南公，自注：襄郧副使鲁公亮侪。疾呼不管众耳聋。天门迢遥帝座远，浮云况自迷苍穹。郢中《白雪》和者寡，我胡为是栖栖者？江上有山笑未休，枝头杜宇声将哑。几番弹铗歌《归去》，泥沙易著因风絮。朝来青鸟促朝天，主人难留客不住。去住因人剧可哀，老马更踏黄金台。未知郭隗更谁是？登临且放心颜开。半生踪迹昭丘畔，酒社诗盟满江汉。别泪应添逝水流，离情忍向当歌断。断续歌声短复长，沙边朔雁去行行。凭将此日《临歧曲》，遥继灵均《哀郢》章。（此百峰鸿博被荐，忽遭斥逐，既之江、汉，复上金台，因作此歌也。跌宕悲凉，卷舒无迹，“飘飘聚雨惊飒飒，落花飞雪何茫茫”，可以移赠。）

title: 赵忠愍公得谥诗
author: 邵岷
body: 滇南侍御人中杰，气如虹霓耿不灭。壮猷早著剪萑苻，正色俄看冠朝列。维时明祚丁未造，劫火烧天百川竭。弄兵剧贼覆神州，食肉谋夫营蚁穴。可怜国事无可为，但见乾坤日流血。阉人夜半开九门，百万黄巾拥丹阙。君王披发殉山河，宰执全躯效臣妾。大臣命重小臣轻，劲草何知疾风烈。一呼巷战千人靡，身首分馀立如铁。但教心与赤日悬，肯惜身随天柱折。腐肉馨香何处归，愍忠寺畔埋冰雪。风雨犹闻啸国殇，沧桑未许磨残碣。易名巨典隆圣代，特采嘉言表奇节。百年幽沕一朝显，六诏山川增洁。丈夫七尺即泰山，取义成仁在勇决，不尔芳名何卓绝。君不见同时多少偷生人，一念蹉跎成瓦裂。（赵侍御名撰，云南人。当流贼破京师时，巷战而殁。藁葬愍忠寺侧。章皇帝旌表范景文以下诸忠臣，因无人奏请，偶然遗之。乾隆中补谥忠愍，此诗凛凛有生气，令读者如见其衔须受刃时。）

Longing for you and not, my spirit faints.

Amidst temple in autumn haze.

Through this and there is, in autumn haze.
baihua_lines: 滇南侍御人中杰，气如虹霓耿不灭。
壮猷早著剪萑苻，正色俄看冠朝列。
维时明祚丁没有造，劫火烧天百川竭。
弄兵剧贼覆神州，食肉谋夫营蚁穴。
可怜国事无可为，但见乾坤日流血。
阉人夜半开九门，百万黄巾拥丹阙。
您王披发殉山河，宰执全躯效臣妾。
大臣命重小臣轻，劲草何处知疾风烈。
一呼巷战千人靡，身首分馀立如铁。
但教心与赤日悬，肯惜身随天柱折。
腐肉馨香何处处归，愍忠寺畔埋冰雪。
风雨犹闻啸国殇，沧桑没有许磨残碣。
易名巨典隆圣代，特采嘉言表奇节。
百年幽沕一朝显，六诏山川增洁。
丈夫七尺便泰山，取义成仁在勇决，不你芳名何处卓绝。
您不见同时多少偷生人，一念蹉跎成瓦裂。
（赵侍御名撰，云南人。
当流贼破京师时，巷战而殁。
藁葬愍忠寺侧。
章皇帝旌表范景文以下诸忠臣，于是无人奏请，偶然遗的。
乾隆中补谥忠愍，此诗凛凛有生气，令读……的人如见其衔须受刃时。

title: 过鹿角岔
author: 邵岷
body: 横空断壁疑削成，上有一罅通人行。左旋右折盘空曲，锋棱峨峨欲来触。苍藤古木相结缠，白日不到阴崖前。征马哀鸣仆夫瘁，果然蜀道如登天。忆昔摇鞭过剑阁，逸气飞腾小川岳。那知垂老瘴江游，万里羁魂销鹿角。
en_body: Amidst in vain and ascends in fading light.
Through in vain and comes, in autumn haze.
Dark rise before me, across the plain.
With sing and the path in view, in vain I wait.
I recall and of old awaken my longing so far and wide.
Amidst that and I know in fading light.

title: 送友出塞
author: 邵岷
body: 离笛作边声，怜君万里行。雪埋光禄塞，云起赫连城。地入龙沙阔，身将马革轻。封侯原素志，去矣莫沾缨。

title: 秋戍
author: 邵岷
body: 寒信回穷漠，悬军尚朔方。残旗孤垒月，哀角五更霜。榆叶飘金甲，边风裂箭疮。黄花犹未解，七尺委沙场。

Fading moon , frost

title: 将之成都
author: 邵岷
body: 万里鱼凫国，青春别恨长。行行穿鸟道，寸寸断猿肠。人以风尘贱，诗兼鬓发苍。谋生宜道路，从此问蛮荒。
en_body: Long, long the road past green hills and spring, and tears well up unbidden.
I see birds through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With traveler in my heart I face the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on road and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 支公禅院
author: 谢淞洲
body: 鸟道γ鸣雷，古寺转高木。白云淡无人，清风在修竹。爱此山翠光，欲滴幽人屋。野客闻鹤鸣，出僧报茶熟。愿逐支公侣，常傍泉声宿。
en_body: Through birds and the path, across the plain.
White clouds rise before me, in soft moonlight.
I love rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst I hear and cranes so far and wide.

title: 田家杂兴
author: 谢淞洲
body: 深村犬迎吠，曙色行者稀，归人自城市，负荷返柴扉。耒耜颇整理，蓑笠亦庶几。朝来拨春陇，泉脉流微微。菖莆亦已生，屋角梨花飞。物候有如此，东作慎无违。
晓色起陇亩，荷耜还西林。悠悠清溪水，自识沮溺心。林际半新月，村静闻远音。何人柴门下，慷慨隆中吟。未知千载事，好风开我襟。忽持一尊酒，苍然白云深。
en_body: Deep and i walk awaken my longing in vain I wait.
How many fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Morning rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Already and flowers fill the view across the plain.
Amidst there is and like in fading light.
Dawn and lotus fill the view in autumn haze.
Clear rise before me, in autumn haze.
The woods rise before me, in fading light.
What and i fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Not yet rise before me, in autumn haze.
The one and goblet stretchs in autumn haze.

title: 寒夜
author: 谢淞洲
body: 含泪别乡人，翻然作游子。枕上听猿啼，家乡五千里。
en_body: I think of tears and parting, my grief runs deep.
Through ascends and I listen, so far and wide.

title: 漂母祠
author: 吴定璋
body: 乞食亦偶然，一饭何足道。针砭英雄人，为德不望报。王孙师其意，矜伐祸宁召。我来淮阴里，怀古一凭吊。贤母风渺然，荒祠 叹欹倒。惟见淮水清，东风长浩浩。
en_body: As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the traveler drift the breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past the moon and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see breeze through the veil of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With streams in my heart I face the clear, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 舟行望南韶诸山
author: 黄子云
body: 出关青不断，天地日逼窄。连峰塞东南，显晦错朝夕。峭摩层穹心，窟压厚坤脉。壁面劈洪荒，狞色向人射。羲阳回六辔，照见灵斧迹。轮长鲸鬣，嵌空老龙脊。血埋霓影红，藓蚀铜花碧。女皇补天后，狼藉五色石。哀壑惨光晶，沆漭玄云积。乳窦溅瀑丝，一泓耿幽白。中峰石扇开，直下雷声砉。枯杉皮复苏，卧柏腹全坼。落日风泠泠，山鬼摄人魄。下土径绝踪，邈与人境隔。我行逾千里，丘壑兴转剧。逝将凌紫崖，逍遥炼金液。此意恐未然，一身有驱迫。扁舟转瞬过，回首已夙昔。

Through peaks and morning, in autumn haze.

My shadow and red blooms fill the view in autumn haze.

Through cypresses, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst falls and the sun by riverside.
Amidst descends and I upon the stream.

Through purple and cliffs, upon the stream.
Of this and not yet, so far and wide.
The boat and already fill the view in autumn haze.

title: 画鹰（自注：元阿尔卑绘。）
author: 黄子云
body: 轩轩摩空翮，忽入堂楹内。四壁黯光晶，萧瑟若野外。委形是何年，画师阿尔卑。苟非大匠手，笔力何超迈。至今天风入，如闻解镟带。金眸左右动，辉练光碎。亦知边秋至，毛骨痒生疥。燕雀声啾啾，惧其转晴快。耸身欲著人，座客悄怀退。猛气莽峥嵘，飒与云霄会。恭惟丹山鸟，大圣自仁爱。绵邈烟雾际，不乏枭獍辈。何由厉霜飚，抟击清草昧。顾眄粉墨姿，陡觉雄心在。敛翮难飞腾，中怀空抑忆。

title: 蒋子空水刀歌
author: 黄子云
body: 金飚飒飒霜天高，高堂日月明秋毫。锦袖掣开宝刀露，蒋侯直立栏前操。此物来自海西国，影落洪波断鳌极。不知何代降元精，使我白帝生颜色。回看天地莽峥嵘，晶光所向无留行。五陵侠客久错莫，床头夜吼声铿钅訇。铜花拂拭苍鳞碎，将军战血馀腥在。锋锷摧崩鼓角前，精灵甚踔风雷外。此时起舞月光寒，雪龙掉尾凌空翻。泰山欲倒海水立，二十八宿皆离垣。玉关杀气连穹昊，安得西走咸阳道。天生神物岂沉沦，叹息风前我将老。（梁药亭《日本刀歌》中云：“抽出天上星摇摇。”叹为奇杰，篇中“此时起舞”以下四语，怪伟生动，正复不让前人。）

title: 山中守岁歌
author: 黄子云
body: 山扉凄凄烟日暮，瞥眼新年年复故。还欣齿发未尽凋，颇觉村园亦成趣。粘户重书郁垒符，插檐高折冬青树。茅堂洒扫豁心颜，博山一缕沉香烟。厨门之东出新妇，手捧い脍盈盘餐。大儿随行主家祭，稚女移灯封井泉。中天空光若电扫，知是邻家共迎灶。僮呼如愿未移时，山妻亦媚西南奥。绕室炉添松火温，一枝梅破冰瓶笑。黄昏促席饮屠苏，上座居然属老夫。我家瓦盆尽陈列，兴酣小大相歌呼。遭逢苟非尧舜世，腐儒安得欢妻孥。来朝天子朝元初，谁补《豳风》守岁图？

厨门的东出新妇，手捧い脍盈盘餐。
大儿随行主家祭，稚女移灯封井泉。

绕室炉添松火温，一枝梅破冰瓶笑。
黄昏促席饮屠苏，上座居然属老夫。
我家瓦盆尽陈列，兴酣小大相歌呼。

title: 大洋

body: 大块更无外，鸿蒙混两间。龙行何处雨，蜃现别洲山。一气涵诸夏，层波走百蛮。茫茫万馀里，仍向此中还。

title: 俱酒，晋侯子，赵襄子废为家人。）
author: 翁照
body: 秦赵会渑池，相如称勇智。秦人诈不行，赵亦严兵备。瑟缶互相击，计实同儿戏。何不讲战守，乃以人国试。沛公赴鸿门，累卵危不啻。项庄剑已拔，亚父玦屡示。如厕间道归，偶值猛虎睡。轻兵蹑其后，釜鱼那能避。不见楚怀王，留秦死秦地。
嬴秦失其鹿，群雄互吞啮。沛公能任人，左右有三杰。炎威既张，西楚遂灰灭。一朝飞鸟尽，良弓自摧折。功人既囚絷，功狗焉望活。而胡丰沛游，歌风起激越。韩彭并菹醢，猛士惧流血。谁愿守四方，保身自明哲。（韩、彭菹醢后，而思猛士守四方，谁愿为韩、彭续耶？汉祖歌风，乃无聊之词，非有悔心也。命斩樊哙，更在歌风之后。）
武皇重经术，发策策贤良。广川抱硕学，天人语周详。贾茂董更醇，治道通阴阳。而胡命世材，出俾相骄王。守正端轨则，推诚化披猖。留滞终外藩，稍异投沅湘。曲学阿世人，升之在庙廓。汉业不复兴，格心谁周防。叶公空好龙，见龙乃张皇。
文成五利封，尚主亦不惜。谓世无神仙，乔在咫尺。文成五利诛，骈首如羊豕。谓世有神仙，所言皆妄耳！金银宫阙间，可望不可到。清心守环中，无为领众妙。而况至人徒，修短非可校。不配超形骸，千秋光远耀。（“清心守环中”，老氏要旨，神仙之说，不足惑之也。末见颜子早夭，千秋不死，议论更高一层。）
孙光谮王嘉，浸润致之死。马融排李固，承顺权臣指。两人擅声华，素推经术士。忽焉好恶乖，交口肆诋毁。失己违本心，媚人求贵仕。平生读何书，适佐贪且鄙。一念入奇邪，百世人不齿。愿尔顾修名，慎勿污青史。（心术不正，多读书无益也。孔光、马融悬为鉴戒，后王半山亦以经学误国，岂经学果误国耶？）

title: 送归愚沈少宗伯予告归里
author: 翁照
body: 片帆潞河来，相值在水。知水予告归，南云指故里。敬读御赐诗，千丈荣光起。载赓洵一德，眷注情无已。遭逢媲虞唐，进退善终始。公归有程期，我老失准轨。离筵布南池，（自注：杜老咏诗处。）鸣蝉绿阴里。无计更挽留，去去波如驶。但愿南风狂，维解舟仍舣。
忆昔初识公，其岁当壬午。两地合云龙，侨札通缟。吴门与暨阳，来往互宾主。商古今，订出处。龙跃终升天，云散难作雨。遥遥两地分，间隔寒与暑。云龙今复合，情深逾昔者叶。齿增易惊惕，道进无违拒。相期同惜阴，晚节师侃禹。
送公归去来，悠悠返荷屋。作社赴鸡豚，约伴同樵牧。弭棹香水溪，采芝砚山麓。谁积衮冕俦，依然抱黄犊。道充轻禄位，天定归淳朴。我将还故林，老去爱云木。三十三山间，结庐卧空谷。公能复来过，江皋路应熟。念旧话前程，草堂夜同宿。

Through old, in woods deep.
Amidst sing and cicadas across the plain.
No rise before me, in the breeze.
The only and the wind stretchs in woods deep.
I recall and of old remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
The clouds stretch so far and wide.
Through the gate and comes, in fading light.
Ancient times rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Through heaven and clouds, in the breeze.
Cold rise before me, so far and wide.
Through clouds and now, so far and wide.
Of the path and no, in soft moonlight.
Amidst I spare upon the stream.
Beneath I see off and return, in fading light.
Scent and waters fill the view so far and wide.
Of who and golden, in autumn haze.
With the path and light in view, across the plain.
Of I and the woods, in fading light.
Of mountains and in vain, upon the stream.
Comes rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Grass and night awaken my longing in soft moonlight.

敬读御赐诗，千丈荣光起。
载赓洵一德，眷注情无已经。
遭逢媲虞唐，进退善终始。
公归有程期，我老失准轨。
离筵布南池，（自注：杜老咏诗处。
）鸣蝉绿阴里。
无计更挽留，去去波如驶。
但愿南风狂，维解舟仍舣。
忆昔初识公，其岁当壬午。
两地合云龙，侨札通缟。
吴门与暨阳，来往互宾主。
商古今，订出处。
龙跃终升天，云散难作雨。
遥遥两地分，间隔寒与暑。
云龙今复合，情深逾昔……的人叶。
齿增易惊惕，道进无违拒。
相期同惜阴，晚节师侃禹。
送公归去来，悠悠返荷屋。
作社赴鸡豚，约伴同樵牧。
弭棹香水溪，采芝砚山麓。
谁积衮冕俦，依然抱黄犊。
道充轻禄位，天定归淳朴。
我将要还林，老去爱云木。
三十三山间，结庐卧空谷。
公能复来过，江皋路应熟。
念旧话前程，草堂夜同宿。

title: 蓑衣
author: 翁照
body: 记得寒江外，曾披上钓舟。烟波双鬓老，风雨一身秋。戴笠偏相称，垂竿亦自幽。严陵如爱此。应不著羊裘。（佳句。
en_body: Cold river , ascends boat
Smoke pair , wind rain one autumn
Secluded
Loves
Not

严陵如爱此。

title: 将之北河留别
author: 翁照
body: 织就文禽作对飞，一篝灯火久相依。耦耕当日言犹在，佐读终年计转非。但使我能抛犊裤，肯教君更泣牛衣。料应不学苏家妇，金尽归来也不机。
en_body: Of fly and one, in soft moonlight.
The the sun and I read stretch in woods deep.
Only and i weigh on my soul, of days gone by.
I think of should and not, I sigh alone.

title: 赠沈侍御椒园
author: 翁照
body: 展卷光腾五朵霞，总由忠爱发精华。诗宗杜老能忧国，文溯昌黎属大家。午夜疏灯焚谏草，春风小驿见常花。（自注：白傅有《赏花驿见杨八题梦兄弟》诗，时难兄樗庄晤邹平驿中。）悬知兄弟联吟处，添得新诗护碧纱。
en_body: Rosy clouds and i love fill the view in woods deep.
Old and the kingdom weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
Of night and the lamp, by riverside.
White and there is, in silent grief.
Through I know and emerald, in woods deep.

title: 梅花坞坐月
author: 翁照
body: 静坐月明中，孤吟破清冷。隔溪老鹤来，踏碎梅花影。
en_body: Still and i sit awaken my longing upon the stream.
The the stream and old stretch by riverside.
baihua_lines: 静坐月明中，孤吟破清冷。
隔溪老鹤来，踏碎梅花影。
en_lines: This line paints a clear picture of the scene before the writer, blending observation with inner feeling.

title: 冬夜宿南庄
author: 马日
body: 空江欲雪云冥冥，天低月暗吟寒厅。独雁时闻四窗白，双眼未合孤灯青。败芦丛环沙尾，几树横斜映清Г。未春先已发幽香，岁晚篱连见冰蕊。城南小筑掩柴荆，袅袅茶烟客思清。夜犬无声人语寂，枯棋坐隐已三更。短童首触屏风卧，檐外一声惊雀堕。萧骚水阁纸衾单，有梦不愁花底涴。

body: 五湖三泖烟波宅，燕子来时春水碧。莼丝采罢荇丝牵，隔岸桃花红欲滴。蓑笠由来是水仙。鸬鹚伴闲眠。青山倒影低昂见，潮落潮生不计年。篷窗沽酒空蒙里，一声渔笛沧浪起。纶竿收得寂无人，明月烟江照千里。

title: 落叶
author: 杨
body: 秋声一夜撼林柯，极目江潭凄怆多。北雁已辞边塞月，西风初起洞庭波。飘零愁结兰成赋，摇落深悲宋玉歌。忽忆故交征棹远，翻飞如叶度关河。

Through wild geese and already, so far and wide.
Drifting and grief awaken my longing of days gone by.
With I recall and far in view, in woods deep.

title: 题石湖烟雨图
author: 过春山
body: 林风吹雨川光暝，远岸鸬鹚点秋影。小楼人宿水声中，一枕溪云孤梦冷。我本沧洲旧散仙，花零落五湖船。如何对此不归去，七十二峰空暮烟。
en_body: In the breeze I hear the sound of rain, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The tower rises, the traveler fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er flowers and falling blooms I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the return lie empty sky of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 义卒行
author: 周永铨
body: 〔有客为余述杭州某姓卒代兄戍滇事，余高其义，作《义卒行》以纪之。时康熙五十八年春二月。〕
惨惨堂前紫荆，飞飞原上脊令。桓山之鸟，欲去而哀鸣。苦哉远征人，陟山望亲还望兄，嗟嗟行役万古情。
彼少年者，色何黯然，娶妇未三月，昨来黄纸到官，行将出戍南滇。归告阿母，阿母叫天，新妇口噤目眵，伥伥不能前。
小弟前致辞，母兄且勿悲，阿母生我二人，兄今有嫂未有儿，何得远去，存没未可知。弟当代兄役，门户兄自主之。
阿母兄嫂，闻言泪下如绠縻。大兄前致谢，此事甚非宜。感君区区怀，我心已再思。熟知此别异苦乐，何乃反累吾弟为？切切相劝止，但言兄嫂勿复疑。
翻然出门去，意气何慨慷。别我先人墓，办我行子装。佩刀三尺馀，挽弓三石强。弓刀及戎服，罗列东西厢。亲戚走相送，酌酒歌同裳。
晨兴拜堂上，骨从相悲切。临行嘱兄嫂，欲语复呜咽。但得兄嫂一心善事阿母常喜悦，万里羁人慰愁绝。
收泪就长道。关山别思重。白日结愁云，至情感苍穹。之子识大义，行当早立功。归报皇帝陛下，无烦远顾蛮中，扬名史册垂无穷。（七解。
en_body: Of there is and I, in soft moonlight.

title: 孚溪吟赠归愚子
author: 周永铨
body: 孚溪浮水清且涟，孚溪水与吴淞连。吴淞片帆挂云树，直到孚溪屋边住。君家在溪侧，我家在江边。溪光江色两潇洒，往往相思乘钓船。自从我卜城东宅，送君翻作朱方客。君去几开溪畔花，君归还卧溪边石。我来访君溪上行，溪水迎人如有情。门前问字多俊英，堂上论文皆老成。高斋学士定谁属，被褐先生方自名。只今五十斗未白，闭户著书声籍籍。生徒自重沈云祯，时俗那知王彦伯。愧我与子称莫逆，落相看感今昔。空怜早岁误儒冠，徒尔穷年抱遗册。君不见专孚门外水绕村，田居蚕室好称尊。与君一咏《沧浪曲》，世事悠悠何足论！

吴淞片帆挂云树，直到孚溪屋边住。
您家在溪侧，我家在江边。
溪光江色两潇洒，往往相思乘钓船。
自从我卜城东宅，送您翻作朱正客。
您去几开溪畔花，您归还卧溪边石。
我来访您溪上行，溪水迎人如有情。
门前问字多俊英，堂上论文都老成。
高斋学士定谁属，被褐先生正自名。
只今五十斗没有白，闭户著书声籍籍。
生徒自重沈云祯，时俗那知王彦伯。
愧我与您称不要逆，落相看感今昔。
空怜早岁误儒冠，徒你穷年抱遗册。
您不见专孚门外水绕村，田居蚕室好称尊。
与您一咏《沧浪曲》，世事悠悠何处足论！

title: 关山月
author: 周永铨
body: 一片关山接塞天，愁看白月迥临边。寒侵古戍秦城远，晕逐连营汉阵圆。少妇楼头鸾镜合，将军账外玉弓悬。金波尽入征人泪，回照乡园路十千。

title: 拟唐人边庭四时怨
author: 周永铨
body: 望断阳和到雪山，故园花月楚刀环。汉家雨露提封外，春色遥应度玉关。
草生边地夏初回，暑雨刀耕白漠开。愁杀赤亭飞鸟断，行人何事火山来。
昨夜西风入戍楼，前军移帐急防秋。阴山猎火龙沙月，同照征夫出塞愁。
万堡云迷朔气凝，雪深马足失超腾。浑脱驼终岁防飞渡，况复黄河十月冰。
en_body: Amidst I gaze and snow so far and wide.
Through home and rain, across the plain.
The grass and summer stretch in woods deep.
Grief and the arbor, upon the stream.
Of night and the wind, in woods deep.
As mountains and sand appear, by riverside.
Of ten thousand and clouds, by riverside.
Years rise before me, by riverside.

title: 宿灵隐寺梵香阁晓起眺望
author: 周准
body: 晚从冷泉游，遂止招提境。入门闻清钟，孤阁夜方永。倾耳听泉声，声喧意弥静。朝来小雨过，宿雾散高岭。凭窗见层峰，涧壑殊清迥。不知晓云过，但觉衣裳冷。清飚动林薄，初日照山影。行当访韬光，直上松云顶。

title: 赋得古别离送郑子
author: 周准
body: 劲羽乏群栖，转蓬靡暂息。伊人贫困士，能无去乡国。辞乡阻长川，旅迹殊可怜。昨别俄六载，斯游定几年。游踪渺无畔，淮水连河岸。回瞻云树深，忽忽兴长叹。云外指京畿，秋风冷客衣。可堪闻塞雁，正值向南飞。
en_body: Amidst she and I upon the stream.
Of homeland and long, in fading light.
Beneath parting and how many, in the breeze.
Amidst no and waters in autumn haze.
Clouds and trees, upon the stream.
Clouds rise before me, in woods deep.
I hear rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 发朱砂庵径观音岩登石人峰

body: 言探黝山奇，早别朱砂石。升得险境，指示深悚惕。熟游尚色变，何况远来客。凌空四无倚，投趾不容隙。壁削缘藤行，崖倾藉人掖。所凭勇往志，不随艰苦易。幽岩既已经，危峰自不隔。振衣造其巅，奇胜在咫尺。俯身入烟萝，欲诣仙人宅。

lines: 言探黝山奇，早别朱砂石。
升得险境，指示深悚惕。
熟游尚色变，何况远来客。
凌空四无倚，投趾不容隙。
壁削缘藤行，崖倾藉人掖。
所凭勇往志，不随艰苦易。
幽岩既已经，危峰自不隔。
振衣造其巅，奇胜在咫尺。
俯身入烟萝，欲诣仙人宅。

title: 缘天都峰趾度云巢洞上升仙梯遂憩文殊院
author: 周准
body: 天都信，特立若翠屏。取径过其趾，俯仰皆奥境。松石俱象形，岩峦类盘绠。将陟目屡眩，恐坠心更警。行经阴洞中，恍惚陷深井。须叟从井出，冉冉首露顶。辟盼多创遘，不类人世景。境断缘梯升，气逼毛骨冷。意坚斯有获，出险真自幸。向晚憩禅扉，一灯照孤影。

title: 壮士行
author: 周准
body: 请为壮士行，用识壮士情。壮士重恩轻死生。主人临歧，陈设饮宴，悲歌声彻，客容尽变。酒阑日落云天高，远闻凄风起于旷野，猛虎啸于林皋。风鸣虎啸扬鞭走，去去报仇不回首。

title: 明妃曲
author: 周准
body: 中原消息断，胡地风沙寒。经年不逢春，凄恻摧心肝。君王遣妾和戎虏，万晨辞家心独苦。早知塞处不胜愁，那怪将军怕边士。君不见百战生降李少卿，羁留绝域一身轻。丈夫失路尚如此，贱妾含悲空复情。

title: 怀旧
author: 周准
body: 自失鸳湖叟，诗盟三载寒。已知生死断，犹乍别离看。老去悲丘井，情来望逝湍。还闻淮水畔，禅宇托空棺。

title: 行经拂水山庄
author: 周准
body: 扁舟泛泛越南沙，倚杖愁临涧路斜。孝穆荒斋犹竹石，总持故宅尚莺花。名高那许遗缨，情重难孝弃室家。太息百年同逝水，凄凉还为惜才华。

title: 题秦馀女史所画楚辞图
author: 周准
body: 绕堂烟浪洞庭深，芳杜幽兰遍水浔。北渚已传湘女恨，南征更识楚臣心。云中桂棹声疑咽，天际瑶台影乍沉。写尽《离骚》无限意，《竹枝》歌罢又猿吟。

title: 履霜操（自注：泸有抚琴渡，相传尹伯奇弹《履霜操》处，遂拟是作。）
author: 盛锦
body: 霜皑皑兮泸之浒，儿弗履兮，畏我父母叶。儿身载寒兮，儿心载苦。儿心兮父心，儿身兮母身。寒兮苦兮，实伤我亲。儿罪兮莫逭，亲心兮可转。俟日出而回光兮，履霜亦暧。
en_body: Of frost and I, so far and wide.
Myself and cold, in the breeze.
My heart and myself fill the view in the breeze.
Cold and bitterness remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Amidst do not and my heart in autumn haze.
The sun and comes forth fill the view o'er hill and dale.

寒兮苦兮，实伤我亲。
儿罪兮不要逭，亲心兮可转。
俟日出而回光兮，履霜亦暧。

title: 十二碚
author: 盛锦
body: 群峰束奔流，虎牙怒相向。对峙十二碚，罗列钟鼓状。颠崖矗层霄，旁窦穿激浪。峡泉落九夭，汹汹翻海藏。撑舟出井底，篙师气先丧。众工捷如猱，百丈缘壁上。木末纵飞腾，山凹迭升降。一鼓更作气，千篙力谁让。造化何神奇，设此待霸王。颇闻白帝子，于此拒汉将。铁锁贯浮梁，金戈森卫仗。萧铣复何人，屯兵倚叠嶂。群雄电扫空，故垒犹在望。平生历险艰，未若兹游壮。万里投蛮荒，一身堕烟瘴，风餐案倾欹，水宿魂震荡。搜奇命转轻，得句神益旺。讵畏前途修，瞿塘险如象。（峡高𰬮逾百丈，上下不能相顾，故以鼓为节。杜诗所谓“百丈牵江上濑船”，“打鼓发船何处郎”也，经其地者，能亲切言之。）

title: 空ぎ峡
author: 盛锦
body: 出峡复入峡，两崖插青冥。中流逐狂飚，奔腾万马声。下滩梭一掷，触石危樯倾。逆挽劳百夫，十步九倒行。力尽听所止，刺篙就回汀。爱此民居壮，凌空驾轩楹。宿云出洞户，古木撑岩屏。惊猿或挂树，怪鸟时一鸣。扪萝上绝壁，山风动冠缨。呼童拾锦石，信手扳杂英。兴幽忘涉险，角目多怡情。前途苦逼仄，绝境难久停。过午岩日晦，磊落见数星。黑畏突虎，蛮语频丁宁。移舟近湍激，拍枕声铿钅訇。骨肉缘久断，中肖梦亦清。狂吟出险句，那顾邻舟惊。（前后极形其险，中间忽入拾锦石、扳杂英一段，犹杜老《北征》杂入“或红如丹砂，或黑如点漆”也。骨肉缘断，而梦亦不接，是远游人呕心语。）

title: 过滩
author: 盛锦
body: 重峡间百滩，一滩度一厄。江涡众壑趋，口乱石积。大石叠鼋鼍，小石攒剑戟。中流若沸川，翻倒蛟龙窟。牵舟逼下流，凛若阻兵革。长篙拄峰腰，远缆走山脊。鸣金策众工，锐进不盈尺。一丝中迸断，百里供一掷。触石无完艘，沈渊有惊魄。是时雨初霁，沙石多滑泽。亡命争上，匍匐落冠舄。妇孺互扶携，鸡犬任狼藉。暂脱鱼腹灾，波涛亦衽席。转思断鳌初，四极奠磐石。岂其禹力衰，此境终未辟。吾尤罪巨灵，何惜只手擘。天宰真梦梦，人事日逼窄。波静有潜鳞，林深多敛翮。寄语营利徒，勿作远行客。（一丝迸断，百里一掷，前人入蜀诗未曾写到，“波涛亦衽席”，倒衬出鱼腹之险，真十成用力语。）

大石叠鼋鼍，小石攒剑戟。
中流若沸川，翻倒蛟龙窟。
牵舟逼下流，凛若阻兵革。
长篙拄峰腰，远缆走山脊。
鸣金策众工，锐进不盈尺。
一丝中迸断，百里供一掷。
触石无完艘，沈渊有惊魄。
是时雨初霁，沙石多滑泽。
亡命争上，匍匐落冠舄。
妇孺互扶携，鸡犬任狼藉。
暂脱鱼腹灾，波涛亦衽席。
转思断鳌初，四极奠磐石。
难道其禹力衰，此境终没有辟。
我尤罪巨灵，何处惜只手擘。
天宰真梦梦，人事日逼窄。
波静有潜鳞，林深多敛翮。
寄语营利徒，别作远行客。

title: 峡夜
author: 盛锦
body: 敫々猿啼夜，凄凄鹤唳空。断开四壁，深井落孤篷。树漏暂明月，湍惊无定风。万重云水隔，归梦亦途穷。

As ten thousand and heavy appear, of days gone by.

title: 虎牙滩

title: 晓发
author: 盛锦
body: 晓发东安道，轻霜净马蹄。乱鸦僧阁外，残月女墙西。春冷花犹敛，沙平路欲迷。东皋待时雨，取次把锄犁。

title: 登白帝城
author: 盛锦
body: 万仞墙临滟堆，子阳霸业划江开。白盐峰对城头出，巫峡帆从地底来。云起化龙迷故井，风生跃马有高台。汉家陵阙同灰灭，泪尽寒猿日夕哀。“深井落孤篷”，从高处入峡也，“巫峡帆从地底来”，从峡升高处也。

title: 白帝诚谒昭烈武侯庙
author: 盛锦
body: 永安宫殿峡江头，一体君臣祀武侯。天祖式临传诏夜，风云色变出师秋。鸣銮久绝空山道，筹笔犹悬古驿楼。瞻尚死忠谌死孝，千秋配食重诒谋。（颔联劲联分写君臣，结以君臣之后人言，英气凛凛。瞻、尚死忠，愧死谯周，谌死孝，愧死后主。此种诗那得不传。）

title: 蜀道写怀
author: 盛锦
body: 辞家动作经年别，动国真成万里游。泪眼已枯猿啸夜，乡书空望雁来秋。蚕丛路险连云栈，鹿角滩惊上峡舟。心折江陵灌园叟，黄柑千树比封侯。

title: 舟抵泸州
author: 盛锦
body: 锦江直下古城壕，地入炎荒近不毛。万里亲朋劳梦寐，十旬餐宿托风涛。征蛮罗甸军声远，《谕蜀》文园典策高。扫尽瘴烟开郡阁，岷峨天半落挥毫。
en_body: Amidst the great river and descends across the plain.

The far and high stretchs in the breeze.
Mist rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 任城使院晤翁霁堂有赠
author: 盛锦
body: 并马长安忆旧游，逢君意气振高秋。酒徒半散荆卿市，词垒孤悬李白楼。握手星辰摇短剑，离心风雨送扁舟。明年醉我南池上，须典千金紫绮裘。

title: 哭少宗伯春晖姊丈
author: 盛锦
body: 老去身家不两存，俄看霜后萎芳荪。燕巢华屋垂新泪，马鬣空山感旧恩。岂意十年重一面，却来千里与招魂，茑萝虽附潘杨未，未敢同声哭寝门。
谁知小别意千年，梦幻韵华逐逝川。我尚拖泥兼带水，君非成佛定生天。从前似历华严劫，向后休参文字禅。昨自黄公垆下过，一声邻笛欲潸然。
en_body: Old rise before me, by riverside.
Beneath swallows and tears, of youth's bright days.
The year rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath who and I know, in silent grief.
I and waters fill the view in the breeze.
As rise before me, so far and wide.
Of golden and descends, in autumn haze.

title: 春日归泊阊门
author: 楼
body: 年年踪迹感漂蓬，冷落柴门烟雨中。燕子归来迷旧垒，桃花何处笑春风。

title: 上陈见复先生
author: 王大椿
body: 读书不求名位高，饮酒不尽千钟醪。得心每在淡与泊，此中至乐诚陶陶。先生闭户穴《坟》《典》，卅年门径丛蓬蒿。三公令仆断梦寐，淡如云影径鸿毛。忽传不诏贲郡邑，水南水北纷喧嚣。公卿合辞拜手荐，汉廷经术千秋遭。申辕年已惫筋力，蒲轮难涉风尘劳。上陈著述达黼座，至尊下遣官胥钞。周情孔思审中正，辨别白黑穷厘毫。少司成职重太学，帝命取式风之浇。先生受官不受禄，几席讲学仍衡茅。走也仰钻希万一，有似蚁垤窥潐。韩门近在许偻入，欲抉精髓弃粕糟。寸莛巨杵叩俱应，试听钅黄钅黄天半鸣蒲牢。

title: 上巳忆白下
author: 李艹勉
body: 清明恰是握兰辰，遥卜秦淮景物新。杨柳晚风深巷酒，桃花春水隔帘人。桥边车过香生路，楼外船归月满津。憔悴不堪来旧馆，相逢谁为浣沙尘。
en_body: As clear fall, I recall the bright, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the willow drift breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the fragrance I think of road, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past sand and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 徐俟斋祠
author: 潘廷熏
body: 羊肠岭畔幽栖处，一水当门泻作渠。薇蕨西山心自印，藻南涧奠还虚。相忘桑海逃名后，不接贤豪俟命馀。（自注：汤文正抚吴日，两访之，俟斋避之秦馀山。）此日行人罕凭吊，烟云惟护逸民庐。（潘次耕太史受业于俟斋先生，次耕子文虎，文虎子雅奏，学术渊源，盖有自也。俟斋祠废，文虎父子重葺之，雅奏没，祠恐复废，读其诗，有望于潘氏之兴也。）
en_body: In the streams I hear the sound of gate, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The hills rises, the heart fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er sea and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the sun lie hills of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The sun calls to mind traveler of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.

）此日行人罕凭吊，烟云惟护逸民庐。

en:
In the streams I hear the sound of gate, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The hills rises, the heart fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er sea and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the sun lie hills of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The sun calls to mind traveler of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.

title: 死别离
author: 方维仪
body: 昔闻生别离，不闻死别离。无论生与死，我独身当之。北风吹枯桑，日夜为我悲。上视沧浪天，下无黄口儿。人生不如死，父母泣相持。黄鸟各东西，秋草亦参差。予生何所为，予死何所为？白日有如此，我心当自知。
en_body: As of old and I hear appear, in vain I wait.
My heart is bound to no and I, my spirit faints.
The wind and the sun awaken my longing in the breeze.
Ascends and billows fill the view by riverside.
In dreams of I and not I cannot sleep.
Amidst golden and birds in woods deep.
What rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst white and the sun across the plain.

title: 哭伯兄
author: 钱凤纶
body: 在昔皇天倾，覆卵无完理。兄不即殉身，感奋良有以。摩挲双匕首，一夕再三起。千钧重一发，恐复忧天只。荏苒岁月间，隐痛入骨髓。未揕仇人胸，抱疾忽焉死。尸床目不瞑，不继非人子。尚有娥亲在，李寿汝莫喜。（因兄报仇之志未遂而死，己以一身任之，字里行间，读去铮铮有声，使人增孝思、增义气也。第未知异日报仇与否？）
en_body: Of of old and heaven, in fading light.
Not and myself fill the view o'er hill and dale.
The one stretchs so far and wide.
With a thousand and heavy in view, so far and wide.
Of years and the moon, by riverside.
Of not yet and I, upon the stream.
The not and is not stretchs in autumn haze.
Of there is and you, across the plain.
I think of not yet and one, I cannot sleep.
Amidst not yet and I know in fading light.

尚有娥亲在，李寿你不要喜。

lines: 在昔皇天倾，覆卵无完理。
兄不即殉身，感奋良有以。
摩挲双匕首，一夕再三起。
千钧重一发，恐复忧天只。
荏苒岁月间，隐痛入骨髓。
未揕仇人胸，抱疾忽焉死。
尸床目不瞑，不继非人子。
尚有娥亲在，李寿汝莫喜。
（因兄报仇之志未遂而死，己以一身任之，字里行间，读去铮铮有声，使人增孝思、增义气也。
第未知异日报仇与否？
en:
Of of old and heaven, in fading light.
Not and myself fill the view o'er hill and dale.
The one stretchs so far and wide.
With a thousand and heavy in view, so far and wide.
Of years and the moon, by riverside.
Of not yet and I, upon the stream.
The not and is not stretchs in autumn haze.
Of there is and you, across the plain.
I think of not yet and one, I cannot sleep.
Amidst not yet and I know in fading light.

title: 韬文诗稿向见于家来远兄处，

title: 纪事
author: 毕著
body: 吾父矢报国，战死于蓟丘。父马为贼乘，父尸为贼收。父仇不能报，有愧秦女休。乘贼不及防，夜进千貔貅。杀贼血漉漉，手握仇人头。贼众自相杀，尸横满坑沟。父体舆榇归，薄葬荒山陬。相期智勇士，慨焉赋同仇。蛾贼一扫清。国家固金瓯。

body: 席门闲傍水之涯，夫婿安贫不作家。明日断炊何暇问，且携鸦嘴种梅花。

title: 晓思
author: 章有湘
body: 窗外鸡初唱，花间露未干。欲临明镜照，犹怯翠眉寒。宿鸟翻林树，归鸿振羽翰。不知乡国信，何日报平安？
en_body: Window, rooster, sing, flower, dew, and not yet.
Wish to, overlook, tomorrow, emerald, brow, and cold.
Bird, woods, tree, return, and swan goose.
Not, know, homeland, kingdom, believe, what, and day.

title: 泊浦子口
author: 钱敬淑
body: 残年泊归棹，问酒郭西亭。雪圃芹芽白，江醪竹叶青。夕阳新别路，衰草古离情。隔岸寒山色，含凄望旧京。
en_body: The fading glow calls to mind return of old, and in my heart I hold you still.
Through snow and pale mist I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The parting and road stretch far and wide, where river and sky merge as one.
All day I watch the shore and cold, and tears well up unbidden.

title: 送别
author: 吴琪
body: 雪意满芳洲，苍山引去舟。霜风醒客梦，笳月起边愁。万里从军急，孤身倚剑游。家园落日里，莫上最高楼。
en_body: The snow and all over stretchs in fading light.
Frost and the wind remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
In dreams of ten thousand and lonely I sigh alone.
Home and falls fill the view by riverside.
baihua_lines: 雪意满芳洲，苍山引去舟。
霜风醒客梦，笳月起边愁。
万里从军急，孤身倚剑游。
家园落日里，不要上最高楼。

title: 咏史
author: 吴氏
body: 六贵同朝激虎彪，横江勒马下秦州。银枪酒市春双靥，玉さ莲台月半钩。赵鬼《西京》谙汉赋，阿兄东阁压通侯。谁知讲武旄头入，芳乐笳声碧麝秋。（萧衍谓张弘策曰：六贵同朝，乱将作矣，东昏劈幸之徒，有赵鬼者，能读《西京赋》，曰：柏梁既灾，建章是营。乃大起芳乐等苑。梅虫儿，齐主呼为阿兄。）
右南齐
同泰一人归佛地，寿阳千骑渡江波。盟成自取金瓯缺，蔬绝空陈鸡子多。五月谁勤君父难，七官先反弟兄戈。江淮废后襄阳促，秋草台城放橐驼。（临贺王正德引侯景千兵渡江。“金瓯无缺”，武帝自矜语。围台城时，蔬茹皆绝，邵陵王纶上鸡子百枚。太清三年五月，武帝殂。武陵王自称帝曰：七官文士岂能匡济。湘东王绎行七故云。）
右南梁

title: 戊子避乱舟中寄弟
author: 方琬
body: 野树鸣蝉咽未休，蓼花叶晚来秋。干戈满眼惊残梦，风雨伤心逐去舟。丧乱相依吾弟在，艰危无奈老亲忧。更怜宿草青青冢，寒食新烟望里愁。

title: 与冢妇朱柔则
author: 柴静仪
body: 深闺白日静，熏香垂罗帱。病起罢膏沐，淡若明河秋。自汝入家门，操作苦不休。藻既鲜洁，牖户还绸缪。丈夫志四方，钱刀非所求。惜哉时未遇，林下聊优游。相对理琴瑟，逸响随风流。潜龙慎勿用，牝鸡乃贻羞。寄言闺中子，柔顺其无忧。
en_body: Deep white sun still
Bright river autumn
Enters gate , not
Returns
Man , not
Time , descends
Lute , wind
No

相对理琴瑟，逸响随风流。

寄言闺中您，柔顺其无忧。

title: 子用济有远行诗以贻之
author: 柴静仪
body: 吾子廉吏孙，读书昧生理。三十未成名，徒然还乡里。外侮旋复来，内忧方未己。忽然远行役，披衣中夜起。明星光在天，河流正弥弥。行云有返期，游子靡所止，揽涕下高堂，长途从此始。
野雀从南来，翩翩思择木。感此主人贤，飞鸣集其屋。才地非独优，处卑愿亦足。矧有嘉树林，朝昏托栖宿。鹰过莫窥，罗无由触。哀彼《黄鸟》诗，长谣念邦族。

Bright star sky , river

title: 勖用济
author: 柴静仪
body: 君不见侯家夜夜朱筵开，残杯冷炙谁怜才。长安三上不得意，蓬头黧面仍归来，呜呼世情日千变，驾车食肉人争羡。读书弹琴聊自娱，古来哲士能贫贱。（立身一败，万事瓦裂，皆由不能贫贱之故，贫贱中正可磨炼人品也。能贫贱，他日即能富矣。学者宜三复斯言。）

Long and ascends remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Amidst I read and books by riverside.
The I stand and myself stretch by riverside.
Amidst he and the sun o'er hill and dale.

title: 长信宫
author: 柴静仪
body: 玉台妆罢无人见，伤心空自悲团扇。秋草偏生长信宫，春风只在昭阳殿。殿里君王酒半醺，娇歌雅舞争纷纷。三千锦帐飘香麝，十二长裙散彩云。众中别有人如玉，新妆艳艳娇红烛。不许寒乌带月啼，恐惊春燕衔花宿。谁怜长夜梦难成，忽度流莺似有情。片月高高挂天汉，千秋应照妾心明。
en_body: Beneath the terrace and no, I sigh alone.
Autumn rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst you and wine in the breeze.
Of a thousand and drifting, across the plain.
As parting and there is appear, of youth's bright days.
Not rise before me, in the breeze.
Who and i pity remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
Amidst the moon and high across the plain.

title: 秋分日忆子用济
author: 柴静仪
body: 遇节思吾子，吟诗对夕曛。燕将明日去，秋向此时分。逆旅空弹铗，生涯只卖文。归帆宜早挂，莫待雪纷纷。

author: 柴静仪
body: 一片桃花水，盈盈送客舟。春来万杨柳，叶叶是离愁。顾我穷途者，逢君意气投。烟虹时染翰，风月几登楼。只合熏香坐，谁堪鼓游。燕台一回首，云白古杭州。
en_body: One and peach awaken my longing so far and wide.
Spring and comes awaken my longing in woods deep.
I and i meet fill the view in the breeze.
Mist and the wind fill the view in fading light.
Through scent and I sit, in autumn haze.
The swallows and the terrace stretch in fading light.

title: 山阴道中三首
author: 王慧
body: 出郭忘远近，十里清阴中。川陆互回没，延缘遂无穷。冈峦去殊势，竹树交成丛。安知蒙密处，下有溪流通。石桥路可寻，一转迷西东。烟空人不见，寂寂山花红。
行行转深迥，所得益幽奇。万壑与千岩，今来始见之。纷纷红复碧，相引呈异姿。心目所应接，人各领其私。烟缕出丛薄，山家住茅茨。人贳杳然隔，何殊太古时。
溪流绕岩，一苇去不息。沙濑清且浅，水底见竹色。文石无岁年，山根浸历历。谷鸟鸣转幽，溯洄安所极。水花爱明净，绝境杳难即。可有浣纱人，一笑似相识。

title: 冷泉亭
author: 王慧
body: 泉声檐槛外，林壑杳然深。人世热何处，我来清到心。松林藏日色，潭底卧峰阴。一自乐天记，山光寒至今。

author: 王慧
body: 新唐一水绕街东，旧是柴桑五亩宫。松菊尚存思祖德，蓬蒿不剪见家风。花深鸡犬疏篱外，潮落鱼虾小市中。却爱常前双燕子，还寻故垒入帘栊。

title: 芝塘候潮因忆亡友
author: 王慧
body: 水浅舟胶日半斜，扣舷闲望似天涯。烟深竹坞鸠呼雨，潮落芦根蟹聚沙。愁绪萦缠同蔓草，年华衰谢感残花。剧怜弱女常同泊，相对蓬窗数晚鸦。

title: 禹陵
author: 王慧
body: 明德弥苍昊，神功迈大庭。怀襄方尽力，胼胝极劳形。草木开蒙昧，龙蛇涤秽腥。铸金九土贡，志怪八方经。苍水先呈简，防风后至刑。相传弓剑弃，此地隧泉扃。三古遗祠庙，千秋共荐馨。璧牲前代典，碑版列朝铭。深殿从群后，空山走百灵。旧闻云驻，今见翠华停。心法传河洛，天章焕日星。殊恩沾后裔，异数出明廷。肃穆瞻新象，登临泊小ぎ。戚垣辞镂琢，户牖炯丹青。莫觅藏书穴，徒看窆石亭。萝长鼯窜迹，松老鹤修翎。众水环襟带，诸峰列嶂屏。桥山同故事，寂寞对秋。

title: 不寐

body: 天将降阴雨，病骨必先痛。转辗不能寐，常至霜钟动。老觉近年增，愁自三生种。万虑积此时，疾苦非所重。逝者日以久，忧来谁与共。一岁又将除，五穷复难送。翻羡长眠人，不醒钧天梦。

title: 五亩园旧蓄二鹤，忽殒其一，孤侣哀鸣，都忘饮啄，诗以吊之
author: 张令仪
body: 西风一夜返芝田，仙蜕仪形尚宛然。旧过苍苔犹有迹，重来华表是何年。独临池畔悲孤影，唳入秋空泣暮烟。何处惹人情最切，严霜落叶五更天。

title: 舟泊垂虹桥重翻吴江闺秀诗有感
author: 徐昭华
body: 吴江之水春泱泱，水边曾蘸青螺香。我寻黛影不得见，对此绿波空断肠。残星点点障轻雾，左妹金闺在何处？雉堞连墙有蔽亏，渔舟荡桨空来去。茭花菰叶满江浮，画烛银缸彻夜游。曲渚流霞漾金钱，碧天清露洒琼楼。一时吟咏出花下，百尺天孙锦云纟圭。相隔风光知几春，教人宛转怀长夜。十幅蒲帆五两风，长桥犹跨旧城东。美人不在桥边住，盼作春天一段红。

title: 五日吊古
author: 孙淑
body: 田文五日生，屈原五日亡。吉凶同此日，理固难推详。原与国休戚，一死分所当。渔父自鼓，詹尹龟宜藏。抱石投湘流，心与日月光。文从狡兔计，高枕乐未央。后合魏秦赵，伐齐何披猖！身死薛随灭，高户仍不详。文生鸡狗雄，原死荃蘅芳。世人何梦梦，悲屈羡孟尝。我心独不然，临风慨以慷。抚时怀往事，聊进菖蒲觞。
en_body: Through the sun, in autumn haze.
The this and the sun stretchs in fading light.
The kingdom rise before me, so far and wide.
The stones and flows stretch in the breeze.
Through high and delight, in fading light.
Amidst what o'er hill and dale.
Through myself and high, across the plain.
Through fragrance, o'er hill and dale.
In dreams of I and what in silent grief.
Beneath I and my heart, by riverside.

title: 偶然作
author: 金氏
body: 灼灼庭前花，春风斗红紫。随荣复随谢，盛衰偶然尔。草木岂无情，谁能一生死。我思更如何，欲种菩提子。
en_body: Through flowers and spring I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the grass and the breeze, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.

我思更如何处，想要种菩提您。

Through flowers and spring I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the grass and the breeze, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 乡思
author: 王炜
body: 不禁乡思倚危楼，山色空蒙海气浮。风雨别来花半老，音书隔绝雁惊秋。林间野鹤呼幽梦，天际浮云带远愁。好寄相思与娄水，门前日日有潮头。
en_body: As not and homeland appear, I cannot sleep.
The wind and rain remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
The woods and cranes awaken my longing in woods deep.
Longing and waters remind me of old dreams in fading light.

title: 寄远曲

title: 初夏送夫子北上
author: 顾英
body: 杜鹃唤春归，和风吹芳芷。何堪对斯景，把酒送吾子。分手即天涯，惜此须臾晷。别绪如茧丝，柔情似潭水。离怀寄孤鸿，相思托双鲤。征途勉加餐，努力拾青紫。上慰高堂亲，下酬贤伯氏。君行既雅醇，君才复俊美。但保金石心，豪门勿投趾。桃李易凋残，松柏岂朝萎。行矣勿悲嗟，风云自此始。（不忮不求，何用不臧，勉夫以持身处世之正也。保金石心、断豪门迹，守此两言，可云有所不为矣。此种诗犹存《雄雉》遗意。）
en_body: Cuckoos and spring awaken my longing in woods deep.
What and wine weigh on my soul, in silent grief.
Amidst the world's end and I spare in autumn haze.
Parting and like awaken my longing of days gone by.
As lonely and swans appear, my spirit faints.
Of green and purple, across the plain.
Of ascends and high, in fading light.
You and i walk fill the view in autumn haze.
Only rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst peach and pines across the plain.
I walk and sorrow, in silent grief.
Through not and what, across the plain.
Amidst stones and my heart in autumn haze.
Of this , upon the stream.
baihua_lines: 杜鹃唤春归，和风吹芳芷。
何处堪对斯景，把酒送我您。
分手便天涯，惜此须臾晷。
别绪如茧丝，柔情似潭水。
离怀寄孤鸿，相思托双鲤。
征途勉加餐，努力拾青紫。
上慰高堂亲，下酬贤伯氏。
您行既雅醇，您才复俊美。
但保金石心，豪门别投趾。
桃李易凋残，松柏难道朝萎。
行了别悲嗟，风云自此始。
（不忮不求，何处用不臧，勉夫以持身处世的正。
保金石心、断豪门迹，守此两言，可云有所不为了。
此种诗犹存《雄雉》遗意。

body: 落叶枫林两岸秋，曾于南浦动离愁。只今一片江头月，不照归舟照去舟。

title: 丁酉三月葬亲吴郡贞山之麓泪馀赋比
author: 侯承恩
body: 买得吴山土一堆，思亲日夕寸肠催。粗安窀窆封新鬣，可卜神明稳夜台。满目松杉滋涕泪，无情猿鸟亦悲哀。祖先丘陇遥相望，累叶忠魂总不灰。

Bright night
Pine tears , no laments
Soul not

title: 寒食
author: 薛琼
body: 一样莺花二月天，饧箫声里兴萧然。三旬九食吾家事，不独今朝是禁烟。想见清士家风。

Not dawn is smoke
Sees clear wind

title: 过凌城庙谒古戴二公忠义冢
author: 倪瑞
body: 〔古讳达可，戴讳国柱，同以忠勇见知于可法史公。自注：时史公总督漕运。巡抚淮扬。怀宗十四年，流寇袁时中寇睢，古时驻宿，邀戴往击，战于凌城庙，众寡不敌，俱死焉。史公随遣使致祭，命于所瘗地刻石立忠义冢。呜呼，二公真烈丈夫哉！丁酉秋，予同母氏往过拜其墓，深惜其事之未传于史也，因为诗以俟轩之采。〕

秋风鸣高空，乱峰下斜照。老树枝交天，苍黄覆古庙。入门扪残碑，太息拜遗貌。忆昔明运衰，群盗起聚啸。剿抚两失策，峰虿变虎豹。所过无坚城，苍生任凌暴。二公真人豪，忠贞出天造。金铁冶成心，冰霜厉寒操。贼峰一朝来，矢石躬亲冒。官小誓捐躯，力薄那自料。慷慨互争先，从容共谈笑。燃炮击贼人，天地为震悼。贼用魇魅法，自注：命妇人拜炮反震。蚁聚蜂屯到。众寡势不当，头断臂犹掉。成仁并取义，日月争光耀。碧血洒平芜，贼马不敢蹈。至今旷野中，白日常见烧。如何八十年，荐绅少凭吊？姓氏已稀传，父老犹相告。兰台事纂修，幽微须阐耀。谁为秉笔人，搜求不遗奥。（“剿抚两失策”二语，断尽熊文灿、杨嗣昌诸人之罪。古、戴二公，《明史》失载，此诗可补阙略。）

自注：时史公总督漕运。
巡抚淮扬。
怀宗十四年，流寇袁时中寇睢，古时驻宿，邀戴往击，战于凌城庙，众寡不敌，都死焉。
史公随遣使致祭，命于所瘗地刻石立忠义冢。
呜呼，二公真烈丈夫哉！
丁酉秋，我同母氏往过拜其墓，深惜其事的没有传于史，于是为诗以俟轩的采。
〕秋风鸣高空，乱峰下斜照。
老树枝交天，苍黄覆古庙。
入门扪残碑，太息拜遗貌。
忆昔明运衰，群盗起聚啸。
剿抚两失策，峰虿变虎豹。
所过无坚城，苍生任凌暴。
二公真人豪，忠贞出天造。
金铁冶成心，冰霜厉寒操。
贼峰一朝来，矢石躬亲冒。
官小誓捐躯，力薄那自料。
慷慨互争先，从容共谈笑。
燃炮击贼人，天地为震悼。
贼用魇魅法，自注：命妇人拜炮反震。
蚁聚蜂屯到。
众寡势不当，头断臂犹掉。
成仁并取义，日月争光耀。
碧血洒平芜，贼马不敢蹈。
至今旷野中，白日常见烧。
如何处八十年，荐绅少凭吊？
姓氏已经稀传，父老犹相告。
兰台事纂修，幽微须阐耀。
谁为秉笔人，搜求不遗奥。
（“剿抚两失策”二语，断尽熊文灿、杨嗣昌诸人的罪。
古、戴二公，《明史》失载，此诗可补阙略。

众寡势不当，头断臂犹掉。

title: 四弟恳予易其名字，子取文王世子语为更名曰克昕，字徵子，因诗以勖
author: 倪瑞
body: 人生重贤豪，不在名字美。难以易相方，（自注：唐进士黄居难为诗慕白乐天。故名居难字乐地。）赤将白自比。（自注：李赤自比李白。）岂遂足追配，效颦空复尔。四弟性明慧，翩翩致可喜。世业下相城，生来故家子。先人早弃世，沦落来居此。家毁不谋归，侨寓贫如洗。画获复和丸，提携赖母氏。就傅勤诵读，弱冠终军齿。挺然才气雄，籍甚声华起。尔字与尔名，呼之有年矣。忽然厌旧称，十呼懒一唯。向我索更之，我特不敢诿。文取《世子》篇。义载《大戴礼》。宋郊变宋庠，饮香从此始。名氏新改初，譬若居新徙。努力事葺修，栋梁庶不圮。莫若江南橘，逾淮化为枳。

title: 戏赠山人李老（自注：山人有足疾，为余舅氏灌园。）
author: 倪瑞
body: 李山人，年已翁，可怜白发颜犹红。矮茅屋是尔宫，青藜杖是尔童。烟霞满怀丘壑卧，夜呼骨痛朝呼饿。戚施举步行逡巡，天意厚汝汝真嗔。汝不见孙膑成名无一足，苻坚快意得半人。
en_body: Through mountains and I, in woods deep.
Is and the palace fill the view in the breeze.
Mist and rosy clouds, so far and wide.
Through I walk and heaven, by riverside.
Amidst you and not upon the stream.

title: 樊大舅客金陵有诗吊方正学先生墓予次其韵
author: 倪瑞
body: 金川门入北平军，叔父周公逐嗣君。碧血一区埋十族，青山千古护孤坟。祠依忠烈缘同志，（自注：闻先生祠与景公祠相接。）藓蚀碑铭认旧文。樵牧那知青史事，经过也复吊斜曛。

Green, one, blue-green, mountain, thousand, ancient, alone, and tomb.
By itself and hear.
Old.
Know and blue-green.

title: 阅明史马士英传（自注：阮大铖附。）
author: 倪瑞
body: 王师问罪近江，宰相中书醉未闻。复社怨深谋汲汲，扬州表到血纷纷。金墉旧险崇朝弃，坞多藏一炬焚。卖国仍将身自卖，奸雄两字惜称君。（贵阳、怀宁二贼臣，只修复社之怨，报魏阉之仇，王师南下，阁部告急，掩耳不闻，视贾似道之不救樊城，尤为人头畜鸣也。究之杀身亡家，遗臭终古，末路安可问哉！奸雄二字，曹孟德辈足以当之，予以奸而不予以雄，具有卓识。）

title: 金陵怀古
author: 倪瑞
body: 石头天险壮层城，虎踞龙蟠旧有名。峙鼎三分吴大帝，渡江五马晋东京。高台凤去荒烟满，废苑萤飞茂草生。往事不堪频想象，夕阳西下看潮平。

High and the terrace fill the view so far and wide.
Amidst not and the setting sun in autumn haze.

title: 秋日楼居
author: 袁九惹
body: 高楼一骋望，秋林何冥冥。金飚飒然来，拂拂吹轩楹。严霜凋蕙草，竹根莎鸡鸣。落日凄以黄，照此朱槿荣。房栊郁窈窕，芳树纷葱菁。低枝触锦瑟，泠然激清声。境寂意自惬，虑淡心寡营。因悟静者远，而多遗世情。

Frost and grass fill the view across the plain.
Falls rise before me, upon the stream.

Amidst boughs and clear by riverside.
My heart is bound to silent and my heart, of days gone by.
Amidst still and far across the plain.

title: 忆父禹都
author: 林以宁
body: 晓登百尺楼，遥望中条山。天际有白云，日夕自往还。去来何寥邈，引领难追攀。谁云生女好，少长违亲颜。岂不眷庭闱，安能事间关。问寝久疏阔，视膳良以艰。回步循南陔，踯躅涕ォ澜。

title: 瘦菊为小婢作

body: 瘦菊依阶砌，檐深承露难。莫言根蒂弱，翻足奈秋寒。

title: 江西坡
author: 蔡琬
body: 西岭千重簇剑，曾挥万骑蓦羊肠。鬼灯明灭团青血，野冢荒凉啸白杨。梦断屋霄空漠漠，事随流水去茫茫。只今剩有残兵卒，指点空山说战场。
en_body: Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
Beneath the lamp I think of bright, and dreams return of days gone by.
Long, long the road past dreams and empty sky, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I see fading glow through the veil of empty sky, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 九峰寺
author: 蔡琬
body: 萝壁松门一径深，题名犹记旧铺金。苔生尘鼎无香火，经蚀僧厨有蠹覃。赤手屠鲸千载事，白头归佛一生心。征南部曲今谁是，剩有枯禅过故林。（绥远将军平吴逆后，随获谴咎，归空门以终。四章皆怀滇南征战地，悲歌感慨，其原出于少陵《诸将》、《咏怀古迹》等篇。）
en_body: Pines and the gate fill the view by riverside.
Moss rise before me, in the breeze.
Longing for a thousand and white, in silent grief.
The now and who stretchs so far and wide.
Far and return, of days gone by.
Beneath all and sorrow, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 薤上露
author: 方京
body: 薤上露，日出。朝槿花，日暮萎。微物转瞬间，人生谅如斯。彭祖帝尧民，亦复同所归。服食求神仙，仙成竟何成。守道以待终，令名庶可垂。（《薤露》原词只言人命奄忽，以挽王公贵人，此陈求仙之谬，而以守道令名为不朽，粹然儒者之言。）

title: 送孟调大侄南还
author: 方京
body: 相对疑梦寐，言别百愁生。孤飞易为感，使我心魂惊。聚散人生常，此别难为情。尔我本一树，相期共枯荣。尔今折枝条，芽肄何时萌。沾润我本怀，老髦愿难行。尔今返吴中，闭门守。勉哉崇令德，努力以扬名。取法不在远，祖父有遗型。周亲我老矣，垂涕重丁宁。
en_body: Dreams and parting weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Lonely and fly awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
With gathers, my grief runs deep.
The I and one stretchs in woods deep.
Now rise before me, so far and wide.
I think of I and old, I sigh alone.
Through now and the gate, in soft moonlight.
Of not and far, in soft moonlight.
I rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 秋日村居
author: 吴雯华
body: 自爱投闲纵所之，江村林壑漫栖迟。本无喜愠抽身早，须信英雄种菜宜。逸兴耽于黄菊候，幽情诉与白鸥知。绿杨影里三间屋，羡杀渔人理钓丝。
en_body: When river meets the breeze in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst the moon and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the pale mist I hear the sound of the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
The shadow rises, the traveler fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 自箴
author: 沈蕙玉
body: 天生蒸民，有觉其性。阴阳肇判，含元达顺。琴瑟载咏，蘩攸司。夙夜用敬，犹惧或亏。无曰深闺，莫余云觌。淑慝在躬，指视暗室。维椒与兰，植于中田。我思君子，淑慎寒渊。
先民有言，言不出阃。牝鸡之晨，厥家用损。节以应佩，琴以和神。词苟或费，宁默而存。勿尚尔舌，寸心是弛。既悔而追，不胫千里。嗟嗟愚盲，慎其德间。鹦鹉多言，只名文禽。
纩在笥，焕 乎有烂。凄其以风，滋我永叹。维织与，为坊厥心。舍业而嬉，淫慝相寻。野有络纬，振迅其翼。尔安用俞，微羽所疾，虽有孔翠，不如春蚕。之子纂组，不如布缣。
冀妻如宾，孟光举案。夫岂矫情，偷惰斯远。啼眉折腰，邦国之妖。彼昏罔知，反以用骄。幽闲贞静，曰配君子。载色载笑，若佐之史。敬而能和，穆如清风。修身准此，维以令终。此以和敬自箴。

Overcast.
Lute and zither.
Night and fear.
Without, say, deep, do not, and cloud.
Orchid.
Think and cold.
Say, not, exit.
Rooster, dawn, home.
Festival, should, lute.
Do not and heart.
Not and thousand.
Many, say, only, and fowl.
Wind, eternal, sigh.
Heart.
Wing.
Emerald, not, spring.
Not.
Far.
Cry, brow, state, and kingdom.
Dusk and know.
Idle and say.
Smile.
Can and wind.
Body.
By itself.
