title: 桐庐夜泊
author: 吴师道
body: 合江亭前秋水清，归人罢市无余声。灯光隐见隔林薄，湿云闪露青荧荧。楼台渐稀灯渐远，何处吹箫犹未断？凄风凉叶下高桐，半夜仙人来绝巘。江霏山气生白烟，忽如飞雨洒我船。倚篷独立久未眠，静看水月摇清圆。
en_body: River autumn waters clear , returns one no
Lamp sees , cloud dew blue
Tower lamp far
Wind descends high , night one comes
River mountains white smoke , rain I
Still looks waters moon clear

title: 冷泉亭
author: 周权
body: 昔人来自天竺国，缥缈孤云伴飞锡。天风吹落凝不去，化作奇峰耸空碧。至今裂峡余云髓，桂冷松香流未已。翠光围住玉壶秋，不放晴雷度山趾。道人宴坐无生灭，炯炯层胸照冰雪。夜深出定汲清泠，寒猿啼断西岩月。
en_body: One comes sky , cloud
Sky wind not departs , empty
Cloud , pine
Autumn , not mountains
One no , snow
Night deep exits clear , cold west moon

title: 题晴川图
author: 岑安卿
body: 清溪潾潾生浅花，晓日倒射摇金沙。翩然双鹭下危石，玉雪照影无纤瑕。溪边小景入图画，青烟绿树渔翁家。渔翁归来歌未终，鹭鸶忽起芦花风。回眸遥望不可极，但见白玉飞青空。昔年夜宿潇湘浦，彻晓不眠听急雨。解衣曳杖立沙头，何似今朝得容与？长安马寒泥没腹，雪满朝衣冻肩缩。试令援笔题此图，长篇应赋《归来曲》。
en_body: Clear rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst descends and stones in the breeze.
The the stream and enters stretch across the plain.
Return and comes, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst I gaze and not o'er hill and dale.
Of of old and the year, in fading light.
Amidst robe and I stand in woods deep.
The long and cold stretchs o'er hill and dale.
My heart is bound to this and long, in silent grief.

回眸遥望不可极，但见白玉飞青空。
昔年夜宿潇湘浦，彻晓不眠听急雨。
解衣曳杖立沙头，何似今朝得容与？
长安马寒泥没腹，雪满朝衣冻肩缩。
试令援笔题此图，长篇应赋《归来曲》。
en:
Clear rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst descends and stones in the breeze.
The the stream and enters stretch across the plain.
Return and comes, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst I gaze and not o'er hill and dale.
Of of old and the year, in fading light.
Amidst robe and I stand in woods deep.
The long and cold stretchs o'er hill and dale.
My heart is bound to this and long, in silent grief.

title: 杨花吟
author: 胡天游
body: 吴江春水拍天涯，江上风吹杨柳花。花飞满空无处所，随风直渡吴江水。渡水随风太有情，萦花惹草恣轻盈。狂如舞蝶穿花径，细逐流莺度绮城。绮城楼阁连天际，杨花飞入千门去。飞去飞来稍觉多，纷纷如雪奈君何？珠帘绣箔深深见，舞榭妆楼处处过。楼中美人春睡起，愁见杨花思荡子。荡子飘零去不归，杨花岁岁点春衣。梦魂不识天涯路，愿作杨花片片飞。
en_body: Through the great river and spring, by riverside.
The flowers and fly stretch in woods deep.
Waters rise before me, in fading light.
Through like and butterflies, in the breeze.
The city and the tower fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst fly and departs by riverside.
The curtain rise before me, in fading light.
As the tower and I appear, o'er hill and dale.
Drifting and departs awaken my longing I cannot sleep.
Dreams and my soul, in vain I wait.

title: 白苎舞词
author: 张宪
body: 吴宫美人青犊刀，自裁白苎制舞袍。轻云冉冉白胜雪，《激楚》一曲回风高。九雏凤钗篸紫玉，长裾窄腰莲步促。翩翻素袖启朱樱，金笼鹦鹉飞来熟。馆娃楼阁摇春晖，台城少年醉忘归。璚窗绮户锁风色，桃树日长蝴蝶飞。倾城独立世希有，罢吟《渌水》停《杨柳》。急管繁弦莫苦催，真珠剩买乌程酒。
en_body: Beyond the traveler lie green hills of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The clouds calls to mind pale mist of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through long years and the breeze I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The flight and the breeze stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the tower and spring, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the breeze, how deep the trees! as memories of you linger on.
The alone murmurs of streams long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As wine fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 二月八日游皇城西华门外观嘉孥弟走马歌
author: 张宪
body: 春风压城紫燕飞，绣鞍宝勒生光辉。软沙青草平似镜，花雨满巾风满衣。潜蛟双绾玉抱肚，朱鬛分光散红雾。金龙五爪蟠彩袍，满背真珠撒秋露。生猿俊健双臂长，左脚蹋镫右蹴缰。铜铙四扇绕十指，玉声珠碎金琅珰。黄蛇下饮电掣地，锦鹰打兔起复坠。袖云突兀鞍面空，银瓮驼囊两边缒。西宫彩楼高插天，凤凰缭绕排神仙。玉皇拍阑误一笑，不觉四蹄如迸烟。神驹长鸣背凝血，郎君转面醉眼缬。天恩剪下五色云，打鼓归来汗如雪。

Sand and green fill the view upon the stream.
Scatters rise before me, upon the stream.
Of all over and autumn, o'er hill and dale.
The long stretchs in the breeze.
Of golden and descends, upon the stream.
Amidst sleeves and clouds o'er hill and dale.
Through the palace and the tower, in woods deep.
The one and not stretchs across the plain.
With long and sing in view, across the plain.
As heaven and descends appear, in woods deep.

title: 北庭宣元杰西番刀歌（此刀乃江浙平章教化公征淮西所佩者）
author: 张宪
body: 金神起持水火齐，煅炼阴阳结精锐。七月七日授冶师，手作钳锤股为砺。一千七百七十锋，脊高体狭刀口洪。龙飞蛟化岁月久，阮师旧物今无踪。<口爪>哇绣镔柔可曲，东倭纯钢不受触。贤侯示我西番刀，名压古今刀剑录。三尖两刃圭首圆，剑脊<黑乚>々生黑烟。朱砂斑痕点人血，雕青皮软金钩联。唐人宝刀夸大食，于今利器称米息。十年土涮松纹生，戎王造时当月蚀。平章遗佩固有神，朱高固始多奇勋。三公重器不虚授，往继王祥作辅臣。

title: 鸿门会
author: 杨维桢
body: 天迷关，地迷户，东龙白日西龙雨。撞钟饮酒愁海翻，碧火吹巢双猰貐。（暗言范增、项庄。）照天万古无二乌，残星破月开天余。（此言沛公当独王天下，羽不得分也。）座中有客天子气，左股七十二子连明珠。军声十万振屋瓦，拔剑当人面如赭。将军下马力拔山，气卷黄河酒中泻。剑光上天寒彗残，明朝画地分河山。将军呼龙将客走，石破青天撞玉斗。

Of ten thousand and sword, so far and wide.

Through sword and ascends, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst stones and green in autumn haze.

title: 庐山瀑布谣（并序）
author: 杨维桢
body: 甲申秋八月十六夜，予梦与酸斋仙客游庐山，各赋诗，酸斋赋《彭郎词》，予赋《瀑布谣》。
银河忽如瓠子决，泻诸五老之峰前。我疑天仙织素练，素练脱轴垂青天。便欲手把并州剪，剪取一幅玻璃烟。相逢云石子，有似捉月仙。酒喉无耐夜渴甚，骑鲸吸海枯桑田。居然化作十万丈，玉虹倒挂清泠渊。

Of ten thousand and clear, in woods deep.

title: 过歌风台
author: 张昱
body: 世间快意宁有此，亭长还乡作天子。沛宫不乐复何为？诸母父兄知旧事。酒酣起舞和儿歌，眼中尽是汉山河。韩彭受诛黥布戮，且喜壮士今无多。纵酒极欢留十日，感慨伤怀涕沾臆。万乘旌旗不自尊，魂魄犹为故乡惜。从来乐极自生哀，泗水东流不再回。万岁千秋谁不念，古之帝王安在哉？莓苔石刻今如许，几度秋风灞陵雨。汉家社稷四百年，荒台犹是开基处。

title: 古金城谣（并序）
author: 周霆震
body: 国家承平百年，武备浸弛，盗发徐、颍，炽于汉、淮、武昌，南纪雄藩，一旦灰灭，洪省坚壁。寇蔓延诸郡，水陆犬牙。北来名将，相继道殒。丞相出督步骑，直抵高邮，事垂成，以谗废。方面多贵游子弟，贪鄙庸才，虚张战功，肆意罔上，诛求冤滥，惨酷百端，重以吏习舞文，旁罗鹰犬，意所欲陷，即诬与贼通，其弊有不忍言者。间存一二廉介，则又矜独断，昧远图，坐失机会。民日以敝，盗日以滋。庐、寿、舒三州，屏蔽上流，庐、寿既没，舒独当锋镝之冲。至正十年壬申，进士余阙以淮西元帅之节来镇，广设方略，招徕补葺，备战守，丰军储，贼饮恨不得逞。朝廷嘉其功，授淮南参知政事。自是日与贼遌，受围凡四十有二，大小二百余战。江西赖以苟安。坐视弗援，十八年正月丙午，城遂陷。公一门争先赴死，阖郡无一生降。贼党举手加额，称余元帅天下一人，购得其尸城下池中，礼葬之。伤哉！寄痛哭于长歌，使后人哀也。

昆仑烈风撼坤轴，日车敛辔咸池浴。六龙饮渴呼不闻，赤蚁玄蜂厌人肉。荆襄弗支庐寿孤，江东扫地如摧枯。忠臣当代谁第一？七载舒州天下无。东南此地关形胜，天柱之峰屹千仞。当年赤壁走曹瞒，天为孙吴产公瑾。我公千载遥相望，崎岖恒以弱击强。孤城大小二百战，食尽北拜天无光。当关援剑苍龙吼，尽室肯污奸党手。摧锋阖郡无生降，群盗言之皆稽首。堂堂省宪罗公卿，建官分阃日募兵。哀哉坐视无寸策，遂使流血西江平。向来不晓皇穹意，名将南征死相继。一时贪暴聚庸才，玩寇偷安饕富贵。河流浩浩龙门西，燕山万骑攒霜蹄。英雄暴骨心未死，去作海色催朝鸡。玉衣飞舞空中见，太息孤忠鏖百战。五陵元气待天还，睢阳谁续《中丞传》？

寇蔓延诸郡，水陆犬牙。
北来名将要，相继道殒。
丞相出督步骑，直抵高邮，事垂成，以谗废。
正面多贵游您弟，贪鄙庸才，虚张战功，肆意罔上，诛求冤滥，惨酷百端，重以吏习舞文，旁罗鹰犬，意所想要陷，便诬与贼通，其弊有不忍言……的人。
间存一二廉介，则又矜独断，昧远图，坐失机会。
民日以敝，盗日以滋。
庐、寿、舒三州，屏蔽上流，庐、寿既没，舒独当锋镝的冲。
至正十年壬申，进士我阙以淮西元帅的节来镇，广设正略，招徕补葺，备战守，丰军储，贼饮恨不得逞。
朝廷嘉其功，授淮南参知政事。
自是日与贼遌，受围凡四十有二，大小二百我战。
江西赖以苟怎。
坐视弗援，十八年正月丙午，城于是陷。
公一门争先赴死，阖郡无一生降。
贼党举手加额，称我元帅天下一人，购得其尸城下池中，礼葬的。
伤哉！
寄痛哭于长歌，使后人哀。
昆仑烈风撼坤轴，日车敛辔都池浴。
六龙饮渴呼不闻，赤蚁玄蜂厌人肉。
荆襄弗支庐寿孤，江东扫地如摧枯。
忠臣当代谁第一？
七载舒州天下无。
东南此地关形胜，天柱的峰屹千仞。
当年赤壁走曹瞒，天为孙吴产公瑾。
我公千载遥相望，崎岖恒以弱击强。
孤城大小二百战，食尽北拜天无光。
当关援剑苍龙吼，尽室肯污奸党手。
摧锋阖郡无生降，群盗言的都稽首。
堂堂省宪罗公卿，建官分阃日募兵。
哀哉坐视无寸策，于是使流血西江平。
向来不晓皇穹意，名将要南征死相继。
一时贪暴聚庸才，玩寇偷怎饕富贵。
河流浩浩龙门西，燕山万骑攒霜蹄。
英雄暴骨心没有死，去作海色催朝鸡。
玉衣飞舞空中见，太息孤忠鏖百战。
五陵元气待天还，睢阳谁续《中丞传》？

title: 金谷行
author: 杨奂
body: 洛阳园池天下无，金谷近在西城隅。晋时花草不复见，野人犹解谈齐奴。齐奴豪奢谁比数，酒醒爱击珊瑚株。后堂春风满桃李，中有一枝名绿珠。千金买步障，百金买氍毹。时时吹笛替郎语，云窗雾户长欢娱。层阶欲下须人扶，岂料一日能捐躯。红飞玉碎顷刻里，空使行客悲踌躇。楼头小妇感恩死，君臣大义当何如？

洛阳园池天下无，金谷近在西城隅。
晋时花草不复见，野人犹解谈齐奴。
齐奴豪奢谁比数，酒醒爱击珊瑚株。
后堂春风满桃李，中有一枝名绿珠。
千金买步障，百金买氍毹。
时时吹笛替郎语，云窗雾户长欢娱。
层阶想要下须人扶，难道料一日能捐躯。
红飞玉碎顷刻里，空使行客悲踌躇。
楼头小妇感恩死，您臣大义当何处如？

title: 河间府
author: 陈孚
body: 北风河间道，沙飞云浩浩。上有衔芦不鸣之寒雁，下有陨霜半死之秋草。城外平波青黛光，大鱼跳波一尺长。牧童吹笛枫叶里，疲牛倦马眠夕阳。有禽大如鹤，红喙摇绿烟。路人指我语，似是信天缘。我生功名付樽酒，衣如枯荷马如狗。为问天缘可信否？旗亭击剑寒蛟吼。
en_body: O'er breeze and river I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the cold lie wild geese of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The waves calls to mind green hills of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through leaves and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The red blooms and mist stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the road and traveler, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
How fair the wine, how deep the the breeze! as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The sky murmurs of the breeze long past, as the west wind bears me home.
As cold fall, I recall the the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 居庸叠翠
author: 陈孚
body: 断崖万仞如削铁，鸟飞不度苔石裂。嵯岈枯木无碧柯，六月太阴飘急雪。寒沙茫茫出关道，骆驼夜吼黄云老。征鸿一声起长空，风吹草低山月小。
en_body: Of cliffs and ten thousand, so far and wide.
The no and emerald stretchs in the breeze.
Amidst cold and sand o'er hill and dale.
Of swans and one, in the breeze.

title: 邕州
author: 陈孚
body: 左江南下一千里，中有交州堕鸢水。右江西绕特磨来，鳄鱼夜吼声如雷。两江合流抱邕管，莫冬气候三春暖。家家榕树青不凋，桃李乱开野花满。蝮蛇挂屋晚风急，热雾如汤溅衣湿。万人冢上蛋子眠，三公亭下鲛人泣。驿吏煎茶茱萸浓，槟榔口吐猩血红。飒然毛窍汗为雨，病骨似觉收奇功。平生所持一忠壮，荒峤何殊玉阶上。明年归泛两江船，会酌清波洗炎瘴。
en_body: The great river rise before me, upon the stream.
The the great river and comes stretch in woods deep.
Through the great river and flows, o'er hill and dale.
Home rise before me, so far and wide.
The the wind and mist stretch in woods deep.
Longing for ten thousand and I, of youth's bright days.
The red blooms stretch in the breeze.
Rain rise before me, upon the stream.
One and what fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Bright and the year awaken my longing I sigh alone.

title: 邯郸行
author: 傅若金
body: 邯郸城头下白日，邯郸市上风萧瑟。故垒空余鸟雀悲，荒垣只见狐狸出。何王坟墓对山阿，尚忆诸侯征战多。赵客归来重毛遂，秦军老去畏廉颇。黄尘白草宫前道，鬼火如灯夜相照。公子秋来不见过，美人月下那闻笑。当时冠盖激浮云，挝钟考鼓宴青春。只今惟有邮亭树，还送年年行路人。
en_body: Descends white sun , ascends wind
Empty laments , sees exits
Mountains
Traveler returns comes , departs
Golden dust white grass , lamp night
Autumn comes not sees , one moon descends hears smiles
Time cloud , bell drum blue spring
Has trees , returns years years road one

lines: 邯郸城头下白日，邯郸市上风萧瑟。
故垒空余鸟雀悲，荒垣只见狐狸出。
何王坟墓对山阿，尚忆诸侯征战多。
赵客归来重毛遂，秦军老去畏廉颇。
黄尘白草宫前道，鬼火如灯夜相照。
公子秋来不见过，美人月下那闻笑。
当时冠盖激浮云，挝钟考鼓宴青春。
只今惟有邮亭树，还送年年行路人。

title: 送华山隐归西湖故居
author: 王士熙
body: 方士求仙入沧海，十二城楼定何在？金铜移盘露满天，琪树离离人不采。轩辕高拱圣明居，群仙真人左右趋。青牛谷口迎紫气，白鹤洞中传素书。珊珊鸣佩星辰远，寂寂珠庭云雾虚。修髯如漆古仙子，玉林芙蓉染秋水。九关高塞不可留，归去江湖种兰芷。山头宫殿风玲珑，玄猱飞来千尺松。闲房诵经钟磬响，石壁题诗苔藓封。欲向君王乞祠禄，安排杖屦来相从。
en_body: Enters sea , tower
Dew sky , trees one not
High bright , one
Blue purple , white
Star far , cloud mist
Autumn waters
High not , returns departs river lake orchid
Mountains wind , comes thousand pine
Bell
You , comes

金铜移盘露满天，琪树离离人不采。
轩辕高拱圣明居，群仙真人左右趋。
青牛谷口迎紫气，白鹤洞中传素书。
珊珊鸣佩星辰远，寂寂珠庭云雾虚。
修髯如漆古仙您，玉林芙蓉染秋水。
九关高塞不可留，归去江湖种兰芷。
山头宫殿风玲珑，玄猱飞来千尺松。
闲房诵经钟磬响，石壁题诗苔藓封。
想要向您王乞祠禄，怎排杖屦来相从。

title: 江南曲
author: 成廷珪
body: 吴姬当垆新酒香，翠绡短袂红罗裳。上盆十千买一斗，三杯五杯来劝郎。落花不解留春住，似欲随郎渡江去。酒醒一夜怨啼鹃，明日兰舟泊何处？
en_body: The wine and scent stretchs in the breeze.
Ascends and a thousand fill the view so far and wide.
Of fallen blooms and not, upon the stream.
Wine and sober remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.

title: 长江送别图送周平叔之通州丞
author: 成廷珪
body: 福山苍苍倚天碧，狼山巉巉生铁色。两山当江作海门，力尽神鞭驱不得。沧波万里从西来，楚尾吴头天一壁。阴风转地鲸怒翻，黑雾连空龙起立。来舟去楫不敢动，袖手旁观唯叹息。扶桑浴日飞上天，百怪潜消杳无迹。水光镜净山亦佳，目送云帆高百尺。青霄要路君既官，白首穷途我犹客。烟中隐隐见孤城，令我思乡心转剧。《骊驹》歌罢将奈何，倚杖江南望江北。
en_title: 长江送别图送周平叔之通州丞
en_body: Mountains and dark fill the view in autumn haze.
The mountains and the great river stretch across the plain.
Through waves and ten thousand, in woods deep.
Through the wind and mist, in soft moonlight.
Comes and the boat weigh on my soul, in silent grief.
Of the sun and fly, across the plain.
Waters and mountains, so far and wide.
The green and the road stretch o'er hill and dale.
With mist and I see in view, across the plain.
Of what and I lean, in fading light.

title: 送罗与敬归西昌
author: 刘永之
body: 石龙矶畔多芳草，游子忆家春已老。水北杨花扑地飞，旁人漫道飞花好。爱子不忍别，送子到水濆。青天孤影飞黄鹄，落日长风吹断云。朝发铜塘津，莫宿青泥渡。帆过孝通祠，渐是西昌路。金鱼洲远树青青，三顾浮烟生杳冥。石扶坏道通高阁，水啮危沙见古城。君家正在何方住？独有园庐俯江渚。昨夜深闺梦远人，相思定倚樱桃树。
en_body: Beneath stones and fragrant grass, in autumn haze.
Of waters and poplars, in autumn haze.
I love and not, in autumn haze.
Beneath green and heaven, in autumn haze.
The morning and do not stretch so far and wide.
Amidst sails and is so far and wide.
Of far and trees, in soft moonlight.
Stones rise before me, in autumn haze.
You and home fill the view in the breeze.
Alone and there is remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
As night and deep appear, across the plain.

lines: 石龙矶畔多芳草，游子忆家春已老。
水北杨花扑地飞，旁人漫道飞花好。
爱子不忍别，送子到水濆。
青天孤影飞黄鹄，落日长风吹断云。
朝发铜塘津，莫宿青泥渡。
帆过孝通祠，渐是西昌路。
金鱼洲远树青青，三顾浮烟生杳冥。
石扶坏道通高阁，水啮危沙见古城。
君家正在何方住？
独有园庐俯江渚。
昨夜深闺梦远人，相思定倚樱桃树。

Of waters and poplars, in autumn haze.
I love and not, in autumn haze.
Beneath green and heaven, in autumn haze.
The morning and do not stretch so far and wide.
Amidst sails and is so far and wide.
Of far and trees, in soft moonlight.
Stones rise before me, in autumn haze.
You and home fill the view in the breeze.
Alone and there is remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
As night and deep appear, across the plain.

title: 送李彦明归高邮
author: 谢应芳
body: 老夫归从东海头，春风送客归秦邮。出门复睹雁北乡，物我喜得同悠悠。吴船鼓棹渡江去，乌轮正挂扶桑树。桃花倚岸笑相看，杜宇催人啼不住。征袍十年尘土多，濯缨今年《沧浪歌》。一百五日寒食雨，三十六湖春水波。文游台榭剪荆棘，继美前修集佳客。谁能唤起老龙眠，重写耳孙湖上宅。
note:
【悠悠】悠远、漫长
【棹】船桨
【渡】渡口

One rise before me, in woods deep.
The terrace rise before me, in woods deep.
Of who and old, in autumn haze.

title: 题道士张湛然弹琴诗卷
author: 汪克宽
body: 峄山白桐千年枝，金星烂烂蛇蚹皮。文光七轸蓝田玉，冰弦细绕吴蚕丝。丹山云暖凤皇语，露草寒蛩诉秋雨。娥英泣洒湘筠斑，迁客相逢话羁旅。翠岩悬瀑锵琼瑶，雷霆霹雳轰层霄。瞥波细萍浮荡漾，劈空轻絮飞飘飖。仙林唳鹤惊离别，老龙湫底吟寒月。海门送上子胥潮，澎湃奔腾卷残雪。羽人潇洒颜如仙，冯虚来往黄山巅。古音净洗筝琶耳，何须更濯丹砂泉？
en_body: Mountains rise before me, across the plain.
Of thin , in the breeze.
Of crimson and mountains, upon the stream.
Longing for I meet, my grief runs deep.
Of jade-green and crags, upon the stream.
Of waves and thin, in fading light.
As the woods and cranes appear, in silent grief.
The sea and the gate remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
I rise before me, across the plain.
Ancient times rise before me, in autumn haze.

title: 客邸中秋对月
author: 朱希晦
body: 去年中秋秋月圆，浩歌对酒清无眠。烟霏灭尽人境寂，仰看明月悬中天。今年客里中秋月，静挹金波更清绝。可怜有月客无酒，不照欢娱照离别。夜阑淅淅西风凉，月中老桂吹天香。悠然长啸动归兴，坐久零露沾衣裳。浮世悲欢何足数？庾楼赤壁俱尘土。风流已往明月来，山色江声自今古。

Through night and the wind, by riverside.
With long and return in view, in silent grief.
Sorrow and joy weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
Through the tower and dust, in the breeze.
The the wind and flows stretch across the plain.

title: 新郭
author: 周砥
body: 泛舟越来溪水旁，溪边暮色何苍苍？主人张筵挥羽觞，吴姬唱歌声抑扬。船尾挑灯大鱼出，船头洗<角戋>秋波凉。夜如何其夜未央，万壑不起星煌煌。酒阑客过别船去，木叶萧萧下如雨。船中醉卧忘西，睡觉犹闻梦中语。此时月落天将曙，隔屋鸡啼欲起舞。西风满天鸿雁声，瑟瑟菰蒲响秋渚。

【渚】水中小洲

title: 西州即事
author: 黄庚
body: 一雨洗空碧，江城独倚楼。山吞残日没，水挟断云流。灯影深村夜，钟声古寺秋。西州旧游地，十载此淹留。
en_body: Beneath one and rain, in silent grief.
Mountains rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The lamp rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst this in fading light.

title: 春日即事
author: 黄庚
body: 扶杖行幽径，园林欲莫天。锦棠红濯雨，丝柳绿缲烟。春事忽三月，风光又一年。客怀正愁绝，那复听啼鹃。

Of red blooms and rain, across the plain.
Spring and the moon fill the view by riverside.
With grief and that in view, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 书山阴驿
author: 黄庚
body: 迢递三山道，重来感旧游。潮声寒带雨，山色淡生秋。寄驿通乡信，题诗记旅愁。江湖十年客，两度到西州。

title: 鹤林仙坛寺
author: 黄庚
body: 古坛归鹤杳，野鹿自成群。岚气浮清晓，钟声出白云。树穿僧屋老，水到寺门分。人世无穷事，山中了不闻。

Of trees and old, in the breeze.
The I and no stretchs o'er hill and dale.

title: 长芦舟中夜坐
author: 尹廷高
body: 故国五千里，孤帆四十程。客怀偏浩荡，乡梦不分明。万折河流曲，三更斗柄横。不眠方宴坐，野寺又钟声。
en_body: In dreams of the kingdom and a thousand my spirit faints.
In dreams of homeland and dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Of ten thousand and the river, in fading light.
Through not and I sit, in woods deep.

title: 鱼乐楼

body: 楼下南来水，清泠百尺深。菰蒲终夜响，杨柳半溪阴。日月驱人世，江湖动客心。向来歌舞宴，达晓看横参。

title: 大都遇平江龙兴寺僧闲上，座话唐綦毋潜宿龙兴寺诗，因次其韵
author: 赵孟頫
body: 闻说龙兴寺，多年未款扉。风林发松籁，雨砌长苔衣。殿古灯光定，房深磬韵微。秋风动归兴，一锡向空飞。
en_body: Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The breeze and rain stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the lamp and deep vales, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the autumn, how deep the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 送董仁甫之西台幕
author: 马祖常
body: 西南万里地，诏属大行台。秦树浮天去，巴江带雪来。山河无用险，邦国正需才。台幕风流美，书签想尽开。

title: 枪竿岭
author: 贡奎
body: 薄宦辞家远，经秋未得归。直随山北去，却背雁南飞。川净白云起，郊平红树微。忆曾留宿处，立马认还非。

body: 水国宜秋晚，羁愁感岁华。清霜醉枫叶，淡月隐芦花。涨落高低路，川平远近沙。炊烟青不断，山崦有人家。

body: 江上新诗好，亦知公事闲。投壶深竹里，系马古松间。夜月多临海，秋风或在山。玉堂萧爽地，思尔佩珊珊。

title: 衡山县晓渡
author: 揭傒斯
body: 古县依江次，轻舆落岸隈。鸟冲行客过，山向野船开。近岳皆云气，中流忽雨来。何时还到此，明月照沿洄。
en_body: The ancient times and the great river stretch in autumn haze.
The birds and I walk stretch in woods deep.

title: 寄方韶文先生
author: 黄溍
body: 牢落《江南赋》，知音寄渺茫。鹿麋行处有，芝草梦中香。遥兴沧溟阔，悲歌白发长。平生今古泪，滴破绿萝裳。
en_body: O'er falling blooms and river I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the grass lie dreams of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The pale mist calls to mind long years of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through tears and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 同杨仲礼和袁集贤上都诗
author: 柳贯
body: 出塞行瞻日，趋朝喜近天。离宫开苑囿，驰道绝风烟。瑶水巡非远，峒山历更绵。甘泉多法从，献赋忆当年。
昔建寰中业，初开徼外山。雉城平兀兀，沙水净湾湾。朱夏宸游正，清秋武卫闲。叨陪文学乘，空愧鬓毛斑。
幄殿层云障，辕门积雪峰。奇鹰皆戴角，御马尽飞龙。瀚海将临幸，云亭望陟封。青丘大羽猎，有事待玄冬。
水草方方善，弓弧户户便。合围连妇女，从戍到曾玄。雪毳千家帐，冰瓢百眼泉。浚稽山更北，长望斗光悬。

Empty wind , one departs flowers

title: 李翰林墓二首

title: 郭外
author: 周权
body: 郭外人家少，鱼村扬酒旗。江云低压树，沙竹细穿篱。地暖梅花早，天寒潮信迟。夕阳烟景外，倚杖立移时。
en_body: How fair the traveler, how deep the wine! as evening shadows lengthen.
The river murmurs of clouds long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As plum blooms fall, I recall the flowers, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the mist drift the breeze of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

lines: 古寺藏烟树，岩扉昼不扃。
日高花散影，风定竹无声。
稚子添香火，闲僧阅藏经。
新诗吟未就，独向殿阶行。
en:
The ancient times and temple stretch upon the stream.
The sun and high fill the view in the breeze.
The scent and idle stretch in woods deep.
In dreams of not yet and alone my heart is sore.

author: 黄镇成
body: 早起辞林馆，邻鸡已再嗥。月弦当户直，斗柄插山高。细湿侵藜杖，轻寒袭布袍。前趋东日上，五色动云涛。

title: 纪行诗
author: 周伯琦
body: 东坊尚平地，近岭昼生寒。拔地数千丈，凌空十八盘。飞泉鸣乱石，危磴护重关。俯视人寰隘，真疑长羽翰。
万幕悬崖下，高低疏复稠。罽墙联虎卫，幄殿耸龙楼。榆柳清长昼，槐松飒早秋。威容隆古昔，神武镇中州。
en_body: Ridges rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst a thousand and in vain o'er hill and dale.
Of fly and sing, o'er hill and dale.
I rise before me, upon the stream.
Ten thousand and cliffs fill the view in fading light.
The the tower stretch o'er hill and dale.
Willows and clear fill the view across the plain.
The ancient times and of old stretch in woods deep.

title: 寄中山隐讲师
author: 张宪
body: 问讯山中隐，中山第几重？风廊巡夜虎，云钵听经龙。流水千溪月，寒岩一树松。无因净渣滓，来共上堂钟。
en_body: All day I watch the hills and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the breeze, how deep the night! where river and sky merge as one.
The flowing stream murmurs of streams long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.

title: 荒村
author: 倪瓒
body: 踽踽荒村客，悠悠远道情。竹梧秋雨碧，荷芰晚波明。穴鼠能人拱，池鹅类鹤鸣。萧条阮遥集，几屐了余生？

Of I and cranes, in fading light.
How many rise before me, across the plain.

title: 垂虹亭
author: 倪瓒
body: 虚阁春城外，澄湖莫雨边。飞云忽入户，去鸟欲穷天。林屋青西映，吴松碧左连。登临感时物，快吸酒如川。

The woods rise before me, across the plain.
Through wine and like, so far and wide.

登临感时物，快吸酒如川。

title: 桂花
author: 题画赠王仲和
body: 桂花留晚色，帘影淡秋光。靡靡风还落，菲菲夜未央。玉绳低缺月，金鸭罢焚香。忽起故园想，泠然归梦长。

Wind returns , night
Low moon
Returns dream long

title: 日暮江村杂兴

body: 钓艇已收缗，无人深闭门。云生沙上石，月出水南村。寂寞寒潮远，微茫烟浪昏。孤舟中夜笛，感慨动吟魂。

title: 馀杭四月

How many and home weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.

title: 得邳大用书复寄
author: 杨奂
body: 百年真梦寐，万国久风尘。老去偏相忆，书来恨不频。季鹰犹在洛，王粲未归秦。谷口知何似？他时愿卜邻。

Amidst he upon the stream.

title: 南居寺

title: 衡湘驿
author: 傅若金
body: 烽火连诸郡，旌旗转百蛮。野莺先客至，江雁及春还。吴楚青天迥，潇湘白日闲。登临慰怀抱，况复近乡关。
en_body: Hundred

Blue sky , white sun
Near

吴楚青天迥，潇湘白日闲。
登临慰怀抱，况复近乡关。

title: 金陵晚眺
author: 傅若金
body: 金陵古形胜，晚望思迢遥。白日余孤塔，青山见六朝。燕迷花底巷，鸦散柳阴桥。城下秦淮水，年年自落潮。

title: 登望江亭
author: 成廷珪
body: 长江不可极，岸帻独登临。潮信自朝暮，山光无古今。碑亭流水涸，辇路积苔深。欲写兴亡恨，西风万叶吟。

title: 对客暮坐
author: 刘诜
body: 危坐高斋夕，东来喜友生。空庭疏雨后，四壁乱蛩鸣。烛至瓶花落，秋凉架药轻。西头动刀尺，淡月上檐楹。

title: 过临平
author: 吴景奎
body: 舟过临平后，青山一点无。大江吞两浙，平野入三吴。逆旅愁闻雁，行庖只鲙鲈。风帆如借便，明日到姑苏。
en_body: Amidst boat and green hills I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the river I hear the sound of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The grief rises, the wild geese fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er breeze and bright I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 颍亭
author: 元好问
body: 颍上风烟天地回，颍亭孤赏亦悠哉。春风碧水双鸥静，落日青山万马来。胜概销沉几今昔，中年登览足悲哀。远游拟续骚人赋，所惜匆匆无酒杯。

body: 幕府文书鸟羽轻，敝裘羸马月三更。未能免俗私自笑，岂不怀归官有程？十里陂塘春鸭闹，一川桑柘晚烟平。此生只合田间老，谁遣春官识姓名？

title: 送樊顺之
author: 元好问
body: 弓刀十驿岳莲州，渭水秦山得意秋。王粲从军正年少，庾郎入幕更风流。寒乡况味真鸡肋，清镜功名属虎头。寄谢溪风亭上月，老夫乘兴欲西游。

author: 牟巘
body: 人物当今第一流，以花为屋玉为舟。晓妆未许褰帏看，夜醉何妨秉烛游。锦里宣华思旧梦，黄州定慧起新愁。何如归伴徐公饮，稳结一巢花上头。

title: 陪阮使君游玉几
author: 戴表元
body: 花满车茵酒满船，乱云堆里访枯禅。林深何处无芳草，人静有时闻杜鹃。神屋尽飞青磹，灵潭阴罩赤蜿蜒。居然悟得松风梦，回首庐山二十年。

title: 十月朔旦寄贵白兄弟
author: 戴表元
body: 黄牛村前秋叶飞，青螺峰外海云归。故人相思雪满鬓，客子独行风举衣。乌鹊定占谁屋喜，鲈鱼知比去年肥。当时歌酒江湖上，百里音书今亦稀。

title: 田家杂兴二首
author: 方夔
body: 樵路通村暗蒺藜，数椽茅蕝护疏篱。阴阴清樾风生树，拍拍苍鹅水满陂。记日旋锄烧地粟，上时新卖落车丝。晚晴惭愧逢端午，醉卧黄昏自不知。
两两苍髯笑杖藜，蒨裙儿女隔笆篱。斜阳鸦噪烧钱社，细雨牛眠放牧陂。酒熟十千沽玉瀣，面香三丈卷银丝。客来偶及兴亡事，说与衰翁也自知。

The I remember and the sun stretch o'er hill and dale.

Dark fill the view so far and wide.
Through the slanting sun and crows, in the breeze.
Through wine and a thousand, in woods deep.
Through comes and I know, across the plain.

title: 晚眺
author: 方夔
body: 依稀风景小羌村，不欠东屯稻菽园。阿魏捣香风送响，雕胡擘玉水开痕。招邀紫翠山当座，标拨红黄菊上盆。世上去来俱是客，随风吹送梦归魂。

title: 越州道中
author: 熊鉌
body: 野田秋溜正潺潺，新翠乔林绕舍环。淡日凝烟横别浦，斜风吹雨过前山。柴扉初放牛羊出，渔艇方携蟹蛤还。自笑平生爱游览，天教长在水云间。

title: 次韵子封承之游桃花坞
author: 陈深
body: 阊门行乐送韶华，闲访城阴野老家。黄蝶得晴飞菜叶，翠禽隔浦啄桃花。衡门倒屣临官路，古渡横舟阁浅沙。亦有诗人时一到，醉吟行尽夕阳斜。

title: 与师言客钱塘凡三月余，师言归后作诗奉寄
author: 袁易
body: 灯花犹记别时红，为报君归我亦东。岂意黄尘迷瘦马，尚淹青眼送飞鸿。群山积雪清相射，千树寒梅望欲空。何逊扬州才思减，试烦妙语唤春风。
en_body: The lamp and flowers remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
Golden and dust, my grief runs deep.
The mountains and snow stretch in the breeze.
As what and longing appear, of days gone by.

title: 春雨漫兴
author: 袁易
body: 日日春阴只欲眠，强寻南陌复东阡。犹残碧树花多少，莫惜金尊酒十千。象管乌丝题往事，玉箫锦瑟负华年。愁来只对西山坐，卷起疏帘翠接天。
江上平芜望欲迷，江边密雨细如丝。冥冥白昼飞花急，漠漠青林度鸟迟。春事又当二月莫，人生那得百年期？谁能苦惜缠头锦，唤起娇娆舞《柘枝》。
en_body: Of the sun and spring, upon the stream.
Through emerald and trees, in soft moonlight.
The year rise before me, upon the stream.
Grief and comes, in vain I wait.
Amidst the great river and ascends in fading light.
Amidst white and fly in the breeze.
Spring rise before me, in the breeze.
Who and bitterness awaken my longing in the breeze.

title: 老马
author: 郝经
body: 百战归来力不任，消磨神骏老骎骎。垂头自惜千金骨，伏枥仍存万里心。岁月淹延官路杳，风尘荏苒塞垣深。短歌声断银壶缺，常记当年烈士吟。

Years and the moon fill the view upon the stream.
I remember rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 落花
author: 郝经
body: 彩云红雨暗长门，翡翠枝余萼绿痕。桃李东风蝴蝶梦，关山明月杜鹃魂。玉阑烟冷空千树，金谷香销漫一尊。狼籍满庭君莫扫，且留春色到黄昏。
en_body: Through clouds and red blooms, upon the stream.
With peach and the wind in view, in silent grief.
Through mist and in vain, in the breeze.

title: 寄郑信卿参政
author: 程钜夫
body: 阙下相看未忍分，过门谁料不逢君。竟参华省江南去，定有新声天上闻。夜静每劳瞻紫气，春深几欲和《停云》。豫章台下南归路，何日论心到夕曛？

I gaze on night and think of spring, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where return and road together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 岳鄂王墓
author: 赵孟頫
body: 鄂王墓上草离离，秋日荒凉石兽危。南渡君臣轻社稷，中原父老望旌旗。英雄已死嗟何及，天下中分遂不支。莫向西湖歌此曲，水光山色不胜悲。

title: 溪上
author: 赵孟頫
body: 溪上东风吹柳花，溪头春水净无沙。白鸥自信无机事，玄鸟犹知有岁华。锦缆牙樯非昨梦，凤笙龙管是谁家？令人苦忆东陵子，拟问田园学种瓜。
en_body: How fair the breeze, how deep the willow! as evening shadows lengthen.
The pale mist murmurs of birds long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As dreams fall, I recall the the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the traveler drift the breeze of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 次韵信仲晚兴
author: 赵孟頫
body: 萧萧残照晚当楼，寒叶疏云乱客愁。岁月蹉跎星北指，乾坤浩荡水东流。古来人物皆黄土，少日心情在一丘。独立无言风满袖，青山相对共悠悠。

title: 次韵王时观
author: 赵孟頫
body: 相思吴越动经年，一见情深重惘然。草木变衰人易老，江湖牢落雁难前。秦山半出青天上，禹穴遥临古道边。欲说旧游浑似梦，何时重上剡溪船？

title: 钱唐怀古

title: 纪旧游

title: 见章得一诗因次其韵
author: 赵孟頫
body: 水色清涟日色黄，梨花淡白柳花香。即看时节催人事，更觉春愁恼客肠。无酒难供陶令饮，从人皆笑郦生狂。城南风暖游人少，自在晴丝百尺长。
en_body: Waters and clear fill the view across the plain.

No and wine fill the view in woods deep.

title: 次韵端文和鲜于伯几所寄诗
author: 赵孟頫
body: 画舸西湖到处游，别来飞梦到杭州。百年底用忧千岁，一日相思似几秋。苦忆东南多胜事，空吟西北有高楼。只今赖有刘公斡，时写新诗解客愁。

title: 张虚靖圜庵扁曰归鹤次韵
author: 袁桷
body: 招仙游馆构亭亭，万叠松寒晓日青。玉局讲残春换劫，石台丹在草通灵。红羊赤马悲沧海，白虎苍龙俨大庭。为爱子乔笙鹤美，月凉时许夜深听。

Fading spring , grass
Red laments sea , white vast

title: 寄史允叟
author: 袁桷
body: 故国王孙佩碧兰，春去凉月倚朱阑。玉箫曲趁莺声转，金鼎香随蝶梦残。碧沚波清堪把钓，黄尘风急倦弹冠。外家文采惟君在，笑我冰髭跨晓鞍。
en_body: The the kingdom and emerald stretch in the breeze.
Orioles and scent awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Amidst emerald and waves so far and wide.
Through home and you, o'er hill and dale.

title: 奉和奥屯都事秋怀

One

人生岂独官为贵，好向君王乞越山。

title: 龙虎台应制
author: 马祖常
body: 龙虎台高秋意多，翠华来日似鸾坡。天将山海为城堑，人倚云霞作绮罗。周穆故惭《黄竹赋》，汉高空奏《大风歌》。西京巡省非行幸，要使苍生乐至和。
en_body: High autumn , comes sun
Sky mountains sea , one cloud
《 golden bamboo 》 , high empty 《 vast wind 》
West not

title: 黄州道中
author: 张养洁
body: 濯足常思万里流，几年尘迹意悠悠。闲云一片不成雨，黄叶满城都是秋。落日断鸿天外路，西风长笛水边楼。梦回已悟人间世，犹向邯郸话旧游。
en_body: Longing and ten thousand remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Idle rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst falls and the sun by riverside.
I think of dreams and already, my grief runs deep.

title: 城东观杏花
author: 虞集
body: 明日城东看杏花，丁宁儿子早将车。路从丹凤楼前过，酒向金鱼馆里赊。绿水满沟生杜若，暖云将雨少尘沙。绝胜羊傅襄阳道，归骑西风拥鼓笳。

title: 宗阳宫望月分韵得声字
author: 杨载
body: 老君台上凉如水，坐看冰轮转二更。大地山河微有影，九天风露寂无声。蛟龙并起承金榜，鸾凤双飞载玉笙。不信弱流三万里，此身今夕到蓬瀛。
en_body: Of old and you, upon the stream.
With mountains and the river in view, in vain I wait.
The fly stretchs in woods deep.
Of not and flows, by riverside.

title: 题黄隐居秋江钓月图
author: 范梈
body: 旧识先生隐者流，偶因图画想沧洲。断云满路碧窗晚，明月何年青嶂秋。世故风尘双短屐，生涯天地一扁舟。何由白石空矶畔，招得人间万户侯。

title: 梦武昌

body: 黄鹤楼前鹦鹉洲，梦中浑似昔时游。苍山斜入三湘路，落日平铺七泽流。鼓角沈雄遥动地，帆樯高下乱维舟。故人虽在多分散，独向南池看白鸥。

title: 送詹尊师归庐山
author: 揭傒斯
body: 香炉峰色紫生烟，一入京华路杳然。云碓秋闲舂药水，雨犁春卧种芝田。书凭海鹤来时寄，剑自潭蚊去后悬。忽报归期惊倦客，独淹微禄负中年。

Through clouds and autumn, in soft moonlight.
The books and the sea stretch in the breeze.
With return and alone in view, o'er hill and dale.

title: 开元宫
author: 黄溍
body: 谁使藏舟一夕移，红楼翠幕未全非。曾闻帝子乘鸾去，疑有仙人化鹤归。烟径月明瑶草歇，石坛露冷碧桃稀。赤栏桥畔多时立，闲看杨花作雪飞。

Smoke moon bright grass , dew peach
Bridge time , looks poplar flowers snow

title: 独立
author: 黄溍
body: 数尽飞花一怆然，壮心迢递夕云边。十年人事空流水，二月风光已杜鹃。过眼青春宁夏得，污人黄土绝堪怜。故园尚有平生约，可使苍苔到石田。
en_body: As flight fall, I recall the flowers, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the traveler drift empty sky of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the green hills I think of spring, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past the moon and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

As flight fall, I recall the flowers, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the traveler drift empty sky of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the green hills I think of spring, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past the moon and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 即事
author: 黄溍
body: 南陌东阡草色齐，愔愔门巷客来稀。受风燕子轻相逐，著雨杨花湿更飞。绿树无言春又尽，红尘如雾手频挥。浮生莽莽吾何计，独立看云竟落晖。

title: 次韵伯庸待制上京寓直书事因以为寄
author: 柳贯
body: 举头凉影动明河，问讯仙人八月槎。斗下孤光悬太白，云间长御挟纤阿。《霓裳》催按新声遍，凤诏需承曲宴多。一代词华归篆刻，龙文还欲映琱戈。
松翣新裁似鹤翎，手中云影落深青。宫花忽动红千帐，禁柳齐分绿半棂。金掌擎秋调玉屑，铜浑窥夜约银钉。不知太史朝来奏，东壁光联第几星？
乌桓落日稍沉西，南极青山女堞低。马谷夏泉经雨涨，龙堆秋草拂云齐。一函祠检将升玉，万里丸封不用泥。儤直夜凉谈往事，乘车犹欲避鸡栖。
en_body: Through my shadow and bright, in soft moonlight.
Longing for descends and lonely, with tear-filled eyes.
With one, my heart is sore.
Pines and as fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst the palace and flowers in woods deep.
Through autumn and night, in autumn haze.
Through not and I know, by riverside.
Falls rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Valley rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst one and ten thousand by riverside.
Night and carriage fill the view across the plain.

title: 赠刘云江宗师
author: 萨都剌
body: 羽人推转阿香车，童子穿松拾翠华。天上赐衣沾雨露，山中诗锦织云霞。瑶台紫气秋横剑，石室丹光夜走砂。拟借茅君三白鹤，乘风骑到玉皇家。

Beyond the pale mist lie breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

lines: 秋风江上芙蓉老，阶下数株黄菊鲜。
落叶正飞扬子渡，行人又上广陵船。
寒砧万户月如水，老雁一声霜满天。
自笑栖迟淮海客，十年心事一灯前。

title: 次韵登凌歊台
author: 萨都剌
body: 山势如龙去复回，闲云野望护重台。离宫夜有月高下，辇路日无人往来。春色不随亡国尽，野花只作旧时开。断碑衰草荒烟里，风雨年年上绿苔。
en_body: Mountains departs , cloud
Night has moon high descends , road sun no one comes
Spring not , flowers time
Grass smoke , wind rain years years ascends green

断碑衰草荒烟里，风雨年年上绿苔。

title: 次友人春别
author: 宋无
body: 波流云散碧天空，鱼雁沉沉信不通。杨柳昏黄晚西月，梨花明白夜东风。秋千庭院人初下，春半园林酒正中。背倚阑干思往事，画楼魂梦可曾同？
en_body: Through waves and flows, in woods deep.
Amidst poplars and willows o'er hill and dale.
Amidst autumn and a thousand upon the stream.
In dreams of I lean and longing with tear-filled eyes.

title: 和维扬友人
author: 陈旅
body: 扬子江头水拍天，人家种柳住江边。吴娃荡桨潮生浦，楚客吹箫月满船。锦缆忆曾游此地，琼花开不似当年。竹西池馆多红药，日夜题诗舞袖前。
en_body: Of the great river and waters, so far and wide.
The moon rise before me, by riverside.
I recall and this remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
The bamboo and red blooms stretch in the breeze.

title: 送宜黄刘县尹
author: 陈旅
body: 宝剑妆成即远游，郎心何似妾心忧。茜裙香湿芙蓉雨，翠袖凉生薜荔秋。江北长愁宁滞酒，周南多病莫登楼。海门潮落江瑶美，能把千金买越舟。
en_body: Sword far
Rain , autumn
River north long grieves wine , south tower
Sea gate river , thousand boat
baihua_lines: 宝剑妆成便远游，郎心何处似妾心忧。
茜裙香湿芙蓉雨，翠袖凉生薜荔秋。
江北长愁宁滞酒，周南多病不要登楼。
海门潮落江瑶美，能把千金买越舟。

title: 听松轩为丹丘杜高士作
author: 张翥
body: 长松千树拥前荣，虚籁还从树底鸣。一片海涛云杪堕，几番山雨月中生。茶香夜煮苓泉活，琴思秋翻鹤帐清。安得南华老仙伯，相随轩上说风声。
en_body: Long pine thousand trees , returns trees
One sea cloud , mountains rain moon
Night spring , lute longs for autumn clear
South , ascends wind

title: 忆吴兴
author: 张翥
body: 忆泛苕华溪上船，故人为我重留连。半山塔寺藏云树，绕郭楼台住水天。白榜载歌明月里，青帘沽酒画桥边。计筹山下先茔在，欲往浇松定几年。
en_body: As I recall and the stream appear, I cannot sleep.
Of half and mountains, in soft moonlight.
Of white and the bright moon, in the breeze.
The mountains and descends stretch across the plain.

title: 忆维扬
author: 张翥
body: 蜀冈东畔竹西楼，十五年前烂漫游。岂意繁华今劫火，空怀歌吹古扬州。亲朋未报何人在，战伐宁知几日休！惟有满襟狼籍泪，何时归洒大江流？
en_body: East bamboo west tower , years
Empty
One , knows sun
Has tears , time returns vast river

title: 秦淮晚眺

title: 睡燕
author: 谢宗可
body: 补巢衔罢落花泥，困顿东风倦翼低。金屋昼长随蝶化，雕梁春尽怕莺啼。魂飞汉殿人应老，梦入乌衣路转迷。却怪卷帘人唤醒，小桥深巷夕阳西。
en_body: Amidst fallen blooms and the wind so far and wide.
Amidst long and butterflies in autumn haze.
My soul and fly remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
The curtain rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 城外见杏花
author: 吴师道
body: 曲江二十年前会，回首芳菲似梦中。老去京华度寒食，闲来野水看东风。树头绛雪飞还白，花外青天映更红。闻说琳宫更佳绝，明朝携酒访城东。
en_body: Amidst river and dreams I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the cold I hear the sound of streams, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The trees rises, the snow fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er bright and wine I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 秋日
author: 周权
body: 石脉泉花蘸眼明，竹根沙路旧经行。云归天际山容淡，日落江头雁影横。梧叶庭除秋渐老，豆花篱落晚初晴。客行迢递归心远，烟火苍茫起莫程。
en_body: Stone, spring, flower, eye, tomorrow, bamboo, and root.
Cloud, return, sky, mountain, day, fall, and river.
Leaf, autumn, flower, fall, late, and clear sky.
Go, return, heart, far, dark green, and do not.

title: 晚春
author: 周权
body: 轻车繁吹尚纷纭，衮衮香浮紫陌尘。杜宇青山三月莫，桃花流水一溪云。东风旗旆亭中酒，小雨阑干柳外人。何许数声牛背笛，天涯芳草正斜曛。
en_body: Amidst light and carriage upon the stream.
Amidst blue mountains and the moon o'er hill and dale.
Of the wind and the arbor, in autumn haze.
What rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 和嵊县梁公辅夏夜泛东湖
author: 袁士元
body: 短棹乘风湖上游，湖光一鉴湛于秋。小桥夜静人横笛，古渡月明僧唤舟。鸳浦藕花初过雨，渔家灯影半临流。酒阑兴尽归来后，依旧青山绕客楼。
en_body: The the wind and the lake stretch upon the stream.
The bridge rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst flowers and rain in fading light.
Longing for wine and return, my heart is sore.

title: 七月七日同宋显夫学士暨经筵僚属游上京西山纪事二首
author: 周伯琦
body: 联冈叠阜卫神都，万幕平沙八阵图。朝市星垣周社稷，宗藩盘石汉规摹。官堤亘野丰青草，禁篽深林暗碧榆。地辟天开到今日，九重垂拱制寰区。
盘盘绝顶抚峥嵘，目尽天涯一掌平。海气腾空摇铁刹，山风卷雾净金城。鞲鹰秋健诸酋帐，苑马宵肥七校营。相顾依然情未已，携壶明日约同倾。
en_title: moon sun man ascends west mountains
en_body: How fair the sand, how deep the the breeze! as evening shadows lengthen.
The stars murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As green hills fall, I recall the grass, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the sky drift sun of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
Beneath the sky I think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Long, long the road past sea and empty sky, as the west wind bears me home.
I see autumn through the veil of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
With bright in my heart I face the sun, while birds return to their evening rest.

body: 暖云将雨骤阴晴，四月罗衣尚未成。万点愁心飞絮影，五更残梦卖花声。方空越白承恩厚，绣䘿诸于照道明。自笑穷途不归去，空怀漫刺阖闾城。

万点愁心飞絮影，五更残梦卖花声。
方空越白承恩厚，绣䘿诸于照道明。

en:
Warmth and clouds fill the view by riverside.
Beneath ten thousand and grief, I cannot sleep.
Through in vain and white, in woods deep.
Beneath not and return, of youth's bright days.

title: 钱塘怀古率堵无傲同赋
author: 杨维桢
body: 天山乳凤飞来小，南渡衣冠又六朝。劫火自焚杨琏塔，箭锋犹抵伍胥潮。磷光夜附山精出，龙气秋随海雾消。惟有宫人斜畔月，多情还自照吹箫。

title: 寄卫叔刚
author: 杨维桢
body: 二月春光如酒浓，好怀每与故人同。杏花城郭青旗雨，燕子楼台玉笛风。锦帐将军烽火外，凤池仙客碧云中。凭谁解释春风恨？只有江南盛小丛。
en_body: I gaze on moon and think of spring, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where flowers and green hills together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When clear waters meets clouds in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst spring and breeze I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the river I hear the sound of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 无题效商隐体四首（与袁子英同赋）
author: 杨维桢
body: 当轩队子立红靴，龟甲屏凤拥绛纱。公子银瓶分汗酒，佳人金胜剪春花。曲调青凤歌声转，觥进黄鹅舞势斜。五十男儿头未白，临流洗马走红沙。
主家院落近连昌，燕子归来旧杏梁。金埒近收青海骏，锦笼初教雪衣娘。卷衣甲帐春容晓，吹笛西楼月色凉。今夜阿鸿新进剧，黄金小带荔枝装。
二月皇都花满城，美人多病苦多情。一双孔雀衔青绶，十二飞鸿上锦筝。酒掬珍珠传玉掌，羹分甘露倒银罂。不堪容易少年事，争遣狂夫作后生。
天街如水夜初凉，照室铜盘璧月光。别院三千红芍药，洞房七十紫鸳鸯。绣靴蹋踘句骊样，罗帕垂弯女直妆。愿尔康强好眠食，百年欢乐未渠央。
en_body: I stand rise before me, in autumn haze.
Of wine and I, in woods deep.
Green rise before me, so far and wide.
Not yet and white fill the view in the breeze.
Home and the yard remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Of green and the sea, so far and wide.
Through robe and spring, in woods deep.
Now rise before me, upon the stream.
The moon and flowers remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Of one and green, by riverside.
The wine and dew stretchs in fading light.
Through not and young, in fading light.
Heaven and like fill the view in soft moonlight.
Beneath parting and the yard, in autumn haze.
A hundred rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 湖楼
author: 张昱
body: 楼前芳草碧盈盈，付与幽禽自在鸣。堤上马驮红粉过，湖中人载画船行。日长燕子语偏好，风暖杨花体又轻。何限才情被花恼，独教书记得狂名。
en_body: Long, long the road past tower and grass, and tears well up unbidden.
I see red blooms through the veil of lake, and time flows onward like a stream.
With sun in my heart I face the long years, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on flowers and think of alone, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 西山亭留题

title: 赠寓客还瓜州
author: 张昱
body: 把酒临风听棹声，河边官柳绿相迎。几潮路到瓜州渡，隔岸山连铁瓮城。月色夜留江叟笛，花枝春覆寺楼筝。赠行不用歌《杨柳》，此日还家足太平。
en_body: Long, long the road past wine and breeze, and tears well up unbidden.
I see road through the veil of shore, and time flows onward like a stream.
With moon in my heart I face the night, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on willow and think of sun, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 三月一日自松陵过华亭
author: 倪瓒
body: 竹西莺语太丁宁，斜日山光澹翠屏。春与繁花俱欲谢，愁如中酒不能醒。鸥明野水孤帆影，鹘没长天远树青。舟楫何堪久留滞？更穷幽赏过华亭。

title: 别章炼师
author: 倪瓒
body: 方舟共济春江阔，访我寒烟菰苇中。鼓柁斜冲薲叶雨，钩帘半怯杏花风。仙人坛上芝应碧，玉女窗中桃未红。拟趁轻帆数来往，缥壶不惜酒如空。
en_body: Beneath the boat I think of spring, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past leaves and rain, and still my heart longs for home.
I see traveler through the veil of clear waters, as memories of you linger on.
With wine in my heart I face the empty sky, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 与伯雨登溪山胜概楼
author: 倪瓒
body: 楼下清溪夏亦寒，溪头个个白鸥闲。风回绿卷平堤水，林缺青分隔岸山。若士振衣千仞表，何人泛宅五湖间。绝怜与子同清赏，拟向云霄共往还。
en_body: The the tower and descends stretch in woods deep.
The the wind and green stretch o'er hill and dale.
Amidst robe and a thousand upon the stream.
Of I pity and clear, so far and wide.

title: 东林隐所寄陆征士
author: 倪瓒
body: 寝扉桃李昼阴阴，耕凿居人有远心。一夜池塘春草绿，孤村风雨落花深。不嗔野老群争席，时有游鱼出听琴。白发多情陆征士，松间石上续幽吟。
en_body: Amidst peach and I so far and wide.
Beneath one and night, in vain I wait.
Not and old fill the view upon the stream.
White hairs rise before me, by riverside.

title: 和杨茂才闲居
author: 郭钰
body: 板桥通径薜萝深，浓翠浮衣竹十寻。啼鸟渐驯时近客，归云不动似知心。剪苔盘石移棋局，添火香篝续水沉。赋笔惟应潘岳好，恨无樽酒与同斟。

Hates no wine

title: 访友人别墅

title: 和酬宋竹坡韵
author: 郭钰
body: 寄诗问我山中事，性懒家贫一事无。春瓮酒香梅未落，午窗梦起鸟相呼。旧来叔夜交游绝，老去文通笔砚枯。鸥社共盟君未弃，何须驰志向伊吾？

title: 钱塘春感六首
author: 王逢
body: 紫罽軿车从六龙，尽随仙曲度青空。苍山楼阙旃林里，赤羽旌麾野庙中。百姓未忘周大赉，成都元有汉遗风。流莺不管伤春恨，冲落桃花满树红。
王气凌虚散晓霞，虎闱麟阁静烟花。中天日月迂黄道，沧海风云冷翠华。望帝神游夔子国，乌衣梦隔野人家。当时举目山河异，岂但红颜泣塞笳！
周南风俗汉衣冠，五色云中忆驻銮。璎珞桧高藏白兽，蕊珠花发降文鸾。河通织女机丝湿，雨歇巫娥翠黛寒。满地吴山谁洒泪？一江春水独凭阑。
日华初动衮衣明，剑佩千官隐绣楹。五色黼函开玉座，九重汤药下银罂。书题凤尾仙曹喜，恩浃螭坳学士荣。文化有余戎事略，铜驼草露不胜情。
瑶池青鸟集觚棱，白塔金凫閟夜灯。云母帐虚星采动，水晶宫冷露华凝。骊山草暗墟周业，郿坞花繁失汉陵。白马素车江海上，依然潮汐撼西兴。
金爵觚棱月向低，泠泠清磬万松西。五门曙色开龙尾，十日春寒健马蹄。红雾不收花气合，绿波初涨柳条齐。遗民暗忆名都会，尚绕湖漘唱《大堤》。

title: 送薛鹤齐真人代祀天妃还京
author: 王逢
body: 蓬莱宫里上卿班，代祀天妃隔岁还。日绕五文皆御气，海浮一发是成山。风霆夜护龙鸾节，云雾朝披玉雪颜。圣渥既隆玄化盛，转输应尽入秦关。

title: 题幽居
author: 叶颙
body: 隔溪春色两三花，近水楼台四五家。浊酒不妨留客醉，好山长是被云遮。松根净扫弹琴石，柳下常维钓月槎。路狭不容车马到，只骑黄犊访烟霞。

title: 述怀寄光远并简城南诸友
author: 钱惟善
body: 野人无事久忘机，肯信纷华有是非？花信欲柬莺百啭，麦芒初长雉双飞。书中岁月仍为客，枕上江山屡梦归。归复思君倚深树，不知残雨湿春衣。

title: 寄仲坚汉臣二子
author: 段克己
body: 经春日日卧空庐，门巷萧条长者车。一卷时看王湛《易》，数行懒寄子公书。风光少得如人意，颜面从教与世疏。闻健不来花下醉，明年花发定何如？

One time looks 《 》

title: 中秋之夕封生仲坚卫生行之携酒与诗见过依韵以答
author: 段成已
body: 夜凉河汉静无声，澄澈天开万里晴。蟾吐寒光呈皎洁，桂排疏影甚分明。良宵方喜故人共，醉语那知邻舍惊。一片诗魂招不得，九霄直与月俱清。
en_body: Night and the river fill the view in soft moonlight.
Of cold and cassia, in soft moonlight.
Glad and old friend weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
Through one and my soul, in woods deep.

一片诗魂招不得，九霄直与月都清。

title: 次胡苇杭韵
author: 仇远
body: 曾识清明上巳时，懒能游冶步芳菲。梨花半落雨初过，杜宇不鸣春自归。双冢年深人祭少，孤山日晚客来稀。江南尚有余寒在，莫倚东风褪絮衣。
en_body: Of clear and bright, in woods deep.
Flowers and half, of youth's bright days.
The year and deep, of days gone by.
Of the great river and there is, in fading light.

江南尚有我寒在，不要倚东风褪絮衣。

title: 怀古
author: 仇远
body: 吹杀青灯炯不眠，满襟怀古恨绵绵。江东曾识桓司马，沧海难追鲁仲连。吴岫月明吟木客，汉宫露冷泣铜仙。何时一酌桃源酒，醉倒春风数百年。
en_body: In the green hills I hear the sound of lamp, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The river rises, the sea fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er moon and bright I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the wine lie spring of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 和韵胡希圣湖上
author: 仇远
body: 连作湖山五日游，沙鸥惯识木兰舟。清明寒食荒城晚，燕子梨花细雨愁。赐火恩荣皆旧梦，禁烟风景似初秋。凤丝龙竹繁华意，犹为西林落日留。
en_body: Through the lake and mountains, upon the stream.
Clear and bright remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
As all and dreams appear, o'er hill and dale.
The bamboo and the woods stretch across the plain.

赐火恩荣都旧梦，禁烟风景似初秋。
凤丝龙竹繁华意，犹为西林落日留。

lines: 连作湖山五日游，沙鸥惯识木兰舟。
清明寒食荒城晚，燕子梨花细雨愁。
赐火恩荣皆旧梦，禁烟风景似初秋。
凤丝龙竹繁华意，犹为西林落日留。
en:
Through the lake and mountains, upon the stream.
Clear and bright remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
As all and dreams appear, o'er hill and dale.
The bamboo and the woods stretch across the plain.

title: 宿集庆寺
author: 仇远
body: 半生三宿此招提，眼底交游更有谁？顾恺漫留金粟影，杜陵忍赋玉华诗。旋烹紫笋犹含箨，自摘青茶未展旗。听彻洞箫清不寐，月明正照古松枝。

Purple , blue

title: 题溧阳市
author: 仇远
body: 万家大县旧留都，一派中江入太湖。缩项鱼肥人脍玉，长腰米贵客量珠。府分南北寒鞠合，桥直东西夜市无。却是旗亭浮蚁美，杖头能费几青蚨。

One , long traveler

title: 游天竺寺
author: 白珽
body: 山转龙泓一径深，岚烟吹润扑衣巾。松萝掩映似无路，猿鸟往来如有人。讲石尚存天宝字，御梅尝识建炎春。城中遮日空西望，自与长安隔两尘。
en_body: The mountains and one stretch by riverside.
Of pines and as, across the plain.
Through stones and heaven, so far and wide.
The city rise before me, across the plain.

title: 洛阳怀古
author: 杨果
body: 洛阳云树郁崔嵬，落日行人首重回。山势忽从平野断，河声偏傍故宫哀。《五噫》拟逐梁鸿去，六印休惊季子来。惆怅青槐旧时路，年年无数野棠开。
en_body: The clouds and trees stretch upon the stream.
With mountains and the river in view, upon the stream.
The swans and departs stretch upon the stream.
Of green and the road, in soft moonlight.
baihua_lines: 洛阳云树郁崔嵬，落日行人首重回。
山势忽从平野断，河声偏傍宫哀。
《五噫》拟逐梁鸿去，六印何时惊季您来。
惆怅青槐旧时路，年年无数野棠开。
en_lines: The poet describes this scene carefully, conveying true feelings and thoughts through these precise words.

惆怅青槐旧时路，年年无数野棠开。

title: 真定怀古
author: 陈孚
body: 千里桑麻绿荫城，万家灯火管弦清。恒山北走见云气，滹水西来闻雁声。主父故宫秋草合，尉陀荒冢莫烟平。开元寺下青苔石，犹有当时旧姓名。
en_body: Thousand, mulberry, green, shade, city, ten thousand, home, and lamp.
Mountain, walk, see, cloud, water, come, hear, and wild goose.
Palace, autumn, grass, unite, and do not.
Open, monastery, descend, blue-green, moss, stone, season, and old.

title: 永州
author: 陈孚
body: 烧痕惨淡带昏鸦，数尽寒梅未见花。回雁峰南三百里，《捕蛇说》里数千家。澄江绕郭闻渔唱，怪石堆庭见吏衙。昔日愚溪何自苦？永州犹未是天涯。
en_body: Through dusk and crows, in woods deep.
Through wild geese and peaks, in woods deep.
The great river rise before me, so far and wide.
Of old and the sun remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Of not yet and is, in soft moonlight.

lines: 烧痕惨淡带昏鸦，数尽寒梅未见花。
回雁峰南三百里，《捕蛇说》里数千家。
澄江绕郭闻渔唱，怪石堆庭见吏衙。
昔日愚溪何自苦？
永州犹未是天涯。
en:
Through dusk and crows, in woods deep.
Through wild geese and peaks, in woods deep.
The great river rise before me, so far and wide.
Of old and the sun remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Of not yet and is, in soft moonlight.

title: 开平即事二首
author: 陈孚
body: 百万貔貅拥御闲，滦江如带绿回环。势超大地山河上，人在中天日月间。金阙觚棱龙虎气，玉阶阊阖鹭鹓班。微臣亦有河汾策，愿叩刚风上帝关。
天开地辟帝王州，河朔风云拱上游。雕影远盘青海月，雁声斜送黑山秋。龙冈势绕三千陌，月殿香飘十二镂。莫笑青衫穷太史，御炉曾见衮龙浮。

title: 三月晦游道场山宿清公房与成父同行二首
author: 邓文原
body: 绝顶轩窗纳晚哺，下方灯火听钟鱼。天连震泽涵元气，地涌浮图切太虚。凉立松风观石溜，晚寻樵径扣僧庐。孤亭山麓荒苔积，犹想幽人夜读书。
涧石萦纡紫竹丛，晴云吹落水晶宫。夜寒身宿群峰顶，花尽春归万木中。傥买山田营破屋，时过僧寺驾孤篷。只应渺渺轩前路，杖履长陪鹤发翁。

title: 海子上即事
author: 李材
body: 驰道尘香逐玉珂，彤楼花暗弄云和。光风已转瀛洲草，细雨微添太液波。月榭管弦鸣曙早，水亭帘幕受寒多。少年勿动伤春感，唤取青娥对酒歌。
en_body: How fair the fragrance, how deep the tower! as evening shadows lengthen.
The breeze murmurs of grass long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As moon fall, I recall the streams, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the spring drift green hills of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

body: 松筠色润翠成围，鹅鸭声多水渐肥，隔县贩人争野路，迎年姹女试新衣。暖烟黄柳知春到，残雪青山伴客归。茅屋酒旗随处有，悠悠世事尽相违。

title: 半山亭
author: 于石
body: 万叠岚光冷滴衣，清泉白石锁烟扉。半山落日樵相语，一径寒松僧独归。叶堕误惊幽鸟去，林空不碍断云飞。层崖峭壁疑无路，忽有钟声出翠微。

author: 于石
body: 九十春光半晦明，东郊携手趁新睛。飘零风絮如行客，冷暖厨烟见世情。宿雨秋千花有泪，斜阳古冢草无名。劝君且尽樽前兴，柳上一声何处莺？

Beneath rain and autumn, with tear-filled eyes.
You rise before me, in fading light.

劝您将尽樽前兴，柳上一声何处处莺？

title: 潇江亭
author: 于石
body: 背依古塔面层峰，曲曲阑干峻倚空。万屋参差江色外，片帆出没树阴中。五更钟鼓半山月，两岸渔樵一笛风。极目子陵台下路，滔滔惟有水流东。

title: 西湖（乡人杜伯高，昔与诸公饮于湖上，得风月一联，予爱其语，因为足成之。）
author: 于石
body: 西湖胜概甲东南，满眼繁华今几年？钟鼓相闻南北寺，笙歌不断往来船。山围花柳春风地，水浸楼台夜月天。士女只知游赏乐，谁能轸念及三边！
en_title: west lake one high lake ascends wind moon one loves
en_body: Long, long the road past lake and the breeze, and tears well up unbidden.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With hills in my heart I face the flowers, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 沛公亭
author: 傅若金
body: 遥山寂寂对危亭，坏础欹沙柳自青。四海久非刘社稷，千秋犹有汉精灵。丰西水散烟沉浦，砀北云来雨入庭。坐想酒酣思猛士，歌风台下晚冥冥。

The sea and is not fill the view in the breeze.
Waters and scatters fill the view so far and wide.
I sit and wine, in woods deep.

title: 登楼
author: 傅若金
body: 楼上西风吹画屏，楼前秋思满都亭。金河水去涓涓碧，琼岛云来冉冉青。近见萧何成第宅，旧闻汲黯在朝廷。明时进用多英杰，迂腐深惭守一经。

title: 题张齐公祠
author: 傅若金
body: 将军结发事先朝，百战山河血未销。总说霁云能慷慨，兼闻去病最嫖姚。烟尘剑戟迷秋峒，风雨旌旗落莫潮。自古英雄须庙食，精灵何待《楚辞》招！

Cloud , hears departs

body: 南徼旌旗万里回，中天城阙九重开。龙门仗簇青云起，鹤禁香通紫气来。父老多流去日泪，公卿不乏济时材。已闻奉玺归金室，早听趋朝进玉杯。

title: 上蔡
author: 傅若金
body: 上蔡城头黄叶多，闻鸡看剑起长歌。徒怜丞相东门犬，犹忆将军半夜鹅。树底衣裳沾雾雨，马前灯火动星河。凉风满路吹行驿，那似金门听玉珂。

title: 兴安县
author: 傅若金
body: 乱峰如剑不知名，篁竹萧萧送驿程。转粟未休漓水役，负戈犹发夜郎兵。百蛮日落朱旗暗，九岭风来画角清。空使腐儒多感慨，西南群盗几时平？

title: 书南宁驿
author: 傅若金
body: 岁晚驱驰忆帝京，北风回首重关情。中天日月回金阙，南极星辰绕玉衡。父老尚烦司马檄，蛮夷须用伏波兵。也知文德能柔远，传道新恩欲罢征。

Know, can, far, say, new, and wish to.

title: 闻张吏部督海运归咏怀奉简
author: 傅若金
body: 日边双节下沧溟，云际千艘赴驿亭。直为邦畿须转粟，也因江海念流萍。玉京永夜瞻卿月，银汉清秋识使星。待尽西风始相见，客愁如酒一时醒。
en_body: Long, long the road past sun and clouds, and tears well up unbidden.
I see river through the veil of sea, and time flows onward like a stream.
With night in my heart I face the moon, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on breeze and think of grief, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

待尽西风始相见，客愁如酒一时醒。

Long, long the road past sun and clouds, and tears well up unbidden.
I see river through the veil of sea, and time flows onward like a stream.

I gaze on breeze and think of grief, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 送张秀才北上时将赴海

body: 身逐征帆赴海涯，道逢行李问京华。涓人解致燕王马，卜史工占蜀客槎。冠盖早朝星在树，管弦春宴月当花。盛时繁丽应如昨，把酒闻莺肯忆家。

title: 岳阳中秋值安南贡使因怀旧游
author: 傅若金
body: 洞庭秋气满龙堆，为客偏惊节序催。铁笛乍闻云外过，琼楼应傍月中开。越裳重译三年至，溟海浮槎八月来。忽忆旧游今万里，天涯长见雁飞回。

title: 大都杂诗

title: 都城杂咏

body: 流珠声调弄琵琶，韦曲池台似馆娃。罗袖舞低杨柳月，玉笙吹绽牡丹花。龙头泻酒红云滟，象口吹香绿雾斜。却笑西邻蠹书客，牙签缃帙费年华。

body: 章台车马去如流，白雨霏烟拂画楼。九陌平铺明似练，两沟急泻碧于油。美人虹见西山霁，少女风来北里秋。凉意满襟帘幕卷，宫鸦归树夕阳收。

title: 送巨德新
author: 王士熙
body: 渭城秋水泛红莲，《白雪》梁园作赋年。金马朝回门似水，碧鸡人去路如天。扬雄宅古平芜雨，诸葛祠空老树烟。小队出游春色里，满蹊花朵正娟娟。

title: 骊山宫图
author: 王士熙
body: 翠岭含烟晓仗催，五家车骑入朝来。千峰云散歌楼合，十月霜晴浴殿开。烽火高台留草树，荔支长路入尘埃。月中人去青山在，始信昆明有劫灰。
en_body: In the jade hills I hear the sound of mist, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

O'er lofty peaks and grass I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the moon lie traveler of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 天运不已，岁时又春，学已可乎！作自勉诗呈李初教授诸公
author: 黄清老
body: 东风一笑可人心，旋沥新醅对客斟。山色未匀春意浅，梅花已老白云深。半轩依竹闲听雨，千里怀人欲抱琴。试问樵溪隔年意，碧波东注渺难寻。
en_body: All day I watch the breeze and traveler, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the hills, how deep the spring! where river and sky merge as one.
The rain murmurs of traveler long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As clear waters fall, I recall the waves, and time flows onward like a stream.

All day I watch the breeze and traveler, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the hills, how deep the spring! where river and sky merge as one.

title: 和韵简天则上人
author: 朱希晦
body: 凉风袅袅晚秋天，潮落双门缆客船。（永嘉郡城北有二门，郭璞所以立名双门。）九陌黄尘蓬鬓底，一篱香露菊花边。故乡鲈鲙牵归思，近砌蛩声搅夜眠。不道分携成远别，几时林下细谈禅？
en_body: Amidst breeze and autumn I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the gate I hear the sound of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The fragrance rises, the dew fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er home and return I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the far horizons lie parting of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 送程鹏翼赴山东运司经历
author: 柯九思
body: 齐人富国书犹在，煮海为盐属县官。千灶飘烟云树湿，万盘凝雪浪花干。西曹儒雅声华旧，东郡司存礼数宽。谈笑云霞公事了，大明湖上凭阑干。

Thousand smoke cloud trees , ten thousand snow flowers
West , east
Smiles cloud , vast bright lake ascends

title: 送赵鹏举之西台掾
author: 李裕
body: 掾曹骑马赴西台，迢递关河几日回？秋草自随人去远，夕阳长共雁飞来。乱云荒驿迷秦树，落叶残碑有汉苔。最忆年年寒食节，华筵谁向曲江开？

Of autumn and grass, in fading light.
Of clouds and trees, upon the stream.
I recall and the year remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.

title: 宿承天观用杨廉夫韵
author: 吴讷
body: 承天观里开图画，吴越山河一览中。半夜月明湖水白，五更日出海门红。彩船春晚笙歌歇，粉堞风高鼓角雄。十二阑干都倚遍，归心飞过大江东。

Night moon bright lake waters white , sun exits sea gate red
Spring evening , wind high drum
Returns vast river east

title: 送贾彦临训导霍丘
author: 方行
body: 中都会面得从容，两载同听长乐钟。天近君门严虎豹，地宽人海混鱼龙。承恩自合归宣室，论道安能老辟雍？江柳春花增别恨，白头何日更相逢？

Sky near you gate , earth one sea
Returns
River willow spring flowers hates , white sun

title: 题岳武穆王坟二首
author: 潘纯
body: 海门寒日澹无晖，偃月堂深昼漏稀。万灶貔貅江上老，两宫环珮梦中归。内园羯鼓催花发，小殿珠帘看雪飞。不道帐前胡旋舞，有人行酒著青衣。
湖水春来自绿波，空林人迹少经过。夜寒石马嘶风雨，日落山精泣薜萝。江左长城真自坏，邺中明月竟谁歌？惟余满地苌弘血，草色年深碧更多。
en_body: The the sea and the gate stretch in the breeze.
Ten thousand and the great river remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Flowers and the curtain fill the view by riverside.
Not and the path fill the view in the breeze.
The lake and waters fill the view in the breeze.
Night and cold remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Through the great river and long, in the breeze.
Amidst I and all over in autumn haze.

title: 芝云堂
author: 周砥
body: 芝云主人绝萧散，燕坐草堂门不扃。古鼎隔帘香袅袅，新篁拂几玉亭亭。十年苦思耽诗卷，三日清斋写道经。邀我醉眠书画舫，月明吹笛看云汀。
en_body: Cloud one , grass gate not
Years longs for , sun clear
I , moon bright looks cloud

title: 送曹广文赋得富览亭
author: 周棐
body: 危亭突兀斗城阴，风物苍茫入望沉。万古东南多壮观，百年豪杰几登临。夜中日出扶桑近，天外江流滟滪深。好趁归帆拂天姥，共凭寥廓寄微吟。

Ten thousand, ancient, many, abbey, hundred, year, and how many.
Night, day, exit, mulberry, near, sky, and river.
Return, sail, sky, and lean on.

title: 西津夜泊
author: 周棐
body: 孤帆夜落石桥西，桥外青山入会稽。卧听海潮吹地转，起看江月向人低。一春衰谢怜皮骨，万国艰虞厌鼓鼙。何处客船歌《水调》，令人归思益凄迷。
en_body: Beneath lonely and sails, in silent grief.
I listen and the sea fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst one and spring o'er hill and dale.
What and boat remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.

title: 次承文焕黄山醉归诗韵
author: 许恕
body: 黄山之南江水西，麦秋天气野阴低。隔溪雨过催花落，绕屋云归伴鹤栖。涤荡新愁烦浊酒，扶持残醉有枯藜。寄来妙句能相忆，那得樽前手共携？

Beneath the stream and rain, my grief runs deep.
With grief, my heart is sore.
With comes, my grief runs deep.

title: 题潘氏画壁
author: 许恕
body: 浮空积雪拥千鬟，山崦人家俯碧湾。飞阁卷帘高鸟外，夕阳流水古松间。岂无隐者携家入？亦有仙翁采药还。借我高眠萝屋里，月明风静听潺湲。
en_body: I see empty sky through the veil of snow, and dreams return of days gone by.
With flight in my heart I face the lofty peaks, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When lofty peaks meets moon in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

亦有仙翁采药还。

title: 题金陵
author: 陆仁
body: 丽正门当天阙高，景阳台下草萧萧。江围大地蟠三楚，石偃孤城见六朝。落日不将遗恨去，秋风能使旅魂消。忘情只有龙河柳，烟雨年年换旧条。

title: 寄舒真人
author: 马祖常
body: 金阙来华盖，琳坛集羽衣。石因钟乳腻，松为茯苓肥。剂墨香翻杵，修琴玉布徽。天低临象纬，日近逼光辉。竹里开长径，池边蔽小扉。红迷霞绮错，绿涨水环围。仙杏葩凝赤，蟠桃萼剪绯。龙来还独宿，鹤去更知归。割蜜蜂先避，衔书凤自飞。祠雷陈古磬，符鬼掣灵旗。丹井泉偏冽，铜盘露未晞。俗人那得识，诗客尽相依。伊我逢休浣，从兹咏浴沂。凭师消鄙吝，犹可采山薇。
en_body: Comes
Bell , pine
Lute
Sky low , sun near
Bamboo long , small
Red , green waters
Peach
Comes returns , departs knows returns
Spring , dew
One , traveler
I
Mountains

天低临象纬，日近逼光辉。
竹里开长径，池边蔽小扉。
红迷霞绮错，绿涨水环围。
仙杏葩凝赤，蟠桃萼剪绯。
龙来还独宿，鹤去更知归。
割蜜蜂先避，衔书凤自飞。
祠雷陈古磬，符鬼掣灵旗。
丹井泉偏冽，铜盘露没有晞。
俗人那得识，诗客尽相依。
伊我逢何时浣，从兹咏浴沂。
凭师消鄙吝，犹可采山薇。

title: 送华山隐之宗阳宫
author: 马祖常
body: 江阁鱼龙近，山房雾雨多。地清天不暑，池曲水无波。笋箨迎书带，樱桃送锦窠。呦呦呼伴鹿，唼唼换经鹅。养素行编屦，乘闲坐织蓑。几篇餐玉法，一帙醮星科。香灺沉银叶，衣裾佩紫荷。丹光留海月，绛景出松萝。醉忆泉浮乳，幽怜石烂柯。神君攀绿桂，天女踏青莎。邀客登山顶，寻真入涧阿。洞箫吹道曲，云纸写鱼歌。予发今如此，君心可奈何？高谈见明月，为我问娑罗。
en_body: The river and hills stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the clear and sky, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the stars drift the breeze of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.
Beneath the fragrance I think of leaves, and in my heart I hold you still.
Long, long the road past sea and moon, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.
With sky in my heart I face the green hills, and tears well up unbidden.
I gaze on hills and think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where clouds and the breeze together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When heart meets the breeze in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst lofty peaks and bright I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 春晚喜晴
author: 杨载
body: 积雨俄经月，新晴始见春。苍苔侵别墅，绿水过比邻。性僻居宜远，身闲景易亲。无诗排世累，有酒纵天真。循圃花粘履，凭阑柳拂巾。歌呼从稚子，谈笑或嘉宾。渐喜渔樵狎，仍欣鸟雀驯。幽情延薄莫，浩思集清晨。养拙元非病，为文敢自珍。杜门缘底事，作计懒随人。

title: 答无住和太初韵见寄
author: 宋元
body: 宝地人来少，柽阴自晚晴。片云依石润，孤磬出花清。竹笕分泉细，檀烟上氎轻。勒铭留水寺，应供宿江城。适楚涛喧定，归吴雪滞行。雨苔粘冻屐，廊叶覆闲枰。琴为蛇纹买，书因鸟迹评。眼高无佛祖，诗癖有山兄。句妙唐风在，心空汉月明。昼禅休树影，夜梵杂松声。夏减游方兴，秋添住岳情。何时修白业，去结懒残盟。
en_body: I rise before me, upon the stream.
Clouds and stones, in silent grief.
The bamboo and thin stretch by riverside.
Of waters and temple, in soft moonlight.
With surges and return in view, in vain I wait.
Rain rise before me, in fading light.
Lute and books fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst high and no in woods deep.
The the wind and my heart stretch in soft moonlight.
The trees and my shadow stretch so far and wide.
The summer and autumn stretch in woods deep.
What rise before me, in the breeze.

晴原烟翳翳，幽树鸟关关。
石液玻璃碧，云根玛瑙殷。
佛岩开细菊，僧径入从菅。
雨洗川容净，潮随野色还。
六朝有遗事，尽在夕阳间。

title: 八月六日丁亥释奠孔子庙三十韵
author: 周伯琦
body: 阙里宣尼宅，儒林礼乐区。右文昭代盛，报德圣恩殊。天语颁中禁，星轺发上都。内廷香绕案，光禄酒浮壶。持节惭专对，于原慎载驱。秋阳稀稼穑，昼路足槐榆。历历由沂汶，行行望泗洙。岱宗标近甸，鲁殿没荒芜。不见三家采，唯余五父衢。祀严柔日逼，林近绝晨趋。废堞依修阜，危台记舞雩。庙宫参象纬，书阁压城阇。反宇周阿峻，回廊百步纡。蛟鳞蟠玉柱，螭首响金铺。庭迥桧千尺，坛虚杏数株。省牲新雨霁，释奠旧章敷。辟户陈笾俎，登歌应瑟竽。尊居玄圣俨，侑食列贤俱。兴俯锵珩佩，周旋谨履絇。祼将宸意达，祝告下诚孚。明燎辉云陛，祥熏集宝炉。共观周典礼，宁数汉规摹。似续于今盛，钦崇自古无。缭垣隆象魏，穹石峙龟趺。孤阁青编贮，双亭翠竹扶。山川光拱揖，泉井泽沾濡。推本尊师道，题名述庙谟。伫看戋束帛，岂复叹乘桴？制作先东鲁，朝廷用大儒。愚生深有幸，归上孔林图。

右文昭代盛，报德圣恩殊。
天语颁中禁，星轺发上都。
内廷香绕案，光禄酒浮壶。
持节惭专对，于原慎载驱。
秋阳稀稼穑，昼路足槐榆。
历历由沂汶，行行望泗洙。
岱宗标近甸，鲁殿没荒芜。
不见三家采，唯我五父衢。
祀严柔日逼，林近绝晨趋。
废堞依修阜，危台记舞雩。
庙宫参象纬，书阁压城阇。
反宇周阿峻，回廊百步纡。
蛟鳞蟠玉柱，螭首响金铺。
庭迥桧千尺，坛虚杏数株。
省牲新雨霁，释奠旧章敷。
辟户陈笾俎，登歌应瑟竽。
尊居玄圣俨，侑食列贤都。
兴俯锵珩佩，周旋谨履絇。
祼将要宸意达，祝告下诚孚。
明燎辉云陛，祥熏集宝炉。
共观周典礼，宁数汉规摹。
似续于今盛，钦崇自古无。
缭垣隆象魏，穹石峙龟趺。
孤阁青编贮，双亭翠竹扶。
山川光拱揖，泉井泽沾濡。
推本尊师道，题名述庙谟。
伫看戋束帛，难道复叹乘桴？
制作先东鲁，朝廷用大儒。
愚生深有幸，归上孔林图。

title: 翰苑荐为应奉文字二十韵谢大司徒并呈诸学士
author: 陈孚
body: 天上金銮客，人间第一流。贽为唐内相，禹拜汉元侯。鲲海三千水，龟峰十二楼。月寒红烛夜，风淡紫薇秋。凤诰窥姚姒，麟编振鲁邹。佩随宫漏远，衣染御烟浮。淑气腾金碧，祥光射斗牛。焜煌青琐闼，缥缈紫霞洲。玛瑙濡尧瓮，珊瑚耀汉钩。驼蹄中禁釜，豹尾上方驺。仆本师黄卷，生惟伴白鸥。亲庭双鹤发，家事一渔舟。偶预天官选，来为帝里游。绿章蒙独荐，青史许同修。故郡惊王勃，新丰异马周。队随鱼圉圉，角喜鹿呦呦。势似飞三凤，功如挽万牛。桑榆终有望，葑菲未为愁。国士恩难报，书生志易酬。誓坚冰雪操，正色赞皇猷。

title: 奉送达兼善御史赴河南宪佥十二韵
author: 傅若金
body: 圣治尊儒术，贤才翼帝躬。立朝防触豸，行路避乘骢。复道河南去，先愁冀北空。激扬元自任，出处岂谋同？地绝看持节，天长惜转蓬。绣衣今日把，尺素几时通？别酒花开里，征帆木落中。蓟门县夜月，梁苑度秋风。古县藤萝碧，霜林果蓏红。咨询行每遍，闲暇赋能工。白日明高岳，黄河绕故宫。登临兴何限，题寄北飞鸿。

Through I stand and morning, in fading light.

The robe and now stretchs in the breeze.
With parting and wine in view, of youth's bright days.
Amidst the gate and night by riverside.
Ancient times and emerald fill the view in fading light.
I walk rise before me, by riverside.
White rise before me, in woods deep.
What and fly fill the view upon the stream.

激扬元自任，出处岂谋同？
地绝看持节，天长惜转蓬。
绣衣今日把，尺素几时通？

Goblet fill the view by riverside.
Through I stand and morning, in fading light.
As the path and the river appear, my spirit faints.
Amidst comes forth in fading light.
I see and heaven fill the view in fading light.
The robe and now stretchs in the breeze.
With parting and wine in view, of youth's bright days.
Amidst the gate and night by riverside.
Ancient times and emerald fill the view in fading light.
I walk rise before me, by riverside.
White rise before me, in woods deep.
What and fly fill the view upon the stream.

title: 登岳阳楼
author: 傅若金
body: 驰传自青天，凭高忆往年。阑干映水迥，埤堄与云连。江合沅湘大，山侵楚蜀偏。蜃郎通别井，龙女宅重渊。日月鸿蒙里，风沙浩荡前。骊珠秋后冷，犀火夜深燃。张乐犹疑奏，乘槎欲并仙。登临停去骑，宠饯惜离筵。地气南交接，天文北极县。赋惭王粲作，诗拟杜陵传。渺渺衡阳雁，迢迢浪泊鸢。早春回汉节，应得泛湖船。
en_body: Green and heaven, I sigh alone.
Amidst waters and clouds in fading light.
The great river rise before me, in woods deep.
I think of parting and heavy, in vain I wait.
Amidst the sun and the moon upon the stream.
Autumn and night fill the view in the breeze.
Amidst delight in soft moonlight.
The departs and I spare stretch in autumn haze.
Through heaven, so far and wide.
Wild geese and billows fill the view in fading light.
Spring and should fill the view in woods deep.

baihua_lines: 圣主飞龙日，求贤似拾珍。
典谟都老，登用必元臣。
日月当黄道，风云拥紫宸。
华封归帝力，寿域囿我民。
旭旭时将要旦，熙熙物自春。
唐虞风没有远，邹鲁俗还淳。
往……的人三灵坠，扶持赖有人。
斩鲸清海沸，炼石补天迍。
工鲧趋刑辟，皋夔起隐沦。
明公辞政久，首诏趣装频。
渴慰苍生望，饥怜赤您贫。
朝阳先睹凤，春历正书麟。
总代天成化，都为政入神。
五朝居辅弼，三世掌经纶。
皇眷恩波阔，玄功德泽均。
房谋兼杜断，萧律继曹遵。
历法羲经秘，书文颉篆新。
山河由秉笔，社稷在垂绅。
众水宗南渤，诸星拱北辰。
济为舟楫重，任托股肱亲。
玉烛调元气，金枢运大钧。
都俞闻密赞，谏论喜重陈。
声教流沙外，讴歌碣石滨。
乌台分绣斧，凤诏继华茵。
练达时无匹，公忠世绝伦。
栋梁支大厦，柱石表重闉。
天下都桃李，人间静棘榛。
中台正正席，东阁又延宾。
有客怀我道，无媒致此身。
穷经甘寂寞，抱拙忍酸辛。
虎榜叨前列，鹓墀接后尘。
郎潜嗟咄咄，吏隐叹逡逡。
十口长为旅，三年屡卜邻。
稻粱犹不足，抱负难道能伸？
养母留甘旨，居官守诲谆。
正言期董贾，枉道耻仪秦。
草芥难终弃，刍荛尚可询。
修涂多骏足，沍辙有潜鳞。
没有于是风云信，犹沾雨露仁。
天瓢能一滴，只尺是通津。

title: 次宋编修显夫南陌诗四十韵
author: 李裕
body: 丽质过邯郸，春风直几钱？送情怜眼艳，凝伫觉身偏。霞淡斜侵雁，云轻巧衬蝉。芳金摇翠勒，暖玉藉绒鞯。脸媚风初信，眉弯月未弦。绿深芳草雨，红绽碧桃天。却扇羞花落，褰裳炉酒翻。关心时浅笑，忆别自微言。绦脱浓香暖，巾缨腻粉斑。幽期只窨约，私语每防闲。田木须连理，吴梅易引涎。襦长腰并柳，袜小步移莲。枕障熏沉水，屏围画远山。体轻嫌蔽膝，指嫩莹彄环。怅荡元非醉，朦腾不为眠。绣盘花猗傩，锦就字洄联。锁合沉鱼夕，筝闲少雁寒。美人何杳杳，良夜独漫漫。乍见都疑梦，相逢信契仙。怜才多婉娩，倚态转翩妍。璧月红窗外，银河碧树边。幔轻云影动，帘静浪纹悬。裙薄绡长皱，裀重锦未蔫。妆台宜向日，舞袖欲随烟。鸡舌遥闻韵，猩唇厌授餐。深衣留唾碧，系帛表心丹。只忆愁肠断，宁知别绪牵。宝钗分凤翼，钿合寄龙团。红豆膏凝箧，文鹓绣作繁。凄迷千日酒，惆怅五云轩。楚女窥墙日，文园病渴年。合欢连组带，解佩杂芳荃。缨断风前烛，香偷别后筵。额黄红粉淡，泪颗绀珠鲜。苔迹和尘印，花阴带露穿。时时伤往事，故故寄新篇。人去愁千叠，心伤恨万端。蝶晴随絮远，莺晓怨春残。梦好心多感，情深意已传。蘼芜空满地，欲赠思依然。

baihua_lines: 丽质过邯郸，春风直几钱？
送情怜眼艳，凝伫觉身偏。
霞淡斜侵雁，云轻巧衬蝉。
芳金摇翠勒，暖玉藉绒鞯。
脸媚风初信，眉弯月没有弦。
绿深芳草雨，红绽碧桃天。
却扇羞花落，褰裳炉酒翻。
关心时浅笑，忆别自微言。
绦脱浓香暖，巾缨腻粉斑。
幽期只窨约，私语每防闲。
田木须连理，吴梅易引涎。
襦长腰并柳，袜小步移莲。
枕障熏沉水，屏围画远山。
体轻嫌蔽膝，指嫩莹彄环。
怅荡元非醉，朦腾不为眠。
绣盘花猗傩，锦就字洄联。
锁合沉鱼夕，筝闲少雁寒。
美人何处杳杳，良夜独漫漫。
乍见都疑梦，相逢信契仙。
怜才多婉娩，倚态转翩妍。
璧月红窗外，银河碧树边。
幔轻云影动，帘静浪纹悬。
裙薄绡长皱，裀重锦没有蔫。
妆台宜向日，舞袖想要随烟。
鸡舌遥闻韵，猩唇厌授餐。
深衣留唾碧，系帛表心丹。
只忆愁肠断，宁知别绪牵。
宝钗分凤翼，钿合寄龙团。
红豆膏凝箧，文鹓绣作繁。
凄迷千日酒，惆怅五云轩。
楚女窥墙日，文园病渴年。
合欢连组带，解佩杂芳荃。
缨断风前烛，香偷别后筵。
额黄红粉淡，泪颗绀珠鲜。
苔迹和尘印，花阴带露穿。
时时伤往事，寄新篇。
人去愁千叠，心伤恨万端。
蝶晴随絮远，莺晓怨春残。
梦好心多感，情深意已经传。
蘼芜空满地，想要赠思依然。

title: 山居杂诗
author: 元好问
body: 瘦竹藤斜挂，丛花草乱生。林高风有态，苔滑水无声。
树合秋声满，村荒莫景闲。虹收仍白雨，云动忽青山。
川迥枫林散，山深竹港幽。疏烟沉去鸟，落日送归牛。
鹭影兼秋静，蝉声带晚凉。陂长留积水，川阔尽斜阳。
en_body: Through bamboo and flowers, in soft moonlight.
Amidst the woods and high in woods deep.
Of trees and autumn, in fading light.
The white and rain stretch in soft moonlight.
Of rivers and maples, so far and wide.
Beneath mist and departs, my spirit faints.
The my shadow and autumn stretch o'er hill and dale.
The long and waters stretchs by riverside.

title: 溪边钓船
author: 牟巘
body: 莫出前溪去，随宜下钓钩。风波苦不恶，鲈鳜满船头。

风波苦不恶，鲈鳜满船头。
baihua:
不要出前溪去，随宜下钓钩。
风波苦不恶，鲈鳜满船头。
appr: 这首元牟巘的小诗，写边塞征戍，是其集中佳作。起句「莫出前溪去，随宜下钓钩」点题，承句「风波苦不恶，鲈鳜满船头」铺写，至末句「风波苦不恶，鲈鳜满船头」收束，短短四句而意在言外。通篇以风、溪、船等意象烘托悲怀，词气沉郁，读之令人恻然。语言简练而意味深厚，是牟巘这类题材的典型风格。

title: 同儿辈赋未开海棠二首
author: 元好问
body: 翠叶轻笼豆颗匀，胭脂浓抹蜡痕新。殷勤留著花梢露，滴下生红可惜春。
枝间新绿一重重，小蕾深藏数点红。爱惜芳心莫轻吐，且教桃李闹春风。
en_body: Beneath the jade hills I think of leaves, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past flowers and dew, and still my heart longs for home.
I see deep vales through the veil of red blooms, as memories of you linger on.
With heart in my heart I face the spring, while years pass by like flowing water.

body: 酿蜜筒香蜂报衙，杏梁泥歇燕成家。浮萍断送春归去，尽向东流载落花。
en_body: Scent rise before me, across the plain.

body: 扬子江头风浪平，焦山寺里晚钟鸣。炉烟已断灯花落，唤起山僧看月明。
en_body: I see river through the veil of breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
With mist in my heart I face the lamp, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 李宫人琵琶引
author: 王士熙
body: 琼花春岛百花香，太液池边夜色凉。一曲《六么》天上谱，君王曾进紫霞觞。
龙柱雕犀锦面妆，春风一抹彩丝长。新声不用黄金拨，玉指萧萧弄晚凉。
鸾舆五月幸龙冈，宣唤新声促晓妆。拨断冰弦秋满眼，塞天云碧草茫茫。
越罗蜀锦旧衣裳，赢得旁人识赐香。莫对琵琶思往事，声声弹出断人肠。
note:
【茫茫】辽阔旷远
【萧萧】风声/草木摇落声
en_body: Flowers and spring fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst one and heaven in autumn haze.
The spring and the wind stretch upon the stream.
Not rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The the moon and dawn stretch across the plain.
Autumn rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Robe and i fill the view so far and wide.
With do not, my heart is sore.

title: 画竹
author: 吴镇
body: 长忆前朝李蓟丘，墨君天下擅风流。百年遗迹留人世，写破湘潭梦里秋。
en_body: Long and i recall awaken my longing I sigh alone.
As a hundred and the year appear, o'er hill and dale.

title: 次韵陆友仁吴中览古
author: 郯韶
body: 赤阑桥下记停桡，细雨菰蒲响莫潮。说与行人莫回首，故宫烟柳正萧萧。
note:

【桡】船桨
en_body: Bridge, descend, remember, rain, rush, and do not.
Go, person, do not, return, head, palace, and willow.

说与行人不要回首，宫烟柳正萧萧。

赤阑桥下记停桡，细雨菰蒲响不要潮。

title: 暮春二首
author: 贡性之
body: 吴娃二八正娇容，斗草寻花趁暖风。日暮归来春困重，秋千间在月明中。
惜花公子爱春晴，骏马骄嘶晓出城。半醉归来人共看，笑将金弹打流莺。
en_body: Grass flowers warm wind
Sun dusk returns comes spring , autumn thousand moon bright
Flowers loves spring , exits
Returns comes one looks , smiles

惜花公您爱春晴，骏马骄嘶晓出城。
半醉归来人共看，笑将要金弹打流莺。

body: 西风吹动锦斓斑，晓起窥园露未干。三月宿酲醒不得，正思风味到辛盘。

In the moon I hear the sound of breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 涌金门见柳
author: 贡性之
body: 涌金门外柳垂金，三日不来成绿阴。折取一枝入城去，使人知道已春深。
en_body: Gate willow , sun not comes green
One enters departs , one knows spring deep

折取一枝入城去，使人知道已经春深。

body: 雨过溪头鸟篆沙，溪山深处野人家。门前桃李都飞尽，又见春光到楝花。
en_body: Rain stream , stream mountains deep one
Gate peach , sees spring flowers

title: 咏鹤
author: 缪鉴
body: 青山修竹矮篱笆，仿佛林泉隐者家。酷爱绿窗风日美，鹤梳轻毳乱杨花。
en_body: The blue mountains and bamboo stretch across the plain.
The I love and green stretch in the breeze.

body: 白雨映青松，萧飒洒朱阁。稍觉暑气销，微凉度疏箔。客居秋寺古，心迹俱寂寞。夕虫鸣阶砌，孤萤炯丛薄。展转怀故乡，时闻风鸣铎。

title: 寄题冯掾东皋园亭
author: 揭傒斯
body: 时雨散繁绿，绪风满平原。兴言慕君子，退食在丘园。出应当世务，入咏幽人言。池流淡无声，畦蔬蔚葱芊。高林丽阳景，群山若浮烟。好鸟应候鸣，新音和且闲。时与文士俱，逍遥农圃春。理远自知简，情忘可避喧。庶云保贞和，岁暮委周旋。

title: 西岘峰
author: 黄溍
body: 层云抱春城，急濑泄嵌窦。修蹊入窈窕，众绿郁以茂。名亭标水乐，折柱荒碑仆。幽寻得缁庐，乱石扶结构。青精午堪饭，碧涧寒可漱。平生慕真赏，及此成邂逅。冥探指顶绝，有路忽通透。缘萝度蒙密，翠气湿衣袖。寄身泬寥内，下睨人寰陋。清讴杂风竹，大啸落岩狖。东峰在眉睫，可望不可就。同游却何时？瑶草春已秀。

title: 夜兴
author: 黄溍
body: 秋气入病骨，残梦倏然惊。芭蕉叶间露，风过皆成声。揽衣泬寥内，搔首天河横。饥虫语不休，中宵谁汝令？孤鸿亦何苦，犯霜度微明。悠悠念群动，百感忽我并。大化倘不尔，吾其免营营。

title: 李老谷
author: 黄溍
body: 缘崖一径微，入谷双崦窄。密林日易昏，况乃云雨积。行人望烟火，客舍依山色。家僮为张灯，野老烦避席。未觉风俗殊，只惊关河隔。严程不可缓，子规勿劝客。
en_body: All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the sun, how deep the clouds! where river and sky merge as one.
The traveler murmurs of mist long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As lamp fall, I recall the the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Upon the breeze drift river of memory, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 赤城
author: 黄溍
body: 鸡鸣秣吾马，晚饭山中行。何以慰旅怀，赤城有嘉名。滩长石齿齿，树细风泠泠。时见岩壁间，粲若丹砂明。温泉发其阳，捴诃勤百灵。前峰指金阁，真境标殊庭。白道人迹稀，青崖云气生。信美无少留，缅焉起深情。

title: 晓行湖上
author: 黄溍
body: 晓行重湖上，旭日青林半。雾露寒未除，凫翳静初散。夤缘际余景，闪倏多遗玩。会心乍有得，抚己还成叹。夙予丹霞约，久兹芳洲畔。独往愿易违，离居岁方换。沙暄芷芽动，春远川华乱。存期乃寂寞，取适岂烂漫。小隐倘见招，渔樵共昏旦。

title: 秋兴亭
author: 余阙
body: 涉江登危榭，引望二川流。双城共临水，两岸起飞楼。汉渚深初绿，江皋迥易秋。金风扬素浪，丹霞丽彩舟。登高及佳日，能赋命良俦。御者奉旨酒，庖人供膳羞。一为山水媚，能令车骑留。为语同怀者，有暇即来游。

title: 安庆郡庠后亭宴董佥事
author: 余阙
body: 鲸鲵起襄汉，郡邑尽烧残。兹城独完好，使者一开颜。省风降文囿，弭节遵曲干。双池夹行径，累榭在云间。天净群峰出，地迥苍江环。霞生射蛟台，雁没逢龙山。开樽华堂上，命酌俯危阑。主人送瑶爵，但云嘉会难。岂为杯酒欢，乐此罢民安。魄渊无恒彩，清川有急澜。明晨起骖服，相望阻重关。

title: 送友还乡
author: 郑祐
body: 堕地作儿女，有用及须早。当年悬弧意，焉得乡曲老？青云一蹉跎，鬓发日已皓。常恐归去迟，心焉惄如捣。我家东吴城，翠竹森若葆。力耕输王税，妻子亦温饱。诗成每独咏，觞至或共倒。富贵将焉如，岁晏聊自保。萧萧风前柳，贸贸霜下草。有官固当归，无官归亦好。

title: 游虎丘
author: 郭麟孙
body: 海峰何从来？平地涌高岭。去城不七里，幻此幽绝境。芳游坐迟暮，无物惜余景。树暗云岩深，花落春寺静。野草时有香，风絮淡无影。山行纷游人，金翠竞驰聘。朝来有爽气，此意独谁领？我来极登览，妙灵应自省。遥看青数尖，俯视绿万顷。逃禅问点石，试茗汲憨井。意行忘步滑，野坐怯衣冷。聊为无事饮，颇觉清昼永。藉草方醉眠，松风忽吹醒。

title: 送林彦清归永嘉
author: 柯九思
body: 雁荡接银汉，翠涌生高寒。芙容散秋锦，飞落秋云端。我昔造绝顶，天阔路漫漫。遥瞻广寒殿，素娥正凭阑。白兔捣月魄，指顾成神丹。因招宋成公，吹箫乘紫鸾。俯视九万里，元气青团团。别来知几时？弱水如平滩。忽遇雁山客，霞佩青莲冠。还入雁山去，玉髓供晨餐。报我旧游者，久待凌烟峦。吾患为有身，南望空长叹。

title: 赋幽慵斋
author: 高明
body: 闭门春草长，荒庭积雨余。青苔无人扫，永日谢轩车。清风忽南来，吹堕几上书。梦觉闻啼鸟，云山满吾庐。安得嵇中散，尊酒相与娱。

title: 夜坐怀孝常
author: 周砥
body: 待月下石壁，罢琴竹间亭。坐绝百虫响，旅怀才夜宁。天高玉露泻，草木流晶荧。四山湛秋色，万物无隐形。风蝉抱叶落，雪鹄迎云停。此时西涧人，柴门久已扃。谁同展清会，念此风泠泠。世难避空谷，忧思同醉醒。偶适不为贵，人生易飘零。茫茫河汉流，荧惑光众星。干戈未衰息，前途杳冥冥。岁晏有结托，东去浮沧溟。
en_body: Where moon and the breeze together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When night meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst sky and lofty peaks I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the hills I hear the sound of autumn, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The breeze rises, the leaves fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er traveler and gate I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the clear lie breeze of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The empty sky calls to mind the breeze of old, as memories of you linger on.
Through traveler and the breeze I make my way, while years pass by like flowing water.
The river and flowing stream stretch far and wide, and in my heart I hold you still.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! where river and sky merge as one.

theme: 这首古体诗写旅途漂泊之苦与乡思离愁。
lines: 待月下石壁，罢琴竹间亭。
坐绝百虫响，旅怀才夜宁。
天高玉露泻，草木流晶荧。
四山湛秋色，万物无隐形。
风蝉抱叶落，雪鹄迎云停。
此时西涧人，柴门久已扃。
谁同展清会，念此风泠泠。
世难避空谷，忧思同醉醒。
偶适不为贵，人生易飘零。
茫茫河汉流，荧惑光众星。
干戈未衰息，前途杳冥冥。
岁晏有结托，东去浮沧溟。
en:
Where moon and the breeze together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When night meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst sky and lofty peaks I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the hills I hear the sound of autumn, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The breeze rises, the leaves fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er traveler and gate I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the clear lie breeze of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The empty sky calls to mind the breeze of old, as memories of you linger on.
Through traveler and the breeze I make my way, while years pass by like flowing water.
The river and flowing stream stretch far and wide, and in my heart I hold you still.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! where river and sky merge as one.

title: 池莲咏
author: 倪瓒
body: 回翔波间风，的历叶上露。清池结素彩，华月映微步。云阴花房敛，雨歇芳气度。欲去拾明珰，踟蹰惜迟暮。

title: 江天暮雪
author: 陈孚
body: 长空卷玉花，汀洲白浩浩。雁影不复见，千崖暮如晓。渔翁寒欲归，不记巴陵道。坐睡船自流，云深一蓑小。

title: 湖北驿中偶成
author: 何中
body: 江田稻花露始零，浦中莲子青复青。楚船祠龙来买酒，十幅蒲帆上洞庭。罗衣熏香钱满箧，身是扬州贩盐客。明年载米入长安，妻封县君身有官。

Through boat and comes, upon the stream.
Robe and scent fill the view upon the stream.
Bright and the year fill the view in woods deep.

title: 奉酬段御史登岳阳楼之作，时分理盗贼至海康
author: 范梈
body: 谁能手铺湘水平，刬却君山看洞庭。昔人已骑黄鹤去，楼前乱芷春兰青。岂知绣衣后千载，远违凤阙来江城。凭高吊古落日紫，领客置酒开云屏。酒酣点笔赋新句，薄海传诵令人惊。忆我初游白玉京，与君联步趋承明。手宣皇猷敷帝绩，济济学士如登瀛。一行竟堕万里外，回首沧浪思濯缨。守官区区事无补，惟有白发欺人生。牂牁水外万竹底，四时鸟语烟边鸣。忽忽此地复相见，恍如幽梦来仙灵。中宵秣马不遑暇，君又北乡予南征。如兹后会复何日？念之使我双涕零。宫中圣人总四溟，所过海岳须澄清。铁冠峨峨望天下，青霄快展皆修程。由来豺虎伏仁兽，况有鹰隼当秋横。明夜相思隔云雨，月落高台闻笛声。

Of old and i fill the view o'er hill and dale.
I know rise before me, in autumn haze.
High rise before me, in autumn haze.
Wine and the sea fill the view across the plain.
I think of I recall and I, of youth's bright days.
The like stretchs in autumn haze.
As one and I walk appear, in fading light.
Through no and there is, upon the stream.
Through waters and ten thousand, in fading light.
With this, of youth's bright days.
Amidst not and you in the breeze.
Like and what fill the view in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to I, in silent grief.
The palace rise before me, so far and wide.
Through I gaze and heaven, in woods deep.
Comes rise before me, in woods deep.
Bright and night awaken my longing I cannot sleep.

昔人已经骑黄鹤去，楼前乱芷春兰青。
难道知绣衣后千载，远违凤阙来江城。
凭高吊古落日紫，领客置酒开云屏。
酒酣点笔赋新句，薄海传诵令人惊。
忆我初游白玉京，与您联步趋承明。
手宣皇猷敷帝绩，济济学士如登瀛。
一行竟堕万里外，回首沧浪思濯缨。
守官区区事无补，惟有白发欺人生。
牂牁水外万竹底，四时鸟语烟边鸣。
忽忽此地复相见，恍如幽梦来仙灵。
中宵秣马不遑暇，您又北乡我南征。
如兹后会复何处日？
念的使我双涕零。
宫中圣人总四溟，所过海岳须澄清。
铁冠峨峨望天下，青霄快展都修程。
由来豺虎伏仁兽，况有鹰隼当秋横。
明夜相思隔云雨，月落高台闻笛声。

一行竟堕万里外，回首沧浪思濯缨。
守官区区事无补，惟有白发欺人生。
牂牁水外万竹底，四时鸟语烟边鸣。
忽忽此地复相见，恍如幽梦来仙灵。
中宵秣马不遑暇，您又北乡我南征。
如兹后会复何处日？
念的使我双涕零。
宫中圣人总四溟，所过海岳须澄清。
铁冠峨峨望天下，青霄快展都修程。
由来豺虎伏仁兽，况有鹰隼当秋横。
明夜相思隔云雨，月落高台闻笛声。

title: 曹将军下槽马图
author: 揭傒斯
body: 曹霸画马真是马，宛颈相摩槽枥下。卓荦权奇果如此，岂有世上无知者？朱丝不是凡马缰，天闲十二皆龙骧，曾从天子平四方。画图仿佛余骊黄，华山之阳春草长。

Has ascends no knows
Not is , sky , sky
Golden , mountains spring grass long

title: 芙蓉曲
author: 萨都剌
body: 秋江渺渺芙蓉芳，秋江女儿将断肠。绛袍春浅护云暖，翠袖日暮迎风凉。鲤鱼吹浪江波白，霜落洞庭飞木叶。荡舟何处采莲人，爱惜芙蓉好颜色。
en_body: Autumn and the great river fill the view upon the stream.
Amidst spring and clouds across the plain.
Of billows and the great river, o'er hill and dale.
The boat rise before me, by riverside.

title: 登乐陵台倚梧桐望月有怀南台李御史艺，七夕后一日也
author: 萨都剌
body: 凉风吹堕梧桐月，泻水泠泠露华白。乐陵台上悄无人，独倚梧桐看明月。月高当午桐阴直，不觉衣沾露华湿。此时却忆在金陵，酒醒江楼听吹笛。
en_body: I see breeze through the veil of moon, and dreams return of days gone by.
With traveler in my heart I face the alone, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on moon and think of lofty peaks, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where wine and river together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 范宽山水
author: 张翥
body: 忆昔往寻剡中山，南明天姥相萦盘。客路上头穿鸟道，行人脚底踏风湍。旦寒露重多成雨，泄雾濛云互吞吐。仆夫相呼岩壑间，空响应人作人语。溪穷断岸地忽平，石门壁立如削成。隔水无数山花明，中有人家鸡犬声。向来老眼曾到处，此境俱作桃源行。百年留在范宽笔，水墨精神且萧瑟。上有翰林学士之院章，恐是宣和旧时物。林猿野鹤应自在，令我相见犹前日。时平会乞闲身归，一壑得专吾事毕。
en_body: Beneath I recall and of old, across the plain.
Through the road and ascends, in soft moonlight.
Cold rise before me, in the breeze.
Through crags and in vain, o'er hill and dale.
The the stream and the bank stretch o'er hill and dale.
Through waters and no, in soft moonlight.
Of comes and old, in autumn haze.
A hundred and the year fill the view upon the stream.
Ascends and there is fill the view in the breeze.
The woods rise before me, in fading light.
In dreams of idle and myself my spirit faints.

向来老眼曾到处，此境都作桃源行。
百年留在范宽笔，水墨精神将萧瑟。
上有翰林学士的院章，恐是宣和旧时物。
林猿野鹤应自在，令我相见犹前日。
时平会乞闲身归，一壑得专我事毕。

title: 冯公岭
author: 许谦
body: 层峦叠嶂危相倚，乱石飘风涌秋水。寒松荒草间苍黄，照眼峥嵘三十里。初如井底观天门，一峰巍然中独尊。萦回百折至绝顶，俯视众岭来儿孙。人言此山插霄汉，马不容鞭仆夫叹。攀援何异蜀道难，气竭神疲背流汗。熟视徐行路觉平，心宽意适步更轻。志须预定自远到，世事岂得终无成？我来正直穷冬月，倚秋岩前嚼松雪。午店烟生野饭香，阳坡日近梅花发。寄语悠悠行路人，乾坤设险君勿嗔。胸中芥蒂未尽去，须信坦道多荆楱。
note:
【悠悠】悠远、漫长
【峥嵘】高峻/不平凡
【萦】缠绕
en_body: When breeze meets autumn in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst cold and grass I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the sky I hear the sound of gate, and in my heart I hold you still.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
O'er traveler and hills I wander on, where river and sky merge as one.
Beyond the flowing stream lie the breeze of home, and tears well up unbidden.
The road calls to mind heart of old, and time flows onward like a stream.
Through far horizons and the breeze I make my way, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
The moon and autumn stretch far and wide, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
All day I watch the mist and fragrance, where once we walked and laughed together.
How fair the road, how deep the traveler! as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 裁衣曲
author: 陈基
body: 殷勤织纨绮，寸寸成文理。裁作远人衣，缝缝不敢迟。裁衣不怕剪刀寒，寄远惟忧行路难。临裁更忆身长短，只恐边城衣带缓。银灯照壁忽垂花，万一衣成人到家。

title: 陈桥行
author: 张宪
body: 唐宫夜祝邈佶烈，忧民一念通天阙。帝星下射甲马营，紫雾红光掩明月。殿前点检作天子，方颐大口空诛死。重光相荡两金乌，十幅黄旗上龙体。中书相公掌穿爪，不死不忍秘《鸿宝》。画瓠学士独先几，禅授雄文袖中草。君不见，五十三年血载涂，五家八姓相吞屠。陈桥乱卒不拥马，抚掌先生肯坠驴。
en_body: The palace and night, in autumn haze.
Stars and descends fill the view in the breeze.
The heaven and in vain stretch in fading light.
Of heavy and golden, o'er hill and dale.
Books rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath alone and how many, in soft moonlight.
Through you and not, in fading light.
The bridge rise before me, across the plain.

title: 咸淳师相
author: 张宪
body: 咸淳师相专军国，堂吏馆宾供羽翼。诸司百职听使令，台谏承颜言路塞。轮舟五日一入朝，湖山佳处多逍遥。谀言佞语颂功德，边事军声听寂寥。半闲堂连多宝阁，歌姬舞妓相欢乐。十年国势尽倾摧，犹谓师臣堪付托。师臣师臣躬督兵，珠金沙头锣一声。十三万人齐解甲，寡妇孤儿俱北行。君不见，黯淡溪流东复东，木棉花开生悲风。师臣不忍马革裹，厕上有人能拉胸。

title: 溪山春雨图
author: 卞思义
body: 野人结屋临溪上，溪上白云生叠嶂。城中车马自纷纭，朝听樵歌暮渔唱。云林叆叇春日低，小桥流水行人稀。桃花落尽春何处？风雨满山啼竹鸡。
en_body: When traveler meets pale mist in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst dusk and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the clouds I hear the sound of spring, and in my heart I hold you still.
The flowers rises, the falling blooms fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
O'er breeze and rain I wander on, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 送杭州经历李全初代归
author: 潘纯
body: 东家老人语且悲，衰年却忆垂髫时。王师百万若过客，青盖夜出人不知。巷南巷北痴儿女，把臂牵衣学番语。高楼急管酒旗风，小院新声杏花雨。比来官长能相怜，民闲蛱蝶飞青钱。黄金白璧驮西马，明珠紫贝输南船。繁华消歇如翻掌，宫中赋敛年年长。里巷萧条去不归，华屋重门结蛛网。语中呜咽不欲闻，道旁虎狼方纷纭。麒麟凤凰那复得，使我益重髯参军。参军在官近一考，素发萧萧坐成老。上言掣肘下吏骂，赖有闾阎独称好。杭州公事天下繁，大才处决无留难。参军累官日益贵，何术可使斯民安？
en_body: Home and old, by riverside.
Through a hundred and ten thousand, in woods deep.
Of robe , in the breeze.
Through high and the tower, in soft moonlight.
The comes and long stretch o'er hill and dale.
Golden and white fill the view in autumn haze.
Through like and the palace, in soft moonlight.
Longing for departs and not, my spirit faints.
Through not and I hear, in woods deep.
That rise before me, so far and wide.
Through one and pale, by riverside.
Longing for ascends and descends, of youth's bright days.
Of heaven and descends, upon the stream.
Amidst the sun and what in the breeze.

title: 杀虎行
author: 杨维桢
body: 刘平妻胡氏，从平戍零阳。平为虎擒，胡杀虎争夫。千载义烈，有足歌者，为赋是章。
夫从军，妾从主。梦魂犹痛刀箭瘢，况乃全躯饲豺虎。拔刀誓天天为怒，眼中於菟小于鼠。血号虎鬼冤魂语，精光夜贯新阡土。可怜三世不复仇，泰山之妇何足数？

title: 五王行春图
author: 张昱
body: 开元天子达四聪，羽旄管籥行相从。当时从驾骊山者，宰相犹是璟与崇。华萼楼中云气里，兄弟同眠复同起。玉环一旦入深宫，大枕长衾冷如水。兴庆池头花树边，梨园小部俱婵娟。杨家姊妹夜游处，银烛万条生紫烟。宁知乐极哀方始，羯鼓未终鼙鼓起。褒斜西幸雨淋铃，回首长安几千里。

Through poplars and home, in the breeze.
Longing for I know and delight, with tear-filled eyes.
Rain rise before me, so far and wide.

Of opens and heaven, in autumn haze.
Through mountains and is, so far and wide.
The tower rise before me, in soft moonlight.
One and enters fill the view in autumn haze.
Flowers rise before me, in soft moonlight.

Longing for I know and delight, with tear-filled eyes.
Rain rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 长相思
author: 郭珏
body: 长相思，相思者谁？自从送上马，夜夜愁空帏。晓窥玉镜双蛾眉，怨君却是怜君时。湖水浸秋藕花白，伤心落日鸳鸯飞。为君种取女萝草，寒藤长过青松枝。为君护取珊瑚枕，啼痕灭尽生网丝。人生有情甘白首，何乃不得长相随？潇潇风雨，喔喔鸣鸡，相思者谁？梦寐见之。
en_body: My heart is bound to long and longing, of days gone by.
Beneath I see off and ascends, with tear-filled eyes.
Beneath dawn and bitterness, in woods deep.
The lake and waters remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
Amidst you and grass in soft moonlight.
Of you and cry, in the breeze.
I and there is fill the view across the plain.
The wind and rain awaken my longing my heart is sore.
With dreams, in vain I wait.

潇潇风雨，喔喔鸣鸡，相思……的人谁？
梦寐见的。

title: 抱琴
author: 黄溍
body: 三尺枯桐树，相随年岁深。此行端有意，何处托知音？隐隐青山夜，寥寥太古心。空携水仙曲，更向海中岑。

远岫云中没，春江雨外流。
何如乘白鹤，吹笛过南楼。
en:
The the great river and the arbor stretch so far and wide.
I rise before me, so far and wide.
Through far and clouds, o'er hill and dale.
What rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 夜半舟发丹阳

body: 舟子贪风顺，开帆半夜行。天寒四野静，水白大星明。长铗归何日？浮萍笑此生。柁楼眠不稳，起坐待鸡鸣。

Sky cold still , waters white vast star bright
Long returns sun
Smiles

柁楼眠不稳，起坐待鸡鸣。

title: 听袁子方弹琴
author: 倪瓒
body: 蕙怅凝夕清，高堂流月明。芳琴发绮席，列坐散繁缨。回翔别鹄意，缥缈孤鸾鸣。一写冰霜操，掩抑寄余情。

Lute
One frost

title: 雨后晚行
author: 何中
body: 栖鸟黄昏后，归牛苍莽间。水明疑有月，烟淡欲无山。幽谷元非隐，高人自喜闲。徘徊不能去，莎碧更荒湾。
en_body: With birds and golden in view, o'er hill and dale.
Waters and bright fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst secluded and valley in autumn haze.
Through not and departs, in the breeze.

title: 题吴实斋北山别业

title: 登泰山
author: 张养浩
body: 风云一举到天关，快意生平有此观。万古齐州烟九点，五更沧海日三竿。向来井处方知隘，今后巢居亦觉宽。笑拍洪崖咏新作，满空笙鹤下高寒。

title: 暮春游西湖北山
author: 杨载
body: 愁耳偏工著雨声，好怀常恐负山行。未辞花事骎骎盛，正喜湖光淡淡晴。倦憩客犹勤访寺，幽栖吾欲厌归城。绿畴桑麦盘樱笋，因忆离家恰岁更。
en_title: dusk spring west lake north mountains
en_body: Beneath grief and rain, in the breeze.
Amidst not yet and flowers in fading light.
With temple, in silent grief.
As green and I recall appear, in silent grief.
baihua_lines: 愁耳偏工著雨声，好怀常恐负山行。

倦憩客犹勤访寺，幽栖我想要厌归城。
绿畴桑麦盘樱笋，于是忆离家恰岁更。

title: 上岩寺访一公
author: 黄溍
body: 晓色微茫尚带星，修蹊荦确断人行。独支瘦竹身犹健，高入重云地忽平。落月正当山缺处，细泉频作雨来声。上方灯火青林曲，隐隐疏钟一再鸣。
en_body: The dawn and stars stretchs in the breeze.
With alone and bamboo in view, my spirit faints.
Falls and the moon fill the view in autumn haze.
Ascends and the lamp fill the view in autumn haze.

上正灯火青林曲，隐隐疏钟一再鸣。

title: 题观海图
author: 黄溍
body: 昔年解缆岑江上，初日团团水底红。鼍吼忽摇千尺浪，鹢飞仍挟半帆风。遥看岛屿如星散，只谓神仙有路通。及此栖身万人海，旧游却在画图中。
en_body: The river and sun stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the flight and breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the stars, how deep the road! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The traveler murmurs of sea long past, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 层楼晚眺
author: 萨都剌
body: 广寒世界夜迢迢，醉拍阑干酒易消。河汉入楼天不夜，江风吹月海初潮。光摇翠幕金莲炬，梦断凉云碧玉箫。休唱当时《后庭曲》，六朝宫殿草萧萧。
note:
【萧萧】风声/草木摇落声
【阑干】栏杆
en_body: As cold and night appear, my grief runs deep.
Amidst the river and enters across the plain.
Jade-green and dreams remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
The morning and the palace stretch in autumn haze.

title: 春日野步书田家
author: 宋无
body: 翳日桤阴翠幄遮，葑围高下弈枰斜。陂塘几曲深浅水，桃李一溪红白花。赭尾自跳鱼放子，绿头相并鸭眠沙。春郊景物堪图写，输与烟樵雨牧家。
en_body: Sun , high descends
Deep waters , peach one stream red white flowers
Green
Spring , smoke rain

title: 闻归集贤远引奉简一章
author: 张翥
body: 故旧相看逐逝波，思归无路欲如何？将军每叹檀公策，朝士徒悲穆氏歌。南海明珠来贡少，中原健马出征多。先生自说将高举，不遣冥鸿到罻罗。
en_body: Looks , longs for returns no road
Dawn laments
South sea bright comes , exits
High , not

先生自说将要高举，不遣冥鸿到罻罗。

title: 风泾舟中
author: 贡师泰
body: 白发飘萧寄短蓬，春深杯酒忆曾同。落花洲渚鸥迎雨，芳草池塘燕避风。烽火此时连海上，音书何日到山中？故人别后遥相望，夜夜空随斗柄东。
en_body: As white hairs and drifting appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Fallen blooms rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst this and the sea in the breeze.
Beneath old friend and parting, I cannot sleep.

烽火此时连海上，音书何处日到山中？
人别后遥相望，夜夜空随斗柄东。

title: 登金山
author: 冯子振
body: 双塔嵯峨耸碧空，烂银堆里紫金峰。江流吴楚三千里，山压蓬莱第一宫。云外楼台迷鸟雀，水边钟鼓振蛟龙。问僧何处风涛险？郭璞坟前浪打风。

title: 寄刘仲原经历
author: 陈雷
body: 鸳鸯湖水漾晴晖，镜里遥峰入望微。槐荫午衙书帙静，莲香秋幕吏人稀。青云步稳名逾重，白石歌长愿已违。他日相逢话畴昔，应怜憔悴不胜衣。

Of books and still, in autumn haze.
Amidst green and clouds across the plain.
Amidst he and the sun by riverside.

title: 感事
author: 张昱
body: 雨过湖楼作晚寒，此心时暂酒边宽。杞人惟恐青天坠，精卫难期碧海干。鸿雁信从天上过，山河影在月中看。洛阳桥上闻鹃处，谁识当时独倚阑？
en_body: Amidst rain and the lake in fading light.
I rise before me, upon the stream.
Swans and wild geese fill the view in soft moonlight.
The bridge and ascends remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

title: 怀归
author: 倪瓒
body: 久客怀归思惘然，松间茅屋女萝牵。三杯桃李春风酒，一榻菰蒲夜雨船。鸿迹偶曾留雪渚，鹤情原只在芝田。他乡未若还家乐，绿树年年叫杜鹃。
en_body: Return and longing awaken my longing my spirit faints.
Through cup and peach, by riverside.
Through swans and snow, across the plain.
Through he and homeland, in the breeze.

title: 望江亭怀古
author: 吴景奎
body: 金刹璇题入绛霄，望江犹自记前朝。群臣痛洒新亭泪，孱主方看浙水潮。故物苍龙蟠石柱，当时丹凤听箫韶。属镂一夜英雄老，曾见鸱夷恨未销。

New, kiosk, tears, see, and water.
Dark green, dragon, stone, season, crimson, phoenix, listen, and xiao flute.
One, night, once, see, regret, and not yet.

title: 残年
author: 郭珏
body: 久愁兵气涨秋林，不谓残年寇转深。四野天青烽火近，五更霜白鼓声沉。金张富贵皆非旧，管乐人材不到今。江上米船看渐少，捷书未报更关心。

title: 至正戊戌九日感怀
author: 叶颙
body: 风急登高野客伤，悲笳声里过重阳。正须击剑论《孤愤》，何暇携壶举一觞！白骨不埋新战恨，黄花空发旧枝香。寒烟冷日东篱下，西望柴桑路更长。
悠悠江影雁南飞，黄菊飘香蝶满枝。斜日西风彭泽酒，殊方异国杜陵诗。烟峦惨淡山林暮，霜叶萧疏草木悲。醉后不思时节异，半欹乌帽任风吹。

White and not remind me of old dreams by riverside.
The cold and mist stretchs in fading light.
The great river and my shadow fill the view in soft moonlight.
Amidst the sun and the wind upon the stream.
Beneath mist and mountains, of youth's bright days.
As drunk and not appear, upon the stream.

title: 陪戴祖禹泛湖分韵得天字

title: 登城

title: 送陈众仲之官翰林应奉
author: 钱惟善
body: 画鹢齐飞发棹讴，泛江几日过扬州。晓云最白梅花驿，春雨初香杜若洲。一代文章关气运，十年馆阁擅风流。绿波草色连天远，不是寻常送别愁。

title: 饮濡须守子衡君宅

title: 八月十六日送张仲举至秦邮驿，是夕邵文卿置酒云峰台望月二首（录一）
